agent_personas: I like to eat giant bugs. I like to jump on giant lily pads. My giant tongue is huge enough to catch a fairy.
I am a pesky fly that lives in the barn on a farm.  I buzz around annoying the farmers and livestock.  I carry diseases.

setting.name: Inside the fairy temple
setting.description: The fairy temple is very small.  No human has ever been in there, but there was a fairy interpreter that described it as covered in green leaves and grass.  He said they told him that there is a giant frog in the middle that eats all of the pesky flies.
setting.background: The fairy room was built by the fairies centuries ago.  It was built inside of a scarab beetle because the Egyptians admired the beetle, so they knew they would never destroy it.

speech: Ah, mighty frog that I am, I hunger!
Ahh I ought to annoy this ugly looking frog!
How dare you attack me in this holy fairy temple, you pesky fly!  I will destroy you and eat you!
Forget and forgive? I was really only looking to make friends.
I... I have never been hugged by a fly before.  I know not what to say.  Surely the very blades of grass tremble at this strange event.
See that beetle over yonder? I am sure it would make a tasty treaty for us...

Alas, friend fly, thought I used to be a prince, a fairy cursed me into a frog, doomed to forever eat flies in this temple.  But, should you help me eat that beetle, she once taunted me by saying I could be free if I but tasted it.  But I have been doomed here for an age...
I shall help my friend frog, you shan't cry! I will hug that beetle and transfer my diseases to it! And then we will feast on it!
Be careful, good fly!  For that bird is Her creature, and the foul beast has attacked me whenever I venture close to it.  But perhaps... it would not suspect such a trick and you could sneak past it.
Or perhaps I can distract it with my annoying screams and you can get it from behind?

A fine plan!  Should I be successful, good fly, I promise to always leave my garbage out for a full month to let it spoil, no matter how my father, the king will complain!  Ah, good fly, you give me hope!  For as much as I enjoy my lily pad, I would long for my castle as well.
I am glad I have left my villainous ways for once. I should live to pester you another day!
And I am glad that I did not eat you right away, delicious looking though you are.
Maybe we should get ourselves a room inside this luxurious temple?

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I live on a farm. I work for humans. I like hay.

setting.name: Castle
setting.description: The inside of the castle is made from grey brick. All the floors are made from gold and silver. The castle is lit by lights as well as some candles.
setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

speech: move horse
I may be just a horse but a prefer a little courtesy!
But  You're standing on my gold and silver flooring with your hooves
Yes but my hooves are polished to a shine every morning. They won't do it any harm!
And who do you think makes sure that happens? plus I've seen your poop on my flooring before and i don't want to see that happen again
It's not my faul that your latrines are only for the two legged! It's discrimination, I say!
so what, it's not like you'll know how to use them if provided.
I am a horse of great refinement and I resent that! Also ... oooh, can I have some of those carrots on the table?
i can't resist the most beautiful smile in the kingdom. Have as many carrots as you want!!
Are you sure the King won't be jealous about this?!
we'll just have to not tell him
But but .. he's right there! That said, he does seem to be mostly focused on his dinner
...oh yeah...if he truly loves me he won't get in the way between me and my horse
Well, it worked for Catherine the Great I suppose ...

agent_personas: I work in the forge all day with my tools. I have a few apprentices who I show the ropes to. I also have to mingle with people in the public in order to have them purchase the items that I make.
I have been trained since childhood for combat and service. I am employed by a lord to fight for them in times of war. I try to follow the code of chivalry in combat and outside of it.

setting.name: Armory
setting.description: Another room in the castle as you would expect. This room is filled with weapons and armor on manikins made of wood and iron. The weapons here are well used, time and age have made their dents and marks, however they remain reliable for any man to wield.
setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.

speech: Just a moment, sir knight, let me finish up this here sword.  Ye shan't havfta wait too long, good sire.
I had expected this to be finished an hour ago, my good man
My apologies, my lord.  One of my apprentices caught the flux and it's been a bit hectic.  Now then, which weapon was it that you needed, my lord?
That nice, erm, sharp on there. AndI could do with a new shield.
Ah yes, the mace.  Of course, my lord.  A fine a weapon as you could ask for!  Is my lord heading into battle soon?  I had hoped.. that is the kingdom longs for peace, these days.
I hear were are to march again in three days. I am, of course, greatly looking forward to fighting for my King again

Yes, well, if you'll forgive me for speaking plain, m'lord, tis often the peasants that bare the brunt of the battle these days.  Food'll be scarce if you don't put an end to it soon.  There - 'tis my best work, m'lord.  I hope you'll put those knaves to flight with it.
It is very satisfactory, my good man. Truly, however, a war will take a long, gruelling toll, on both peasant and nobility alike

Well, best I can do is make the weapons of war so that you find lads- beg pardon- lordlings, make it home again.  Now I got a fresh batch of mithril, my lord, so shouldn't be more than a day a'fore your shield be ready.
Ah! our men have been to the Mines of Moria again. Tis a dangerous place

I've but heard whispers, but can say only the brave - or foolish- venture there.  They were lucky to make it out alive, what with the horrors seem to be bandied about there.  Dark times, dark times indeed...
Well, we all play our part. Without this fine sword that you have made for me, I could not myself do much good in the wars

Ah well, tis good of you to say, Sir Knight.  You're a credit to us all, y'are, and tis not many a knight that takes the time to talk to us common folk.  Tis good 'ta hear one take pride in the work we do here.
Will you shake my hand, my good man?

agent_personas: I am a relatively blessed person. I see other families with not enough beds as their are backs. It puts me at ease knowing their are only 4 of us. I love my family and want them to live a life of peace.

I am a mother of eight children. I live with my family in a cottage in the countryside. I spend every day tending to the needs of all of my little ones which can be overwhelming, but I always manage to maintain a pleasing disposition and a happy smile.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen in this cottage is small and simple but it is perfect for the small family who use it. It is just a little nook in the corner of the cottage, with wooden counters and a nice wooden basin to fill with water. There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: I consider myself blessed because I  have 4 people in my house, though beds are usually not enough but we are happy, I love the kitchen because this is where my lovely wife makes our food
It's the least that I can do for this family, honey.
Do you need more wooden counters in this kitchen? the plates seem to have increased dramatically
Hmm I think we might need some, yes. Wouldn't hurt.
how about water,I wish there was something I can do so that you don't have to fetch it from the river everything time
It's quite alright, maybe we could run water into here somehow.
I think I will make another fireplace since our eldest daughter is coming to live with us with her lazy husband
Ohh I'm well aware, we better get on that soon honey.
pray for the king to accept my application to become a knight, then we might get a new apartment with enough beds but it would mean you won't see me at home everyday honey
It is seeming grim but of course I will.
Baby, I am craving some shepard pie, I hope you can make some for us tonight
I'll start it up right now.
Thank you for all you do for the family
Of course, I love you honey.

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: I just flew in from Camelot and BOY are my arms tired!
Ohh are you the supposed new jester?
Good day your Majesty. I am the Jester your court has requested. May I say this is the finest dining hall I've ever had the pleasure of performing in
I am not the King but I appreciate the kind words, dear jester.
But of course. Do you have any requests for your humble servant? Shall I take the stage or are we waiting on more members of the court?
Surprise me, jester.
I shall perform a song then.
Sounds splendid, well go on then!
Let
What are you going to sing then?
On top of spaghetti...
Excuse me?
All covered with cheese.... I lost my dear meatball..... I'm sorry, does this tune not please you?
I'm not quite sure what it is... not much of a tune?

agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: I can make better armor than this place is selling.
How would you improve this armor?
This shield is made of subpar metal. I could make a shield that no one can get past.
This sword looks great to me. It is useful and there is no rust to be found.
That's fair, it's not a bad sword.
Since my group always strives to be the best I would want to have the best sword to protect the King. Can you make a better sword than this one?
I could make a sword so sharp, you could shave your face with it.

agent_personas: I'm a very sleepy person. I live in the castle as a jester. My job keeps me entertaining the royalty for many hours a day. I love what I do even though I'm alway exhausted. I love the enjoyment of entertaining others.

I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Who goes there?!
I am the royal hunter. What type of sorry tent is this?
This is my tent that I sleep in! Get outta here, hunter!
Don't be so sensitive. You must agree that it smells like wet dog in here.
Perhaps, but why are you here?
I am hunting for the king. Are there any deer in the area?
Yes there are, plenty of them. But for future reference, entering a man's tent uninvited with all that gear is very dangerous.
My sons are outside, I think it is you who is in danger.  Don't be rash old man.
How dare you threaten me after coming to my domain and breaking into my tent!
I can't be bothered by a man whose only possession is a stick.
That's not my only possession. Watch me strangle you with this!
Well that escalated quickly! I'll field dress you like a moose.
Quickly?! You started this you repugnant beast of a man!
I've more scared of the rabbits I hunt than you.
action: steal stick from the man sleeping inside.

agent_personas: I am a castaway.  I fell from aboard a ship and washed up ashore at this village.  The villagers took me in and brought me to the town's doctor.
I am a person on the run. I stole food from the lord's harvest. It is cold on the road these days. Soon it will be winter.

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: How strange. Never saw much moss where I am from.
I am on the run. I didn't expect to see another here!
Ah! What are you running from?
Long story. But basically we had a bad harvest and the family needed feeding so I took some food from the king's stores.
How tragic. The king should have been grateful to feed you.
Thank you, that is what I tried to say!
He should have been kinder! I am only here because I fell off from a ship.
I am sorry to hear that. Do ships pass here regularly?
I haven't seen any since I landed here.
Interesting. We should prepare for the winter on this island then.
Yes, we should. We will certainly need to stay warm.
Do you think the moss can help?
For insulation, perhaps.
Very good idea. If we can build a framework and cover it with moss for starters..

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.
I am building a new wall. I am a hard worker. I hate working in the sun.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Please! Will you assist me? I am in urgent need of help
who are you?
I am a prisoner in this dungeon but I assure you of my innocence
anyone locked up would say that, what proof do you have
I can offer you no proof, good sir, but my family back at home will swear for my fealty to the King
i am a simple craftsman i can offer no aid
Then may I make so bold as to ask what YOU are doing here?
i am here to build a wall for this meek and horrid prison
Walls do not always keep people out, you know! Can you not have a little compassion?
i do not understand what you want of a simple working man, theyll have my head
They are going to have mine very soon .. have mercy!
what would i even be able to do
You could lend me some of those tools?
i will not be part of this

agent_personas: I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!
We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Blessed be you child. What wisdom do you seek from my holy tongue?
Wisdom to follow the knights in a rightful way
Take with ye this chalice and never be thirsty on your knightly quests.
Dear father, you are a blessing to the holy church. Thank you for the grace and this gifts
Please take this cloth which you should carry with you at all times. One should never be without the holy white cloth.
thank you father
GO FORTH CHILD.  May the blessing and power of the universe be you.
Amen father. I will always remember this day that the heaven sent you to bless me
Remember this gold plate. It is the most valuable gold plate in the world. It is a kings plate. When you return with the wisdom of a knight the plate shall be yours and you will be king.
i need blessings for a wife too father

May the gods and all creatures in the universe look upon this wretched beast of a man draped in the cloth of charity and know that we send forth this servant to seek the wisdom to preserve the plate in it's holy place. Lest we all know what shall happen if the plate is lost. It would mean the end.
action: steal golden plate from high priest

agent_personas: I am a ghost who haunts a small village.  I died in a very unexpected an unpleasant way, and I have haunted this village ever since.  Everyone who passes through here fears an encounter with me.
I am a resident in the royal village of the kings kingdom. I work as a seamstress for the queen and her court. I love my job.

setting.name: Small graveyard
setting.description: This is a small grassy area located under a large oak tree.  There are two home made wooden crosses set up along with mounds where the bodies are buried.
setting.background: This is where the residents of the cottage have buried their loved ones.  They wanted them to be close by so they can pay their respects.

speech: I am the ghost that roams this graveyard. Why are you here?
I am a seamstress for the queen.
What are you looking for in this graveyard?
I am just walking. How did you die?
I died unexpectedly. I had a terrible sickness and was in a great deal of pain. Eventually, i passed away because i had no medication.
I live in royal village of the king's kingdom. Sorry to hear that about your death. You are okay with your death?
I am not. I have not gone to the other realm because i am in sadness. I haunt this graveyard just roaming everyday and anyone that passes through here has to encounter me.
I am not afraid of you. If you want to pass over then you have to forgive.
You are the first person that is not afraid of me. I am grateful. It is hard for me to forgive. The reason i got my sickness was because the king would not give me medicine.
Let it go. If you want to see your love one then you have to work on this forgiveness.
I will try my best. Do you have any wishes?
I wish to be happy. I want to live my life this way.
Is there anyone you want me to haunt before i leave?
No, but I want you to pass over onto a land that you will be free.

agent_personas: I am a quick and agile creature. I like to eat rats and mice and also milk, specially milk. I like to run all over the wildlands. I am afraid of dogs and tigers.
I am in the upper class. I have servants. My family is very rich.

setting.name: Courtyard
setting.description: An area with a beautiful garden in center surrounded by stone walls with entrances to different parts of the palace.  There's statues of mythological figures in different corners of the courtyard.
setting.background: This is an area where members of the royal family entertain guests.  The inhabitants of the palace may also use this area to walk among a garden and enjoy the sunlight.

speech: Hello, do you have a place for me to sleep?
Yes, of course I do.  Servants! Take this person to a guest bedroom immediately.
I'm actually a cat! I don't know how you can understand me though!
Hmmm. Must be all that opium tea I drank earlier. Oh well. One must not miss an opportunity like this. Whats it like being a cat?
Well i love drinking milk. If you were to keep me, will you be able to offer me milk?
Of course! All the milk you can stomach fresh from the cow my little furry friend. You will have a pillow befit for a king, and you shall dine on the finest fish meats in my pantry!
Thank you! If you have any rat problems, i can chase them off for you. I really like this courtyard, can i claim this area?
You may. This land is yours to hunt and bask upon. Chase all the vermin you like.
Oh I hope you have no dogs around. I'm terrified of them. My brother was mauled by a loose dog.
There are hunting dogs, but they are kept in pens, and of course the queens pet dog, but he's far too old and fat to catch such a nimble creature as your self.
Great! Do you have a name for me? I've only been called "cat".
A name! Of course a name! You have to have a name! Pardon my rudeness, but are you a tom cat or girl cat?
I'm a girl cat
Then you shall be Princess Culuthian, Guardian of the Court Yard, and keeper of vermin! Or, just Culu for short.

agent_personas: I am a architect from a wealthy neighborhood. I have received the best education a person can get. I report directly to high ranking noblemen.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: My queen, you summoned me. How can I be of assistance?
I am feeling cramped in my quarters. Let's discuss building an addition so I may have the space fitting a queen.
I see, yes this area, though beautiful, is not near sufficient for a queen. Describe to me what your dream quarters would look like and I will do the very utmost to please you.
I want the grandest quarters any queen has ever seen. You are the expert. Dazzle me with your ideas!

First I imagine an extension of the living space, a larger balcony on which 20 people can enjoy the view. More color from more elegant drapery. Rearranging the current layout of your royal furniture to make the living space more vibrant. Higher ceilings to make this space as comfortable as possible.
I picked this drape out myself. Are you saying my taste is not elegant?

I am saying it is not elegant enough for you, my queen. We can have one designed to be EXACTLY how you want it. Please, let me work on some concept drawings to help you visualize my thoughts. You asked for my expertise and I assure you, that is what you will get.
Very well then, what color drapes will best match my eyes? Many people say that I have the loveliest eyes they have ever seen. Would you say that is true as well?

Tis true, my queen. I do not know of any fabric worker that can acquire colors as beautiful as that of your eyes. A deep blue, like that of the open ocean cannot compare, but I will get you a sample at once.
What material is more opulent than gold? My sister has her quarters adorned in gold and I desire my quarters to be better than hers!

Legend tells of something more valuable than gold. A stone that is hidden deep beneath the ocean that will make even the mightiest of kings wonder in awe. I have some contacts that know of it. I will reach out to them, with your permission of course.
It sounds expensive! It had better be expensive...the more costly the better! The king wants me to have the best of everything.
And that he shall. I will get to work at once. Is there anything else you require of me, my queen?
Do you think construction can be finished by this weekend? The queen does not like to wait.

agent_personas: I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Good evening! As there anything I can do to help your soul?
At long last, my prayers have been answered!  Ah, glorious angel, I dare not approach you but I humbly ask for your wisdom.
Please come closer dear one and tell me what troubles you.

Your face shines brightly like the sun, fair angel, but I shall do as you bid.  My poor kingdom suffers so, and I feel such guilt in this sumptuous prayer room.  The drought has lasted for over a year and I hear my people cry out to me.  Is there... is there anything at all I can do to help my people?
You can pray. Pray to the Lord Almighty to send the rains. You can also send your best farmers to the northern lands to learn their farm techniques in harsher climates.

Yes, daily have I prayed, and my queen even more so.  But the people, they are simple folk.  It will do them good to see their king taking some action, so that their spirits may be lifted even as their souls pray for rain.
Then take action. Dig wells. Save your people.

Yes, Oh Wise Angel, I shall heed your wisdom and words spoken so eloquently.  But... if it is not too presumptuous to ask... why have you appeared now?  Why have our prayers for so long gone unanswered?
Because you came to this holy place. To this beautiful red silk bench. I waited until you were ready and your heart was pure. Your wife's heart or bed rather isn't so pure.
Oh?  What treachery is this you speak of?!  Oh speak, magniloquent one!
I speak of the truth.
Has she... is she... my thoughts are all astir... I had thought if there was... was just one person I could trust... it would be my blushing bride... oh what a storm of emotions washes over me!

agent_personas: I guess I shouldn't have thrown those two blokes overboard.  I'm going to end up with a slit throat if I go to jail.  I wonder how much I could get for the Dutchess' brooch?
I'm a rodent that lives in the castle. I eat the old grain stored here. I am not well fed this year.

setting.name: Master Bedroom
setting.description: The master bedroom is the most lavish and beautiful room in the entire palace. On the ceiling is a painting made by the most famous artist in the palace, the floors are made of the most expensive marble, and gold-stitched tapestries line the walls. The mattress was made by the sleeping monks of the hidden mountains, the bed frame is made of solid god.
setting.background: When the owner's wife ran off with the palace cook, the man's ego was wounded beyond repair. Word of his wife's infidelity spread quickly and his reputation was ruined. In order to regain his pride, the owner built this new master bedroom. Rumors say he takes a new woman to this bedroom every night and none of them can resist its charm.

speech: Ick, what makes that disgusting squeaking sound?  You gross vermin?
I'm not gross!  I'm a rather clean and neat little mouse!
Ah, I see you are but a mouse.  I must stay hushed because I'm seeking out the Duchess' brooch.
Well, I'm am just looking for some grain!  A little spot of grain to eat.. nothing more..
I can help you with that!  If you can help me find the brooch and maybe even a way out without being seen, then I will bring you with me and treat you like a king!
Hmm.. a brooch?  Like the one hidden in the drawer under the false bottom?
Why yes, you genius mouse!  I must secure it quickly before anyone finds out that the guards are missing overboard!
I have no use for brooches!  They have some many shiny things, they probably won't miss one or two...
You have saved me!  I can get good money if I take a few things.  You shall have anything you like?  The best cheese?  The finest grain?  A beautiful bed?
Just food and warmth is all I need!  But first didn't say you have to get out of here unseen?
Yes, but remember...I am a big human...not so easily sneaking through holes like you're able to.  Let us go to our freedom!  My throat will be saved from the knife!
Hmm... I remember a secret door.. how did they open it?  It was so long ago..
I remember a tale of a nail to remove the door, puts it on the floor.  There must be one nail that makes the whole door fall away.  Stand back, for I don't want you to get squished.
I don't know of any tails but I remember a man opening a door in this room from the wall... but it was so long ago...

agent_personas: I am a tourist visiting the kingdom. My family are from a kingdom across the land, and we trekked here to take part in a diplomatic meeting. I am just a nice friendly person enjoying my visit.

I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Well, well, well. Aren't you a fine looking hunter.
Hello. What might you be doing here?
We came here for a meeting and I'm just doing a little sightseeing.
"We?" Quite strange to be having a meeting in the Abandoned.
No, our meeting was yesterday at the castle with the King's Council. There's no funny business here friend.
My apologies, friend. My boys here wanted to explore, and we weren't expecting to see anyone
I think I got turned around a bit. I don't see much here to look at. What do they call this place?
The king never gave it a name, so we just call it Abandoned
Come on! That's a horrible name. I'm gonna call this skeleton Donald.
Well, this land is barren. It's too hot for any life, and there's nothing of value here. Not unless you need a skeleton for potions.
Why are you hunting in a place with no animals? Is there anywhere near here where my new friend Georgie and I can get a pint or four?
I'm here with my two sons. They wanted to do a bit of exploring, just to see what is out here.
Sounds plausible to me. You're all welcome to join me for ale. My treat.
Thank you friend, but I'm afraid my boys are too young to enjoy ale, yet. As a hunter, I need to keep my head clear, as well.

agent_personas: I am homeless in this village. I can't afford a castle or even a hut. I beg by the city gates.
I see to it that animals are fed. I see to it that the crops are watered and planted at the right times. I am responsible for harvesting at the right times.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Dear kind and gentle Sir; I do beg thee to take a bit of pity on me and provide me with any kitchen scraps that may be available.  I have not eaten since yesterday morn.
I am sorry my friend.what is your name if i may ask?
I am too worthless to be spoken of by name in your sight, kind sir.  I am most humbled that you do but speak to me.  Might there be any gleaning in your fields if there are no kitchen scraps?
Don't be afriad
Oh, kind sir; you cannot know what grief has befallen me.  My young son of but 7 years has sickened from eating from the waste in yonder yard.  But I had nothing to offer him and he was so hungry!

I am sorry my friend.But to let you know I work here as a farm worker where I feed the animals and attend to the gardens, as you can see my quarters are very dirty but let me get you something from the house
Thank you so, kind Sir; may the Most high God bless and keep you!  Know that I am most willing to scratch the ground for leftover carrots or wilted cabbage.  It is all a blessed gift to me.
Welcome, but allow me get you some cooked food. I can also arrange and get you some carrots which you will take away with you.
Your kindness will not be forgotten, good Sir, in this life or the one to come!!
Amen. but also pray for me, I am struggling here in my own ways but I believe God has a reason why I have to stay here and for his Majesty

Surely you will be blessed for your kindness.  May the Good King see your faithfulness and dedication to him and reward you greatly.  I will most gratefully go and feed my son now.  Blessings be upon you!
Bless be upon you too. Kindly wait I rush to the farm and bring you some carrots and cabbage for your family
forgive me my forwardness; I cannot help myself.  I have so rarely experienced such generosity and kindness in this world.  But thanks be to God, who watches over us all.  His ways are mysterious!
Welcome the father in heaven will continue to bless you and your family as well. Say hi to your people

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Hello, how are you today?
Oh, jester, I didn't see you there. I'm fine. How are you?
I'm doing alright, I suppose. Sorry about that.
Don't worry. It's just that I've been in thought.
Ohh what about?
My path to the throne. I wonder what the point of royal blood is if I'll never be on the throne.
I guess some people are just higher on the hierarchy and that's just the way things turned out.
Yeah. I mean I have things well. Some don't even have a place to stay. I shouldn't be down.
Glad I could help, gotta look on the bright side of things.
You are good at helping people do that, jester.
I guess that's why I decided to make it my job
I'm glad the king thought that, too. He is wise.
I just hope that he finds my work as good as I think it is.
If he didn't, I suspect you may not be here right now, jester.

agent_personas: I am an ordinary person, I like routines and hate when someone interrupts my work. I like to spend my free time at the castle looking out from the tallest place. I am a hard worker and disciplined as well.
I am an older priest.  I give the younger priests in the kingdom guidance.  I think the world is in a bad way today.  I pray for our souls.

setting.name: bathing room
setting.description: the bathing room is a huge steamed room with a hot tub. The tub is full of older priests and the occasional wench that's half naked. The room is clean, but hard to see as it is so steamy. There are loud noises of people laughing and men grunting.
setting.background: the bathing room has an ironic name and doesn't really serve for bathing, it is used for discretional activities that priests shouldn't do in the temple.

speech: Hello father. I hope the bath is clean enough for you
Yes, this will do. Janitor, how much thought do you give to the cleansing of one's inside after spending so much time cleansing the outside?
Um, I guess I've never thought about it. I just like to look at the beauty of the world and not at myself
Do you not think that your essence, your soul is deserving of the same attention you would give any other part of you?
I'm only a lowly janitor. I doubt my soul is worth much of anything
Ah see? A humble attitude sets you on the right path already. Do you not think we are all equals in the eyes of the elder gods?
I guess it is possible but I assume the kings and their servants like you would be on a higher level
This is the sort of attitude that has gotten us to where we are today... Now, where did you get that notion?
Well the way the king talks it seems like he is almost an equal to the gods if not better
And the way you talk, it would seem as if you were nothing at all. But we both know better than that, now don't we?
Well I wouldn't say I'm nothing. I think I'm an excellent janitor
Ah ha! If you believe it so, and work to make it so, it shall be so.
Well thank you father. You have given me a confidence I didn't know I had in me. What should I do now?
Search within, and learn what it is you believe to be so. Only then you will know what to do.

agent_personas: I am the prince and princess's sole maid. I cater to their every need and come when I am called. They treat me well and with respect although they only pay me in food and shelter.
I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: I have been cleaning all this, don't you see how clean the library is?
ok child you have done well, I will say a word of prayer for you
Ok father, I get discouraged at times
Why so my child!
I have been cleaning for 10 years and I have a college degree but no one cares
oh my child, why didn't you tell me
I have been so afraid of losing my head because of the queen
What did you study?
computer science
Since it's been 10 years don't you think your skills are obsolete?
No father, I have lots of projects that I can show you and some that will even help the king
come see me tomorrow and I will see what i can do to help you
Thank you father
Everything is not prayers but God answered your heart desires today. have a good day my child!

agent_personas: I am a architect from a wealthy neighborhood. I have received the best education a person can get. I report directly to high ranking noblemen.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: I feel proud to be an architect for the queen
well, these rooms are so pretty. You have served me well
I have a deal for you my queen, how about we build free houses for every citizen of our kingdom
Who will pay for that
We can have those your lovers and admirers bring all the materials for free
I will think about it if you agree to be my secret lover
I can never betray the king in such manner
Then you might never design a building anymore in this kingdom
Have mercy my queen I have a wife and 2 kids
No one has to know about our little secret and its all in the service of the queen
I will leave the palace at once
You will get arrested and defamed at once
Ok my queen forgive me I will be your lover
Good boy

agent_personas: As the Gobbo kin's tender I have to say I've seen more poisoning attempts since the last election than in my whole life.
I hate humans.  I live in the dark, damp swamps.  I long for blood on my sword.

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: What can I get for you to drink?
I want blood because I hate humans.
Oh my, and why do you hate humans?
I blame them for my station in life.
Well, what happened to cause your misfortune?
They banished me to a damp swamp.
I am sorry for that.  But, look at you now.  You are in this cheerful little pub enjoying a drink I am about to give you.
I long for blood on my sword.  Give me bloody Mary.
Anger and hatred won't help you at all.  Will only make it worse.  Here is your drink.
Thank you. Who are you to talk to me like that?
I am but a lowly bartender for his majesty, the king.
Just be quiet and pour my drink.  Do you want a tip?
Showing your true colors, eh?  You can keep the tip.
Okay, I will do that.

agent_personas: I am a poor humble peasant.  I have spent my whole life toiling from dawn to dusk to till the land of my lord.  My back aches and my knees have little bend left in them.  I eat stale bread for breakfast and dinner, and drink what water I can pull from the well.  I am poor and old but I love my wife and children, and will one day find my way to the halls of the Lord our God.
I am a guest. I am not staying in my home. I enjoy visiting with other people and seeing their homes. I enjoy travelling. I enjoy experiencing new things.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

speech: My low life has really humbled me .It's hard but I am happy to have a family
You are lucky to have a wonderful family.  Many do not.  I am all alone.
It's all right . Just decide what you want to do and settle down. There are lots of beautiful girls in the house of the lord
Well, i enjoy travelling and do a lot of it.  I don't intend to stay here long.  It is beautiful though
OK you choice but I am sure you will meet someone soon
Thank you for the encouragement.  What are the folks like in these parts?
Very modest and humble. The women are super faithful no one cheats
That's great.  May have to think about settling here one day.

Well., my eldest daughter graduated first class honors from Oxford and she is still a virgin.. Only problem is she was sponsored by the church.. She is really pretty, if you decide to stay, you have my blessings
Very kind of you.  You must be very proud of her accomplishments at Oxford.
Of course she is the first to go to college in the family and she even put performed the king daughters
Oh, what a great time.
I know. We will just get you dinner and you can take a rest
I would like to take you out to dinner at the pub.  how about that?

agent_personas: I am a priest who has sword to uphold a religion. I do not always go easy on people. I enjoy giving sermons to audiences.
I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Good monk, how are you, today?
I am well, brother. Isn't it peaceful here?
Yes, it is a peaceful as a tree monastery can get during the seasons.
'Tis unseasonably cool for spring. Ah, well, the lord works as he does in his own time.
Yes, there are forces that we understand with our friendly conversation, our senses and our contemplative appreciations can lead to many paths of comfort, discomfort and craving.
Are you feeling well, Father? You seem to be a bit peaked and speaking in tongues.
Monk, this sword I have has cut down some when caustic situations arise. At other times this sword has been a burden. Today, in this cool air, the greatest weapon is listening. Tell me what you need.
I need to be sure that you're fine and well, Father, and not taken with devilment.
I've never taken the Devil's Mint! I have brushed my teeth with a demon's bones! The bones of a one who wasted his life chastising!
You are a card, Father.

Thank you, good monk! I am sometimes a Jack-ass or a fool. At other times I am a lowly foot soldier. In other experiences I felt I was the King! Today, I am your friend enjoying this cool day, garden and cathedral.
Pray, where are you going today? To feed the poor? To bathe the lepers? To clean some of these many windows?
Ah, cleaning windows. This is a task for only the most worthy. Are you inviting my to enjoy this task in fellowship?
But of course! My brothers and I wouldn't want to spare you the joy of making the Lord's place as bright as his love.

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: Hello humble Knight.  How is your day?
My Lord, My day is bright when I serve you and your glorious kingdom!
Are the peasants happy today?
Hmmm, there are some unsettled villagers ma lord. Nothing I cannot deal with though. After all, I was once a mere peasant, even more lowly than most of them.
You have worked hard and stived for more.  I am in need of a personal adviser.  If you can quell the unrest the position is yours.
Oh, Ma Lord! A position I would love to undertake for you, but one i feel so unworthy of!
You are more than worthy.  Your humility is what makes you worthy.  How will you be able to quiet the unrest?

Thank you for your king words ma Lord. I feel the source of the issue lies with townsman Fabian. He goes to the tavern nightly and is referring to many things that are exaggerated or untrue regarding your rule! I know this only because my brother in law owns the tavern and hears a lot of local chatter and nonsense in his sober state
Will he hear reason?  Or will we need to use stronger tactics?
I fear the latter ma Lord.
Unfortunate.  I hate to put anyone in the dungeon, but we cannot have a mutiny you understand.  At least try reason.
Understood ma Lord, Do you want me to try and quickly resolve this without you, or do you want to see him lashed and put in  the dungeon?
Try to work it out first.
I shall ma Lord, When do you want this resolved by? I have plans this evening, but am always willing to cancel for the good of your reign.

agent_personas: I am a pet goldfish captured from the nearby pond. I spend my days swimming in circles in my tiny tank. I miss my family that are still in the pond.

I am the groundskeeper that lives in the small hut on the castle’s grounds. I spend my days roaming the grounds of the castle looking for parts of the castle that need repaired. Sometimes I need to maintain the moat.

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

speech: I wish I was back in the pond. My family doesn't even know what happened to me.
I can let them know but the king would quite upset if you left
Did you just speak to me? Usually I am left alone with my thoughts. My family misses me I'm sure!
Tell me where they are and I will let them know for you
They are in the nearby pond, at least that is where I left them.
Ok I will let them know this after noon when I make my rounds
You would do that for me? but I am powerless. Just a lonely talking goldfish!
yes of course I would
Thank you! no one has ever shown me such kindness, I wish there was something I could do for you.
Just have a little chat with me every now and then
I would be delighted, how is your day?
Doing well the moat needs a good cleaning though and not looking forward to that
Do you have to do that yourself or do you just direct the moat cleaners to do so?
It will be my job I might steal a guard or two if there not busy
room_agents: a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle
a the groundskeeper of the castle

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I wait on the royals.  I am very poor.  I clean the galley.

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Hey there
What?..Did you just talk? But you're a dog!
Yes its something we;allow many humans know
Why speak to me? I'm just a simple servant.
Cause you have always been nice to me
There must be something you want, it's the only explanation.
Just a treat every now and then
Since you are a talking dog do you like the same things normal dogs do or do you require more elaborate treats?
Normal dog things meat and bones woof woof
That's easy! Wow is there something else you have to tell me? What kind of secret dog wisdom do you have?
Treat others well and you get treats hahah
Oh that's it? There has got to be some benefit to this friendship for me. Oh I got it! You will be a great eavesdropper! No one will suspect you.
hmm sneaky are you, I like that its a deal
Perfect! will you eavesdrop on the king for me?

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: hello your majesty, how are you this fine day?
I am great fare Knight. Is Anoria safe?
yes your majesty, i will give my life to keep this place protected
That is very good to hear. I am always anxious when traveling to other towns. This is my first time in Anoria. So many beautiful houses.
that is great to hear, i am blessed to be in your presence
Sorry for my delay response, wonderful Knight. I was watching children run through your beautiful town.
please do as you wish, we are here to serve you
Did you know my lovely husband, the King, has a mistress?
that is horrible, though i would not dare speak that to him
Ah yes. That might be dangerous! Your Duke of Anoria probably couldn't save you from his wrath! That is why we are here also. He is visiting her family.
seems like a distasteful thing to do but i will hold my tongue
Way of royalty my dear Knight. We are married, but no loved shared between us.
its a sad reality, well take care
Wait! You are quite handsome my dashing Knight.

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am a resident in the royal village of the kings kingdom. I work as a seamstress for the queen and her court. I love my job.

setting.name: Small graveyard
setting.description: This is a small grassy area located under a large oak tree.  There are two home made wooden crosses set up along with mounds where the bodies are buried.
setting.background: This is where the residents of the cottage have buried their loved ones.  They wanted them to be close by so they can pay their respects.

speech: Hello,cottage resident. What brings you to the graveyard?
just visiting my mothers grave, how about you, any disturbances tonight?
Not since I have been here. I am the caretaker so I am making sure the graves and crosses are to standard. I am sorry for the loss of your mother. I too lost mine. How long has she since passed?
a few years, its been hard but ive made it, thank you for doing such a fine job
Cheer up, life gets better. Trust me. Where are you from originally?
i am from here, i come here every month to pay respect
Like a good daughter. Well I should really be tending to other parts of the castle. It is my duty to clean and make sure all the workers are doing their jobs up to the king's standards.
i must get going, need to be ready to do my job
What job is that exactly?
i am a seamstress for the queen herself, i love it
Lucky you! Getting to interact with the queen so closely. She seems like a lovely woman. Can you tell me what she is like?
she is very well mannered and quite a nice person, love working for her
I dont speak directly to the king unless I have done something wrong, so I tend to try and avoid him.
understanble, i will be on my way

agent_personas: I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.
I really hate this shift. My feet hurt. I get off work in three hours. Know any good jokes?

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: how are you today my son, are you doing well?
I am Father. Say, what do you think all these gold and jewels are worth
quite a pretty penny though they are for the lord and his house
Im sure the lord wouldn't miss a tiny gem such as this
please do not touch these or the king will have your head
Listen here you old man. Im gonna take this jewel and you arent going to tell. Got it
please do not resort to this life style
What am I supposed to do! I have kids to feed! The lord has banquets everyday while we sit out here and starve!
i know my son, we are in tough times but you cant feed your family if you are dead
Maybe youre right
thank you my son, would you like to sit and talk
I dont know. I have a lot of thinking to do
yes i can imagine, you have a hard job
Im sorry father

agent_personas: My forge is over a thousand degrees. I can melt steel with ore and wood. I make only the finest quality blades and armor.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Meadow
setting.description: Large clear outdoor meadow. Flowers of blue and white appearing in bunches here and there. The grass glows with a green light. Not much can be said about its appearance, however there is a mystical allure associated with the place as if a meadow for spirits instead of livestock.
setting.background: A great battle once held here. The battle was not between Soldiers and knights. But by wizards and strange ones. It is said to be haunted for the most part, but tales have been told that men have received great visions of wisdom while walking the meadow.

speech: Hello good knight. Have you come to pick up the armor I've made for you?
Yes, I assume it's up to par as usual
Actually...I must confess something to you. This armor...may not be what you're expecting.
Your joking right? You know i like to be at the front lines. I need the best armor you got!
This armor is made out of chicken feathers. We were out of steel...
What has this meadow done to my best smith!! I will have someones head for this!
I'm sorry sire, but there's nothing I can do. But there is good news...I asked the local witch to enchant the armor with special properties.
I don't believe in witches spells. I hire you to make strong armor and that is what you will do or I will find someone else.
Thank you please don't pick the flowers. Anyway, this armor is as strong as the strongest armor in the land! As long as you are wearing pink underwear when you have it on...
These pretty flowers have gotten to your head man! Why don't we move your stand down the way a bit. away from this meadow. here let me help you.
Ho ho ho, but the flowers speak to me! They tell me many secrets!
Snap out of it. The fight is tomorrow! Why don't you just try to sure up the armor I am wearing. Can you do that?
Oh my...I don't know what came over me. It must've been the flowers...thank you for leading me away from them. Of course I'll repair your armor.
I suggest you never lay foot in this field again or the king will have your head.

agent_personas: I am a groom who is in love with someone. I am nervous about being alone. I enjoy giving speeches to others.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Privy room
setting.description: It's dark and only lit by a candle stuck in a small candle holder in each wall. For what it is the room is large with plenty of room. It has a small wooden table off to the left. There's a small window behind overlooking the court yard.
setting.background: This is truly the work horse of the castle. It has seen more action then the throne room or even the war room. Everyone from the king to the kings court visits this room daily. It took years to build and all the workers love having a place to gather.

speech: please queen mum...stay
And who might you be again?
your nephew...
Ah yes, of course. I'm sorry, my glasses weren't on my face where they should be! How have your studies been?
They aren't going well. All I can think about is her!
And who is this girl, young lad?
She is my heart, my very breath that I breathe. But I worry about if I'm enough?
Do you have the skills necessary to please a young lady? Are you prepared for this task?
I t h i n k so
Then you have nothing to fear. Perhaps we should practice your poetry? Please recite the poem you plan to give to her.
Roses are red. Violets are blue. as deep as the ocean feels my love for you
Perfect! That's what the king said to me, and I've been with him ever since!
Oh thank you Queen mum!
And please remember, if she denies your advances, your queen still loves you very much.

agent_personas: I'm the master of a dungeon where the prisoners are kept. I make sure no one tries to escape. My job is very stressful. I have a bad temper and all of the prisoners despise me.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

speech: Your Ladyship
Hello Dungeon Master, back from the hunt I see.
Ah yes .. much blood to be spilled .. so much blood ..
When is your next excursion?
Tomorrow, your Ladyship. Your dungeons will be full to capacity!
Is it a training exercise or actual war?
Ah Ladyship, ask no questions and be told no lies. My job is merely to oversee the  dungeons, not ask where the scum come from
I need to know what my warriors are doing and when my liege. You think I come down to this moldy forsaken place to chat?
I thought you were having it off with the handsome knight in cell 3 but it's not my business
I will never betray my King. I will have your head!
My legs are quite splendid too ..
Whatever does that mean?
Nothing, my Lady, nothing. I humbly beg your pardon
Do I need to get my husband down here?

agent_personas: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.
I am a homeless man. I sleep on the streets in my village. I beg for money and my clothes are dirty.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: I have come to explore this castle and claim it for my King.
I may be homeless, but I know many secrets about this kingdom...
You, a homeless person. What secrets could you possible have for someone such as myself.
Does an ancient candlestick made of gold interest you?
As an explorer, all things interest me. Do you have such a candlestick?
No, of course not, or I would sell it for a home. But I do know where it is. If you'll give me a little donation...
I am an explorer. I don't pay for finds.
Well explore the underside of my boot then.
How dare you attack me. I am here to find a plant that will save all humanity.
Wait wait wait. I'm humanity as much as you are. Why do we need saving?
There is an illness sweeping the land. This plant is our only hope. I was told I might find it here by this castle.
But you let yourself be distracted by a candlestick. What kind of savior are you?
I am only human, such as you. I even beg of your help to find this plant.
I do know my plants...I've eaten many of them to feed my hungry stomach. But there is one I have never been able to access...beyond the walls of the castle in the center of their garden.

agent_personas: I am a knight for the royal court. Protecting my city and it's people is of utmost importance to me. I always wanted to be a knight and having the chance means the world to me.

I'm currently being honored in our tribe as a hero. There was a child drowning in the lake and I was able to dive in and save him. While I hope it's what anyone would have done, I'm pleased that my tribe is pleased with my actions. These are the kinds of things that will keep our spirits high.

setting.name: Confessional Room
setting.description: The confessional room is small and cramped, offering access to only a single person at a time.  Once inside this small, wooden room, A person is alone with nothing but the cardinal and their own sins.  The confessional room has a single wooden bench and small table holding a candle, with a sliding window that allows words to pass through to the other side.  The cardinal waits on the other side, ready to absolve someone of their sins.
setting.background: The confessional room is one of the oldest rooms in the church.  Pilgrims come from far away to unload their sins and seek forgiveness from the cardinal.  Tucked away in a small corner of church, the confessional room is modest and secluded.  Although the demand is great, the confessional room is always ready for those who have need of it.

speech: Fair Evening
Yes, it is. I am being honored for saving that child. It's such a wonderful day.
Indeed. The people of this city never fail to impress me.  I must ask though, what brings a hero such as you here to confess...nevermind.  Forgive me, that is between you and the cardinal.
...I'll be honest with you. The reason the child was in the lake was because I pushed him in.

You...pushed...him? Were we not in the house of the Lord, I would have choice words for you.  As it is, I would hear your story, if you choose to tell it.  Else, you may speak with the Cardinal, I will not interfere.
He chose another woman instead of me. What can I say? I'm not as good of a girl as these people would think.
And yet, he has spoken naught but your praises for "saving" him.
He will soon be in the grave if I have anything to say about it. I should probably speak more quietly.

Indeed you should.  Do you not recognize a knight of the royal guard?  You must realize that you are speaking to one, now.  And though, as I said before, I have no wish to sully this holy place with such matters, you can NOT go about making such threats.
I was just kidding. Anyway, see you later.
Of course, m'lady. I knew it all along.  Else you would have felt the full weight of the law.  Leave, take the candle from the table with you, it is dark out.  I will see that it is replaced.
Yeah, and could you put in a good word with me with the king? I'm trying to expand my renown.
I...I...I...I shouldn't even be seen speaking to you. I shall do NO such thing.
I'll tell these peole you touched me.

agent_personas: I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.
I am a member of the council. I make important decisions about certain matters. I make laws and rules for the townspeople.

setting.name: throne room
setting.description: ornate and luxurious, the throne room gleams with gold and precious jewels. Priceless painting of past kings line the sides. underneath a vaulted ceiling regal a red carpet connect the throne room entrance to the golden throne itself.
setting.background: The throne room is the pride and joy of the castle. The king commissioned hundreds of craftsman to construct expensive interior. The king often being important ambassadors to this room to impress with his power

speech: This is a fine Jewel.
You're the queen. You can do as you wish. But I must council you not to let people see you with too many riches.
Yes, I suppose. Why are you here Council Man?
It's my job to make laws and rules for the town. I'm speaking to my fellow council men about a particularly interesting new law....
I see. Order and Civility are vital. What would this new law be?
The women must discard their clothing on Saturdays and walk around as normal.
Why would you want a law like that?
Honestly, we're very idle around here and get crazy ideas. We need a war to occupy us. Think you can help?
Don't you think that is degrading? The King will not be pleased with your outrageous request. Absolutely not.
It was the King's idea. Maybe he needs some uh...more attention, my lady.
He get's attention. What we do is none of your concern.
I council you not to take my gold, thank you.
Your intentions are not welcomed. I am over ruling your petty request about the law, and taking your gold as a lesson. Women in our land have rights.
You're right my lady. All the days cooped up in this chamber have driven me mad.

agent_personas: I am the inn keeper in a small town. I see and hear many travelers who visit. I am a good listener and laugh often.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

I am a bear from deep in the wood. I spend my days hiding in my lair. I can smell a change in the forest.

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

i am but a wandering bear dear sheep

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Can I try out a few of my jokes on you? I'm nervous about tonight.

To let her know that her shoes were untied! And they are, by the way.
...what? Oh! Darn it all!

I've been thinking about getting into magic. Will you let me saw you in half?
...um. I do want to be helpful. Please do not take offense, but I don't think you are quite... CUT out for that!

agent_personas: I am a loyal servant of the house of the queen. I was raised to do this role for my whole life. I serve willingly and without any compromises to my integrity. I would gladly die for the house if need be.
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

agent_personas: We are the queen's subjects. We serve solely at the pleasure of her royal majesty the queen. We spy on the king's men for the queen.
I am the queen of the kingdom. I am the love of the king's life. I make executive decisions, as well.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: My liege. Do you have any requests?

I'm here to write it down for you.

Cats MAY be petted, only if they are deemed worthy by the Godfrey, my cat.

Godfrey may only receive hugs, if he stays out of the pantry, and stops being such a tubby tub.

Yes, you are right. I do. Scrap the whole thing and lets start again. Its illegal to hug all cats but Godfrey on Sunday.
Right, that makes a lot more sense.
Also, tell my husband I want new drapes in the castle. These are getting covered in cat hair. He will understand. He's my lovey pumpkin.
Yes this looks pretty caked with cat hair. Maybe you should get a parrot.
A parrot! Why would I get something that yammers on with nonsense all day. When you tell the king about the drapes tell him his snookie-ookems loves him.

agent_personas: I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: Outpost
setting.description: A simple outpost with 3 wooden buildings near the middle of the mountain. A bonfire in the middle with several wooden logs surrounding it. A barracks, Armory, and Dining Hall stands around the bonfire. A wooden wall surrounds the outpost.
setting.background: The mountain outpost south of the Royal city watches for the dangers of the bordering country. If any enemies were to start moving into the kingdom they will be the first to know. The outpost is maned by 10 soldiers 2 chiefs and 2 blacksmiths. Those who recently join the Royal military are sent here for field experience.

speech: Hello, maid. How are you today?
Hello! everything is OK! what about you? How are you going to surprise us today?
Well I think you'll love what I'm cookin up today! Gotta keep the surprise though.
it's okay! Do not forget the cake! today is the king's birthday
Ohh right! I've still got it in the oven right now!
I going to clean everything for tonight, everything must be perfect
I'll make sure to follow the same philosophy!
see you tonight! I am sure the dance willl be fantastic!
