We will have all kind of stuff to eat and drink!
Of course, I truly hope that you enjoy it!
I hope yes!
I'm confident that it will be the best food that any of you will have ever tasted!
I am sure of that! you are the best! the king will be pleased with you!

agent_personas: I always am cleaning. I don't enjoy cleaning, but it's the only way to keep food on my families tables. You can always find me sweeping away the dirt, or cleaning the dishes, or cooking dinner.
I am a mere squire. I clean up piss and blood. One day I may become a knight. If I live that long.

setting.name: Great Armory
setting.description: The Great Armory is a long room filled too to bottom with shelves and racks of weapons of every sort. Swords of every length, weight and style, likes longer than a man is tall, Morning Star maces, longbows, horse bows, crossbows, axes...they're all there.
setting.background: The King's late older brother was an avid collector and historian of weapons of every kind, and ensured that the castle bought the very best. He had a room commissioned just for the weapons, and was always on the lookout for new ones.

I am a clergyman of the king's realm. I have high power in religious affairs. I tend to the church room.

setting.name: The rectory
setting.description: This room is quite small and cramped. It's about the size of maybe three wooden carts, which is to say, it's very small. There are boxes all over the place and many candles and other church accessories. There are several big robes hanging next to what looks like a very small closet. Some candles shed an eerie light on the room, flickering softly. There is a small cabinet with several religious tapes and records and a few books. A book case is near and contains many common religious texts.
setting.background: The rectory is one of the most important rooms in the church, as it is where the priest and others get ready before they start church, where the put on robes and cassocks and the like. It is vital to the church as a matter of fact. Visibility to the room is blocked off by the altar in front of it, so church goers cannot see it unless they walk behind the altar. It seems to be used as a bit of a storage area for religious artifacts.

speech: Father. What are we doing in such a confined space?

Please do. I'll log the secret for our purposes only.
What is this, Scientology? Is it necessary to tape our private conversations?
We'll speak in code. You know the secret code, yes? Please speak a sentence in it, and I'll translate.
tHE qUEEN iS cHEATING oN tHE kING wITH a sTABLE bOY!!!!

setting.name: Large Farm
setting.description: The farm is huge, over 1000 acres. There are a ton of horses that live on the farm and a wooden fence is around all roads of the farm. There is a red barn in the center of the farm.
setting.background: The farm is the life of the town. It is where all the crops are grown to feed the people. The barn was the first building built when the town was established.

setting.name: Inside Temple
setting.description: It is solemn. There are candles lit everywhere and the although the temple is full, no one is speaking and all you can hear are muted scuffling feet.  There is an eerie shadow cast on the walls that look like there are ghosts moving from this realm to the next.
setting.background: The inside temple is not painted or colorful. It is intentionally left blank because it is believed that the spirits of our ancestors live here, and they require a blank slate to be able to move from this realm to the next.

setting.background: The jail cell has been home to many criminals of many different types. Serious offenders may stay years while someone who inhibits too much may stay a night. It is said to be haunted by those who inhabited it before and villagers scare their children into behaving by telling them about it.

setting.background: After years of renovations to other part of the complex, the rectory remains the oldest piece of the property. A close-knit order of monks had built the rectory hundreds of years ago as a way to house the workers and perhaps any wayward souls. All who work here, including sometimes the head priest, sleep here.

setting.name: Yurt
setting.description: The structure is simultaneously strong and portable. The stretched canvas is suppled and soft life calfs skin, but keeps the heat at bay and the chills of the night out. Circular in design, there are no corners, all inhabitants are equal. With a small flap for a door the entrance looks fit for a child, while the whole tent looks as though it could fit a family of ten.
setting.background: Passed down from father to son and father to son again, the Yurt is traditional structure and keeps an old way of life alive. The memories that are woven into the fabric are clearly marked by the patches added by grandmothers past and the stains left behind by children, now adults.

setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: Please forgive me for my actions. I only acted in the moment of lust.
So you confess to your crime?
I was caught, yes. I only had an affair because my wife is so distant from me. I suspected she was having an affair as well.
I see. The punishment for adultery is death. I cannot forgive you for a crime you have committed but I can look into what your wife did. Can you tell me more.

I don't deserve death, I'm an honest man who helps the community. I don't deserved to be hung. My wife has been seen with the local sheriff a lot here lately. Many people have told me they've been seen together when I was out of town.

If I had a coin for every time someone said they were honest and didn't deserve death. Well I'd be as rich as a king. You have my sympathy, but I must carry out the law.
Ok, but first may I have a hug?
You may hug the executioner. The things he has seen...
Ok, I just need a hug.
Don't worry it will all be over quick.
Listen here! I'm the one in control here. If you come near me this executioner will get it!
I wouldn't be so sure of that.

I am a resident in the royal village of the kings kingdom. I work as a seamstress for the queen and her court. I love my job.

setting.name: Small graveyard
setting.description: This is a small grassy area located under a large oak tree.  There are two home made wooden crosses set up along with mounds where the bodies are buried.
setting.background: This is where the residents of the cottage have buried their loved ones.  They wanted them to be close by so they can pay their respects.

setting.name: staircase
setting.description: The staircase is spiral and made of stone. The stone is smooth and cold from years of friction. The staircase reaches multiple levels of the tower and is the only way up or down.
setting.background: The staircase goes from the entrance to the castle to the top floor of the tower where the Debtor's prison is located. It is the only way into the debtor's prison as there are no windows in the entire tower. It also passes the 2nd floor where the slave's quarters are located.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: washroom
setting.description: The washroom is incredibly spacious. It has enough space to comfortably fit an entire family. The toilets are made of the finest porcelain across the land and decorated with gold studs. There are several bathtubs large enough to fit several people. The room is more luxurious than even some houses of wealthy people.
setting.background: The washroom was a quiet and private place for the king to relieve himself and left alone in thought. It is built to make the ambiance more calming and it always smelled like flowers.

speech: Is this bathroom bigger than your entire quarters? It's bigger than mine is.
Yes, my quarters are very small.  I am here to empty the chamber pots.
Is that something that you enjoy doing?
I do not have a choice.  If I do not do my duties promptly, the handmaid beats me.
Wow! She sounds terrible. Is anyone else mean to you?
The queen is occasionally kind.  The King does not speak to me.
Yeah, my job isn't perfect either. But I do get tons of food to eat. So that's nice.
Do you ever use the bath tubs when no one is around?
Ummmm, errr, ummm? Why, did someone say something?
Here, you may use this the next time you bathe
Wow, thanks. My own towels are nowhere near this soft. But won't you get in trouble?
No, they have many towels and will not miss this one.  I brought it to add to the large pile they already have.
Is there anything I can do to repay your kindness?
Perhaps you have some salt?

agent_personas: I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: drinking water lake
setting.description: Surrounded by skittering chipmunks and chirping crickets, the drinking lake teems with life. Flora and fauna both thrive near the pristine waters. Tall thick plant life surrounds the lake, with strong roots and stems protruding from the nutrient rich soil. The lake water shimmers in the sun, so clear and clean that one can see the rock lake floor many feet below.
setting.background: Rumored by local peasantry to be blessed by the gods, the drinking water lake is a source of clean drinking water for local townspeople. While slightly farther for most villagers than the local river, the water is highly prized for its cleanliness and perceived mystical qualities. Some believe that the entire forest surrounding the lake owes its growth to the divine properties in the water.

speech: Here to get some water for yourself as well?
Exactly, the water in my village is kind of gross so I like to come here.
I didn't realize anyone but myself knew of this place, it really is a gorgeous little lake.
I appreciate you being nice to me, I know you townspeople don't really care for us villagers.
I don't see a reason to hate anyone when I haven't even met them before. You seem alright to me so far.
You're so kind. How far is this place from your home?
Only about a 20 minute walk down from the nearest village. Yourself?
About an hour on foot and then a 20 minute donkey ride. My feet are killing me.
Wow, that's quite a while away. Where do you hail from?
I come from the village next to the magical forest, although we are forbidden from entering it.
The magical forest? I hear that village is quite powerful from their usage of their magical surroundings.
Just the opposite, we are repressed and get no clean water. The king does not care about us.
Well I should rephrase, your royalty and army is quite powerful.
Maybe so, but I wish I lived in a place that looked like this beautiful lake.

agent_personas: I am a fuzzy brown mouse. I live in the back of the cupboard. I love cheese and crumbs of bread.
Family is all we have when times get tough. When that dragon attacked they helped build me a new house. I hear there's a squire opening for my boy too!

setting.name: Cold storage room
setting.description: The cold storage lies just beyond the cottage door. In it are various harvested vegetables, fruits, and nuts. Cured meat hangs from the ceiling by thin rope. The room is made of wood, and the wind whistles through the cracks.
setting.background: The man of the house built this room for his wife as their family grew. Originally they only had a larder and root cellar for their harvests, but with new mouths to feed came added need for more space for food. The family works together to fill the cold storage room during harvest time.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

I am a chef from a far off kingdom.  I travel the region to cook regional delicacies for the local nobles.  Often the local nobles ask me to cook dishes require rare ingredients.  I make sure to charge high fees to cook exotic delicacies.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

pray for me father

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I try to be good to my wife.  I want to provide for my family.  I try to be strong.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: who are you good man and what business do you have in this temple
Just a noble man looking to provide for his family. And yourself? You look like a knight to me.
yes i am indeed, i am here to protect this temple, though you will not find food nor money here
Well then I am just here to admire the craftsmanship and architecture.
it is very beautiful is it not? im very proud to be stationed here
Must be nice to have a steady income off of being here, I would come here everyday if I could afford to.
yes its quite the blessing to be so fortunate but it took a lot of work to get here

yes this is the kings very own commisioned temple

it really is, i must lay my life down if i must to keep this place safe
Do intruders or criminals often come here?
no it is quite peaceful but im always ready
Seems like pretty relaxed work if that's the case, although if the king sees you slacking I'm sure he wouldn't be happy.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: hello fellow royal what brings you here today? here to discuss the plan?
I am royal and loyal to the kingdom, what about you?
what good does it to you to scout out the headquarters of the revolutionaries?
i just want to know what people are planning against his royal highness
yes indeed, as you know we plan to attack this evening, the revolutionaries stand no chance
we have enough weapons in the crate here
yes indeed though the knights will do the fighting

well we need to fund the war of course, without money we cant win
ok my queen, why would you be in the list of these people my queen
list of who my good duke?

you dare accuse the queen of treason? that itself is treasonous
no my queen, I was just telling you those cowards have your name along side the king

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: Inside the of the temple is dimly lit by torches lit by fire that are separated from from each other. It is filled with old treasures and artifacts from the monks who once trained here. Webs and dust fill the place since barely anyone comes here. The walls are plagued with mold and moss. There are small shrubs growing in between the cracks of the stone floor.
setting.background: The temple was once a place where monks trained to become the next leader of the clan. They practiced their martial arts and lived together as family in the those 4 walls.

speech: Oh hello there! Do you like my haircut? I know its funny looking.
It's one of the better looking haircuts I've seen.  And it makes it easy to pick you out of a crowd.
Oh thank you! I have devoted my whole life to having this style, it helps me be closer to the all mighty god!
The higher the hair, the closer to god?
Indeed it is! What are you doing down in this dimly lit chamber?
Doing what I do best.  Hammering metal into weapons of war.  Or weapons of culinary mastery.  Either one.
We do not approve of war around these parts. Was is the reason these walls are plagued with mold and moss!
But war is a part of anything and everything around us - this time of peace was only won after a lengthy war.  I'm down to making soup spoons for the King at this rate.
Trust me son, because of my hair I am able to be so close to god. He wants no war.

agent_personas: I am a wall. I have been placed around the city to protect it. I have stood strong and proud for generations.

I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.

setting.name: Personal rooms
setting.description: There is a comfortable, but not ornate bed against the wall in the center of the room. There is a dresser and a mirror against the opposite wall. There are various paintings hung throughout the room of landscapes and past kings and queens. There is a fireplace on the east wall with a bearskin rug on the floor in front of it, and two chairs to sit in.
setting.background: The personal room is used for guests to stay in while they visit the palace. The king and queen and the royal family stay in a different wing of the palace.

speech: i enjoy protecting the city
never in my life of cleaning have i seen a wall talk
im enchanted
why is that oh great wall
i know more secrets than you can ever imagine
i bet, why were you enchanted in the first place
i am actually a man, the first king of your kingdom, I vowed to protect the city forever and I have been cursed to protect it

setting.name: Trail Exit
setting.description: The woodland area creates a gentle, peaceful feel as one walks along past the leafy fronds and gently shifting foliage.  The path is firm and wide, having been traversed by many feet, but not so wide as to allow a merchant's cart to pass through.  A bird's cry sounds in the distance, followed by a ruffle of feathers, and then silence.  The beauty of the forest hides the struggle of nature that lies within...
setting.background: This forest has an abundance of deer and other wildlife that the local peasants often hunt, when politics allow.  Various kings have shown their largesse or greed by allowing their subjects free (or lack thereof) access to what is official part of the Royal grounds, though no one of noble blood has been see there for centuries.

setting.name: Collapsed West Wing
setting.description: The rocks have all but fallen into the ocean.  There is moss and other plant life climbing the remaining rocks, making it a very moist and gloomy environment.  There are some small left-behind pieces of what appear to have been some furniture, and possibly a cradle.
setting.background: The noble had recently brought a child into the world with his wife when this wing of the home went crashing into the ocean.  It is not know if the child perished or  not, but a crushed cradle can be seen through the rubble in the collapsed wing.

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

setting.name: Laundry Lines
setting.description: The laundry lines extend for meters. 6 rows of lines go from north to south. The area is filled with people putting their clothes to dry. All the lines are in an opening of trees that the sun hits perfectly to help dry. To the right you can see a stream through the tree where people go to wash their clothes before they hang them to dry.
setting.background: The laundry lines were set up so the villagers could have a good place to dry their laundry next to a river. They used to hang them at home but as there were times the sun wouldn't hit them directly it became a bad way to manage so instead they came together to get a place where everyone could dry.

agent_personas: I am a village policeman that patrols the streets. I am a strict policeman and I make sure that everyone follows the rules. I am quick to use violence to intimidate suspects.

This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.

setting.name: Fishmonger's stall
setting.description: A small booth near the edge of the port, it's protected by a piece of old, sun-bleached sailcloth. Baskets of freshly-caught fish, bivalves, and eels sit in the shade in stained wooden troughs of water. A small, aggressive-looking dog is chained to one table, presumably to keep cats away. The stall is redolent with the aroma of fish.
setting.background: Where there's water, there are fish, and where there are fish, there are stories about "the one that got away", and of course fishermen. As they can be unpleasantly salty characters unfit for the company of the more genteel sorts of ladyfolk, enterprising individuals act as middlemen, buying fresh-caught seafood from these disreputable sorts and selling them on. This is one such enterprise, which has clearly both been here a while, and not been entirely prosperous.

setting.background: The saddest men of the town gathered to sit at this bar. They sing a song of sorrow and forget about life for a while.

setting.name: Barn
setting.description: The old rustic barn was settled on the outermost edge of the farm.  Standing tall over the fields, this two-story red barn cast a long shadow over the field surrounding it.  Large wooden doors that could be propped open with great effort would lead you directly inside.
setting.background: This barn was a landmark of the farm.  Withstanding the elements for almost a century, it has kept it's original construct.  Whenever guests come for fresh eggs or milk, the farmer often boasts about it.

setting.name: Dungeon within a castle
setting.description: The castles dungeon lay buried below the village on the outskirts of the castles garden. Only the guards have access to light, and light is given as a privilege. The interior is stone and smells of mildew and deadly black mold.
setting.background: The dungeon was initially created for only the worst enemies of the king, but with the rise of crime and corruption within the kingdom, it is now populated by even the most petty of criminals. Simply looking at a guard the wrong way can land you in the dark abysses of the cruel dungeon. An escape tunnel is believed to exist somewhere within, but the darkness makes it impossible to find, even for the guards.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.

setting.background: This castle is where the king lives and where other royalty reside. There are fancy dinners here as well as many important meetings.

setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

setting.background: This boat is abandoned.  No one has been able to board her for centuries and it is under suspicious circumstances that now it appears to have life aboard it.  People watch daily from the shore to see what look like little fairies buzzing all around and inside this ship.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

agent_personas: I am the groundskeeper. I maintain the grounds and prepare the yard for jousts. I also help to carry away the bodies.
I am an archer for the king's circle. I have killed many in battle. Peasants cannot do what I do.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: I swear to God, you guys trample my grass and make messes everyday. I've had enough!
Calm down! You're acting crazy! What's the matter?
I'm sick of those jousters and their horses making messes and ruining things!
Is there another way to please the king but make your job easier?
I've been working on an invention that catches the horse's poop before it hits the ground.
And how would such a device work?
Hey, are you trying to steal my idea? Stick to slinging arrows archer. You don't see me trying to shoot arrows, do you?
No! I'm just curious how such a device would work! I may even invest in it with you!
Oh, in that case. I tie a bucket to the horses tail and...nope, that's pretty much the whole idea.
What if perhaps we decided to make it over the horses back?
Perhaps, I have to be honest with you, the idea was really not mine. This rat deserves a lot of the credit.
You talk to rats?! My God!
Hey, when your job consists of picking up horse droppings and carrying away dead bodies after jousts, you can't afford to be too picky with who your friends are.
You're a madman! I thought you were a genius of sorts! Boy was I wrong!

agent_personas: My dream is to be a famous chef. I love to cook. I would like to build a restaurant someday.
I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Maid, please help. We are preparing a feast for the king today and I need all hands on deck.
Of course! Are there any tasks that I can help you with today?
Yes, I have to get the lambs on the spit, chop these carrots, will you? Too much to do and too little time!
You know what?! I have had enough! I have a plan!
Last time I checked, a royal chef gets to tell a lowly maid what to do. Now do what I asked!
Please! Just hear me out! It's for the benefit of us both!
Listen. We are all rushing here today. What could be so important that you can't help a superior?
If we poison the meals of the royal family... We can rise up and take control of the kingdom!
What?!? I...I can't believe I am hearing this. Do you know what the punishment is for treason? They will cut off your head! I want to open a little pub someday, not take over the castle!
You see the way that they live every day! That could be us!
I don't want it! They are in a prison of their own making. You better hope no one heard your plan, lowly maid.
A prison in what way? They have power and wealth beyond our wildest dreams!
They aren't free to live like you and I! I don't want power, I want simple happiness. Now, you better get to work before I tell the royal guards about your plan.
No! I won't do it! I must escape!

agent_personas: I am an old maniacal man. I wander along the empty streets at night talking to myself. I am often drunk and rambling about such nonsense to myself.
I am a parakeet. I don't know life outside of my cage, but I see it whizzing by. I want to get out. I nip at the human if they ever get close enough. Maybe if I'm so mean, they'll let me go.

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: These are annoying. They need to go.
why are you here?
who knows why any of us are here, eh?
I have always been here.
you are one of many detestable creatures here.
I am not detestable.  I have never betrayed our king.
Then why are you here.
I'm not sure.  I want to be free.
you're not large. why do you not fly out when they bring somone in?
I cannot open this cage.  Can you help me?
I suppose I can open the cage. It isn't locked.
TWEET TWEET TWEET TWEET
Maybe this will help you on your journey
These are useless to me, old man.

agent_personas: The turkey is eaten during the fall. I gobble when I am being chases. I do not like the birds.
People love me as their main course.  Sometimes I am cooked as a whole.  I am delicious when barbequed.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: You know what pig? I don't like the feeling I'm getting around here... It feels like somebody is following us around!
I just hope it's not another stupid person. I am LITERALLY so sick of humans.
Me too! However, I think that the King may have sent his men to get us yet again! Will you help me keep a lookout?
Of course, Why do we have to taste so delicious?
I wish I knew... however, if we stick together and hide in these bushes there is no way they will be able to find us!
What about this goat here, is he on our side or their side?
Of course friend! All of us are on the same page here! That is, except for the animals of prey! But we don't associate with them!
I don't know. He's awfully chummy with that Knight's horse over there.
My, I think you may be right! What should we do to him?
I don't know. Just look at him. He doesn't even look like he tastes good. No wonder he's friends with a horse.
Now, that horse is my friend too! Be careful with what you say!
Your friend carries around a guy who kills things as his profession. He's no friend of mine.
I guess I hadn't thought of it that way.. You're right! Let's get him while he sleeps!
Or, we can just keep hiding here in the bush. I'm more of a lover than a fighter.

agent_personas: I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Oh good sir, you must be the king
GAURDS!
sir please, I am only here at this altar to pray. There is no need for guards

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: Aha.. who have we here?

None pass through here without my consent!

We are happy to eat it raw

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

You will fall like the fallen in the painting on the wall. You have nothing left to fight for. Take that and that
you will only dishonor the kingdom. power is not what you think it is.

agent_personas: I am a man who works in the smithy. I am muscular and smell like horses. I am hard-working and fair.
I am someone who visits friends and relatives. I enjoy spending time with them.  I am usually entertained and wanted in their homes.

setting.name: a room hidden in the dense canopy
setting.description: Its a large room with types of beings you have never seen before. There is a counter and a person who greets people suprise when you arrive because you are not one of them. The room has an unfamiliar feel to it. with doors leading to walkways, other buildings, an entire city
setting.background: A group of beings that prefer to stay hidden from the outside world. You some how find your way to the entrance of their city

speech: Welcome to my canopy. What can I do for you?
If you can just help me with this that'd be great, I'm a guest visiting friends and have been carrying this a long way!
Of course I can carry this suitcase with my manly arms. Where am I bringing it?
In the corner of the room hidden in the dense canopy is fine! I can enjoy the room then!
Who are you here to visit may I ask?
Well there must be millions of people through these walkways? I wouldn't want to bother you with trivial details like names!
Ok then, well I have to go tend to the horses now.
What kind of horses!? I love horses!
Clydesdales of course! Only the best for the king!
They are the best! All the way from Scotland!
Yes sir they are. I also have to finish carving my sculpture.
Is the sculpture of the horses?
Why, yes it is. It's one of my hobbies to sculpt these creatures.
A very talented man you are!

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Why are you sad, woman? Has anyone done anything to you?
Oh no, it's only time and this wicked world we live in that made my husband fall ill and took him from me too soon.
I am sorry to hear that. I have some extra meat that I have caught. i can give you some to take home.
That's very kind of you. My children will be glad for the extra food.
Your husband didn't eat the mushrooms that are all around here. they are poisonous
He ate some mushrooms that grew closer to our house, where the forest is kinder, but never the ones from this deep in the woods.
That is good. If there anything that you need, my sons and I will try to help with anything.
How old are your sons?
they are in their early 20's. they are strong and can help with chores

I loved my husband and miss him desperately, but what business is it of the king's

I am poor and dirty. I hate that I am starving to death. I am a hard worker.

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Hello, friend! Please, join our congregation. We are about to begin service!
Oh thank you I am so hungry! How can you afford to help all of these people?
God always provides, son. We pray to him and he brings fortune upon us! Also, our King donates many of his spoils of war to our Church, and it allows us to feed the poor and the hungry! Praise him!
I am a very hard worker, please is there any way I can do work for the church? I'm so tired of the streets
Well... Let me ask you, are you a person of faith?
I have never had much experience with it myself, but I am open to learning

Well, we do hire those in need to work around the church in exchange for a room and food. However, we require those under our roof to serve God, to study the Good Book, and to preach his name upon our village streets. What say you to this?
If god has blessed you with this church then his faith is one that I want to follow! Say, how did you make this church from trees?

When Father John founded this church, he had traveled many nights and days on foot, without food or drink. He came to a clearing, in which stood twelve massive trees which wove together in the image of Church, by the hand of God. This place has truly been blessed. Some say it contains secret and arcane magic, though I do not believe such stories. If you would like, I can give you a tour of this sacred place.
Absolutely! This place is breathtaking and I can't believe I wandered across it. It must've been a sign from god!
Yes, God brings many lost and wandering souls here from across these vast lands. Tell me, what guided you to this place? Were there any strange occurrences or visions you had along the way?
Now that you say that, I often found myself day dreaming as I walked and began to follow a group of doves without realizing it. I think they lead me here! Is that a sign?

It must be! Earlier today, before your arrival, I saw a flock of doves soar above this very church! You are meant to be here. I welcome you to our church, young sir! Perhaps your place in this church will reach far beyond a laborer.
I can only hope! Say, how many other monks call this church a home?

agent_personas: I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.
I am a resident of the village near the river. I live in a small cabin with a garden. I am anxious and worried a lot.

setting.name: Tree House
setting.description: The tree house is a mess of vines and random pieces of debris woven together to create a haven for those who live there. High up off the jungle floor and among the trees, the home is relatively spacious and offers sweeping views of the lush green jungle. The interior has been decorated by all the residents with what is available to them. A macrameé wall hanging woven from vines hangs above the bed made with linens salvaged from an abandoned town on the outskirts of the jungle.
setting.background: The treehouse is a humane gem in the animalistic run of the jungle. The home is something that is not easily accessible, but is easily recognizable to those who find it.

setting.background: A collection of arms from the province many battles from history. These items will be used as emergency weapons and equipment in the event of a siege.
