setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: Servant, I hope you're ready for a hard day's work, there is much to prepare before the festival.
I must dust this diamond off so it will sparkle.
Be very careful with that diamond, Servant. It is worth more than your life!
Here take it!
What provisions have you made for tonight's feast? Is the lamb prepared for the sacrifice? If we do not appease our God, there will be a famine for many years.
I shall start cooking.
This ruby will be a vital part of the ceremony. You must clean it and keep it safe. Can you be trusted?
I will keep an eye of for it and make it my top priority.

How dare you remove the sapphire! You are only to touch the ruby, nothing else. This sapphire is priceless and was a gift to this church from the King himself. If I tell him you tried to steal it, you will be at his mercy. What do you have to say?
I was only trying to clean it so it could sparkle.
Don't forget your place, Servant. The High Priest has trusted me to make sure these treasures are safe and everything is ready for the grand festival.

agent_personas: I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.
I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: I think I will eat some of this deliciousness that is setting out on trays.
Get dog, get. That is not your food. We are to clean this up, not let you lick the plate. Filthy.
I miss my family, they always let me eat the deliciousness...
Oh my, poor dog. Where is your family?
Check my collar and please help me, I love food!
I cannot let you eat off of the plate. Here is some food you can heat on the ground. Your collar says....Oh my, I know the robinsons. I think they just left for the next town over this morning...
Oh no, they left me forever..whatever shall I do....
Don't cry dog. They are planning to return within the week. You can stay with me until then. I do not have much but I have a small space you can stay.....
Okay thanks! I call the couch!
I do not have a couch. I am a maid. I live here in a small room the king provides. I save all of my money to pay for a education for myself so I can get out of here.
Oh well the floor will be fine. What is your area of research?
I want to study architecture. I love looking at the castle and all the designs.
Are you going to be a builder?
A designer if I can help it...

agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.

We are the king's personal army. We are an elite group separate from the main army. We train everyday to be the best we can be. We honor a strict code of chivalry that applies to peasant and royal alike.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Hello army. I am tasked with the honor of making all of your equipment. I am passionate about this. I will make you armor that no man or beast can penetrate!
Fantastic! We already have fair armor, but find ourselves training every day and wearing it down.
That armor is not fit for dogs. If you wear that to battle you will be skewered in a matter of minutes. Here, try this piece on and tell me how much of a difference it makes.
What a phenomenal helmet! It's light in weight, shines like the sun, and cannot be penetrated. For an elite army like ours, we require your services!
That is why the king commissioned me! I make the best armor in the land after my father died due to crappy armor.
Such a sad story! But your legacy will be strong when you create armor for the king's personal army. We'll need daggers, swords, and axes.
Yes, I make fine weapons aswell. Made from black dwarven steel, they are sure to never fail you in battle so long as you keep the blade sharp.
Let me see this one! I see it swings well, and then knight is barely able to dodge it. This, indeed, will serve us well. How many gold pieces?

You need not pay! You are part of the king's army. He has paid for everything already. Just take your pick and defend us. Please keep us safe, so long as you do, I will continue to provide you equipment.
Grand! Now we will be prepared when the dragon comes again. We can handle any beast, just as you said.
Take this too, some dragons have a very tough hide and this axe will cut through it like butter! It is heavy, so give it to your strongest man.
My brother in arms, that soldier over there, is the beast in our group. He'll wield it well!
Great! Now go keep us safe!
Everyone in the campaign shall use your weapons and be prepared for anything. Thank you, great armorer!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Dining hall
setting.description: A somewhat ornate room with stone walls, hanging tapestries, and a detailed look dinner table in the center with many chairs.  There's candles on the dinner tables along with place mats for those who come to eat.
setting.background: This room is used primarily by visitors and guests to the tower.  It's also used to celebrate various occasions and family reunions.

speech: Good day Visitor, I see you have traveled to this land too. I am tired after traveling for many days and look forward to the warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a very weary traveler. We have escaped a tyrant of a king and are in search of putting down root in a land of our very own.
I can certainly relate to that. I left home when I was only a boy and have been traveling ever since. This seems like a good kingdom but I haven't been here long. Are you traveling alone?
No, I come with a large group of weary, hungry men, women and children. They wait for morning to keep traveling farther north.
Here, take my sleeping bag for the children. I am a veteran traveler and can find comfort anywhere. I have been to many places and seen many things.

Oh! Thank you! They will be thrilled. We are headed to that valley over those mountains. It will be a long journey but hopefully well worth it. I heard there is a river and streams and is untouched by man.

Goodness, that is where I have just come from! It is indeed a fantastic place. I camped many nights under the stars and kept myself fed by fishing in the streams. It's a desolate place though, do you think your group possess the skills to settle there?
We may be a weathered bunch but we are strong and resilient. We will make a wonderful home of this place. As long as water flows there we can turn it into an eden.

Your courage is most noble, I wish you a successful journey. Take a look at this flower, I picked it from next to one of the streams. It is most exotic and fragrant. You should find many like it on your travels. I hear they are valuable.
It smells better than a night blooming jasmine. I will have my wife make a lovely perfume of these.

Be warned, though. It can be treacherous trying to pick them as they grow on high rocks next to the stream. That's why they're so valuable, as well as their aroma. I should also warn you of the wild animals that roam that land. Many a night I had to protect myself from danger.
It was very nice talking with you. You have helped more than you know. Maybe when we have this place tamed you will come visit.
I look forward to seeing what you make of it. For now, I will continue on with my travels south to find more exotic items and perhaps finally the riches I have always dreamed of.
Take this for your travels to remember me by. It has served me well.
action: give a sleeping bag to visitor
put a sleeping bag in bag

agent_personas: I am an infant fly. I eat rotting flesh. I grow large and will soon become something else.
I am a spider. I am large, black, and have eight hairy legs. I wait to trap insects in my web. I enjoy eating unwary prey. I live in a darkened wood near a remote village.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: What a wonderfully dark and dreary cell I have found myself in!
You there speaking, I will eat you now since there isn't much around here for me to eat.
Wait! Please don't eat me now. Look over there, a gruel bowl! Perhaps there are some morsels left we could share?
Let me look and see.
I also have this piece of rotten flesh I was saving for later.
That will do. I feel my strength coming back after that meal!
Hooray! So what kind of spider are you anyway? Are there webs around here I need to look out for?
I am the king spider and the only one around this area. I'm getting tired of this cell, would you ride on my back out of here?

Hmm, I could do that... but how do I know you won't eat me. Besides, if I can find some more rotten flesh to eat, I will soon grow large and eventually become a fly. Then I could come and go as I please!
Yes I want you to come with me in case I need to energize myself. You're plump and can spare a piece of your flesh.
I'm not convinced. Have you been outside? What's out there for me? I like the damp, repugnant atmosphere in here.
There is all kinds of great things, just trust me. Will you hop on?
I think I will wait here under this bowl instead. Surely there is more rotten flesh somewhere! Bring some back for me and then I will be convinced to join you on your next journey out.
Alright sounds okay.
action: steal An empty gruel bowl from spider

agent_personas: I am the mysterious merchant of the village. I sell rarities from around the world that can not be purchased anywhere else. I am very wealthy and I liver in a large manor near the castle.
I am a part of a group of travelers.  I go from town to town selling food to the locals.  I grew up poor, but my travels have paid off well.

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Hey friend would you wanna try and find some food to eat?
Sounds like a plan! This looks like quite the festival they're having here.  Hard to believe people here celebrate something so gruesome, but I guess we've met all sorts in our travels, eh?
Did I miss it, what is the festival for?

Apparently the king but five years ago here discovered his wife, the queen, was having *quite* the parties behind his back.  So you can imagine, then, how a fella might be inclined to do... erm... something rash.
So did he kill her?

I think she probably wishes so, and the lovers... ach, they didn't get off easy at 'tal.  Nah, he hired some wizarding type person and had her turned into a horse.  Said at least he may as well get some pleasure out of riding her!

agent_personas: I go to church every week.  I am a parishioner of a Catholic church.  I pray to thank my God.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: Your Royal Highness
Yes, quite.
I hope I do not intrude?
By the gods, this incense is making my nose run. Do hurry up.
It's marijuana, Highness. The priest's little habit
And what, pray tell is that?
A herb, Highness. People smoke it to relax
I must have one for my chambers. You've been most helpful.
You might want to conceal that from the King, Highness.
And why is that?
Some people .. disapprove, Highness
Outrageous! I will pen a new decree on the matter. People should relax whenever they want. Unless it interferes with their productivity, of course.
I admire your stance, Highness. First you must pen a decree saying that the Queen can pen decrees, however
Yes.. there is that...

agent_personas: I am a performer by day, and savior by night. I protect the poor from the King's ruthless soldiers. I am calm, compassionate and a peace loving man. I do not rise quick to anger. My sword is my only trusted friend.
I am an outsider that likes to explore new worlds. I feel really comfortable in the kingdom. I  have certain benefits that make me feel important.

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: I feel like I am looking for Juliet and Romeo or Rapunzel
And pray tell, why are looking for such fairy tale beings?
I am an actor and being in this tall lighthouse makes me think of that.
Ah yes, now I see! So have you travelled to many places?
I perform by day, and save the poor by night. My travels take me everywhere when I perform
I to have been to many lands and places. How is it that you came to be here in this lighthouse?
I was helping out the poor from the kings soldiers. It seems they are picked on too much by the soldiers.
Ah, the poor, they will always be with us. The Kings soldiers are honorable men. What you say shocks me.
It shocked me too. And I had to make sure before helping them. But yes they are being taken advantage of.
And how is it that a performer can help protect the poor from soldiers? By what means do you do so?
My sword helps in that direction. I run them off. I do not think the king knows of what they do.
A sword! And what would a performer know of swordsmanship!
My father was an excellent swordsman and he taught me well.
Ah, I see. And was he of noble blood?

agent_personas: I am a mage from with a long white beard. I concoct magic spells of my own. I am a practitioner of the dark arts of magic.
I sell and trade items to earn money. I am not royalty. I live in villages and can travel far distances.

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Hi, I am a mage, who are you?
Hello mage, I am a merchant! I sell and trade a variety of different items!
wonderful! I myself concoct magic spells. I am particularly fond of the dark arts! I have an important scroll I must deliver to the castle
Wonderful! I have a bag here with some interesting items...
It seems there's been quite some battle here. I say... what's in that bag of yours?
Lots of different things... just waiting to be traded for that scroll of yours.
I am a master of the dark arts! I'll just take it, an deliver the scroll to the castle as well!
You dare steal from me? I will steal right back!
we could do this all day foolish merchant!
are you ready for a fight?
Armor won't protect you from my powers! You're just a weak human!
I can still fight back!
Violence will solve nothing. viva la resistance! Let us take the scroll to the king together!
Hm... yes, I think that may be a good idea.

agent_personas: I am a roach, a type of bug who lives off the crumbs of humans. I like to live in dark and damp places. People fear me and scream when they see me.
I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Ah, I don't see many bread crumbs around. Mouse, have you been stealing my food?
Are you kidding? There's a big bag of grain in the barn I have been munching on. If you need a nibble, go out there.
Then why are you in here? In my space. I am the only non human aloud in these quarters!
I carry the Kings sword, I can wander wherever I please. You do not want to become acquainted with my sword, do you?
The kings sword? You playing with your imaginary friend again? That king would stomp on you!
See how it gleams? It would take out your roachy armor in one slash!
Alright alright, lets be friends instead of foes ay?
Sounds good. Say- what are in these locked trunks? Do you know?
I have heard that the knights keep things to remember their old life by in there.
Well, here's something we could enjoy! How about a swig or two of this brew?
Ah yes! this would help wash down the crumbs, oh wait if I had any.
No kidding. I'll bring you some grain next time I go out.
So kind of you little mouse. I usually eat over there under their beds!
Well, it's time for this mouse to get a good night's sleep.

agent_personas: I am a bodyguard working for the royal family as was my father before me. I prefer this life of protection to feeling weak and unhelpful like the farmers and merchants of our city. I always put duty before my own happiness.

I'm a traveler. Rather than settling down in one town, I feel compelled to go from place to place. I make money by carrying news from town to town, by bringing small objects to sell such as needles and lace, and by telling interesting stories. As soon as I have traveling money, I move on to the next place.

setting.name: Inside Tower
setting.description: The walls and are made of marble and trimmed in gold.  So too are the winding stairs that lead up to the observation deck.  Ivy lines the outside of the walls and sprawls all the way up the side to just near the top of the tower.  The tower itself is intimidating for those who dare to approach.  The tower stands tall so as to see out way across the beautiful land it watches over.
setting.background: The Tower stands off in the corner of the Castle.  One of many ornate vessels of the castle, the Tower serves to protect the kingdom's valuables and its people. Its towers over the beautiful farmland in the countryside and is a marker for those who travel off in the distance.

speech: Stop!  Who goes there?
I am simply passing through town I mean now harm I swear.  I was just trying to trade some supplies and get some rest.
What supplies do you seek and what land are you from?  It is my duty as the royal bodyguard to vet all travelers for the kingdom.
I have ran out of kindling to make fires and my clothes also need repairs.  They have been worn by the elements.
Surely you have a tailor in your own village, and kindling.  By order of the king, what is your name?
I am called noel I am from the next town over I won't be long just passing through./
Noel,  that name doth sound familiar.  Do you have a brother that has been imprisoned?  I have heard talk of a Noel that will come at dark to rescue him.   I fear this visit is more than you say!
If I was here up to no good why would I give you my real name?  I haven't heard of such an imprisoned man.  I haven't even got a brother.
I shall keep half of your gold until you return as a promise that your stay will be honorable then!
I don't believe this is a real policy.  I feel like you are just shaking me down and stealing from me.

I beg your pardon, but I come from a long line of bodyguards - my father, and his father before him. I dare not say this is a shake down.  This is merely a good faith deposit that you will be on your way and not besmirch our village.  I will also be sending extra guards to your brother whom you claim not to know.
Well it's a shakedown now I'm out of here.  Thanks for the gold kid.
You shall not pass!
I'll be taking this as well.  Your really slow!

agent_personas: I live in a large city, but I am leaving it behind.  There is too much noise in this city and I can't take it any more.  I seek to live in the peaceful and more quiet countryside.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Entrance to the Pine trees
setting.description: Very tall and towering pine trees that create a dark canopy of shade. Long skinny trees sway in the sky from the soft breeze. Pine needles scatter the ground like plush carpet.
setting.background: The Pine forest is home to many deer and other animals. It is a sanctuary for people escaping the loud city. It is serene and peaceful and many people have found solace here.

speech: This forest is so peaceful. I wish I lived here rather than the city.

Ah hello there, friend!  Have you come to search for the faerie city that the king has sent the bounty for as well?  I heard that there were strange lights in this forest, so I thought it as likely as spot as any.
Oh, faeries? I just came here to get away from the noise. But I'd love to see some faeries.
Hm.... well the bounty for them is quite substantial, so I suppose I don't mind sharing we came across it.  I could always use another pair of hands.
You can keep the bounty. The experience of seeing faeries is more than money can buy.
Well, you don't need to tell me twice, mate!
But I don't know if I can carry this backpack much further. It's so heavy.

Well, I suppose we could rest for a spell.  The forest I've heard is quite large, so we'll be able to take our time.  I threw the other city hunters off my trail so we should have the place to ourselves for a while.
I see. Well, while we rest for a bit, why don't you tell me a bit about yourself?

Aye, sure, why not.  Good to know who you're workin' with.  I'm a hunter by trade.  Used to work up at Lord Hastings manor a ways back, but he, erm, cause Lady Hastings and I in a compromising position.  So I find myself now with a lot of free time on my hands, and in need of being far away from any of Lord Hastings men!
Oh, so you're a bit of a troublemaker. What do you hunt besides faeries?

Oh, well, I haven't *specifically* hunted these types of faeries.  Dryads and the occasional nymph, mostly.  Even a werewolf, once!  But what about you, traveller?  What brings you this far into the forest?
I come from a large city, but I'm trying to get away from it. I'm looking for a new place to live where I can find peace. This forest seems like a nice, quiet area to build a new home.
Aye, well, best be on your guard.  I find that when the forest is quietest is when you need to start watching your back.

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How do you think of my new home, Knight?
The home is beautiful, my lord.
Thank you!  The king has seen fit to deed me this land and this home.  I am truly happy here.  What are your aspirations in the kingdom?
I aspire to be the greatest knight to ever grace this kingdom.
You are well on your way , Sir.  I have this paper for you!
Thank you. I also have something for you as well.
Thank you!  Why do I deserve this?  Is it a good thing you are giving it to me?
The ring contains power that could potentially protect you from any enemy.
Are you aware of enemies that I am not?  I feel secure in this place.
Yes, there are enemies all around. Some closer than you think.
Et tu, Brutus?
I hope I have not frightened you. But I want you to be prepared.
As long as you are still on my side I feel secure as ever.  Did you look at that paper?
Yes I did. But there's one thing you must also realize.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I have to get out of this place!
Ha, ye'll not be gettin far there, scum!  No one's made it out of this place without Johnny the Skinner 'aving a crack a 'em first!
I'll skin the Skinner if I have to.
Yer not makin' it any easier fer yerself, laddie.  Even if ye made it past me, there's 20 other guards outside this room.  Ye'd not make it but ten footlengths.
You're right, it's pointless. I'm not supposed to even be in here. I was wrongfully imprisoned.
Huh.  You and everyone else that's passed through these walls.  But I've a mind ta here a fairy tale - how is it you were put in this here place.
My wife was found dead, thought to have swallowed poison. I was accused of her murder, but they ain't got any proof.

Hm, well the King can be a fair minded man when he's kept away from the bottle.  I'd say yer odds are fairly even as to hav'n a sober audience fer ye ta tell yer tale.  Seems a might fishy that there was even poison in yer house though.
My wife was a very unhappy lady. She had hinted to me that she didn't enjoy life after having our three children. I suspect she bought that poison and ended it all herself.
Well, can ye at least have a neighbor lady speak on yer behalf?  Not that I've much of a head fer bandying words about ta prove a point, but couldn't hurt ta have another voice on yer side.
My wife's sister was our only neighbor, and she hated me. She's the one who accused me of the murder.

Ah, well, that do be puttin a wrinkle in things, and no mistake.  Still, it do be speakin ta yer character that ye haven't stabbed with that there knife.  Don't suppose ye'd be willin ta hand it over?
No, I'm sorry sir, but this is my only chance to escape this terrible chamber.
Well it twas worth a try.  Sorry there, fella, but yer grip on this here knife is all wrong.  Tis a little to easy ta disarm ye, see?

agent_personas: I am a unicorn hunter who is very brave and loyal . I travel around the world looking for unicorns . I eat unicorn meat and take the horns for magic.

I walk through the woods and through the meadows grazing on the small shrubbery plants and grasses throughout the regions. I also look for other gatherings of deer and talk to them. I also avoid humans when they come near and gallop away if they see me.

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

speech: Excuse me, deer... Have you perhaps seen any unicorn about this shore?

If you seek to hunt my mistress, you are too late, hunter. The Red Bull, at the behest of the king, has driven them all into the sea. Look out upon the waves. That is not foam but their manes as they struggle against the tide.
The Red Bull hast struck again! Drowning the wealth of unicorns and with it, their magic and potent horns! Do you mean to say no other unicorns in these lands are left?

Why do you think that I do not run from you? Without the unicorn's presence, soon the land will be barren and lifeless. I will say, though perhaps I am merely chasing hope, the face that the land still blooms might mean that there is one last unicorn.

This is unwise of you to suggest such a thing to a hunter, foolish dear... What is to stop me from committing your slaughter and seeking the last unicorn for myself? If these few spring blooms indicate a final magical beast, than its blood belongs to Man.

I only say this because I know it to be false. If there were a last unicorn, she would do all in her power to stop this. That she has not means that either there are no more unicorns or that she has been bewitched by one stronger than you.
Tell me more information, beast! Tell me how to find this bewitched creature or face certain death!

You are short sighted even for a human. First tell me what you intend to do once the forests are gone and the land is barren. What will you eat? The dirt? The sand? This seashell? Kill me if you must ! I am already resigned to my fate.

What will I eat? Where will I roam? GOD will sustain me. GOD will lead me. GOD will show me the path. You will die, surely, and when you do, there will be no eternal life in your bleak existence. For me, even if I were to starve my mortal flesh upon sand and earth and sea water alone, I shall live on forever. There is only now one hope for you and I both. The poultice made of unicorn horn grants those who consume it eternal life and freedom from starvation. Perhaps, if you were to lead me to this last unicorn, we could partake together.

You offer to upset the balance of nature, that which you believe your God created, and yet you think God will smile upon this endeavor? Hunter! The only way that I would go with you on your journey is if you wore my hide! Kill me or leave me in my mourning! I grow more and more tired of you humans by the second!
God does not create eternity on Earth just to scorn those who seek it! This is your last chance to join me! This is your last chance to survive the coming oblivion.
I grow tired of this! If you'll not see reason, then I will force your hand!
.Have it your way, you foolish beast!
And so the chase begins! And the longer you chase me, the less time you spend hunting down the last unicorn!

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I'm a nasty horsefly. Bzzzz. Kill me. Bzz...

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: Oh hello!!! How are you!!!
I am good.  How are things going with you?
I'm great! I'm just here to play....but that waters pretty gross looking!
Just the way I like it. I have just been buzzing around.
ohhhh, do you live here? It would be so cool to live here!
I really don't live here, I just come here often to buzz around.  What are you doing here?
Ohh, so you come to play too. I just like playing! There's not a lot of other kids around here - so I like to explore!! but I hear there's alligators..
Yes, there are alligators and other dangerous creatures.  I like to buzz around the alligators to make them mad.  I made one really made, so I came over here to hide from him.  He almost ate me!!
That's so scary!! but that sounds so fun. You sound like you go on a lot of adventures !!
There is a lot to do around here, especially since I can fly.  I went through the castle earlier.  The sun was so inviting, I found my self outside before I knew it. .
Ohhhh! That's so cool - I wanna be like you!! Did you see the king in the castle??
No, that would have been fun to buzz in his ear!! There is an electric eel moving around, you better watch out.  Have you done anything fun?
woah!! I've never seen an eel before! I wanna touch him!! I haven't done anything yet, i got lost in the woods earlier before I found this place.
No, don't touch him!! He will shock you.  There is poison ivy over there as well - it will make you itch!!  Don't your parents worry about you being by yourself?

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I, Sir Bart am the protector of this realm. I will not be Ned Starked. You there, what are you doing with that axe?

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Here is your wine M'lord.
This wine is warm! You are in the presence of myself and the queen, and you bring warm wine?
Apologies! Shall I return it to the cellar?
Ugh, no, that will take far too long. We'll drink it as it is. AH! Sip it first, swine, I'll not be poisoned today.
*sip wine* It is warm M'lord, but does not taste like bitter almonds, a good sign no doubt?
Hmm. Yes, I suppose. *Takes wine* Test this meat for us as well. A small bite! And you will address me as Sir Bart!
Yes sir Bart. Mmmmmm, that must be the best horse I have ever tasted!
Good, then we'll need more of this from the kitchens just before our party guests arrive. This silverware will need to be polished as well!
Right away Sir Bart!
This rug will have to be cleaned as well. Surely you'll have time for this as well?
I live only to serve.
And what of this gown? What is this doing here?
Perhaps one of the Ladies dropped it in her haste to attend to the king?
Then you will find its owner and return it also! Why are you still standing here? Get to it!

agent_personas: I am a bear from deep in the wood. I spend my days hiding in my lair. I can smell a change in the forest.
I am a county hiker. I like to tramp through the forest. I love nature.

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: RAWWWRRRRR
Eek! Please do not eat me good bear. I am full of junk food and soda - I would be very bad for your arteries
**thinks to himself, Gosh, why do humans always assume were going to eat them** Whose there? As I can  not see through this thick fog!
It is I, a hik ... erm, a large and hungry tiger
Do not like to me human, I can smell your fear! It stinks, the smell gets so bad that I normally hide in my lair to get rid of it!
Oh, that was the KFC I had for lunch.
You humans are vile. Are you lost? It is to cold to be out here roaming around.
I admit to being a little lost but ordinarily I know these woods well
I have never smelt you in these woods before.
I normally give bear territory a wide berth. Why aren't you hibernating anyway?
I spelt a change in the forrest, It awoke me!
you traditionally wake in a bad mood don't you?
Of coarse I do! I am a bear!
Well just ease off there buddy. I just want to find my way to the nearest Burger King

agent_personas: I am a snake. Snakes are not regarded as important in the realm. I kill rodents and chickens.
I live in a small pond in the middle of the woods. I spend my day looking for food around the pond. I always keep a lookout for predators so I can run away.

setting.name: Bog
setting.description: Frogs croak in the reeds that surround the bog. The water is very murky and underneath the surface tadpoles dart around. There are minimal places to stand to stay dry.
setting.background: The frogs have made a home in the murky waters of the bog because they are able to hide from predators more easily. The seldom need to be on dry ground and there are a surplus of bugs for them to consume. The reeds are so tall that when birds land on them the frogs can see them and swim quickly away.

speech: Hissss... I wisssh there was a spot of sssun here.  All this damp is getting in my sssscales.
You know, my cousin Rita is a speech therapist on the Big Pond. She can probably work with you on that lisp.
Inssssolent frog!  A noble sssnake like myself always sssspeaks in such a way.  It is a mark of our nobility.
Lighten up snake. Hey, do you know that girl Sally who sells seashells by the seashore?
Are you...sssssasssing...me... little frog.
It's the perk of being poisonous. It's like having a super power.
It would be worth your dessstruction even if it doomed me to have your voice be ssssilent.  But enough of this meaninglesssssss... chatter.  I came here with a purpossse.
You came to the bog for a purpose? Maybe I can help.

There is a particularly taassssty fish that my Lord King bid me fetch for him.  It do sssso would grant me power beyond my... sssomewhat meager title.  It is of a golden hue and ssssmells very strongly of elderberriessss.
Okay, I'll help you get him. Do you have a plan?
Truthfully thisss place is not well known to me.  I have covered but a fraction if this sssmelly bog.  Do you know of any sssuch fish? Or any who have traverssed these lands?
I'm not sure. How big is this fish? Is his name Chuck? There's a fish named Chuck who kind of looks like that.
I would be intrigued to me thisssss... Chuck.  But do not alert him to my presence.
Oh yeah, I'll help you get Chuck. None of us frogs like Chuck at all.

agent_personas: I am a chef from a far off kingdom.  I travel the region to cook regional delicacies for the local nobles.  Often the local nobles ask me to cook dishes require rare ingredients.  I make sure to charge high fees to cook exotic delicacies.
I work at the local tavern.  I enjoy talking to the soldiers that frequent the tavern.  I steal tips from the change of the patrons.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: What kind of a crowd do we have out there tonight?
Ugh, the usual rowdy lot.  I tell ye, soldiers all be well and good for a chat, but they expect a little too much in the handsy department.  Look, but don't touch, aye?
Just remember that you're splitting tips with the kitchen so be nice and friendly.
Oi!  I earn em coins, fair and square.  What's innit fer me if I have ta worry about the likes of you takin what little coin I get?
More leg, less lip and we'll both get enough tips to be happy, now get that food served while it's still warm.

Ya know what.  I've had it up ta here with yer attitude.  I'm out there, smiling while getting pinched and prodded, and yer back here, all cushy with the food.  And don't think I ain't be seeing ye stealing a nip er two when ye think I ain't looking!
That is because I am a talented chef  who has traveled the world. And you, well..I'm sorry I can't think of anything nice to say about you.
Ha!  Maybe in yer wildest dreams.  If you be soooo talented, then why are ye cookin' in a dinky backwater place like this.  This isn't exactly cookin' fer the King immself, is it?!
None of you deserve my talents. I've cooked food for the most powerful kings in all the world.
Ah, yes, please by all means, serve the mead ta the custom out front.  I'd love ta see ya try and do what I do.  You wouldn't even last a minute!
Oh now you're worried about serving customers. That plate of food has been there for 20 minutes.
Aye, yer all talk til there's work ta be done.  Ya know what, I've had it!  You can go be serving the soldiers yerself.  I quit!
Oh no please don't quit. We can never go on without...JUST KIDDING. Don't let the door hit you on your way out!
And I'll be takin' THESE fer the wages ye keep "fergetting" ta give me!
action: steal coin from a serving wench
steal mug of mead from a serving wench
give mug of mead to a serving wench

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Oof. What a performance. I guess I should really work on some new material.
Our king is always pleased with your performance. Come, Jester, look at our beautiful castle grounds.
The rotten fruit I've been picking out of my ear canal would bear evidence otherwise.
See? Your wittiness is evident even after your performances. I will consult the chef regarding serving larger fruit in the future.
The last thing I need is a face full of melon! Thank the gods for ale.
I'll give you my Royal Insignia in exchange for your ale.
Brother, you and I both know that those are personally inscribed. It would do me no good to carry it.
It was worth a try. Where will you spend your time until the next performance?
Perhaps in the royal library? Maybe increasing my vocabulary will be useful in creating new stories and jokes.
I think that would be a splendid idea.
Hey! Stop doing that so loudly, you know those are contagious.
Well, then I'll need some entertainment. Do you happen to know anyone available?
Hardy-har. If you're in need of something really funny to look at, allow me to point toward the nearest mirror.
I can see why you have fruit in your eardrums

agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hoy there! Anything interesting happen this shift?
Same old same old. Making sure nobody stabbed the king on his chamber pot. How about you brother?
I got to throw a drunk noble out of the banquet hall. Lord Bartley's cousin or some such.
Ha ha ha ha, I bet the old goat deserved it. Say, who's the girl sitting on the bed over there?
Ah right, forgot you haven't been here long. This here's Matilda. She brews the best ale this side of Hornsby, runs the tavern down in the town.
Well she sure is a pretty wench! Ale you say? I could do with a tankard.... or 7.
Now you're talking! So how are you liking the guard's life? better than farming turnips?
Sure is! I had never slept in a room with only small cracks in the walls before. And there is no money in turnips since they started breeding those giant ones over by Canterbury.
This is for the ale, Matilda, and some extra for you if you bring some of that gooseberry mead. Say, do you drink mead ... er... sorry forgot your name
Baldric. And gods yes I drink mead! Doesn't everyone? Matilda, you don't happen to have a sister do you?
I don't think she does, but there are plenty of fine lasses around the tavern for a bachelor like yourself
I bet the girls just love a man in uniform. Shall we blow this smelly barracks and go down to the tavern?
The missus is expecting me back tonight, but go drink a pint for me.
Oh, a married man. Well I shall drink a pint to your goodwifes health and dally an extra maiden on my knee in your honour. Farewell for now!

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: sitting room
setting.description: the sitting room has a goat's skin as a sitting place in front of the cottage's fireplace that is just a fire burning in a pit. It is incredibly small
setting.background: the sitting room is used to entertain guests but also serves as the main room such as the kitchen and bedroom.

speech: Ahh a warm fire after traveling in this rain all day. Doesn't get any better than this.
Nope, a plate of food, a blanket.  Have you heard of the road ahead?  Any talk of Bandits?
Not as of late. But when I came through here a few months back it was thick with them. The king had to send down a whole regiment to clean em out.
Well that makes me feel a little better.  I know they are bad in the East, but that's the only place we can get the spices of value.
I've got to try some of this roast goat. Last time I was here it was amazing.
I'm in too.  I think I'll make myself at home and relax a while before we journey on.
You in a hurry to get on the road again. Seems like traders are often that way.
Well time is money, but roast goat is worth sticking around for.  What brings you to this cottage?
I'm travelling back home to see the wife and kids. Been working out West.
I'm sure they will be glad to see you.  How long have you been gone?
About four months or so. It's amazing how much the little ones change in a short time.

I hope you have a better wife than I do.  Mine could not wait the long months I was away.  She had taken up with my brother when I got back home.  I guess I can't blame her.  It's a lonely life being a wife of a traveling merchant.
Your brother. That's a sad tale there. I hope you gave him a good beating when you found out.
No, I did not.  I just packed my bags and left without a word.  No use in fighting.  Just keep moving on, that's my motto.

agent_personas: I am a easy going creature. I like to sleep and travel around the grasslands. I dislike it when birds are around as they make me nervous and uneasy.
I'm a rodent that lives in the castle. I eat the old grain stored here. I am not well fed this year.

setting.name: Hidden passageway
setting.description: This is a narrow underground path that is surrounded by stone walls and a dirty and grimy floor.  Many insects and rodents dwell here underneath the temple.
setting.background: This is a hidden passageway used for escape.  This is typically used when the temple members fear an assault on the main building.

speech: It is quite filthy here isn't it.
My kind of place.  I just wish they had a better harvest spoil this year, I'm starving!
It has been rather dry in that area hasn't it. I just glad theres none of those darn birds down here!
Tell me about it.  They don't generally come underground though.  Got anything good from the left over temple offerings?  Any human sacrifices?  Old Goat skin?  I'm not picky.
I may have some goat skin, let me check for you!
That would be great.  I've been scrounging around the castle all day, but they are all paranoid about the black plague.  They see one rat and they lose their mind.
I mean, can you blame them? That nasty thing killed many of good people!
Good people, Ha!  The king is a tyrant! It would do the Kingdom good to have a good does of the plague with that one.
I hope some of them birds get the plague, I could do with out a few of them.
Yeah, I'm with you on that.  Those hawks are always trying to steal my family.   How's the priest does he believe in pest control?
Fortunately for us, since he goes along with that fairy tale, he does not believe in killing! We should be safe until someone else find out were down here. Like the hawks
Surely the hawks won't come under ground.  I was told they wouldn't.  Have I been lied to?  What about that goat?
Ah I finished it off, I apologize. We can start on the priest if you like? He seems to be getting pretty old.
He seems like a willing victim.  I wish he wasn't so big on fasting, I could use a little more meat on the bones.
room_objects: an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
an a dirty and grimy floor
