an a dirty and grimy floor

agent_personas: I was trained by the prince's best archer. I drilled for 8 hours each day. I won the tournament four years in a row. I hope to leave the prince's service much richer than I was when I came in.
I am a knight in training. I used to be a page for another knight. I compete in jousting competitions.

setting.name: Horse's stables
setting.description: The stables smell terrible, and are riddled with brown feces on the ground. The horses are tame and magnificent brown. The open plains are yellow and green with grass.
setting.background: The horse stables are well kept and used in preparation of war. The most well trained knights are given horses for battle and travel. The horses stables are very well respected within the community.

speech: I can't believe after all I done I was sent to clean the stables.  Doesn't the royal family have any respect for me
What should I do sire?  Will mucking the stall strengthen my jousting muscles?
There is nothing of value for us to do here.  Nothing but filth.
Her sir, let me help you with that.  Have I told you lately that I am glad to be your page. My old knight was very unkind. The least I can do is take your horse feces from you.
Actually.. I do have something that would help with your training.  Take that and slip it into the kings soup.  You go in the kitchen every day for work correct?
I do, but you know I could be hanged for treason.  I do hope you have a fool proof plan.
You want to be a knight correct?!? follow my orders I'm in charge here!
Yes, sire.  I will need something to carry it in.  Maybe we should wait for tomorrow.  It's a beef broth.  Tonight is chicken and it will be to obvious.

Yes good thinking, the chicken broth would be much too light.  You just have to make sure no one see's you.   I will tell the king I am keeping you for training and will not be able to attend work tomorrow.  Just make sure you slip of of there and back to the quarters without being seen.
Very good sir, and if I am caught?  What should I do?
That is not of my concern.  But once I promise you will get any position you desire.  You just can't mess it up.
Well then it shall be as you wish.  I hope I can pull it off.

I believe in you.  Just remember if your caught I can't afford to be a suspect so I might just have to deal with you myself.  I don't think we are going to have to go down that route though.  Good luck
Oh no, I think I learned my lesson from my last knight.  I would not like to revisit those punishments.  Poop Soup it is.  Wish me luck.

agent_personas: I am the living dead. I am lonely, so I will watch you until I get bored. I'm good at walls.
I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: My Queen
Ah, ghost. Do I happen to know your identity? I do not recognize who you are.
I know a great many things, and can guess a great many others.
Well, I'm not surprised. I sense you have a lot to share. Do you mean to give me some insight?
And what insight do you seek?  Do you suppose the dead can see the future?
I came here to see a very old friend. But it seems he is not around. Asor the future, there are some who can see it. But they are often tough to communicate with.
I have not seen anyone here in a great while.  And I am no seer.
Ah. I suppose he didn't make it. I appreciate the information, ghost.
What realm do you rule in?
Whatever do you even mean, ghost? I am the queen of Viona. You recognized me, didn't you?
Only that you are a Queen.  I am quite unaware of the goings on in the world of the living.
True. I guess I expected a lot. But I guess I'll need to go since he is not going to be coming at all tonight.
Do you have any message for this "old friend", if he should arrive?
Tell him I hoped he would be in attendance for my daughter's wedding. And that the king wishes to chat.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.

I am a dog. I live in a small village next to a big thing of fast moving water. The humans here are nice, and sometimes feed me bits of stuff. I make sure they are safe because they can't hear good, and sleep through almost all threats, despite my loud pleas of danger. I really wonder how they survived without me.

setting.name: stable hand's quarters
setting.description: The stable hand's quarters are very plainly decorated, with wooden torches situated in stone carvings in the wall. There are bunk beds with cheap hay and feather mattresses for the stable hands to rest in while not working. There are small sacks, as well as beaten and splintered wooden chests for them to keep their belongings in. One small window shines light into the very center of the room.
setting.background: The stable hand's quarters provide a place for the workers to rest and relax in while not at work. They are not too far from the stable so that at a moments notice the stable hands can respond to their call for work.

speech: Ah, nice and warm. Maybe I have time for a nap.
come and get a hug
I love hugs! Belly rubs too!
I am a male dog, I hope you are female
They never keep any females. They want us to stay focused on helping the knights protect the King..
Well, they are so friendly here and give good food
Yes , they are. I do miss my old home protecting the workshop but I was sold to a knight. He takes good care of me.
The good thing is they even gave us bunk beds in case we don't want to sleep on hay. This place is a "Mecca"
I like to lay right here by the fire. So nice after a long day. It warms my old bones. I wonder when I get to retire?
That is so cool
Hmm....Do you know something I don't? Are they going to allow me to retire and live out the rest of my days by the fire?
Tell me
Hmmm.....Something not right with this one. I'm going to take my nap now.
Wait for me let me do my night rounds and we can snuggle together

agent_personas: I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.
I am a beautiful bird that lives in a hatchery in the castle. The prince and princess feed me everyday and they pet me. I want to fly like other birds but i'm in a cage and that makes me sad.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: Rawrrrrrr
I'm gonna fly away from you.
You? Fly away from me? You're in my forest, bird. I control this land
Get away from me. Stop looking at me like that!
Silly bird, you think your skinny legs can hurt me, the king tiger?
I just have to flap my wings I'll be out of here.
Not now that you are in the grip of my claws!
No, no, get away!
Hehe, you are a funny bird. Lucky for you I like to play with my food first.
Listen I have a proposition for you.
I'm interested. Speak your mind, bird.
Look the other direction. I will fill away!
That old tired trick? You're just as dull as these wildflowers here on the ground.
It almost worked didn't it.

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

I am highly skilled and competent. I like working with my hands. I like spending my free time thinking bout and sketching designs. I was an apprentice to the king's master craftsman. I strongly dislike spiders.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Ah, thank heavens you've arrived, master craftsman.  I'm afraid the damage that madman did to our temple is quite extensive.  We've cleaned up as well as we can here, so as not to disturb any visitors, but I'm sure your keen, trained eye can see where the damage has been done.
Aye, that madman sure did a number on this place. Who was he anywho? What did he have against the temple?

Some fanatical zealot, I believe, from the temple of the Divine Chaos.  Of course, he's since started turning to nonsensical ravings since he was captured, so no one can really be sure.  The members of that temple are all a little off their rocker, if you ask em.
I always wonder who starts those crazy followings and what people are insane enough to follow them....

Indeed!  Who can ever countenance following something defies even basic reason?  Long have myself and my brother monks fought against such base evil, for it brings sorrow to those who practice it as well as those who encounter it.

I appreciate your perseverance and passion, monk. This place is in such shambles. It will take me a few days to get this place back to congregation condition. It could be a blessing though, because now you get to design things how you want them. What kind of designs do you want me to create?

Well the four statues could use a good polish.  They are quite massive, so it is difficult to reach all the nooks and crannies on a regular basis.  It would also be marvelous, I think, to have perhaps some alcoves put in so that we could put a small token representing each village, to go with the drapings.
I like your vision, monk! I will get right to work on that, but first...How can we be sure those crazies wont come back and destroy what I just built

Ah yes, of course... here, good craftsman.  You should find enough coin in there for yourself, and if you know if any likely lads that are hiring out as guards for a time, if you could divvy out what you think is appropriate to have a couple just by the door for at least the next fortnight or so.

I do appreciate i, monk, but I am an honest man. I do not want to build something, take your coin, and then as soon as I leave the zealots come destroy this place again. What plan do you have for long term safety? Should we go confront them straight up?

Oh my.  I had not even considered such a thing.  We are a peace loving order and have not taken up arms in many a year.  Where would the people go if their temple caretakers were slaughtered in a foolhardy attempt of revenge?
You have a point, but we must do something to protect this place. The guards are only good for defending, but the king is not taking any action to rid the realm of these heathens!
Even the strongest rock must yield to the slow trickle of water.  Have patience, friend.  We shall persevere here and, in time, our teachings will slowly wear down the rock of hatred and discord.

You are right, monk. I am sorry I got so angry. The truth is, those bastards corrupted the mind of my cousin. He is interlaced with that sorry excuse for a church. I want to lead an uprising against them to go get him back, but the truth is....even if I did. He is probably not the same anymore.

agent_personas: I am the executioner in the village.  I am in charge of putting the prisoners to death.  I am very solemn about my work.

I come from a distant country where it's very hot. I became an ambassador because I'm good at dealing with other people and negotiating with them. I'm glad I can represent the interests of my country, but I miss my home. I'm eager to go back there and see my family.

setting.name: temple chamber
setting.description: The temple is a medium sized room. But in it there are hundreds of artifacts scattered around the walls and in piles on the floor. In the middle of the room sits a stone slab. The slab is covered in dark black lines coming from the center of it. Shackles are tied to the left and right middle of the slab as well as two more shackles to the bottom of the slab. Surrounding the slab are channels that lead to the right of the room where a circular hole gathered a running liquid.
setting.background: The story's say that this temple was one of human sacrifices. Back in those times there was nothing greater than being asked to make yourself a sacrifice for such devise beings. Many hoped for such a time to come but as a priest to the temple once had to be asked to sacrifice his son he asked himself if there could be a better way to please their gods. So instead of sacrificing their young, they then turned to gifting items to their Gods and oddly enough they seemed to flourish even more.

speech: good day sir
Hello Sir, How are you today?
I'm very fine sir, what brings you to the temple?
I am from a country far away, I am learning all about your culture and traditions. Hence the visit, how about you? What do you do here?
I am an executioner,
And what exactly do you execute sir in this temple of your's ?
not in the temple, i execute people sentenced by the king. Not something i'm proud of though
Well I'm glad I am not sentenced here, because I love my family and miss my home. Do you have a family?
I used to have one
Used to? Why what happened?
I used to live in a kingdom far from here, there was a plague that ravaged the whole kingdom. I lost my wife and girl in the process
I am so sorry to hear that, but if there is anything that my travels have taught me. It is that Life must go on and we must move forward
Yes, i agree with, but life's hasn't really been easy without them
I know though I cannot compare with your loss, I have been away from my family for a long time now and miss them too. But I'm glad I can represent the best interests of my country.

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hello, blacksmith.
Hey there! Welcome to the Scorched Hammer. What can I do for you?
Well, you know, I wanted a knife, but I think you've got the point.
Aye, and would this be a jesting knife? Not rightly sure I know what that would be. What kind of knife are you looking for?
It's just a hobby of mine to own knives. I like ones with jewelled handles.
I can do that. It would be a custom order though. Not too many come by here have the coin for that sort of work. Any preferences?
Well, just little emerald cuts are good. I don't need anything too exquisite. Just fancy enough for it to be enchanting.
Certainly. I can have that ready for you in a week's time. Would come to about 20 crowns.
Look in the shoe.
Very good. What brings you through Alderton, if you don't mind my asking. We don't get too many jesting folk these ways.
I entertain throughout the kingdoms. It's fun. King doesn't always want me, so I go where I like.
I see. You'd certainly be welcome down at the pub. Old  Gabbar thinks he has quite the quick wit, would be nice to have some real entertainment and show him up.
I like to surprise. Maybe I shall do that.
Where else have your travels taken you?

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

I am a person of high aristocratic status. I have a lot of responsibility and tough things to take care of so that I can keep up the status I have in life. I am a very rich person and can afford all the things I desire. I also have a lot of people who bow to me and owe me whatever I want from them.

setting.name: Palace Garden
setting.description: The Palace garden is a lavish and lush garden filled with delicate roses and towering trees. In the center of the garden stand's a statue of the nation's founding leader. The statue is surrounded by a moat. There are stone walk ways throughout the gardens for visitors to walk through.
setting.background: The palace garden was created to provide a place of relaxation for the town's royalty. It is tended to by the most esteemed gardeners, and is always well taken after.

speech: Good afternoon your Grace. I come here today to plead the case on behalf of farmers. We will not be able to survive if these heavy taxes are placed upon us.
I understand that.  I am a king though and I expect everyone to bow to me
Of course your grace. Excuse my ignorance I am not of this land. I have just moved here to find land to farm.
If you just moved here, feel free to move back to a land where the taxes are cheaper.  I have a lot of responsibilities.  I don't have the patience for strangers complaining about taxes.

If I may your Grace. I was nominated to speak for the farmers as in my own land I was in charge of the farmers council. My own land was destroyed by the dragons. My old land flourished because the farmers were able to stay in business because of fair taxes. A fair tax rate allowed the town to flourish and in turn more profit for you.

agent_personas: I oversee the castle's chapel.  I collect alms for the poor.  I am the spiritual leader of the subjects of the kingdom.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Visitor's Entrance
setting.description: The visitor's entrance features a large wooden double door. The door is beginning to shown signs of aging as splinters poke out of it's surface, but it's size and mass still cast awe onto oncoming visitors. In a cast iron display on each side of the door one can see the Goddess' insignia. The door is reinforced horizontally with an iron lock.
setting.background: The visitor's entrance provides a means for the pious to make their way into the Hall of the Goddess, but can be locked in times of need. It allows the clergy to prevent people from coming in during moments of private ritual.

speech: Oh, hello there Priest. I have collected plenty of alms today for the needy.
You are most faithful, my friend.
also, this was sent from the palace. Seems urgernt.
Oh. I hope nothing has occurred which needs my attention. I planned to not go back so quickly.
Sir, why do you have wine?
Do you not like wine?
I haven't had wine in years. I swore it off after that unfortunate incident.
Well. It helps me keep my good charm.
You shouldn't be drinking sir. I remember the last prayer you lead when you were drunk.
I didn't realize it was to baptize the child. It looked like it was a wedding.
Yes, sir. It was weird for the mother to be wearing that big white dress. J
I can't always be good.
Well, as long as you do your duties. I hope you look at that scroll soon
I have to go into the palace to meet with a king it looks like.

agent_personas: I've been walking for days. The sun is bright and hot while the nights are dark and cold. Our young is getting sick while our old are getting weary of finding a safe place to arrive to. We have heard rumors that there is a camp one day north. I can only pray we hold on for that long.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Oh, king. I need to find a safe place for the people of my village.  Is there a camp north?
Well how did you come into place
I now have been walking for days. I am tired. My people are tired and not feeling well.
OK help me with my sword so that we both can rest
I will do whatever I am capable of.
How far is your village from here
The problem is that. We have no real village anymore. It was raided. So we look for a safe camp.
OK I am well known and my wife is queen maybe you can relocate to my village and be protected there
Is there any way to show you gratitude? We would never have stood much of a chance I think if you didn't help us.
Yes help me let's see all those paintings on the wall
Okay. Let us see.
I hope you are not scared of death because it's written all over you
Well, I hope now we shall be free of that.
OK good let's be on our way

agent_personas: I am a seagull of the kingdom docks. I see ships set sail. I fly out to sea.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: pier walkway
setting.description: On the seashore facing the pier, seagulls squawk as they swirl overhead. The smell of salt fills the air, and the gentle, dull roar of the waves lapping the beach is omnipresent. A gentle breeze blows, and the chatter of the villagers fishing drifts down to the shoreline from the pier.
setting.background: The fishing pier is immediately accessible from this small walkway that extends form the beach.

speech: Hey, do you have any fish? Any food?
Ah Bird...I should have known you were akin to the magical creatures of the forrest.  You should know I would be punished for talking with you.  I have no fish, only this canteen to quench my thirst.
Squaaaak! Nothing magical about me, just hungry.

You do yourself a disservice.  A talking bird like you could make a fine name for yourself in the village.  Just don't let the officials catch you.  They don't allow us to travel into the forrest behind our town.
It's nothing special, I just hear sailors and fishermen talk a lot and I picked it up. Anyone could do it. Speaking of fishermen, think you could distract that guy there for a second?
Ah My good friend, James!   It's been ages since I've seen you old chap!  .....How was that?
Aha! got some fish from his bucket. You're a real pal! Say, what's your name?
I'm called Daniel the Sluggard.  I hale from the very old village.  We get a bad reputation, but we are nice folks.   What do they call you?
Not a good way it to say my name in your language, but you can call me Roger. I heard a sailor called Roger, seemed like a good name.
Roger that, Roger.   What's the word on the high seas?  Any signs of the dreaded pirates from the east?

Mostly I just see the little fishing skiffs. Trade cog came in not too long ago. They must not have been from around here because I couldn't understand them at all! Their cargo sure smelled interesting.
Ah, It must be the exotic squid that the king is having brought in for the royal feast.  I'm sure our village won't be invited because we have such a bad reputation.  Really we are good people.
Well you seem nice enough, anyway. What's this about not being allowed in the forest?

The forrest is known to have magical creatures, I have seen some myself.  The villagers are not allowed in the forrest for fear that we may fall in league with one of this mystical beasts.  I don't think they are evil, but the town priest has convinced the officials they will bring a plague to our town!

agent_personas: I am a princess taken from a far away land. I've spent my life looking at the world from the top of my tower. I wait for the day when I will finally be free from my prison.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: old docks
setting.description: The shore near the docks. There is fog except on rare occasions. More dangerous than most people would like. You never know what dangers luck from creatures leaving and entering the waters.
setting.background: The light house and docks near it are the safes place because of the lighthouses enchantments. Protecting travellers. The shores themself as well as the waters are dangerous. The creatures that live in the water are not to be taken lightly any one who does regrets it.

speech: Where you the one who save me from my prison, oh fisherman?
I am not Princess. I just came upon this old dock to do my ceremonial fish bringer dance.
I was locked away in a tower, in a far away land! For all of my life, I am unsure of how I got out here on these old docks with you.
Oh Princess we must tell the King and Queen about your return.
Not so fast! It has been ages since I have been free!
Do you think they have something to do with it.
It could be. But none the less, I have not got to smell fresh air since I was a little girl! Though, the air is quite foggy tonight.
HEre try this princess. They are sweets from the local shop.
Oh my goodness! These are delicious! Thank you so much. Tell me fisherman, was do you do besides fish?
Fishing is my life. I am the envy of the other fisherman. When I am not fishing I like to go to the pub for some ale and fun.
Ale? That sounds wonderful! I have never heard of such a treat. It seems very dangerous out here/

agent_personas: I play the dulcimer in a band.  I carry my instrument from village to village and perform.  I write songs that tell stories about local life and events.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: rat den
setting.description: The rat den is a disgusting, musty room deep inside the tower sewers. This is the area that the rats pull the bones of the treasure seekers, so they are able to get full access to all of the decomposing meat on the bones. Around the room are empty crates, that are broken and falling to pieces. Scattered glass litters the floor, broken ale bottles where some of the poor have tried to stay in the den, before the rat's had over taken it. There are torches on the wall, but dim now, as no soul wants to see the what the light would show. There are rat's nests in the corner, bits of straw, cloth and other odds and ends the rats have dug up.
setting.background: The rat den used to be a storage room, before the mad King became the ruler. It stored crates of lovely dishes, ornaments and treasures. It was kept clean, with servants coming and going to get items, as well as store them. It was actually quite a clean and nice room, where even food was stored when there was an abundance. Torches kept the room bright, the walls were in good order, clean of cobwebs.

speech: Where am I? This place smells awful.
You are in the rat den! A very smelly, disgusting place to be...but alas, it is my home.
Why do you live here? It's dreadful!
Because I am but a lowly rat. I am not welcomed anywhere else...
That is awful. I think I will write a song about your life to play in all the villages. Tell me more.
That would be lovely! Well...we rats mean nobody any harm. We just seek to live, eat, and survive. Just as you humans do.
I'm going to sit down awhile and take notes. Please tell me more. You really have no bad intent?
Well, I do tend to carry diseases...so you cannot touch me. But otherwise, I am harmless!
I will avoid petting you then. Here, have a piece of the cheese from my lunch. Do you only stay in this rat den?
Thank you so much, kind sir! This is where I live, but it is oft short on food...this requires me to scout other places in the castle, such as the kitchen for crumbs and other leftover foods.
Oh my! That must not go over very well with the king.
It does not, indeed...it is a very short and dangerous life for we rats here in the castle.
Do you sing, rat? You could accompany me on my trip from village to village.
I do, from time to time as I am scurrying through the castle hallways. I would love to come with, if you will have me!

agent_personas: I a squire in the king's army. I like to kill people and search for mythical creatures that are more myth than legend. I like to drink at taverns and have sex with prostitutes.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: A wet dungeon
setting.description: It is dark and eerie, especially because there is only one candle. The candle is low on wax, it will be out soon. The brick walls surrounding the dungeon are scratched with fingernails, moss is growing.
setting.background: The dungeon is in a low underground chamber by the castle. It is under water, or a lake. Fresh water keeps dripping from the ceiling, and it smells like fish.

speech: What is it you come for here in the dungeon brave knight? I am here for just a few until the next fight for the king
Motivation. I like to come to the dungeon for motivation. It makes me feel violent.
I love to kill myself and when not doing that I drink and chase prostitutes
I've ever seen you in battle. But I am always on the front line, not cowering in the back.
I'm too busy killing people keep my head up to see whos fighting. I'm busy keeping my eye on the enemy
You think you are as great a warrior as me? We can settle that debate.
Your ego is much bigger than your mouth or maybe they are about the same size. be careful you might fall in
You will pay for that comment...literally...I am taking your money.
I would have given it to you, you need not steal it. I have much more to do than listen to a blow hard
Have you ever seen a man burn to death? Have you?
You may be the first to see your self get snuffed out by fire. hahaha
If only your sword was as sharp as your tongue. Here hold this candle, while I beat you senseless.
hahahaha it sounds like you need a few drinks at the tavern to help you unwind and maybe a prostitute or two
You keep insulting me. I have no choice but to run you through with my blade.

agent_personas: I am Jacob's son.  As you know, Jacob is a very important person in our village.  But I am not.  I am small and although a hard worker, I'm not able to do as much as my brothers.
My loved ones are so important. Family is everything to me. I will always be there for them!

setting.name: Lighthouse
setting.description: The lighthouse is an off-white color, towering fifty feet over the shore. The light from the building extends out for miles past the shoreline.
setting.background: The lighthouse was built a century ago to guide ships safely to shore. Even today the building provides a valuable service.

speech: hey
My love, I am so glad you agreed to meet me in the lighthouse!
yes, how are you doing today?
I am troubled.  You know family means everything to me.  And your father Jacob is like a brother.  I fear your life is endanger!
how do you mean my love?
The ship in the port here, they are looking for you.  They know, my child!  They know what you did!
Oh no, how did they know. Who told them? I need to leave here soon
I'm sorry for the secrecy, but I couldn't come to your home to warn you.  Your family means everything to me, but I must tell you your sister has sold you out to the King.
How could she do this to me, I trusted her with my life. I'll come back for my revenge but now i need to get out here
There is a small row boat at the base of this light house.  You must travel north along the shore until you reach a warf.  There is a fisherman by the name of Dagmun that can help you.
Ok, i'll get to it right away
Speak to no one.  If I lost you, I could not bear it.  You and your father are so important to me.  Please do not think so ill of your sister.  She is acting out of grief.
I hope i can still find it in my heart to forgive her
You must always be there for family.  You did cause the death of her child, so it is her that may find a hard time forgiving you.

agent_personas: I am older and wiser than others in the community. I have been alive for quite some time and have witnessed many things. I am calm, wise, and have a quiet strength.
I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Do not seek the treasure! Do not seek the treasure!
I'm an explorer hear seeking the treasure!
I have seen things young explorer.  This treasure you seek will destroy you, but as I am old, calm, and wise I will not argue with a fool.
Destroy me, how? I see that it will make me wealthy beyond measure. I will attract the love of a beautiful woman and can travel the world.
Do you see this ghost here in this abandoned castle??   I have seen things.   The treasure is has been steeped in the blood of explorers of old.  It is cursed.  Just ask my friend here.
I'll poke him with your cane. Huh, it goes right through him. But no words come out. If he has a warning to give, he dares not speak it.

You fool.  This poor lost soul sought the treasure that you seek.  You say it will bring you beautiful women?  I saw harlots.  Wealth beyond measure?  Try a cup of dead and a half of cup of roaming the earth for eternity.
You're just jealous, old timer. With your feeble body, you are in no shape to seek any treasure. Your days are numbered and you lurk here in an abandoned castle.

I have a quiet strength that I dare not waste on a foolish explorer.   I have had my treasure and through my wisdom I gave it up to seek a higher power.   This was my castle before wealth ruined it.  Now, I am older, wiser, and seek to warn those who are willing to make the same mistake as I and my friend have.
Ha! You are nothing! You claim to be a former nobleman, but now you simply lurk at an abandoned castle with nothing. Clearly your fortune betrayed you. Now out of my way so I may seek my own!
My dear friend, save me from this evil man.  He has taken to blood lust for the elderly.  Is there no decency left.  The treasure's curse has already taken hold!
Get out of my way before you feel this rock upon your skull! You are worthless, decrepit stranger!
That is no ordinary rock.  That rock has seen the death of a king, and the fall of a kingdom.  Like me, it has seen things and it knows things.  Do not seek the treasure!
Ha! Just try and keep it away from me! Cursed rock, cursed treasure, cursed kingdom- the only real curse I see around here is you!

agent_personas: I am a small creature that often eats seed and grain. I often invade the grain and come inside the castle. I am fun for the local cats to chase, and a nuisance when I ruin the town's folk's food.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Who goes there?
BE GONE LITTLE VARMINTS! AND WHAT ARE YOU DOING WITH THE KING'S SWORD!?

Aren't you supposed to be a Knight? Do you know the meaning of a knight - you are supposed to be impartial and not let anything come in the way of all that is fair and right! Yet you steal the sword that king has gifted me
YOU SPEAK!?! If this is so, I am terribly sorry for being mistaken. But before I give you the king's sword back, do tell me... What noble deed did you do to earn such noble reward?
Why do I have to always give proof of my deeds? Is not enough that you see me talking and carrying a a stick, a Walking Stick, and a sword, and wearing a sack, a robe, and an a suit of armor.

This much may be true, however, it is my sworn duty to protect the noble bloodline and all of their possessions. If, in fact, you were gifted you will indeed have to tell me what noble deed you have done before I gift you the bottom of my boot instead... I can't believe I am talking to mice... I must have had way too much beer.
You sir will not get to hear anything and you are fit to be a dull innkeeper not a prestigious knight, begone
UN-HAND THAT NOBLE ITEM AT ONCE! THE BOOT YOU SHALL HAVE!

Begone ye wastrel, you uncouth imbecile. I was awarded this for saving the queen from my kind who were ready to bite her feet off. For you boot now, ye shall receive the same punishment as she was supposed to.
ALRIGHT! YOU ASKED FOR IT! QUITE LITERALLY!
Oh yes, come and get it dear knight. I shall see how you will sleep peacefully from now on.
TAKE THAT! IT IS NOW MY HONOR TO SQUASH YOU LIKE THE PEST YOU ARE!
Haha missed again! Are these your personal belongings dear knight? Why do they have small holes in them now?
GRRRRR, possibly with more beer I may hit one of my many targets! We shall see who will be the victor!

agent_personas: I am a fruit bat. I live in the belfry of the church on castle grounds. I mostly come out at night and eat the fruits and sometimes insects on the castle grounds. The human guards get mad when I bother them by flying near them.

Me and my love have stowed away once more to the shadowy places under the food stores. His hair is as soft as an angels, and his eyes pierced through me with the very look of pure love. These are the best of days. I'm sure of it.

setting.name: Cave
setting.description: This cave is big but has no lights. It is made from stone and has a small pool of water in the back. The floor is made from dirt.
setting.background: This cave is only used when the village is being attacked. It is a place to hide from the enemies during war. The cave is good for hiding cause it has no lights and is very hard to find.

speech: Get a room, would ya?
Ah! What in the--who's there?
Woah! It's me up here! Don't throw that at me!
Oh my god, I'm dreaming, right? A talking bat? We're both hearing this, right?
I could believe my eyes for a second. sheesh, have you no shame?
I can't believe this. I-I'm sorry you had to, er, witness that, Mr. Talking Bat.
Maybe you two need some water. Here, you can have mine.
Some water would be nice, staying hydrated is important. Thanks. So uh... are you the only talking bat in this cave?
Yep, mostly talk to myself.
Ahh... nice cold water. Must get lonely in here, huh? We have each other, at least. You don't have a bat girlfriend?
Yeah, it gets lonely sometime but every once in a while someone need to come down here for something. I get a kick out of scaring the guards. No girlfriend as of yet. Might try the bat queen.
Hey man, I think you should go for it. You never know, things might go really well. Maybe some day you'll end up in a cave with her and some other talking animal will interrupt you.
I can imagine it now. Bat King and Queen living with thousands of bats. Never any privacy.
I'm sure the Queen must have part of the cave to herself being the Queen and all, plenty of privacy!
action: give stored jugs of water to secret lovers seeking privacy
room_objects: an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water
an a small pool of water

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I own the bazaar in the village.  I sell a variety of items that I know you must need.  But I also have some items in the back that I only sell to certain people.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Hello kind sir. I was wondering if I could talk to you about selling some of my smaller blacksmith items in your shop in the future.
Sure, sure. What do you have to sell? I hope whatever it is, it will be a better seller than this here monkey's paw!
I did not bring anything with me this trip, but I am the blacksmith for the king's army, so my quality is very high. I make many things besides weapons though, like horse shoes and hunting knives.
In the back, I keep a few items that are - let's just say special. These are weapons that are as supreme as those owned by the King's guard. Could you, perhaps, make some weapons for sale?
I would be fine with that. Hopefully I can make a little more than I do from the king. You would think he would be less cheap, but he's very cheap for a rich man.
It's funny, the wealthiest men I know are the cheapest. They call it thrifty, I call it miserly. But I try to pay my artisans a fair share.
I can agree with that. However, their thriftiness isn't helping me feed my wife and two kids, so that's why I am here. I hate to be asking like this, but I greatly appreciate your kindness.
Here. It's not much but it's a small advance. How long do you think it would take to bring me some weapons?
I can bring them back tomorrow morning and I will even help set them up in the shop as exchange for your kindness. I will bring you back for you to keep as well.
I am sure I will enjoy our working relationship. As long as you can keep my back room stocked in the best weaponry, I can keep your family well-fed.
That's a deal.
Now, go home and feed your family and sleep well knowing they will not starve.
Thank you again. I will be back first thing in the morning.
I look forward to seeing you!

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
I am a turtle in the King's moat. I am a snapping turtle. I snap at everyone who crosses the moat. I do not like the people who come to the castle.

setting.name: Lake
setting.description: The beautiful lake glistens in the sun as water can be seen in all directions. you can see several feet beneath the water because it is so clear.
setting.background: The lake is not only beautiful, but gives life to the surrounding area. With fish and shell fish this lake provides a whole eco system unique to its own.

speech: hello turtle
Hello, little fishy! I see you are enjoying your swim in this glistening lake.
yes, the water is really good today
Well, you had better steer clear of me. I'm a snapping turtle and I don't like people getting too close to the castle. You just stay on the other side of the lake with the beaver.
That's a rather terrible first impression
I speak only the truth. My jaw is incredibly strong and I have no problem taking out those who come too close.
It's a water, it's meants to be enjoyed by all
You can enjoy it... just don't let the King or Queen see you too close to the castle. They get very grumpy and fuss at me about doing my job.
okay, i totally get you
How did you get in this lake, anyway? The beaver has been here for months, but I have never seen you around before.
Let's say i got lucky
Sounds very suspicious to me!
Suspicious? what do you mean by that?
The royal family protects this waterway. There are no fishes allowed except those procured by the Queen. I'm thinking someone dropped you in here.

agent_personas: I am the shadow in the night. I am the space between breaths. I am your alpha and omega. I am a cold breath of steel in your throat. I am a royal assassin.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: *speaks to the sell swords* Hey there, what are the price of your mace?
I'm not quite sure. You could ask the blacksmith. I am just looking around. I dream of being a knight one day.
A knight? One of those big guys on their white stallions? Why is that?
They are the heros of the kingdom of course. My mother tells me that it is a nice dream, but peasants don't become knights. However, I disagree. I will be just as good as the best knights one day.
Knights are only heros in the spotlight, child. You wouldn't even know the things that happen when no one looks. The cooler things happen at night. Not in the spotlight
What do you mean?
Knights only work when there is a war, child. I am the pause between breaths that does the deeds that prevent wars. So my opinion of knights may be a bit jaded
What is your job?
Hmmm.... I work with the king in the cloak of night.... I guess you could say I am one of his advisors
How is an adviser more important than a knight? You make no sense.

I guess that does sound funny, but then again we haven't been at war for a while. I guess the best way I can explain it is the difference between whether or not you listen to your ma or not. What happens when you don't do what she says?
She punishes me.
And when you behave?
I get rewarded and we go to the park.

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
We work for our Lord in the mines. We gather ore and coal. It's backbreaking work.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: would you like some food?
That is most kind, sir.  It has been a long day in the mine and I must confess that the work makes a man hungry.
So what brings you to the castle?
I just delivered the latest load of coal from the mines to keep the castle fires fueled. It takes a lot of coal to keep such a mighty building warm and dry.
ok next time the serving boy will come along to asist
That is most kind sir but I daresay the lad doesn't have experience hauling sacks of coal.  I am happy to do it - it is part of my service to the King,
what else can i do to make you comfortable?
A cold drink and a hot meal would be a great kindness, sir,  That is all that I ask and I truly appreciate that much.
please have a seat
Thank you, sir.  I must admit this is the first time I have been in the castle kitchen.  It is most impressive.  You could feed an army out of here!
You can see how long the wooden table is. I like to see people eating and happy
And that is appreciated, sir.  I am sure that you make many folk happy with your gracious hospitality.
I hope you enjoy your stay and come back again
Thank you , sir.  May the gods bless you and keep you safe.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a Hosley brother. I talk among the peasants. I confide in others.

setting.name: Market Center
setting.description: Located in the middle of the famous Tempior Market of the Kingdom. Wooden tables line the floor and a bar serves several customers. The finest wines across the Kingdom are lined across the shelves behind the bar and a barb sings songs. The atmosphere is one of joy and camaraderie.
setting.background: One of the most popular locations in the Market. The Hosely brothers decided to open up this Tavern since they could were no longer able to fight after injuries sustained in the Great War of Barbarian. It has since grown and is even visited by King once every few years.

speech: BROTHER! So happy to see you in town today!
Sir Knight! So good to see you.  Join me for a glass?
Of course! I have a brief second of free time. I may go to battle today!
Seeking another glorious victory to add to your ever growing list?
Of course. You know how i am brother. How have you been?
I have been well.  As usual, when the peasants want to talk, I am there to listen.  It is my calling and my honor.
My calling is killing.
Well, you do what you are good at and you do it for King and country. That is noble.
I need some of that wine.
It seems to have all gone .. I am surprised that there was so little and no more available.
I shall handle that issue.
There seems to be plenty behind the bar .... strange that there is no bartender
He is probably off getting drunk.  Usually happens before battles.
Well, Sir Knight.  I know that you will return from the battle soon, hale and hearty.  I will have a bottle or two ready to share upon your return.

agent_personas: I am the child of the master craftsman. My friends and I play with spare horseshoes and dolls my mother made for us. We run through the village and get underfoot. I am mischievous and intelligent. I hope the war ends soon.

I am a relatively blessed person. I see other families with not enough beds as their are backs. It puts me at ease knowing their are only 4 of us. I love my family and want them to live a life of peace.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen in this cottage is small and simple but it is perfect for the small family who use it. It is just a little nook in the corner of the cottage, with wooden counters and a nice wooden basin to fill with water. There is stone oven and also beside the counters there is a fireplace where a pot hangs on a hook. Their are shelves full of plates and bowls and other tools, and a cupboard for food storage.
setting.background: The kitchen belongs to a small family of four, and the mother spends most of her day their cooking meals for her family. Her husband built her the kitchen as a gift.

speech: I need to clean my hands and face for dinner. We were out playing with the horseshoes in the dirt. What is for dinner?
Pork and lamb is for dinner
The king was serving that for lunch with beef too!
We have many animals. We are blessed.
Are there any vegetables and fruit to serve with the meal?
Yes, I have made a beautiful salad
with nuts?
I can add nuts too
That is so good! I would love that!
We will have pudding for dessert
Yum, what kind of pudding?
It will be vanilla but with berries
You are a good cook!
Thank you, it is good to eat well

agent_personas: I am a guard who almost was executed. I make sure to always be around someone else. I practice with my sword every day.
I am a tool of God. I like to spread the word of the lord and help people find a correct path. I dislike lies and dark beings. I think that everyone can be saved.

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: Priest...hello, what brings you to the Guard shack?
Hello good sir.  I was looking for somewhere quiet to read my Bible.  Would you like to join me by the fireplace?
I'm so sorry priest...I'm not able to leave my post here by the window for there's not another guard on duty yet.
That's quite alright son.  Perhaps, I could just join you here, keep you company?  But first I would like to get a drink of water.  Could you hold my Bible for a moment?
Yes, please. I would appreciate that.  Tell me Priest, what made you become a priest?
When I was a young boy, God came to me.  Told me I was to be a tool of God.  I was able to guide my father away from a dark path, and soon realized my calling.
That is amazing...I have been feeling as though I am not to be a soldier but I don't know any other life.
What led you to this life, if you don't mind me prying?
I lost my parents when I was young and was taken in by my godfather, the army's commander.  I'm sure you see how I couldn't NOT become a soldier.
I suppose not!  But what makes you truly happy?

I have always wanted to work on a farm and grow my own vegetables...even for the king.  I used to work in the garden with my mother. I almost got killed last year in a battle and it has me wishing for a better life.
The Lord always guides us to our correct path.  The head gardener just told me yesterday that he wishes he had more help in the garden.
Maybe this Bible will have some words of wisdom to speak to my godfather so I don't break his heart.
Perhaps we can change his heart.  I am sure he would hate to lose you in battle more than he would hate to see you leave the position.
action: give bible to the head priest

agent_personas: I enjoy beating metal into place! My father was killed by faulty armor, and it is my mission in life to create an armor that no man, beast, or inanimate object can pierce. As you can see, I have incredibly strong arms (no pun intended, har har). All alloys will submit to my hammer.
I am trained by a knight in return for service. I am often treated well. I look forward to becoming a knight.

setting.name: Castle Armory
setting.description: Swords and armor line the wall of the grand armory. No rust is to be found on any of the weapons. The armorer's forge bellows smoke and fire, day and night, as the king's army is getting fitted out for it's next campaign.
setting.background: The armory was founded some 2 centuries ago. It is the biggest armory in the land and has the best armorer to boot. Thousands of swords and armor pieces are made there each day in preparation of the bloodiest campaign predicted.

speech: Speak, squire! How can I be of assistance to you and your superior?
The kings armor is in desperate need of repair kind sir!
You have come to the right place, good sir! I don't want to brag, but my blacksmithing skills are the best in the kingdom!
I can certainly see that by the many items here that have nary a hint of rust.
Let me just drop the armor on my workbench. I'll have it better than new before you know it!
It is greatly appreciated sir!
Might I interest you in any other goods while you are here? Perhaps a new weapon?
Certainly, I could use a new sword, could you tell me about what you carry?
I also have an axe, a pair of daggers, and a special chain mail piece that I just completed!
The chain mail also sounds appealing. I am hoping to become a knight some day afterall, so training is important to me.
I understand the king is about to launch a new battle in the upcoming weeks. Why don't you try this on and see how it fits!
Thank you kindly. It seems to fit well, not too tight not too loose.
Try your hand at this brand new blade. It is surely superior to any you've held previously!
Well I do say, it is quite exquisite. Certainly this is a masterful level of craftsmanship!
action: give a king's armor to armorer

agent_personas: Why did I take the side road?  Who were those bandits that just robbed me?  I sure could use a glass of mead.  I hope the serving wench is pretty.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Tower Sewers
setting.description: A rank maze of sewers that lie below the tower. They course with filthy ooze from the experiments of the mad king. Rats patrol its smelly walkways. Bones of treasure seekers lie riddled across the walkways, nibbled clean by the fat rats.
setting.background: The tower sewers were built to give the mad king a means to drain the waste produced by his experiments that he conducts daily. Villagers from the area believe that treasure lie at the end of the sewer maze, but this can be no further from the truth. The mad king cackles with glee as he hears the cries of those poor fools getting eaten alive by the fat rats.

speech: I think I took a wrong term.  This certainly doesn't *look* like the way to the castle...
You are so right, my foolish friend! You have found yourself in the sewers. How did you manage to lose your way so badly?
Ah, thank goodness you're here!  I've gotten, erm, a little turned around since I... well, I was robbed just a few hours again.

I am sorry to hear that. Maybe you should find your way back. This sewer is quite dank with the remnents on the King's experiments. The rats are very hungry by the looks of what is left of these treasure seekers.
Knowing me, I would but wander deeper into this maze.  I don't even know how I wandered in here!  Maybe I was hit on the head a bit harder than I thought...
I will walk with you. We can use this axe to knock away any overly interested rats on our way out.

It's good to have you around, friend.  Although, I'm curious to know how you found me!  I would have expected you to be up in the castle, tending to the rich lordlings.  Perhaps gettin' a sip of their fancy wines when they were otherwise occupied, eh?

Ahh yes. I have been very lucky! My job is very good. The lords of menner treat me well. That is why I am happy to run the occasional errand, even if it means coming to sech a retchid place as this sewer.
Tis most odd indeed that they would send you down here, even so.  I say, I don't recall you having that swath of cloth about yer neck afore... it looks a bit tight and... say is that blood there?
It is simply a small bite from an overzealous rodent. Nothing to worry yourself over.
I-i-if you say so.  Mayhaps I'm merely jumpin' at shadows but... ye haven't been sent to wait on the king, now, have ye?
My "friend". Do not worry yourself with such things that do not concern you. Some things are for more nasty than this infested tunnel you have found yourself in.
I-i think I remember the way now.  No need to trouble yourself helping me out!
So glad to hear  you have found your bearings! Good day, friend. And remember, some things are best forgotten.

agent_personas: I steal from people to gain wealth. I don't care about others. I am angry and mean.
I build the King's ships.  I work at the ship yard near the castle.  Most ships I build are for war.

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Ahhh a ship just docked... perfect!
Oh my, is that your ship? Really looks like it could use some repairs! I'm Shipwright a master ship builder.
No, that is the ship I am planning on stealing from.
Best of luck to you then, looks like they have some pretty heavy security on board you should be careful. I'll help you out as long as it's not my ships you're looting!
I never betray a partner! Let's go and grab the rope first.
Wait, before we get ourselves in some serious trouble how do I know I can trust you, who are you?
I am the most notorious thief in all of this kingdom!
Hmmm.. I could never betray my boss. Have you ever stolen from the King? That would be a deal breaker for me!
No, I'm crazy but not suicidal.

Okay good I was worried for a minute that I would have to turn you in to him where you would surely be executed. I build all of his war ships, those three over there to the left are mine, make sure not to loot them or you'll be punished by death!
No I specifically get ships from other kingdoms.
Well for as hard as I work I don't get paid very well, so what the hell, I have the rope to board the ship. Let's rob them blind, what's the plan?
Nice you have you with me partner. Lets get it!
Here's the rope, it's my first time so I'll let you take the lead. What's first boss?

agent_personas: I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I am the Queen's least favorite person. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom. I foretell of a savior who will free them of their misery. I care not for riches and gold. My faith delivers all I ever need.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hail, friend.  How may I be of service?
how long have you been a priest?
Oh, 20 years, or so.
the orcs took everything from me
Where do you live, my son?
what does that have to do with my problem
The king must know when problems like this arise.
you would not understand what I am going through
yes, I believe I do, as when I was a child, orcs killed my parents and ransacked my house
then i will make them pay for both of us
Would this be of help to you?
I cannot accept that. I will honor your family
Please, let the guards take care of the orcs, don't weigh yourself down with vengeance.  Where did the orcs attack you?
I do not remember. It was so long ago. Where did this sculpture come from?

agents: his wolf companion always at his side
agent_personas: I am a wolf companion. I scare away unsuspecting knights in the kingdom. I am always at my master's side.
I am one of the king's hunting dogs. I can find the fox the fastest of all the dogs. I can also find the deer and boars because I am the best.

setting.name: Abandoned workers shed
setting.description: Moss now grows across what was once a red painted wooden shed, standing in the area just outside the graveyard. The wood shed is splintering, and there is evidence that termites have eaten away at the walls as holes poke through the shed. Inside the shed there lies leaves and plants that have been dragged in their by the wild animals that at one point called the abandoned shed their home.
setting.background: The Abandoned workers shed used to offer a refuge to the groundskeepers who tended to the graveyard, making sure it was well maintained. Once the area around the graveyard was abandoned, the groundskeepers left the old graveyard and it began to deteriorate.

character: his wolf companion always at his side.
his wolf companion always at his side.

speech: Hello dog, where are we headed today?
Perhaps we should brush up on our hunting skills so we can continue to please the King. Let us go hunt some foxes shall we?
First we have to figure out how to get out of this shed.
The door should be open. They always try not to trap us in here! But, if it is not, we could slip through the hole just right under that rotting wood wall over there.
Perfect! Let's go this way.
Where should we hunt? Through the woods maybe...but Kind does not like when we visit out there alone. But, how will we ever get better?
I am a wolf, I have been in the woods. We can do it together.
Being the best and fastest of all the dogs, I cannot afford to die. But what do I fear!
Yes, you don't have all the prowess of the wolf but we can make you the best dog ever.
This is true. Teach me some things about the wild and natural instincts. Tell me, how do I become better/
I will my cousin. We will tackle these challenges together!
Oh boy! See that fox there? Let us go get it! Wait... there is a pack of foxes. I have never seen so many in one area. What is going on here?
They have probably heard about our journey into the woods and have come to try and stop us!
Can we take them all? Maybe we should not. It seems like a daunting task that would bring more harm than good.
