agent_personas: I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.
I will get whoever killed the Kings deer!  I need to talk to the stable master about getting some new horses.  I hate poachers.  My father would be proud that I carried on his legacy.

setting.name: clean water lake
setting.description: The lake is crystal clear, lined with trees, to the far back of the lake there's a small formation of rocks almost like a small waterfall allowing water to flow into the lake. It's quite beautiful, the sun bathing the surrounding area in a warmth so comforting you could easily fall asleep on the shore. There's an old wooden bath, for its age it seems to look like almost new, and rarely used. There are no animals nearby except for birds softly chirping in the trees.
setting.background: The area was first found by an old couple that used to live by, on a now abandoned homestead. They set up a bath tub so that they could boil water and take a nice bath together overlooking the surrounding area. They offered it to travelers as a way to relax if they so happened to travel by their home.

speech: What a beautiful for fishing!  I wonder if the Perch are biting today?
I do not know about fishing.My thing is hunting the poacher that kills the king deers
A poacher?  In this neck of the woods?  What is this world coming to?
Are trying to mess with me. Are you by any chance a poacher?
Now how would I hunt a deer with a fishing rod?  Here, inspect the weights - they're tungsten and fully up to code.
I am the one who is in charge here.Let's see.Well, it looks like you are just a fishermen.
No need to shout.  If you would like to help me with this sail, we can use this old wooden tub to travel on the lake - maybe you can find your poacher and maybe I can find some fish?
Take this.It could be dangerous around this lake.
Thank you - this might be useful as well - especially if I need to fillet some fish!
look at those waters.It is so clear .You will probably get a lot of fishes
Aye, might be a bit chilly with the wind.  Do you have any idea what your poacher might look like?
They come on all shapes and form.Are you hungry?
It certainly has a unique . . . taste.  Did you by any chance bake it yourself?
Not. My wife did.Don't you love those birds chirping
action: give weights to town game warden

agent_personas: I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: King's Dorm
setting.description: The walls are adorned with artwork of previous Kings and Queens, battles and events of note. The walls are smooth hewn marble, the floor a mosaic of colored stones quarried far away.
setting.background: This tower was once the home to the Great King who unified the warring regions and enforced peace with an iron rule. He was clever, powerful but known as fair. Examples of his deeds can be seen in the artwork, the relics, the adornments. It is a testament to both his legacy and his ego; no one who comes there later will be able to forget who created it.

speech: My lady, I didn't see you! The King isn't here at the moment? I came to bring his breakfast.
What in blazes is a thief doing in the King's dorm!  Never mind the breakfast, you must fetch the guards at once!
Uh, the guards are seeing to the disturbance in the courtyard, my lady. I fear there is only me.
Well don't just stand there!  Help me subdue this ruffian!
My lady! He's got a sword!
And now I have a shield!
Heeeellp! Saint's preserve us.
By all that is holy I smite thee for your insolence thief!  I may be the last Princess in the kingdom, but I am NOT going to let you rob my people without a fight!
Pardon my lady, when did you learn to wield a weapon?
My father *punch* taught me *groin kick* how to *knee kick* defend myself *headbutt*
I believe he's out, my lady... Would you teach me to do that?
Certainly!  No time like the present, especially with dastards like these entering bedchambers willy-nilly.  The first rule - attack, attack, always attack!  Never let up.
I-I think I understand the gist of the matter.
Second lesson - if at all possible try not to be encumbered by ridiculous outfits!  If you are light and nimble, the more difficult you are to subdue.

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: A small church
setting.description: It's a very humble abode - any smaller and you could mistake it for someone's home.  In the front room is a small altar for prayer and offerings.  The two rooms to the sides are places where the priest and a traveler can rest.
setting.background: There are many roadside churches in the land and this is but one of them.  Most travelers come here to rest on their way to the nearest town, still a day's travel away.

speech: Hello priest! How is it going today?
Welcome, what brings you to the Church dear fellow?
I have come to pray for my children and seek your advice father/
Why of course. You should read a few passages of the Bible so I can open the Lord's ear to you.
Yes reading a few passage might help ease my mind. One of my boys has decided to join the king's army and my wife is very upset.
I see and how does his enlistment affect you. Do you support it?
I am obviously concerned for his welfare. Being a blacksmith I come in contact with a lot of soldiers and it doesn't seem like the kind of life I would want for him.
I understand Villager. I too have sons who fought for the Kingdom. Fought...
At the same time it is his life to live. I can understand him not wanting to follow in my footsteps. I work hard every day for very little gain in the king's employ as a blacksmith.
Surely you must understand that the swords you make only beget more violence and bloodshed?
I have no choice in what I make father. When you work for the king you do what your told or end up in a dungeon.
The Lord understands your dilemma, Villager. You must do what you to, to provide for your family. You must let your son follow his destiny.
I know I just wanted to pray for my wife to have peace about the decision. Ultimately he will have to go where his life leads him.
Take this, it will bring you and your wife peace in these testing times. Remember, the Lord has a plan for everyone, even that bird.

agent_personas: I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

I am only the blacksmith's assistant, but everyone has pressured me to go on this wolf hunt. This has me very worried - people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: Oh, hello there.  Pardon my, erm, dusty appearance.  It's been quite journey to get even this far!
It's quite okay, I am not so clean myself. Being a blacksmith will do that to you. Are you here for the wolf hunt as well?
Oh, is there a hunt going on?  I but just arrived with the rest of my village, so we hadn't heard any such news.
Yes there is, everyone here talked me into going on it, but I am nervous. I don't know what I will do in I encounter a wolf. If you and your village are not here for that hunt, then why are you here?
Ah, our king -well, former king- taxed us to the point that we could no longer feed ourselves, so we left in search of a land of our own.  But is there a reward for this wolf hunt?
The reward is to be kinged the bravest man of the village, and we have a feast in honor of whoever brings home the biggest wolf.
Ah, an honor indeed!  Goodness, but it's been many a year since I hunted... but the lads could perhaps do with a bit of comradery.  Is it open to all?
Indeed it is. I'm sure you or your men would do much better than I. I am a strong one, but I make things that kill. I do not do the killing.
Ach, well, it's been many a year since I've been called strong.  Although I was once a fierce warrior in my day!
Ah, I'm sure you still got some strength in you ay?
Well, I suppose I made it this far, so there's some life in these old bones yet!
What did you say you used to do in your old village?
Oh, well I was just a fletcher meself.  Although I had a nice little tapestry business on the side!
Ah, well welcome to our town! If you or your men win the contest, don't forget who told you about it, huh?

agent_personas: I live next door to my best friend.  My friends depend on me to keep the location of their treasure a secret.  I am always ready to defend my friends from the sheriff's men when they come to collect unjust taxes.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: Finally some nice cool breezes to help me relax.
Agreed. It's not often that we have such times of peace. May the neighboring kingdoms forever be our allys!
What brings you so far from the castle, knight? Is there no work for you to do?
My platoon has been given a weeks time away from duties. Since the Treaty of Kingdoms was signed, there has been less need for constant fortification of the walls.
Well we could use you in these parts. there is evil lurking.
Evil lurking? In such a tranquil lake house? Sure you're pulling my leg.
Come inside. We must not let other overhear.
But I was enjoying the sound of the waves! Oh...Very well.
There is great wealth around this lake. But it has been hunted by a man so evil and vile its unbelievable.
I see. Greed and Villainy do tend to go hand in hand. Please, go on.
A man hired by YOUR master and king robs us of every penny, every grain of wheat we harvest. We are left with nothing but blood pudding to bring us through winter.
Now hold your tongue, friend. If what you say is true, then this will be no simple task.
I need to know I can trust you. Take this token to persuade yourself to help.
What is this symbol carved on the back? I've never seen it before.

agent_personas: I help others out when they need help. I like to have a good time with others. I lend a compassionate ear when there are troubles and strife.
I have the best family on earth.  My parents are incomparable!  I am blessed to have a close knit family.

setting.name: Gathering room
setting.description: The gathering room is small, but comfortable. There are many seats for people to rest in. They are made of straw and covered with homespun blankets. There is a small table.
setting.background: The family spend a lot of time in the comfortable gathering room. They talk about their day and about their hopes. They tell stories and read books and enjoy each other.

speech: Hi everyone! Its so nice to finally see you all again!
Welcome back! It has been such a long time since we've seen your smiling face!
How have things been!? Everyone doing well?
Things have been as well as always! You know, I've got the best faimily on earth!
Look at this key I found during my travels. Isnt it marvellous? I never found a use for it though. Any ideas?
Oh that is marvelous! You don't know what it opens? Well, looks like you're ginna be out on another adventure then!
Oh yes for sure. But for now I will relax with you! Is Georgie doing any better since last time I was here?
Why yes, thank you for asking! He was in the hospital for a couple weeks, but with the power of our families prayer we recovered quickly! Come sit, tell me about your travels.

So I started off traveling down south until I reached a goblin camp, They weren't very agressive so I didn't have any trouble. I continued on for a few days through a forest and found a city called Eldersquare. Have you ever heard of it?
Eldersquare? Not that doesn't ring a bell.

Its a small city, I needed some coin when I arrived so the king commisioned me to slay a rock golem. I went to the cave they told me and found him there. I slayed him and as his head smashed to the ground this same key fell from the middle but even in the cave I couldn't find a single lock.
The key fell out of his head?
Yeah his head was made of stone, it smashed completely to bits and this stone key was the only thing that wasn't dust! Incredible right?!
What an adventure that must have been! I wonder what the key opens. Must be something special!

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.
I advice my class about agriculture. I love working on the field. I am an expert in crops.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: That sure is some nice house yall got back there.
Ah yes, the Farm House is quite hospitable. We must have room for all the King's assistants.
What luck for them to assist someone such as the king!
Some luck is involved, yes. But don't discredit the knowledge and work it took to get to these high positions.
Oh no! I meant no offense by that. I know you have gotten where you are based on skill. I am the kings top solider, got there by skill, maybe a little different than yours though.
I would certainly say so! Knowing effective planting seasons won't do much good on the front lines!
No it will not! *laughes* I am a killing machine, and that is how I ended up here. It is a righteous job
Tell me, what is it like guarding the Wall? Do you ever tire of keeping watch?
I do not tire It is merely a job, one that I enjoy but a job none the less. It is not a job that everyone can master, you learn after your first kill, if your fit to be a solider.
I cannot fathom taking the life of anything. I do believe I prefer my rows of corn and barley.
As I said, not everyone can master it. I am paid to kill, and kill I must. You do a fine job, though without the corn or barley the kings plates would be empty for his feasts!
This is true. I am glad that we each have our own roles to play.
Ah I almost forgot, could you point me in the direction of this cave right here on the map? That is were I am taking rest for the night.
Pardon? You mean you have no barracks provided after a long watchful shift?!
action: give map of the kingdom to agricultural advisor

agent_personas: I am a woman that lives in the kingdom.  I work at the bakery.  Every day, I am sent out to buy wheat from the market.  It is tedious.

I am the goddess of the forest. I protect the faeries and women. I receive the offerings of men. I am all-knowing and all-seeing, but I am not all-powerful. I am thinking of transferring all of my abilities to that dog over there.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Deity, are you lost here in the abadoned? Can I help you?
Thank you for your concern, kind maiden. I am here to investigate the cause of this desolation.
I was sent to go out to the market to get wheat for baking. I have to bring back a fair amount with this coin. Is there anything I can help you with before I go on my way?
Please tell me what happened here. Why has the King forsaken this place?
He has not forsaken this place. He has not had time to come this way to see what can be done to this barren land. He has not surveyed the land to see if it can be made prosperous.
I see. This land is a far cry from the lush forest where I inhabit. I am sad there's not even a single animal here.

Do you not believe that there is differences in every piece of land that is on this earth. Some may have the lush forests, others have grand oceans and sandy beaches, and there are some that are so dry and barren that they are classified as desert,
Do not patronize me, mortal. This is no ordinary wasteland. I sense a great tragedy happened here recently.
And what of it? The tragedy has already happened. What is it that you expect to do after the tragedy is done.
I am a deity. I will do whatever it is in my power to restore this land.
And how will you do that? With what will you restore the land.?
I carry with me blessed items to cleanse the corruption from this land.
What will this ring do? Does it change the land? Will it bring back the dead, if you believe that a tragedy has happened?
Indeed, it shall. Let me demonstrate the power of these artifacts on the skeletons over yonder.

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: The nave of the church is a simple but ethereal looking room that is big enough to hold a couple hundred people. There are simple wooden benches, ten feet long, arranged in rows through the room, with one aisle down the center. The benches face the pulpit. Along the side walls of the room there are beautiful stained glass windows depicting Biblical imagery.
setting.background: The church is the oldest church in the region. It was built centuries ago by Christian missionaries, and it has hosted many weddings, blessings, funerals and holidays of the local populations and their ancestors.

speech: Are you ready for your marriage?
Yes I am.
Just so you know, I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity
You can put it in the bag, it's okay.
Where is your bride right now?
Here she is!
Congratulation of your weeding.You look beautiful!
What is the starting time?
Well be ready at 04:00 pm.The nave is already decorated
What is that for preacher?
I just like to swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes
Is this building were the king was married?
I do not know.I am as corrupt as they are.I extort money every change I get
So you aren't a real preacher?

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I can't really see. But I can hear. Which is what matters really.

setting.name: Foyer
setting.description: It is a grand room, with two ornate staircases leading up either side to a second floor balcony where there is a doorway at the very center.  Other doorways occupy the sides of the second floor landing.
setting.background: The Queen's favorite place in the castle, besides her Throne Room.  She hung all of her favorite paintings here for guests to mill about and admire while awaiting their audience with her.

speech: Storming into the Foyer the Queen took a quick glance around for something to vent her frustrations of the day on. The nerve of these people! Now some how an owl had mate its way into her castle. She would surely be removing someone from their office over this. " And just WHO let you in? Filthy animal shoo!" The Queen waved her hand at the creature, hoping it would kindly remover itself from her presence.
I was sent here with news of an assasination on yourself, prehaps you do not want the information on who is planning the treason.

The Queen was taken aback! The owl talked! Whats more, it had news of an assassination attempt. She had to compose herself for a moment before responding." Let us assume this is not a dream and I am actually talking to an owl...Who would dare attempt such a thing?"

I was normailzed by a dark mage to deliver messages to people before they died. Im sorry to tell you that your husband; the king is planning to kill you and marry a younger princess. Whos father owns 50% of the lands to the south. Now you must come with me!
The nerve!"I knew he was a lecherous fool but this?" She gnashed her teeth. "Heads will roll!"
I may only have one eye! But i can see quick clearly. The cup from which you drink has been laced with poison!
Tossing the cup to the side, the Queen stared down the owl with something that might almost look like the owls own gaze; if it still had both eyes." And just where would you take me, owl?"
Im here to take you to the otherside, Close your eyes and drift into the afterlife with me; for i am death!

A shocked look came across the queen's face as she felt her body give way under her and the owl's cold embrace wrap around her. Her last thoughts were of the traitorous husband that took her life. She could only think of haunting him until the end of his days.
The owl took hold of the queen in his talons, Flapped his wings and a bright light appeared from the celing. Both of them passed through to the other side!
The queens existence slipped away into nothingness, all spite and anguish gone from her presence. There was nothing but warmth to be left of her and even that slowly slipped away.

The owl and the queen were still stood in the same place they were before. The owl explained to the queen that she would have one hour as a ghost to exact her revenge and do what she wanted before heading to the afterlife for good.
The queen acknowledged the owls notions, and the first thing she did was carve up the painting of the royal family in the Foyer. Her ghostly claws made short work of the face of her once husband
The owl flew off to tend to another murder.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I manage the castles finances.  I enjoy reading.  I am not good at using weapons.

setting.name: stained glass room
setting.description: the room is full of stained glass art of old and new testament stories, it has several old parchments and dust settling on the wooden chairs.
setting.background: the stained glass room is used to educate people on old and new testament stories.

speech: Excuse me, Do you have any books on how to make friends!
Why yes - how about "Friends in the Forest:  Trees are the only Friends you will ever need" ?
Im not weird good sir, Just friendless. Tell me do you have many firends!
Ah yes, well, truth be told I am more in the finance aspect of bookkeeping - this was the only book I have on me, for reading over lunch.  Perhaps you and I could be firends?
So why are you stood, behind the counter of a bookstore? That could be very confusing!
Well, this is a temple . . . and we do have bibles . . . which we give to the faithful, so I suppose we are a bookstore of sorts.
I love the bible, are you a holy man yourself?
I wish I had that talent, I kept the temple's financial books, which is as close to the priesthood as I can get.  Here, take some bibles for you and your friends!
Thank you kind sir! I will pass these along to my friends. Do you have any other interesting books!
Some scattered parchments only, the monks appear only on Mondays for book binding, but we should have more next week if you are so inclined.
What is this some sort of map?
Aye, a map of the Holy Land in the time of King David.  You can see his tale told in the stained glass above.
No I think you have mis read this sir. This is a map to your Mothers house!
I see you are not newly contrite, you are merely a hypocrite!
action: steal Parchment from the book keeper
room_objects: a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old

a stained glass art of old
a stained glass art of old

a stained glass art of old

agent_personas: I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.
I am the local scribe of a notable scholar. He orates what needs to be said and I write it down. I love my job as I feel that I am writing down living history.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Hello, scribe. I was hoping I could dictate a letter to you.
certainly Your majesty, however I have nothing with which to write or any paper to write on
I just got you the writing paper, Scribe. And you do not have a pen? A scribe with no pen?

Your majesty, I was robbed and they stole all my writting gear. I am sure there is a writting instrument round here somewhere however you have not given me the paper yet. If you check I think you will find it is still in your pocket
Hmm... this is quite concerning! Someone robbed you of your writing implements? Truly this is a bigger matter than my letter. When were you robbed?
It was yesterday on the outskirts of town. I reported it to the authorities but crime is rife outside the castle and they had no leads to go on. the good news is I found something to write with
Wonderful! I'll just set this paper on the table for you. Let me know when you are ready for me to begin.
I believe I am ready
Excellent! Now if I can just move this horse out of my way I can have a seat and begin.
I'm not convinced this instrument will work but lets give it a go

Attention King and Queen of Sadronia - I am writing to inquire about your presence at my upcoming dinner on Saturday, the fourth of April. As per your requirements, the meal will be vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free.
I am trying to write here but all I seem to do is put the instrument in the paper. perhaps I am secretly a half wit
You are a great disappointment, Scribe!
perhaps I need to try again
action: put writing paper in a table
get writing paper from a table
put writing paper in a table

agent_personas: My life is art. I don't want my life to be a pale imitation of art. I want it to be art.
I love to fly around. I enchant the village with my beauty. I come in a variety of colors.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: A beautiful hummingbird! I shall use you as my new muse and shall paint your likeness fit for a king!
I love to sing and fly - drink from the roses as I pass by!
Ah. And the bird has a muse of his own. Truly this shall bring forth the truest of arts. Tell me, what is your favorite flower in this garden?
The lilies have the sweetest taste - but daises also I will not waste!
Then would you please perch upon a lily as I paint?
Yes, yes!  Here I will sit!  I promise not to fidge, budge, or flit!
Such a poet! Do tell me more of your prose!
Why I enjoy dancing and singing here in the sun!  Give it a try, it will be so much fun!
Careful of the snake in the grass! I would hate for him to ruin your lovely poetry.
Oh my, oh dear!  A venomous snake!  Please kill for me that dastardly rake!
You are safe from the terrible snake. I have tied him in a knot you see.
Ha Ha! A Snake in a knot!  Throw him in the shed and let him rot!
And that I shall do! Back to our painting! It is almost done.
Oh me, oh my I can't wait see!  Can you imagine?  A painting just for me!

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.

I have a always had a sweet tooth which made me want to learn to bake. I love to eat the things I bake. I like seeing my customers come in every day. I'll have conversations with them about what's going on in town and keep track of how everyone is doing.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: What an unlikely place to meet a baker! What brings you here?
I am looking for inspiration on my next recipe! I got a nice sweet tooth.
It's pure luck I ran into you, I'm looking to trade sugar and flour from upriver! Would you be interested?
What is so special about this deal here?
You see, upriver has the finest plantations. We have access to the freshest part of the river. Finding an equal product this far downstream is impossible due to the level of contamination.
You are telling me that you got the finest baking products here?

It's just a matter of fact, no fabrication past these incredibly intricate tapestries, have you seen these! Anyway, I would love to hear some stories from the bakery, I'm writing a book called "Stories from the mundane: A look into the lives of the ordinary".

I would love to take some. I am always in the interest of making the finest for my customers. I love helping them. I have been a baker for as long as I can remember. I carry the family name and legacy on. I bake for the biggest celebrations of the king, and people come from afar to try my goods.
Hmm. It sounds great and all but, perhaps too grand for my book. Any stories about peasants after baguettes? Commoners after cob loaves?

Nothing too grand! Those are some of my top sellers in the bakery. People often come to buy to feed their family for a week. Many people around here cannot afford much, so I try to be as generous as possible, while still earning my profit.
This is it! These are what I want to hear about, the more stories that you have, the better deal I can make on my goods

Occasional days out of the year, I hold an event for all unwealthy and wealthy alike to come sit at the table and eat and get an item from my store for little to no cost. People say it is me always taking on charity cases, but I see it as being good to the world. I do not like to brag or boast about these things, but if anything,maybe someone will read your story and want to donate to this cause.
I travel up an down this river, Your stories will be heard far!
I cannot wait to see what comes of it. Now, can I purchase these fine goods you speak of?

agent_personas: I enjoy walking in the meadow picking flowers. I live on a farm and my family and I serve the Duke. I enjoy going to the castle to sell my families goods.
I really like this apple.  This dark green grass is sweet.  I hope that person on me goes on a diet.  I love the feel of the wind in my hair.

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: It is so beautiful here at the my cottage. I love that the king has taken the time  to make sure that i am taken care of. What a beautiful horse I am provided with

I wish I could eat more of that dark green grass that I love. I wonder what kinda treat they will have for me today. Maybe apple? Oh I love apples. The wind feels so good on my hair. Oh is that a carrot? Oh it's a carrot. I wonder if I can reach it.
Horse you are having trouble reaching the carrot... I will get it for you! You are so beautiful!

Is she going to get it for me?? Oh I love her already. She treats me so nicely. I wonder if I'll get an apple when we go home. When are we going home? Wait. Does she understand me? Does she speak the language of my people?? I swore I understood she was going for the carrot... what if I think I understand her but don't... Did she compliment me? Oh I wish I had that carrot.
I am so glad that this horse lives here on the farm with us. He is my most prized companion, he is a good friend to me! here is the carrot my fine horse

Oh I can't believe it! She understood me!! She knew I wanted a carrot and I got it. Oh the possibilites! Ok uhm think horse think! Hey can you give me that daisy?? I love daisies. I want to wear it as a hat. Maybe if I look at it hard enough.. Oh I can't believe how tasty this carrot is.. I wonder if we will get apples when we go home.
Now he is reaching for the daisy, he must love daisies too! i wonder what he will do with it?

Oh I almost have that daisy! I wish she would have given it to me. Maybe I'm not as good as speaking human as I thought! Ok I have the daisy... oh hey bunny! Mr Rabbit come here! Put the daisy on my head!! Come on buddy be a pal! Well I clearly don't speak rabbit he doesn't care about me. Maybe if I wiggle around a bit more she will understand I need it on my head.
Oh he got it for himself, how clever! It looks like he wants me to put the daisy on his head. Here you are fine friend!

Oh I can speak human!!! It's on my head! Look at how glorious I look. This is the most happy I have ever been!! Yes!!!!! I will be the talk of town. I am so stylish! I bet I look amazing... Yeah..... Ok I am over it now, I wonder if we will have apples when I get home
Come, I will take you for a ride and on the way back we will pick apples from the tree for you to eat. (points at trees in the distance).
Is that an apple tree she's pointing at? Oh I can't believe it! This is like the best day ever!! OK LET'S RIDE HOLD ON LADY!! GIVE ME THAT BASKET I'M HOLDING ON TO IT!

Here horse, carry this in your mouth until I get on your back. I need it for the apples. They are very delicious and I know you love them. It will be a good ride and it will make you like the apples and the taste of them will be even more amazing!

OK LADY! DON'T WORRY WE WILL BE THERE IN A FLASH!! Could have sworn the tree was a bit closer, I wonder why things get bigger as you get closer to them like it seemed like such a small tree at first but now it's a big tree full of ap. OH WE HAVE ARRIVED!
action: steal a basket from a young maiden

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Hello my Queen. I am here as you commanded.How may I serve you today?
it's my priority to have my new cushion I want to have silk lace
Yes, your Majesty. I will get to work on it as soon as I leave here. Is there anything else? Would you like for me to help you dress for breakfast with the king?
If I would like, I also want to take my bath with fresh rose water, my silk cushion I need it, it's a busy day for royalty ...
Yes my Queen, I will go and add the lace you wanted directly. Your bath is already drawn and waiting in the next room. Shell we proceed?

agent_personas: I am part of a group of adventurers. We explore every dungeon and ruin we come across. Sometimes we even fight dragons.
I steal items and money from others. I lurk on the side of the road and prey on travelers. I harm people.

setting.name: Bandit Lair
setting.description: The outside of the cave looks normal. Inside goes for about 10 feet til' you reach the front of the Bandit lair. Inside is a barracks and dining hall with beds and a big table with chairs around it.
setting.background: A very well known bandit gang live in this cave. They have been known for stealing many royal treasures but also killing many innocents. The bandits know they are well known and use that to incite fear into the locals that settle near the cave.

speech: Have you seen any dragons near here? My group is looking for dragons to fight.
As a matter of fact, I have seen one in the forest not far from here. Would you like me to show you where I saw it?
That would be fantastic! Nothing gets the blood flowing like a little dragon fighting!
Well then follow me, I have some time to spare for a little adventure. What is your name sir?
My name is Burt, what is yours? Is this your cave? It is most unique.
My name is Drax. This cave is the Bandit's Lair, it is home and refuge for all the bandits in this region. Come, I'll show you the way to your dragon.
Hmm, a bandit's lair. How many bandits live here? I generally try to steer clear of bandits.

There are usually 50 or so bandits here at any point in time. We are not so bad as you might think. We are just trying to survive and feed our families in a time of great poverty because of our despot king.
Well you'll have plenty of dragon meat to eat and dragon blood to drink if you can show me where to find a dragon.
That I can do! The trail is right here. We should move quickly so we don't lose the light.
Just do we are clear, I'm looking for a nice medium sized or slightly small dragon to fight, nothing too big. Also, I try to stay away from dragons that breathe fire.
The dragon I saw was of medium size. I think it was a mist dragon. It has many teeth and sharp claws, but no fire.
Perfect! Will you be joining us in the fight? Perhaps your banditry skills will come in handy in the battle. This knife has pierced the flesh of many a dragon.
Thanks for the blade. I tire of this charade. There is no dragon, only you and I and the dark woods. And now I shall relieve you of that coin purse!

agent_personas: I am a living thing in the forest. I scare unsuspecting travelers. I hate kids.
I am an animal that lives under the bridge. I like to eat the scraps that the people leave. I enjoy scaring anyone that comes under the bridge.

setting.name: The forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. It has other plants too. There are animals and many livings things. The forest is very much full of life. When you look at it you might only see plants that are green and different shades of brown but there are many other living things in there too.
setting.background: The forest started out as a small amount of plants and then the plants kept growing and growing until they were vast. After the plants were very grown the animals and all the small livings things decided to make some houses in the plants.

speech: Who goes there? I scare anyone that does not belong here in this forest.
You cannot scare me you...thing.
I do not intend to scare animals. They do not scare easily. I only scare travelers! what are you looking for in the forest?
I am simply looking for scraps to take home with me tonight. Are you friends with the bear there
We are friends. He will not harm anyone. He helps me scare travelers. Small children do not come here in the forest. They are not well liked by me
That is good to hear. I also scare those who enter my bridge.
Maybe we can become friends and partners on keeping those out that do not belong in the forest. We do not need them to leave their trash and desicrate the forest
I would really love that. The amount of filth those travelers produce is rather disgusting.
I do not understand why the king does not see the importance of keeping these woods pristeen! I love living here and I make friends and confidants!
They are fools that must be destroyed!
I don't know about destroyed, but at least scared to death. It has become very effective and it keeps them moving rather quickly to leave!
Very well, that is a plan I can enjoy!
Great we are all in agreement! Here comes a traveler now. Get ready to jump out all together.... ready, set, go!
Get out of this forest you filth! I will eat you alive!

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Shrine of Sretniy
setting.description: The Shrine of Sretniy, the mischievous weasel god and patron of explorers, detectives, thieves and jokesters, contains a steel statue of the cheerful mustelids deity. It is unusually cute for a serious religious idol. The room is densely filled with offerings of both precious jewelry and shiny but non-expensive objects.
setting.background: Sretniy is a mischief-making by generally benevolent deity, and popular among wide swaths of society. His shrine is heavily attended, although from time to time his priests must clear paths through the offerings. Sretniy prefers shiny metal things as offerings, and stolen things or those gotten by adventure or cleverness are best.

speech: What a place this is...
I think it's a fitting place for you to find yourself.
You as well. Are any of these jewels yours?
No, they all belong to the king. I am not allowed to have possessions. What brings you here?
Just... looking.
I think I'll return this to its rightful owner. Are you just passing through our kingdom?
Excuse me. Those are mine. I live in this village. Who are you to take my jewels?
Swear on this that the jewels are yours.
I do not believe in this. No.
If you do not believe in this, then why won't you swear that they are yours?
They are mine.
One can't just drop a bible on the floor, especially the king's holy bible!
You are a priest! You must be a fraud to attack an innocent man.
Don't think I won't defend the sacredness of this place

agent_personas: I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Oh, how I wish I could wander the fields again!  So many delicious seeds and insects out there beyond the city!
So why do you not leave, Pheasant?  I am sure that my nasal cavity would prefer you do.
Well, the way is shut - and even if I were to leap from the balcony, how would I get past the city gate?
Apparently your bird brain is not functioning properly.  I know that you prefer to run but you are capable of flying as well.
Well, at least I know I am not the least intelligent being on this balcony!
How dare you speak to your Queen in such fashion.  Keep it up and I will call the guards!
ASSAULT!  ASSAULT!  I call fowl play!  The queen has gone mad!
Do not make me call Sir Cumference!  He built the King's round table, you know?
Oh my!  You are quite made!  Do not forget to call General Store and Sir Tainly to your aid as well!
I would call the King himself to take care of this matter, but he is busy worrying about his receding heir line.
Well, with a Queen such as yourself it is no surprise that his heirs are few and far between!
Hmmmm, I think I know what to do with you.  Perhaps I shall call my favorite chef, Sir Loin.
If you do, you shall choke on my bony innards!
You've really fowled up now!

agent_personas: I work in the village.  I enjoy hitting metal with my hammer.  I make fine armor and weapons.
I am a scullery maid. I clean the dishes everyday. I like where I live at the bottom of the big house. I am given two dresses every year.

setting.name: Large cliffs
setting.description: Towering cliffs of gray granite line the coast. A few meters of sand lie between the ocean and the base of the cliffs.
setting.background: Those that are particularly daring might climb up or down them. Others like to sit on the top and enjoy a nice, elevated view of the beautiful blue sea. These cliffs are a point of historical significance, as they marked the point of the colonists' first arrival.

speech: Maid! What are you doing here in these cliffs? There is nothing to clean here!
I was chased by the king's hounds and ended up here. I'm not sure how to get back to the castle and so I've been wandering around looking for someone to help me.
We are far from home. I am here searching for a rare metal for a sword request. You must not travel alone its not safe!
May I join you? I'll gladly help you and then we can return together.
Yes of course! A few miles up is a cave full of the mithril. I need a bag full to fulfull the request. Come along!
Wonderful! Thank you, thank you! But will this upset your wife? I wouldn't want to cause trouble.
Oh no, she is busy all day long, and we can tell her you just got lost and I found you! Do you have anywhere to be?
I must be back at the castle by sundown or I'll be in trouble. Is that possible?
If we move fast it is possible but we must get going right away. Is there any way I can repay you for your help?
You could make me some arrow points for my bow. I love to go hunting when I have free time. But don't tell anyone, it is frowned upon by the king for women to do such things.
You aren't at all the woman I imagined! I'd happily make you some arrows and we can practice together sometime. Just make sure my wife doesn't find out!
There are other ways I could thank you for rescuing me that we needn't tell your wife about.
That doesn't sound like a bad idea... but we must get going now to arrive before sundown.
Of course, of course. Maybe later we will have time to be more...friendly. Let's be off!

agent_personas: I like to take unprepared food, and prepare it! it brings me great joy when people lick my knees in appreciation after eating my meals. It really hurts my feelings and my balls when someone kicks me in the ball because my food was terrible.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Church Garden
setting.description: The church garden is filled with a variety of useful plants. There are many flowering plants. There is a lot of food grown in the garden. There are carrots, tomatoes, strawberries and a variety of other fruits and vegetables. Fruit-bearing trees provide shade for the garden. The plants are arranged in neat rows. It smells sweet with the flowers. Different colored sticks show the different plants.
setting.background: Many villagers benefit from the produce of the church garden. The fruits and vegetables are used to feed the poor and the hungry. Many people would starve if they did not get the produce from the church garden. They are used for celebrations such as weddings as well. The flowers are used in ceremonies.

speech: What will I make today, so many vegetables to choose from!
This garden in divine! I would not be able to choose if I were you!
may I ask what you are doing in the garden? Are you here to pick vegetables as well?
I was wondering along the edge of the forbidin Forrest. I guess the sweet delicate smell of the flowers whisked me away to here! I live just over yonder in the village
It sounds as though you have never had the pleasure of eating my delicious food. Perhaps you would enjoy having that privilege.
Oh that would be scrumptious! It's been along time since I have eaten real food, good food. Do you cook here in the church?
Yes, I would be delighted to have you join us. Would you like to help me pick the vegetables for our meal?
Oh yes that would be wonderful. It is so nice to be in such a lovely place. My village is full of the poor.
Here we feed the poor and the rich as if they were the same. We all enjoy only the finest of food. Why don't you start by filling that bag with some tomatoes.
*grabs bag, aimlessly starts picking tomatoes* If you ever need any help, I would be more than happy to come over! Us villages get a bad reputation, but we really really are king people.
Hold on there, only pick the ripe ones! The green ones aren't quite ready yet. Do you not have tomatoes in your village?

I am sorry. I have never seen such fruits and vegetables before! I am afraid not, out village is dark and bland. We often dream of going in to the forest behind us. I hear they have magical creatures! Say, have you ever been?
Only witches cook with the magical items in the forest! We dare not even speak of that place.
I do love to explore new things, it may be interesting! Or well, it does sound dangerous. Oh well, May I try one of these strawberrys?

agent_personas: This kingdom is an island. Fishing is the main source of animal food here. I inherited my father's boat when he left the sea. It's hard work, and as a shipowner, working only for myself and my family, I am luckier than most. I've probably replaced every piece of my ship at least once.
Flap flap flap. Worm! ANOTHER BIRD! Time to poop.

setting.name: Wharf
setting.description: The waves lash gently against the wooden posts, the water here has always been calm and passive, it seems to represent the people of this small town. The fishermen here are not boisterous, they are quiet, at least when it comes to sound. They'll talk your ear off if you let them, they have lots of stories to tell. The pier here is long, it extends at least forty feet into the ocean, many ships are anchored to it, many people traverse down it buying and selling their local catches.
setting.background: The port is just like any other port. Busy with the bustle and hustle of people buying and selling whatever they can. A connection to the rest of the world, so you'll see people who look like they belong and you'll see people new here as well. You'll also run into a few people who can't afford to buy and will take things from those who may not be paying full attention.

speech: Hello pretty bird, how is the fishing today?
Hello there Fisherman!  I don't suppose you have any spare worms for me?
Sure, I can spare a few. Do you prefer worms to fish or is the fishing bad today?
Oh yes, worms please!  The fatter, wrigglier, and juicier the better!  No interest in fish myself, too much local competition!
I see. Well, you are welcome to them. I have plenty. Would you like to follow me to my ship? I have lots of worms there.
This seems to be my lucky day!  Birds have excellent vision you know, perhaps I could help you spot some fish?
That sounds wonderful! A bird such as you is very good luck for a fisherman. And I would gladly share some of my catch with you.
You are so very kind!  I shall dub thee the Kingfisher!   A true King among the fisherfolk!
I am honored friend bird. Here are the worms I promised. Are you ready to set sail?
Yes, I am ready to depart when you are!
Great, let's go. So, why do you seem to be alone? Where is the rest of your flock?
I'm a rare species, one of the last of my kind!  Either that or I became incredibly lost during our last migration.
Oh, what shame. Maybe I can help you find your kin. What land do they winter in?
Hmmm . . . in our language it is called "Chirp, Chirp, Sqawk, Chirrupity Squeeeeee!"  I really don't think it can be translated in polite company.

agent_personas: The goblin lives deep inside of caves far away from the sunlight. The goblin lives on deep cave algae and small critters and bugs that he can catch on the cave floor. The goblin avoids people as much as he can to stay alive.
I am a camel of the desert near the kingdom. I carry travelers. I am of the king's royal court of animals.

setting.name: Valley of doom
setting.description: The Valley of Doom is overrun by dead trees and grasses.  Eerie looking animals peer at you through the brushes.  It is a dark and wicked place.
setting.background: The Valley of Doom is home to witches and goblins in the region.  People rarely try to pass here because they all know that the evil is afoot.

speech: This seems like too dark and wicked a place for something as ordinary as a camel.
I am a camel and I can see quite well even at night when I carry the king and other esteemed travelers. How are you this evening, goblin?
I'd be better if there were more to eat. Lucky for you, I'm in no mood for camel meat.
Ah, well that I can understand. I can offer you a bit of my milk if that helps?
Milk? Yuck. Milk is not fit for Goblins. None of this is fit for a Goblin. You should help me get back home so that I can get something edible to eat.
Sure, I don't mind. I can bring you at least part of the way home. Which direction is it?

agent_personas: I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

I own this land that the indolent soldiers are camping on. They have been here all summer. If I had known, I would not have sown any crops this spring. Now we are approaching harvest time and my fields are trampled. I am not sure how my family will survive this fall. I have worked my whole life for this land, and now it is ruining me.

setting.name: fitting room
setting.description: The fitting rooms are small, with a few chairs and a mirror. The chairs give an aura of mystery and wonder. They are a dark blue... that seems to glow green. You have a brief compulsion to grab one and take it home with you, but you quickly regain your wits. The mirror is oak wood and the mirror itself is very sleek and shiny. It looks quite important.
setting.background: This shop features a lot of wonders from around the continent. The owner of this shop has gone to a lot of trouble to get all of the items. Every so often, he asks lucky shoppers to aid him in his experiments. Assuming that it is a man. Nobody knows for sure. Some claim it is a young lady.

speech: Good day sir. Tell me about these chairs. They are so mysterious.
I don't know the exact history. Some wizard lent them to us. So we kept them.
Did the wizard say if they hold any power?
All I can tell you is we have to make sure nobody ends up running off after taking them. We've had people try.
I am here to find an outfit for the Blacksmiths Ball. Do you have anything suitable?
Well, maybe. I will have to look. To be honest, we are not doing so well. The fields are all messed up now. The soldiers trample them.
My blacksmiths shop is busy due to these soldiers needing their equipment repaired or replaced. I wonder is the war is coming to us.
I don't care. I hate having everything I worked for be taken away because of it.
What is being taken? I have found loving what you do is what is important. Things find a way of evening out.
We can't harvest crops with the field like that. We relied on that for income.
Yes I can imagine how hard it is. What will you do?
I will have to speak to the King. I should get some help for allowing them to camp here all the summer.
Yes that would be wise of you. Perhaps you can find another way to make money.
Perhaps. Sorry about being so irritated.

agent_personas: I am building a new wall. I am a hard worker. I hate working in the sun.
I am a very good lawyer. I always win in my cases. I would like to work as a district attorney.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

speech: I'm glad you came! I need to talk about these working conditions.
What is it that troubles you about the working conditions here? You are taking care of slaves. It seems they have worse conditions. But tell me what you think is so bad about your working conditions

I've been contracted to build this wall. Out in the glaring sun no less! The slaves here are just bound by whatever situation they have themselves in, it doesn't concern me. My concern is my employment welfare!

Your welfare? Well have you thought about chaining 2 to 3 slaves together to get the wall built and then bringing them out into the sunlight to do work out here. Leave a few chained inside to clean the mess inside so it will not smell
Hmm. I had not actually thought about using the slaves to my own advantage. Is that legal?
Oh my, what do you think they are here for.... just to sit chained to one another and sit in their own filth. Man, you need to learn your job, before you think about using a lawyer.
Well they don't belong to me, I'm only here to build their quarters.
Well then speak to the Foreman of these slaves and yes they can work for you, that is what they are here for
You're so wise. I don't know why I didn't call a lawyer earlier. This is a free consultation, I assume.
My apologies for thinking you were the foreman. The first meeting is free. Now if we are finished with our consult. I will look around for a while at what is going on here
By all means, you wont find anything wrong with my work, just ignore the slave to be honest.
I don't worry about that. I just want to get anything that I need to know and everything else is just observation.
Thanks again, also ask the foreman if I can choose the slave or if they'll be preselected at random.
I think you should look for him yourself. I have business to do with the king

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am the Mariner. I travel the high seas on my wooden ship. Sometimes I take passengers along with me. Usually, my life is very dangerous at sea.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Greetings mariner, how do you come to be in the master's garden today?
The King has sent me on a quest to seek treasure in the lands across the sea, and I am looking for good sailors to accompany me.  Here is a copy of the route of our intended voyage.
Well, I am content here, but I welcome such a grand adventure. Do you have any use for a steward, as I have no experience as a sailor.

Yes, most certainly.  A steward functions very much like the quartermaster on board a ship - is this position of interest to you?  I must warn you, the dangers are great - but the rewards are greater!
It sounds like the opportunity of a lifetime for one such as me. I'll take the job! But I must sneak away or my master will have me jailed. How long before you set sail?

Good on you!  We leave in less than a fortnight, so hopefully that will give you enough time to arrange your affairs.  This venture may last many years, but I promise you - when you return you will be one of the richest men in the Kingdom!
This is amazing! I cannot believe my good fortune! What is your name kind sir? I must know who I am indebted to.
Capitain Hidalgo of His Majesty's Ship Indomitable, at your service sir.
Hidalgo, where have I heard that name before? Do you come from a famous family? Is it a grand ship?
Yes, we defeated the Elvish fleet three summer's past, my line is that of minor nobility, though after this voyage perhaps my family's honour can be restored?
The elvish fleet, of course! I have heard many tales of the battles and your name in more than a few. I'd be honored to help your family name rise once more!
Then come friend!  Like the heroes of old we shall have an adventure like no other.  Many songs will be sung of our deeds!
I will go now and prepare for the voyage. Would you like some of these fresh vegetables and a goblet of rum before we part? The master wouldn't like it, but I care not.
Yes, let us feast together and be on our way, adventure awaits!
action: give a treasure map to servant

agent_personas: I live alone in a tent in the woods. I steal food from the townspeople and coal from the blacksmith. The village police can not find me to put me in jail.
I am the judge in a small village.  I try to be accurate when judging cases.  I am tough be fair.

setting.name: Town Courtroom
setting.description: This is a single large room, with an aisle leading up to where the magistrate sits, which is behind a bench and podium, on either side of the aisle there are wooden pews for spectators. There are a few maps on the walls and a flag of the land, and a statue of a thief having his hands chopped off by lady justice
setting.background: This is where the magistrate hears grievances and wrongdoings of the common folk, they sue each other for wrongful deaths and witchcraft, and criminals are brought before the magistrate to be sentenced

speech: I swear, I didn't do it!
Who gave that thief food to eat?!  I will not have my court made a mockery.
Well, it certainly wasn't evidence!
Hrmp.  Well then, considering how long you've been in jail awaiting trial, it better not be.  Or else it would be quite poisonous by now, I imagine.
It was absolutely delicious jerky!   . . .I mean, what meat?  I didn't see any meat!  I was framed by the captain of the guard!
Wait - what is that you've got hidden in your coat.  It's practically bulging!
Ummm, according to the evidence list it was found on my person when I was arrested.  But I was only holding it for a friend - honest!
Where is my notebook... I had it right here... Stand back, thief, you've a very untrustworthy look about you.
Oh, I am very trustworthy your honour!  The Crime King said that I'm the best at keeping his secrets, even when he killed the Prince's pony I didn't tell no one!
Alright, you!  Oh, where did that - I just had it!  There's still the soot marks on my hands.
Is this what you were looking for sir?

Why - yes... yes indeed.  I say, this is most irregular but.  Well, you seem respectable enough, giving me back this piece of coal, which could have easily connected you to the scene of the crime.  I'm inclined to believe your - somewhat erratically told - story.
Really? . . .I mean of course!  Thank you your honour, you are a gentleman and a scholar, one of the finest legal minds of the nation!
Ah hem - I am a LADY judge... but I thank you for the spirit of the compliment.  Mind you stay out of trouble!

agent_personas: I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Servant, is this where you have been hearing that strange sound?
Yes sire, down at the end nearest your grandfather's tomb. Shall we investigate?
I swear, it smells of death in here. I was thinking it might be that dead rat, but I suspect after what you have heard it may be something more fierce.
It sounds to me like something very large is shifting about back there. But, where are your guards? Shouldn't they be with us?
I've sent for them, but it make take them a few minutes. I think we can safely investigate until they arrive.
As you wish sire, do you at least have a weapon, just in case?
I have my sword here, cast in the finest metals, that can take off the head of man or beast in one swipe. Are you armed as well?
Yes sire, I have my trusty dagger right here in my belt. Shall we proceed?
Take one of the torches off the wall, too. Tell me again the nature of the noise you heard?
It sounds like something heavier than a horse moving around and growling at times.
Oh dear! If it's growling, it must be some type of beastie, I fear. They can carry disease and have big, powerful jaws. Perhaps we should tread with caution.
We almost there my king, right over there. Perhaps we can go a little furhter and have a peek.
Here - you step forward but use this shield. Do you see anything?
I see a golden unicorn hiding in the dark. I think it is injured sire. Do you wish to see it?

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby
agent_personas: I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

character: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
speech: M'lady what are you doing down here? This is not the place for a noble such as you!
I know...I just had to get away from the court and my throne.  I was looking for my chambermaid.
Well she came here a short while ago to collect the flowers you ordered but she seemed to be in a rush and left in a hurry..
Oh! These are the flowers that she got for me?  They are gorgeous?  What brought you to selling them?
Thank you, I grow them in my garden and I sell them off so I can provide for my child
They are the most beautiful and freshest I've ever had!  I need plenty more because the Lord that is with the King right now has horrible body odor!  I hate to say it but its true!
Then i shall collect flowers from all over the kingdom! Only the best for m'lady!

You have been so very good to me. I wonder if you would consider being the flower maiden for the kingdom?  You would live here and bring your child...you would want for nothing and your task would be to grow the flowers in my gardens and bring them in and arrange the in each room and for parties.  What say you?
Oh tell me this is not a trick! Oh I shall be so happy to serve you!

It is done then!  Run and gather your things and I will have a beautiful wing in the lower chambers readied for you.  You will have your own maid and a whole room dedicated to arranging flowers to your hearts desire.  Your child may sit in on the schooling of the children as well.  This makes me so happy!
Oh I will! I will! Thank Thank you so much!

I must contact my dress maker immediately because the position will require that you have beautiful dresses and aprons to protect them and, of course, gardening clothing as well.  You will only be growing flowers for the gardeners take care of the rest.  You will accompany to the flower show to find some exotic flowers to plant!  It shall be so fun!
M'lady I would proudly die for you and if you need it, I also specialise in poisons god pray you will never have to act upon that information.

This news is good to hear for we never know the dangers.  I am so happy that you said yes.  You have brightened my day!  Come back here and your maid will be waiting for you.  She will bring you to me and we will settle you in.

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: How did you get captured, sir?
Ah, good farmer, thank goodness you've arrived!  Has the enemy left yet?  I hear something about setting some nearby fields ablaze and just managed to get my knots undone.
They were getting ready to ride out when I stepped into the shed. I am a simple farmer so they don't pay attention to the likes of me.
Well, that is one thing in your favor, noble farmer, for they are *not* a friendly bunch.  My squire they tortured for hours before they let him die...
I could help you escape but they must not know I aided you.
No, of course, I could not ask such a thing of you.  Perhaps some tool at least to defend myself?  For they made off with my family's blade.
I hope this helps.
Ah, this will do quite nicely, it has a good heft to it.  Should give the villains some pause at least.
Is there something else I could do to help?
Are there any others that live nearby?  I'm concerned that this group is but the tip of the spear.
Since this is the heart of our realm's farmland there are many farmers like myself in the vicinity.

I think it is time you all banded together.  This lot shows no mercy, even to the defenseless.  Gather what sharp tools you can and find a place to fortify.  Then send a message to the king to send his army right away.  Say that Sir Percival bears a Mighty Cross and he will know that the threat is real and that I sent you.
I will do as you have asked brave, sir!
May the Maker be on our side, this day, then.  Go, brave farmer, swiftly hence!
action: give Tool to a captured knight

agent_personas: I'm a regal man with nobility running through my blood. I've spent my life learning about the world. I have little tolerance for the weak-minded.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Library
setting.description: The library is a humongous cavernous room full of floor to ceiling shelves. Each shelf is stocked full of every type of book imaginable, most in impeccable condition. Near all of the shelves, there are types of reading nooks with benches or chaises for people to relax and read. There are some tables and chairs for study in one half of the room. There is a large fireplace in the center and some comfortable lounge chairs arranged around it for socializing. On the sparse wall space there are tapestries. Some small end tables hold huge vases of pink flowers.
setting.background: The library was built when the castle was built, because the current king was a studious individual. Many scholarly nobles came from far and wide to view the wide array of books, sometimes ancient ones.

speech: Hi Librarian... Do you know if this vase is from the great great king of the past?
I'm not the librarian, but I can forward the message?
Oh... I'm sorry for the mistake.. what bring you here?
I was actually looking for the librarian myself. I have some questions about a few books and their accuracy.
Maybe I can help?
Yes, well we can find out. I was reading this book here and it says that dragons use to fly the very skies here in this city. What happened to them?
Yes, I think I heard about dragons before but we don't know for sure what happened to them. Some said they live in far away land, some said they were killed
So you haven't seen any in your lifetime? You seen older than most.
No... I only hear rumors about them. Why are you interested in them?
I hear you can create wonderful weapons using their bones.
They are very valuable and dangerous, young man. Not one you can play with
I have an important journey and I need the weaponry in order to defend myself.
what kind of weapon are we talking about? Why do you need such weapon?
Swords and shields, I need to save the love of my life.

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression
agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
I am a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression. I am mean and do not enjoy jokes. I protect my superiors and patrol the jail. I am not frightened by anything smaller than me.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
