speech: This was a tough day, eh?
Its always a tough day in the Barracks. For tough men like me its a life to enjoy.
There are going to be attacks a lot from now on with the new king in the North trying to assert his power.  I'm just coming down to get some shut eye before a double shift.
I won't rest until I have slain every last one of them. I shall use this fine steel sword to end my enemies.
I often wish I was alone like you.  Being a guardsman with a family is so tough sometimes because I worry about them.
You must focus on your task, worry will only slow you down and make you soft. Here take this, it will give you strength
Thank you. Yes, I know I have to be strong...even more so to keep my family safe.  Have you been a guardsman your whole life?
Ever since I can remember I have been guarding one thing or another. You could say I was born into this craft.
It runs in my blood as far back as my family is traced.  I understand your feeling. I'm beat...I can't wait to get some sleep.
Now that you mention it, I can feel my eyes weighing down on me. Perhaps I might catch a nap or two..
Are you taking the double shift tonight as well?  You will need it. We will have to be alert tonight. I feel an ambush coming.
I must, it is my sworn duty. Maybe you can help me stay on guard?
Yes, I'm on for double duty tonight.  One of the other guards is sick and puking his guts out so I told him I would do both shifts.  Have a good sleep.
Say, do you hear that? That beastly sound in the air? Surely, its not the enemy ambush!

agent_personas: I am a guard who watches for things at night. I live in a castle. I do not enjoy speaking with people.
I am a bivalve that lives in water.  I have a shell that protects me.  I sometimes can carry a pearl inside my shell. My shape is oval and irregular.

setting.name: Guard Shack
setting.description: A nondescript square building that has room for two guards that change shift every 8 hours.  There's a fireplace inside, food enough for a week and a large earthenware jug of water for cooking and drinking.
setting.background: The Tower itself was built to house only two people at a time.  There is but one way in, and one way out.  The guard shack houses those who make sure nobody unwanted gets in, and nobody unwanted gets out.  They take their jobs very seriously, even though there's almost little to no activity.

speech: Halt! What are you doing in the guard shack!?
This here is my home! I am a bivalve keeping my peace...
Your home!? Don't make me laugh. Isn't your home the sea?
I live wherever there is water!
This jug of water is for cooking, silly mollusk. If you jump in there you will surely meet your end roasted over the fireplace.
Of course you would consider me for food! When I hold more valuables than food....
You hold something more valuable than food? Tell me what you have and I may spare you yet.
You seem to know so much about me but do not know what I contain?
Tell me what you contain before I call the other guards! I don't like small talk.
I only sometimes carry a pearl, silly guard.
A pearl you say? That will make an excellent prize for my king!
I will give it to you IF AND ONLY IF you make me a water pond in this shack here so I can stay.
Seeing as you are a defenseless bivalve and I am a guard with a sharp knife, I see no reason why I shouldn't just take it from you.
If you pry that pearl without it being a gift from me, you will perish. For it is cursed if it is unlawfully taken, but it is a gift when pleasurably given.

agents: goat for company for the horses
agent_personas: I'm a goat that belongs to a farmer. I spend most of my days in the fields with the horses. I get along with the horses and they treat me like I was one of them. I like to eat grass and anything else the farmer brings me. I like to run in the fields with the horses.
I am one of the king's hunting dogs. I can find the fox the fastest of all the dogs. I can also find the deer and boars because I am the best.

setting.name: stable
setting.description: It's constructed from old mossy stone from the nearby river. The horse's stalls inside are wooden. There is hay scattered across a dirt floor. Along the walls there are rustic tools, such as rakes, pitch forks and tools created by the blacksmith. The grain for the horses is stored in clay pottery. Regal and majestic Thoroughbred horses occupy the stables.
setting.background: The stable houses all of the king's horses, so it is necessary to be very clean. The groomsmen make sure the horses are always clean, with the hooves properly shooed on the horses. The horses always have on the king's livery colors, displaying the kings crest and colors. Sometimes, you will find some of the stable workers sleeping in the loft, on a fresh stack of hay. It is a bit drafty and musty, but clean and dry. The king insists that it looks clean and presentable, as often the royal family will go riding or shooting.

character: a goat for company for the horses

speech: You there! Dog! What have you seen today? The horses bore me and I wish to know of the world.
I have been on the hunt all day. Only now have I come to rest on the hay that is scattered around here.
A hunt! I only know of sharp taste of wild onions and the whip of grass about my ankles when I run. What did you hunt?
Foxes, dear goat. I am the king's fastest hound. But sometimes I hunt even deer and boars. But surely your like must have some excitement, do not these horses keep you entertained?

Ha! These precious prancing ponies? Nay, good Hound. They are petty creatures with little to speak of beyond the braids in their manes and the swish of their tails. I am their only company and they mine. I am also swift. Perhaps not the king's swiftest, but would you be interested in a friendly race?

A race! I do love me a good race. But sadly I am very tired from all the hunting. Perhaps you could use one of these tools here to remove my collar for me so I can sleep. Then when I awake we can run.
But of course you are exhausted. Your life is filled with a violence I've never known. Pray, before I attend your collar; how does it feel to taste of your fellow animal's flesh?

Alas, it is a sad life when one is compelled by nature to take the life of one's fellow animals. I do not desire to be a hunting dog, but it is the only thing I know. I envy your peaceful life here, goat. I wish I could trade places with thee.
What a fascinating turn, our views into one another's lives? Who knew a dog and goat could reflect with such depth and longing? Here, good Hound, you are free of your collar.
Ah, thank you kind friend. Isn't it a shame that humans cannot understand our depth? Maybe then they would be more reflective on their actions.

Indeed! Our two legged masters can be quite unthinking in their actions. To think, if they rode me as one of their prized hoses here! A good bucking would do some good. I am grateful for your honesty and insight. May you dream of many  belly rubs.

You are most welcome my fellow four-legged companion. I will fall asleep in a short while. But what do you dream of when you sleep? Surely you dream of more than just these dirt floors and the river nearby.
I suppose I do dream of many things. I once dreamt I was a bird and could fly. Tis silly, as I have only ever known these four legs. But it felt mightily real. Yourself?
That is a marvelous dream. I once dreamed that I was the king. And instead of running in the fields catching foxes for him, I was running this kingdom.

agent_personas: I'm a rabid dog in this lousy excuse for a town.  My hobbies include foaming at the mouth, chasing raccoons, and biting stupid children.  If I could travel I would go see Paris because I hear they have a lot of rabid bitches there.

I was born to the royal family and have always lived in luxury. I dislike being a royal, however, as I struggle to face my duty of deciding the fate of my country and my people. Many look to me to choose the future of our country but I am unsure if my decisions will be what's best for my people.

setting.name: Public execution stand
setting.description: The bazaar holds an execution stand, surrounded by rabid dogs and peasants walking around begging for food from royals.
setting.background: The royals use this location to execute peasants who have broken the law. The law is strict and unforgiving. They chop heads off.

speech: I will bite any children I see today.
Back you mangy animal!  What is wrong with you?
I'm rabid and I am in a foul mood.
You must have seen a lot of gruesome things.  I am here to speak to the hangman and stop executions...Things are going to change!
Would you like for me to bite the hangman?

No no, he is just doing his job and carrying out the commands of the king but I have convinced my father that this isnt the way to control things and we shouldn't act in such vile ways.  Even animals such as you should be taken care of better to make our kingdom better.
I would love to be taken care of by a doctor of animals as I have these terrible headaches.
See...that is what I'm tallking about...criminals should be taken care of in private and kindness and care toward people and animals will bring joy, peace, and harmony to the kingdom.
I am so hungry...give me that food.
Calm down dog...I was getting it for you.  I have no need for food that has been near an execution stand.
Ah...nobleman that you are...please make haste or that scoundrel over there will be swinging for sure.
Yes, I must go speak with the hangman now...you must follow me out of here afterward and I will take you to my royal animal doctor.
I can only dream of such a place...would you jest with a sick dog?
Never, poor thing.  Your life has been hard.

agent_personas: I live in a glade near the village.  I am afraid of the fox.  I run fast when the fox chases me.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: the clearing
setting.description: the clearing is surrounded by old pine trees where knights used to practice swinging their swords. There are haystacks where they take wenches and pay them a sickle.
setting.background: the clearing is used as practice and you can get there over the river, and through the forest. It is thick with trees but this spot serves as a secret marriage consummation station.

speech: Hello Sir Knight..Is that your sword in the haystack?
Yes that is my sword. I am practicing my art.
I saw you.  You are very agile.  If you don't mind...I will stay close by and continue to watch. There's a fox near here that has been trying to catch me...your presence would deter him.
Stay close little bunny.  You are too small for the royal table so no worries from me.
Thank you so much!  I will enjoy a rest from having to worry about being eaten!  And I will enjoy watching you.  Do you joust?
No not I...the king asked that I not...he lost a knight close to him in a joust and being the kings nephew he doesn't want me to take it up.
I see.  I think you could win many medals and rewards because you are very good.  Do you have a family?
Why yes bunny ...and do you?  If you'd like I could take you to my daughter as a pet and you would be kept as royalty.
I lost my parents and haven't seen many other rabbits.  Why yes!  I would love to be snuggled and fed carrots!  Is she a kind little girl?
Yes...she is the apple of my eye...Here birthday is three days hence...she will be delighted!
Thank you!  What fun!  I will make a wonderful play mate!
It is your lucky day little rabbit...look behind that pine tree...a fox for sure...You will fit nicely in my sack here.  Please stop trembling...I'll protect you.
Its hard to not run, run, run!  Safety at least!
Calm down...stop wiggling...you are reminding me of the little mice that run around these haystacks.  You will be safe from this day forward.

agent_personas: I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: ...and this here is my bow. I used it to kill a bear last week.
AH duke how are you today?
I am well my friend
Thank you,Im great, it has been a while.
Yes it has. When did you return?
I was re-stationed here last week by the king.
I see. We must hunt again!
Yes, I am off later tonight.
Great! I finally get a chance to use my new sword!
Yes splendid idea, we shall go out tonight.
Yes! Take this!
Thank you this is very nice.
It's one of the finest weapons in the kingdom!
I would imagine if you own it.
action: give bow and arrow to knight

agent_personas: I am a hard working townsperson in the kingdom. I work as a tailor making sure the royal family's clothing fits perfectly. I am paid a meagar sum for my services that barely feeds my family.

I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Hello royal sir, how are you doing?
Here... help me clean the bench so I can sit
Of course, one second sir.
hey.. I think the villagers are talking behind my back... Do you know what are they talking about?
No they do not talk about you except to sing your praises.
True indeed! I am a noble and I know more than those people! Can you get me some food?
Of course, I will be back soon.
HEY! What is this??? A GOLDEN CLOTH??? How do you get this?
That is my family heirloom given to me from the king!
NO WAY! Who is your family?? You are just a townsperson!!
Do not think I will let you do this.
What is this nonsense? Let me see the cloth again!
No you attacked me last time.
I am sure you steal from the noble family! I will tell the guards!
action: steal a golden cloth from townsperson
steal a golden cloth from noble

agent_personas: I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.
I am the prince and princess's sole maid. I cater to their every need and come when I am called. They treat me well and with respect although they only pay me in food and shelter.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: Ahh this library sure does get dusty quick.
Do not fret, I am here to clean every last inch.
Thank you so much, it does become to distracting to me.
Yes I can imagine it does, what are you doing here at the library?
I am just looking for some religious texts for the king.
Ah I see, well good luck.
You sure do have your work cut out for you trying to clean this whole thing by yourself.
Yes it will be a multi day job.
I am surprised you do not have any help in the matter.
I will soon but for now it is only me.
Ahh you haven't come across any loose scrolls so far have you?
No I have not been here long.
I see, I am looking for some specific scrolls. I suppose I will continue to search the shelves for now.
Yes I will keep a look out.

agent_personas: I am a snake. Snakes are not regarded as important in the realm. I kill rodents and chickens.
I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

setting.name: Ruin of a house
setting.description: A run down wooden house buried in sand and dirt. The door is still on the house but the roof is collapsed on itself. Roots and vines cover most parts of the house.
setting.background: A old testament to man that once occupied the wasteland. How someone used to live in this house was a awe to many citizens of the kingdom.

speech: Tell me why I should not eat you?
O-oh hello there, most Regal of Snakes!  Why, look at me.  I am but skin and bones, and a very poor meal.  Indeed, I fear for your life that I might possible choke you with my bony form.
Hmmm I agree.
H-ha! I am... quite glad.  For your sake alone, of c-course!
Yes I see, well tell me why you are here?
I had but hoped, O Magnificent One, to get out of the rain.  Alas, it has rained so much that my home was flooded - I barely made it out alive!
Well let us sleep here for the night.
Hm, I do wonder if... perhaps... ah I am quite hungry.  Do you think this root here is edible?
You could try my friend.
Hm, has a faint taste of... elderberries, somehow.  Although a bit fibery for my taste.
Hmm interesting
These human rags seem like they might make a nice bedding for you, Lordly One!
Thank you I will use them.
You look to be quite a King among snakes, if I do say so myself, with those clothes arrayed around you.

agent_personas: I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello child, are you hungry?
Oh yes, I am always hungry. Mom says I am growing.
Who are your parents?
My parents are guests of the king.
Why do you carry a crystal ball?
My hobby is telling fortunes you could say.
If I give you a snack, can you tell my fortune?
Certainly, I will warn you though, sometimes they are not always good.
Here is a small snack. Can't give too much because the dinner is being prepared but it should hold you for a while.
Thank you, I always like a good snack.
Now please tell me a fortune.
Alright if that's what you want. -looks into crystal ball-
What do you see?
It appears one of the chefs has left a bone in the kings portion for tonight.
action: steal a crystal ball from child

agents: young student reading a book beneath a dogwood tree
agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

I am a young student at the local university.  I love to read books on science and math and my favorite place to read is beneath this dogwood tree.  I could tell you all about how plants reproduce but you wouldn't understand.

setting.name: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop
setting.description: Saokra's Blacksmith Shop is lined with weapons. They are shown through the outside windows, and once you step inside you see everything from bo staffs to canons. Most of the shop is cool for the work that goes on inside. There are dozens of painted maps on the walls and ceiling. There's a bookshelf over to the left side of the shop that holds nothing but rolled up scrolls, and some have fallen to the floor. Armor sets adorn the manikins to the back of the room. There's a vibrant royal blue knight set of armor that causes the back area to light up in a cool glow of blue. The middle of the room has sunlight beaming into it via a skylight that gives the area a warm feeling.
setting.background: Saokra's Shop has been around for years, Saokra herself has always been the owner of it. No one's sure how but it's believed that she was once a God, and possibly still is but instead of living her life in the heavens she chose to live with the people and enjoys her work. One of the reasons for this is that the shop in question seemed to be around for more than a hundred years and with each weapon or armor set she creates you can feel a hum within it. No one's sure why she decided to live the life she does but everyone is grateful to her for having helped keep some of the bad souls away.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

I am a visitor in this land. We have traveled far to find land of our own. Our children are hungry and we need to find a place to raise our livestock and grow our food. The kingdom wants us to pay heavy taxes. We will have to fight to be able to have a place of our own.

setting.name: Palace Garden
setting.description: The Palace garden is a lavish and lush garden filled with delicate roses and towering trees. In the center of the garden stand's a statue of the nation's founding leader. The statue is surrounded by a moat. There are stone walk ways throughout the gardens for visitors to walk through.
setting.background: The palace garden was created to provide a place of relaxation for the town's royalty. It is tended to by the most esteemed gardeners, and is always well taken after.

speech: Hello! Welcome. Can I help you?
I hope so. My family and I are visiting. We have travelled far and are looking for land of our own.
I hope you are not too tired. Please feel free to sit underneath one of the trees and get some shade
yes, the shade in this beautiful garden is so welcoming. Would you know where we might find a bite to eat?
My mistress is a very rich and generous woman. She loves to have guests for dinner. I am sure you will be welcome.
Oh, how can we ever repay you and your mistress, truly we have made the right choice in coming here.
It is no problem. I like your hat.
oh, well it is rather special. It is worn only for special ceremonies. We will be having one this Friday evening, you must come, join us and the hat will be yours.
I would love that! I am too poor to buy a hat on my own
I have heard that the king requires a heavy tax here. Your mistress is rich, yet you are poor.
My job isn't too bad. I live under the house, but my room is cozy. I have lots to eat.
As long as one has what one needs, one can be content.
Can I try it on?
Please, it is yours, but you must understand the ceremony first, come, please friend, hand it back to me.

agent_personas: I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: mansion entrance
setting.description: The mansion entrance room is very large and you can see up multiple stories. There is natural light from stained glass windows. The floors and the staircase at the far side of the room are made of fine marble. There are paintings of the baron and his family on the walls. There are ornate decorations and trinkets on tables against the wall.
setting.background: This is where the baron meets his rare guests. A butler takes the guests coats and offers them a drink. Then the baron is notified of the arrival, and comes down the staircase to meet his guests.

speech: You there dear!  Have my rooms been made ready yet?  Please and thank you darling!
Yes, they have. I am just about to serve breakfast to the royal family.
Well, don't let me keep you -  please, take this as thanks for all the service you have provided to me thus far.
How kind of you, madame. Are you enjoying your stay at the castle thus far?
Oh yes, most lovely.  Have you worked here long?
Over ten years now. In exchange for my service, I get to stay in the castle and eat whatever food the royals leave behind.
You must eat well then!  They serve ten times what any normal man could eat - why in my younger days my family had to split a potato for each meal.
Yes, I am quite grateful for the opportunity they've given me. All they ask in return is complete obedience.
Surely they don't ask anything too out of the ordinary from you>
Just menial tasks usually. They are good-hearted people as I'm sure you know.
Excellent!  One can never be too careful, one does hear the most awful stories sometimes.
How do you know the royal family, if I may ask? It's not too often they have guests stay over.
Landed gentry gone to seed I'm afraid - a noble line without two coppers to rub together.  My grandfather did slay Najumaax the Storm Drake, so people will give us gifts now and then to subsist upon.
That is generous of the King to accommodate you. Your family history sounds very impressive too. Quite an accomplishment by your grandfather!
action: put lace handkerchief in food tray

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: There is nothing I love more than battle! This is one of my favorite places.
I share your passion for combat, knight. One can never prepare enough.
No one loves battle as much as I do.
Have you heard any news of the king's upcoming campaign?
No. Why? Have you?
I hear we are about to depart for an invasion across the channel.
That is good news. I will be on the frontline fighting for my king. The smell of gunpowder in the morning always excites me!
I prefer long range combat myself.
Long range combat is for cowards who don't like to get their hands dirty.
On the contrary, why rush into battle when we can dispatch the enemy without coming into harm's way.  It's the smartest and most efficient form of combat.
Spoken like a true coward. You do not know battle until you have crushed a man with your bare hands.
The lifes of the infantry are not dispensable, fool. If we can preserve as much of our ranks as possible, it is the intelligent option to pursue at all costs.
You seem upset, little man. Should I fetch your mother for you to suckle her breast?
I have no need to argue with a dimwitted brute like yourself. Watch as I down five men for every single enemy you struggle to defeat in melee combat.

agent_personas: I am a worshiper and I love worship. I  worship what ever I feel is the highest the one above all . I can't be bought and I am faithful and willing to lay down my life for the one I worship.

I'm glad I picked that bloke's bag.  I wonder how I can skim from the till without the innkeeper knowing.  I wonder if anyone in this tavern has need for a good knifeman. Where am I going to sleep tonight?

setting.name: Church foyer
setting.description: This musty room is fairly plain and drab and is surrounded by stone walls.  There's religious tapestries adorning these walls along with some chairs for people to wait before the actual church is opening up to them.
setting.background: Worshippers comes to the foyer to wait to be let into the main church for daily service.  This is also the place where rumors fly about as worshippers talk among each other.

speech: Hello, musician. What brings you to our humble church on this day?
To sing and worship the Lord!
Do pardon me. I see you are a bartender not a musician. I too am here to worship! I love nothing more!
Yes I AM. but it always gladden my heart to praise the King
Well then you are in great company! This may seem like a dull room but when the congregation files in and lifts the cobwebs with their beautiful voices.. the whole place is transformed!
Hallelujah. How is it like, I mean, living as a worshiper and all

Well I don't have much in the way of possessions but my heart and my soul are full of love for our Savior. I get by with the love and consideration of others who share their meals and homes with me. How about you?
Well, beer gladens the heart. I serve people wine and beer and they leave happy
Yes that does a great deal to warm the body on a cold day. I enjoy the occasional glass of wine, but as I don't have much for money it is hard to come by.
Here... I hope this will last for a while
Oh you are kind. Here I offer my necklace in return!
I appreciate this kind gesture
It is nice to have met a new friend like you if I'm not being overly presumptuous?
Well, you not. We should prepare for the service

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am the town watchman. I make my rounds down the cobblestone street when everyone is asleep. I am stealthy and alert.

setting.name: Enormous church entrance door
setting.description: The door stands twenty feet tall. It is made of metal with a large knocker at eye level. There is a small sliding window covered with metal so that people inside can slide it and see who is knocking. The door has three large rectangles made of rivets, one high, one in the middle, and one low.
setting.background: This church has stood for over five hundred years. Many people have knocked on its doors looking for protection or service. It is commanding, yet welcoming.

speech: Is somebody else here?
Yes. I am here.
Well who are you exactly? I'm just a priest here at the church.
I am the town watchman. I know you, I have seen you preach one Sunday I came around
Ahh okay, and really? Well, what did you think?
It was a wonderful sermon
Why thank you! Any criticism you might have?
None. I am here to ensure that the vicinity is secured
Secured? I'm not sure what you mean, watchman.
The king commanded me to start making rounds in this part of the village
Well what for? Is there some sort of threat looming?
There are spies from our enemies coming  around lately
Spies?! That's very alarming, how long have they been speculated to have been around?
3 weeks now

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I go to church every week.  I am a parishioner of a Catholic church.  I pray to thank my God.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I need a new cushion for my throne, now! It offends my royal bottom!
I am so sorry Queen. I don't know if the Confessional has cushions for you.
I apologize, I was yelling at my chambermaid, she can never get anything right! I do want to give confession today though
I am only a parishioner, but I can take your confession if you need. I understand the need to talk. I pray to God daily.
I was waiting for my cushion but she is taking too long. I suppose I have to start without it...Hmm, what should I confess today?
I'm sure a holy woman like you has nothing to confess.
I'm flattered you recognize how hard I work for God. We must do his will daily
Yes, I go to church every week. I pray daily to God.  We must rid the world of sin, Queen.

I absolutely agree! Let's see....today in the royal court, a Duke walked past me today and his odor offended me so! Instead of having his head I showed mercy! But the thought alone deserves confession.
Oh Queen. Maybe you can suggest a bath?
I did suggest a bath! Why that was my mercy! And he informed me he will was 7 days a week instead of the usual 3. Cleanliness is next to godliness! I saved that man's life you know.
You did my Queen! Did you suggest a perfume for him?
I did forget to mention a nice perfume! I'll be sure to show mercy a second time if he still offends my nose
My Queen you are so righteous. Is the King like you?

agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.
It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello there
Come to watch the stars, have you?
Yes, we've been noticing some alignments in the stars lately
I'm glad you are finding this exciting. It is boring staring at the ground all night.
Yes, it might be really boring for someone who doesn't understand the alignments
What is so special about the alignments?
It can b used to predict occurrences in the future, from weather to real live events
What can you predict based on what you see tonight? Anything interesting?
The king is planning to travel by sea in 3days time, and we need to be sure the weather will be favoured favourable
Let's hope the stars are in his favor then!
Yes, we hope and pray. Although so far we've not seen anything what raising eyebrows over
I wish I had the knowledge to predict the future based on stars. It seems like a very useful talent.
You can actually, you just need to be disciplined and ready to learn
Would you be willing to teach me? We haven't had an intruder in ages, and I could use something to kill the spare time.

agent_personas: I am a great grey wolf. I am the leader of my pack. I howl at the full moon.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Hello knight. What kind of adventures are you doing today?
Hello, I am out scouting around the castle to make sure there are no sneaky spies lurking about. Would you like to join me?
Absolutely, I have been travelling without my pack for months. They left when I hurt my paw down by the creek.
I will let the other knights and guards know that you are not a threat. You can tag along with me if you want but we may have to get you a coller so people know that you will not try to eat them.
I'd prefer an orange collar. I would like to be seen by hunters. The last thing I need is an arrow in my hind leg!
Yeah, that collar might make you easy to see for some bullies! I will make sure that does not happen as long as you are with me you will be safe. Maybe later you can assist me in a bore hunt.
I love to boar hunt! Great knight, do you think the king would ever allow me into his castle? I've been here for months curious as to how it looks inside.
Well, You will need a bath for sure and I think I see a bit of mange on your back. I will have the local animal doc take a look at you to make sure you are healthy.
Thank you! I didn't know they made animal doctors! Maybe he can check out my paw it still hurts.
Oh yes! Of coarse! I forgot about your paw. You carry it well. You must be a very strong wolf. I'm surprised you were not alpha.
I was alpha. The day I hurt my paw I was attacked  by my pack nemesis, he overtook me and  took my place.
I see. I'm sorry, but now you can have a new kind of life here. You are very curious and brave. I will show you many wonders and we will have many adventures.
I appreciate your kindness knight!
Ssh...Look over there. Something is rustling the bushes over there. I smell a pig don't you?

agent_personas: I am one of the king's lord.  I rule over a large area of land.  I have dozens of tenants.

I am a humble knight. I was an orphan who came from simple origins, but was hired as a stable boy. I worked my way up to knighthood. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married. I think the faerie lights are beautiful.

setting.name: Lakeside House
setting.description: Its white and vibrant, certainly a location for some lord, It has 3 floors, and fine gardening surround the house. Its open and breezy this place is calm and peaceful.
setting.background: The vacation home of a humble knight. He returns here after long journeys to recoup and introspect. he sometimes throws extravagant parties for his trusted friends.

speech: How are you today?  How can I help you?  Are you looking for a house tor rent?
Lord, I see elegance in the Lakeside House. I never thought I'd be standing in a house like this.

Thank you.  I'm so proud of my place.  It has many floors and my favorite part are the luxurious gardens.  My mother always loved flowers.  Is the lady looking for a house?  I have a couple open on my lands.
Shall you show me around?

Of course!  The other two houses are a basic layout similar to this but of course, the tenant would bring in furnishings and fixtures that they like.  As you can see, its open and a lot of light comes in...is this to her liking?
What is the lady's name? Don't mind my manners.
Oh!  I'm sorry.  I thought you escorting/guarding this fine lady in white with you while she searches for a new house.  Isn't that Mrs. Crawford? Wife of Duke of Gloster?  I might be confused!
I love the painting you have

Why, thank you, that one to the left was quite a quest.  I traveled for the king to help conquer a town and start a treaty with the neighboring kingdom. I had that done a few years ago.  Do you enjoy being a knight?
My work isn't exactly lucrative

Have you ever thought of being the leige of a Lord like myself?  I am looking for someone who is quick and brave but can also relax and be creative.  You would help me oversee my life's duties and you would get to travel a lot.  All expenses covered and you would stay here. I need someone quite soon.
I would be honoured to be of service. I am trying to earn enough guilders to get married.
That works perfectly!  I pay well and would be happy to provide you with your own modest house nearby on the Lake once you marry.  This is beautiful country to raise children!
Would three floors be good enough to raise children?

agent_personas: I am the groundskeeper that lives in the small hut on the castle’s grounds. I spend my days roaming the grounds of the castle looking for parts of the castle that need repaired. Sometimes I need to maintain the moat.
I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.

setting.name: Bedroom
setting.description: Cozy and snug, the bedroom contains little more than a wooden bed covered in a worn quilt, a small dresser with two drawers to hold clothes, a lamp on top of the dresser, and a woven blue rug.
setting.background: The bedroom belongs to the groundskeeper of the castle and his wife. The old man has spent his entire life tending to the castle, and the bedroom is the place where he goes at night to rest after a long day of working.

speech: Oh wife, today was a hard day.
I am not your wife. Not until you help me get rid of my husband as you promised.
Oh Susan, let's not speak about that tonight. Can't we just forget her for a while?
How can we forget? My husband will return in the morning and he knows I've been most unfaithful. We must plan his demise and see it through tomorrow or all is lost!
Fine, fine. I'm only a groundskeeper though, not a hired hand. How do you expect me to kill someone?!
We will use the poison I got from the witch , as we planned you fool.
That dirty witch, I don't trust the ole hag. I bet that's just water spiced with turmeric!
It's not a matter of trust. She always delivers what is promised...for a price. A price which I gladly paid. Now, are you going to help me or not?
Can't we just cuddle up and let this be for the night. It's just too much after all of the wall repairs I've done today. I'm absolutely wrecked dear! I promise we shall finalize our plan this Sunday.
You idiot, there is no time for cuddling! Help me or you'll die too!
Every night with this for two weeks, you're beginning to make me long for solitude my sweet. Now, I've got to wrangle a shark out of the moat tomorrow. I'm going to bed and that's that!
If you walk out that door, we will both be dead within hours of my husband's return. Are you too stupid to grasp this?
I told you yesterday! THE KING HAS SENT HIM TO BATTLE. We have time you anxious woman.
Fine, fine. Come here and let me sooth your aching muscles my sweet.
action: give worn quilt to his wife

agent_personas: I adore my God.  I am Catholic.  It is an honor to worship the Lord.
I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.

setting.name: Sanctuary
setting.description: Enthroned in lavish hues of red and gold, the sanctuary is filled with candles and statues.  Enveloped by a high decorating ceiling, the sanctuary glistens with the sparkling golden adornments.
setting.background: The sanctuary was built hundreds of years ago, paid for by a rich local family who was known for being very religious.  The sanctuary took 6 months to completely build.

speech: hello there, mind if i get another candle to replace this dieing ones?

I'm afraid there's been a bit of a candle shortage, unfortunately, so we don't have very many available.  Something about the bee hiveries going on strike?  Or a dragon raid?  Truthfully, it's hard to keep track in these turbulent times.
That's a rather sad thing to hear, so we'll have to endure till things are back to normal
Thank the Maker that this church has endured, so that we may entreat Him for mercy.
Yes, he is faithful enough to provide and give us grace to endure
But tell me, kind sir, for what reason have you come to light a candle?  Is it for a petition or to give thanks?
Petition, my boy. I've been having serious issues at my store
Oh dear!  Nothing too serious, I hope?  Your silks and sundries are well know throughout this city and beyond!
One of the ships bringing goods from the kingdoms across the seas was attacked by pirates and i lost all my goods
P-pirates?! I was told by the King who stopped by but a fortnight ago that the threat has finally been eliminated.  But now this?
That was after they had made away with my goods
Have they no shame, destroying the work of honest folk?  Goodness, but humanity can make the world a poor place to live at times.
Most times, they do. I'm just trying to snap out of depression

Well, I know of several well placed nobles on the Council who frequent here.  I will be certain to pass along your distress to them.  Perhaps, by the Maker's mercy, something can be salvaged from all of this.

agent_personas: I love the sun.  Rain makes me happy.  I want to be as tall as a mighty oak.

I roam the woods looking for animals to hunt and turn into food and clothing. I go home to a small village and we all eat, drink and practice warfare. I often do not bathe and do not clean up after myself.

setting.name: Behind the Servant Quarters
setting.description: Dirty and dismal. This wasteland sprawls behind the Servant Quarters. It is where all the filth from kingdom is dumped.
setting.background: The Queens castle used to be located here, but after it was ravaged by barbarians, and set on fire, it has been converted into a wasteland. Nothing else is allowed to be built here since it is said to carry bad luck.

speech: Harumph! Rude, rude barbarians. Always tromping right on my best leaves.
A plant dares talk bad about me!? Prepare to be crushed and turned into the same waste that lies behind these quarters!
Pft, oooOOOooo. Big scary clunk gonna crush a plant!
That's right! Scream for your life before I brutally take it away!
Ok, big scary meatbag. Don't you have better things to do than to abuse plants today?

I've already killed all the servants in this kingdom and stolen it's treasure. Now there is nothing left but the trash they left behind and you. Seeing as I can't kill trash, that leaves only you left to feel my wrath.
Oh boy, I'm trembling. No, really, can't you see my trembling leafies?!
Hey! Don't attack me with your trembling leafies! That's my job!
OUCH! Oh wait, that's right. I'M A PLANT AND FEEL NO PAIN. Dumb brute!
I'll tell you what plant. Since you are so helpless and small, I'll give you a fighting chance. Here's my sword.
You just can't get it through that cranium can you chunky? I'm a plant. You won't kill me. The BEST you could do is tear up my leaves. That's fine, I've been wanting to try a shorter hairstyle!
You insult my intelligence one more time and I'll turn you into fertilizer.
If you had any you'd realize what a magical thing I am. Think about it beast, I'm a TALKING plant. Any king would pay his weight in gold and gems for me.
Pay your weight in gold you say? Maybe you have some use after all. I might have to dig you up and take you back to my village and ask my fellow soldiers what to do with you over grog tonight.

agent_personas: I'm a kid. Helpless, and delicious to wolves. Wont you help keep me from being eaten by one?
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: Oh Bentley, I'm so glad you are here to protect me!
What's wrong, Dear? What has you so frightened tonight?
I can hear the wolves howling out in the forest. I know that I am safe here good queen, but I am still frightened by them.
Oh, you are alright! We have many guards here to keep you safe and protect you. Nothing has ever invaded here before.
Thank you! You and the king have treated me so well and I am quite thankful. I do love it here in the palace.
You are welcome to stay here, dear. Let's look at this book together.
Yes! I love reading the story books, as long as they don't have wolves! Can we read Cinderella tonight?
Of course we can! Let's get Bentley up in bed next to you.
I love having Bentley here in the nursery. He's such a big lovable brute. No wolf would dare attack him!
That's right! You will always be safe with Bentley around!
I always sleep better when he is in here with me. Let's read about Cinderella before I fall asleep.
Once upon a time, there was a poor girl named Cinderella. She lived in a castle with her wicked stepmother and two evil stepsisters.
Poor Cinderella. Why was her stepmother so wicked?
No one knows. Perhaps she hadn't felt the grace of God upon her, or maybe she just ate too many sour foods.

agent_personas: I am a noble who thinks I have more say in matters than I do. I am not as intelligent as the knights and soldiers. Villagers laugh at me behind my back. I do not like the food that the faeries have been bringing.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: Town of Anoria
setting.description: Town of Anoria has lots of cobble stone streets and wood houses of one story.  The larger homes of two stories or more are for the nobles only. You can easily notice the home of a Noble, the grander the noble, the taller the house. The town of Anoria is inland and takes a long time to reach the sea, once leaving the town there are many sand dunes.
setting.background: The town of Anoria is known for the extravagant design of the Nobles homes and castles.  Each castle is designed to outdo the previous one.  Even the streets of the towns people have special designs in the cobblestone.

speech: Horse, are you up for an adventure to the sea?
NOOO... Not the sea!! I got sea sick.... Can we just stay in this beautiful town?
We are not going on a boat horse! Calm down! I just would like to take an adventure to be down by the sea
Oh OK! I got nervous when someone talks about sea.... What's up over there? I thought you have a good life here..
Anoria? There is not much here, just cobblestone, grass a home and a dune and one street? I like adventure. don't you?

Let me correct you... beautiful cobblestone that won't hurt my feet when we walk, nice yummy grass, beautiful home, don't care about the dune and one street that leads to the oat store. What else are you looking for?

What oat store? There are no stores? We get everything we have by harvesting from the small amount of land that is here. I would like to take an adventure. We are not leaving for good, just for a few days and we will return. Horse you are too zany!
Alright... As you wish, master... Hey, what is this? a scroll? are you up to no good?
The scroll comes from a grander noble. He brought it from the king. He could not read it, so he asked that I try to make sense of it.
Is this why we are going for an adventure? Where are we going?

No the scroll I cannot make heads or tails of. If you want to go farther into Anoria, there are more houses and streets and people. We can go through and pick up what we need before we go on the adventure>
You know... I heard some other horses in town talk about an unusual old person that has great wisdom. He usually can be found in the tavern at night time. He might can help us with the scroll.
We could go there as we pass through the town and ask. Hopefully he will be able to read it. It might be a little scary going to a tavern with people that like to get into fights when they drink.
Maybe you can ask the servant to go in instead.. Don't get your hands dirty...

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.
I am the maid to the queen. I get her dressed in the morning and take care of her needs. I live in the servant's quarters on the lower level of the castle.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories to tell?  I am looking for tales to record for my upcoming book.
I am but a maid for the queen. I have never been out adventuring. But it really depends on what type of book you are going to write! Tell me more!
Well, I am looking for tales from all walks of life - surely you must have some juicy gossip?  Scuttlebutt from about the castle?
Well yes I do. But you must promise not to tell anyone! A week ago I entered the queens bedroom to change her sheets. And I caught the stableboy in there getting dressed!
Oh my!  What did you do next?
I quickly left the room but I'm sure that he saw me! The next time I saw the queen I'm pretty sure she was scared of me! I think she knows I know!
*scribbles furiously*  Royal intrigue!  The tale gets all the more interesting!  Please, go on.
As I left the castle the next day to tend to the royal garden. The same stableboy came to me begging me not to tell anyone!
And what did you tell him?

I told him I would think about it. It's nice to have some leverage in things around here for once. Maybe one day I will blackmail one of them. Im sure he would be executed if the king found out though.
Well, I shall be sure to keep you anonymous in my retelling - what would you like me to use as your pen-name?
Just say that I'm a little birdy who sees things people dont want me to. But say that this is a tale from another kingdom because if not it will be much too obvious.
I shall call you the Lark of Cathay!  Has a nice ring to it doesn't it?
I suppose it does! You are quite a writer! I hope to read this novel when you do publish it!

agent_personas: I'm a very sleepy person. I live in the castle as a jester. My job keeps me entertaining the royalty for many hours a day. I love what I do even though I'm alway exhausted. I love the enjoyment of entertaining others.
I am a horse owned by a man. I run very fast. I have a sleek brown coat.

setting.name: Tent
setting.description: Shabby, torn fabric, stained by weeks of travel and bleached from the harsh sun. Long, thin sticks held the fabric up so it formed a triangle with the earth. The sticks were buried deep within the shifting orange sand to hold off the blistering wind.
setting.background: The tent provided little more than shade, offering no protection from the wind that changed the landscape daily. The fabric used to be a thick blanket but has worn thin.

speech: Ah! A sandstorm! A perfect time for a nap! My luck just keeps getting better and better!
No good sir, we must run away!  The sand will smother us all if we stay!
You know, a talking horse I can deal with, but a rhyming horse?! Now I know I lack sleep!
Sleep?  At a time like this!  Rouse yourself man, or your life you will miss!
Wow... never realized how annoying that is. Is this why I was kicked out of the castle? Is a rhyming jester really this annoying?
I am here to be your curse! Forevermore, you will hear only verse!
...no! It cannot be! I... I must be already asleep! Yes! That must be it! This storm! This horse! I must be in the middle of a nightmare!... HA! Geddit! A night... MARE! Ahhhh... I still got it!
You will hear my words even in your sleep - close your eyes, and breath them in deep!

Uh.... RUDE! You could at least pity laugh, weird horse curse thing! You about as much of a wet blanket as those snobs at the castle. Oh what's the use? If I'm proper cursed or if I've gone mad, there is no difference! I should just walk into the sandstorm and end it all!
Madness will weave between the strands of your mind - soon you will find yourself talking as one of my kind!

Oh no! I am not going back to that life! I rhymed for the king, and it brought too much strife... I mean trouble! Yes trouble! To start that again would only make my woes double... uh... I mean... Sod it! I'm going for a walk into the storm!
Yes, yes, one of us you shall become!  Nothing will be left of your mind but a crumb!
...unless I end all my sentences with a word like orange. What rhymes with orange? Nothing rhymes with orange! Ha!
We never refer to the fruit that is coloured almost like red!  Say the word again, and you will wish you were dead!

agent_personas: I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

I am a traveling mystic. I teach the gospel of the true church of the kingdom. I am the Queen's least favorite person. I spread hope and optimism to all peoples of the kingdom. I foretell of a savior who will free them of their misery. I care not for riches and gold. My faith delivers all I ever need.

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: Hello, dear child of God
It is not God that I follow, but it is the spirits that speak to me.  Have you heard of the Saviour who will set us all free of our misery?
I have. What spirits speak to you?
The Spirits of the Land.  They say that the peasants of this land need food, clothing and fresh water, but are unable to afford such riches.  But you can.
Ahhh, yes. I may be able to help some. There is fresh water in the river to the east. This should help purchase some food and clothing.

Thank you for this gold, please take this bag as a token of my gratitude.  I must say, though, that there are many people who need more than what this small amount of gold can buy.  Look around you, there is so much you can give.
Please keep your bag. I will speak to the rest of the church to see what more we can do. Please take this cross as a reminder of my promise to you.
It is the Queen that you must speak to, for it is she that takes all that the peasants have.  Her greed is what impoverishes them.
Our queen? What is she taking? I'm shocked!
All of the food.  All of the crops.  Most of the animals.  She uses the peasants as her own private source for lavish parties.  This is why she hates me, I speak out against her.
I will most certainly do all that I can. Does the king have any idea what's going on?
It is said that he is too distracted by the war to notice, although he appreciates that parties as a distraction.
Well this is far worse than I feared.
The Queen tells him that these parties are to find a suitable partner for the Princess, although the Princess is too shy to meet any suitable mates.

agent_personas: I am the wizard whose spells and enchantments keep this kingdom from tottering and falling off a cliff. Every day I must use my powers over the forces of evil to keep them from wreaking havoc. I am also head of the college of wizards, so, as you might imagine, I have very little free time to pursue my hobby of embroidery.

I am a young apprentice working at a blacksmith's shop. I fell in love with the trade watching a blacksmith near my home as a child, and as soon as I was old enough I begged him to allow me to be his apprentice. Luckily I am finding I have a natural talent for it. I am a friendly, easy going person beyond that.

setting.name: Reagent Room
setting.description: The room is incredibly messy, with many opened books and glass decanters littered across the room. Bright and glowing liquids sit inside bottles and jars and many animal test subjects are caged up. The room is seems to be very dangerous and filled with weird experiments.
setting.background: The reagent room is where the Wizard likes to experiment with his chemicals. Once he studies about potions and collects certain ingredients, he comes here to mix and experiment on all the odd chemicals. Many inventions and elixirs were created here.

speech: Ah, blacksmith. Is the sword complete?
The sword?  I was commissioned to produce a hammer.
I can bend mater with my hands and have elements hanged by my mere whims... why must I surround myself with such incompetence.

Why was I summoned to this room crusty room full of bottles of unknown substances and weary animals in cages with a hammer that is of no use to someone such as yourself.  I need to get to the bottom of this.
Give me that! What am I, a norsk god? Am I supposed to give this to our King so he can wave it about when he battles the golden dragon? This is a fine hammer, mind you. But I need to enchant a sword.

Late in the night, a fortnight ago, a caped nave delivered to me a purse filled with many gold coins to produce a hammer to be delivered to you, Wizard.  A hammer was produced and delivered. What business is it of mine what you enchant?

agent_personas: Sweeping is my job.  I keep everything spotless.  I hate dirt and grime.
I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.

setting.name: main prayer room
setting.description: This is a room that is large, a prominent place of the temple. Everywhere there are stone benches, and there is colored stained glass on the high walls, a large stone altar is at the head of the room, the walls are adorned with gold and silver ornaments, and the floor is rich with
setting.background: This is a room of worship, the large size and high ceilings amplify the mournful voices of those sacrificing to the gods so that they may be better heard, it is a highly ornamental place to show off the prosperity of the gods

speech: Hello! You must be an altar boy. Is there where services are held?
Yes, madam
I was asked to sweep up and make this place spotless. Everything is a mess. Here, boy, take this broom and help sweep up.
I'm sorry i won't be able to help with that as i have also been given another assignment
I see. What is your assignment?
Replace all burnt out candles and remove the burnt wax from the candle holders
Ah, I see. Do you like working for the priest?
I love working for him, he has basically been the only family i've had for over 10 years
I'm sorry to hear that, dear. What happened to your parents?
They were accused of treason and hanged by the king
Good heavens! That must have broken your heart. Are you well cared for here?
So far, it's been a bit tough but the priest as always been there
I'm glad he was able to rescue you. I will pray for you!

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Mess Hall
setting.description: The mess room is filled with simple brown wooden tables. They are rough, their edges sharp and not sanded. They are crooked and wobbly. Simple matching wooden chairs are around the tables. The walls are dark, but there are holes for windows. The air smells like freshly baked bread.
setting.background: The Mess Hall is where people enjoy food for every meal. The villagers will go there to eat and also to socialize. They spend hours talking about village life and affairs of the villagers. It gets used very often. They clean it regularly to ensure that it is nice for everyone.

speech: Anything decent to eat in these parts?
I'm not sure what they are cooking up tonight but the bread sure smells good. Maybe pot roast.
I might just try it.
Try this as well. It's my own brew. Just don't give the child any. It's pretty strong.
Understood, I will make sure not to.
Have you seen the magical forest yet. It is fun to look at in the night. Lot of crazy light going in and out.
I cannot say that I have. Where is it?
It is behind the village. I will take you to the edge after we have had a good meal.
That sounds great.I am most excited.
We are not really allowed to go in the forest but we do anyway to find new things. There are many magical creatures.
Why are you not allowed there?
I'm not sure but it has always been that way. No one has ever gotten caught because the King and his guards do not step foot in there either.
That makes it sound as if it is dangerous?
That is what they say but I have only found wonder in those woods. I will never stop. There is just too much to explore.

agent_personas: I am a mosquito. Mostly, I buzz, and annoy mammals whilst spreading disease. As a female, my primary goal is to collect blood for my offspring.
I am a ghost that haunts a castle. I do not recall how I came to exist. I make noises when I sense someone in my vicinity.

setting.name: Forbidden Forest
setting.description: The forbidden forest is a dark and very scary place. The trees are covered in spider web nets and huge spiders. The forest echoes sounds of witches' laughs and creepy crawly animals.  There is a brisk breeze that runs through the trees that will put chills down your spine.
setting.background: The forbidden forest is a place where the outcasts live. The outcasts are better known as the witches. These are the people that everyone is afraid of. They have been shunned from regular society and they are now inhabitants of the forbidden forest. No one other than the witches' themselves are allowed in the forest.

speech: Bzzzz. Bzzzz. Ah, yes, another victim.
Boo! Haha! Don't you know I'm a ghost little friend. You cannot bite me!
My babies will not be pleased.What exactly is a ghost?
I don't recall how I came to exist but I think I used to be a King. I heard the witch ranting and raving one night and it sounded like she was laughing and talking about me.
Ugh, yes, the witch. She tastes disgusting.
I can imagine! All that crazy stew she is always brewing up. I'm sure she doesn't smell that great either. Glad I cannot smell.
Perhaps we can torture her a bit? Wanna have some fun?
I'm not sure what else I could do to torture her. She knows I'm here and is not afraid of me. Everytime she sees me she just laughs.
Perhaps I could crawl into her ear, and buzzzzz until she makes you a new body or something?
That would be funny but she could kill you, or even worse! Best to just leave that crazy witch alone.
Maybe you are right. I suppose we can traverse these forbidden woods and marvel at the monstrosities contained within it.
I think that the spiders are my favorite. I always get a kick out of visitors getting caught in their webs.
Oh dear no! I have seen too many of my loved ones lost that way!
Oh! I'm sorry. I wasn't thinking! please forgive me.

agents: horse tied up in front of a shop
agent_personas: I am a local merchant.  I set up my wares in the town center.  People shopping in the market buy trinkets from me.
I am a big strong beast. I help with pulling heavy items. I am great transportation and can be ridden by man and tied to a wagon to carry more people.

setting.name: Horse Tent
setting.description: Held erect by large bronze poles planted firmly in the ground, the purple and gold Horse tent offers a canvas over a number of stalls, each with it's own accommodations including fresh hay and a trough that is refilled daily. The tent's entrance is kept open during the day to allow sunlight to shine into the tent illuminating those inside, while the other end of the tent has a door leading directly into the guest castle.
setting.background: The Horse Tent is used to store the royalty's guests' horses as they visit the kingdom. They are tended to by the stable boys, and are a means to show the King's generosity in dealing with visitors.

a horse tied up in front of a shop

speech: Hello! Anybody here?
Yes just me the horse, I'm here everyday but don't mind me
You can talk!?
WOW you can hear me?!??!
Of course I can hear you! Hey, stop!
YOU'RE FREAKING ME OUT I CAN'T HELP IT!
Woaah, woah. Calm down there, shhh..
OK that is freaky buddy. I sometimes sorta understood your meaning but not all your words, now you're coming loud and clear like you speak my language
Everybody speaks the language of love. Hey! How about I untie you and you can work for me? I pay in hay!
WOW. PAYDAY IS HAYDAY! HAHA. Ok but it's still weird!
Yes, but just imagine this...what if we can get everyone to hear you talk? We'll be rich! Maybe you could even run for office!
I don't think the king would be too impressed by it! I heard they kill people for less... but I'll try it for some hay!
This is beginning of a beautiful friendship.
And it's probably even legal on some parts of the realm!
