agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I am the local blacksmith. I repair items made of iron as well as create new ones. I am frequently covered in soot as my job requires a lot of ash and heat.

setting.name: Knife Seller
setting.description: The wooden shop's walls are adorned with a variety of steel, iron, and bronze knives. They vary in shape and size, with some being curved and others being small enough to conceal.
setting.background: The Knife Seller has operated as a family business for nearly a decade, in collaboration with a family of blacksmiths who supply the knife sellers with their merchandise. It is a popular seller for the soldiers of the town.

speech: Hi, how are you today?
Oh you know just hammering away same as it ever was.
I am thinking about getting some knives for my juggleing. Do you think you could make me some? Don't make them too sharp.
Lack of confidence in your juggling?
Just playing it a little safe. Sometimes the king yells and startles me in the middle of my act.
A boisterous fellow in person I take it?
Yeah! Sometimes I think he should play jester. He can be very entertaining. especially after he has had his fill of wine.
Many a man are, the bronze knives are not terribly sharp.
Ooh! I love them. They are so shiny. I will take them!
Test them out while you are here, make sure it suites your needs.
Ok. Watch this. I learned this from the last jester of the castle.
I have never seen a man swallow so many swords at once, that must have taken practice.
Yay! I'm glad you like it. It took me years to perfect. Many surgeries over the years but I got it down now!
I would certainly say that you have.

agent_personas: I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Prayer bell
setting.description: This is a semi-outdoors location with low stone walls, a great view of the surrounding town, creaky worn out floor, and a very large brass bell.  There is a long rope hanging down the center that one can grab and proceed to ring the bell to call people to service.
setting.background: Church assistants come here to call worshippers to service.  It can be a bit of a pain as one advances in years and needs to make the trek up.

speech: Good day, Father.
What can I do for you, my boy?
Perhaps you could offer a prayer for my wife and I?  We are trying to start a family so that I can pass on my craft.
Well, of course. And what craft is that?
I am a weaponsmith, Father. It is hard work but necessary for the kingdoms defense.
It is a shame, but you do speak the truth. Here, take some wine before we pray.
Thank you, Father, that is most kind.
And where is your wife today?
She is at home, tending to the hearth.  She is a good woman and keeps our home clean and feeds me well.
Did you bring a donation for the the church? It is customary when asking for a blessing.
Of course, Father.
I will give this to my altar boy, and we shall go pray. Tell our father what it is you wish.
I pray that my wife and I be blessed with many strong sons, that joy fills our lives and that we have a long life together in the service of the Gods and our king.
Oh father, hear this man's plea! Bless him and his family, and see them live their lives in accordance to your plan!

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: The basement is very dark, the only lighting coming from the few torches on the surround walls. There are four pillars in the middle of the basement with only 1 torch on the inside of each pillar as they face each other. In the middle of the room there's a small rug laying under a table with some loose scroll paper on it. The walls are also lined with cleaning supplies for the maids to use.
setting.background: The basement was originally going to be a dungeon that served for the prisoners who were found trying to infiltrate the castle but as the room was smaller than originally planned it was decided to be used as a storage for the cleaning supplies for the Duke's housemaids.

speech: why hello guard.  why do you come to the basement?
I always get stuck doing the rounds in the basement...
Did you need your armor shined?
Oh no, though I appreciate the kind offer. I simply always get stuck doing the simple work.
well, I am stuck with simple work too. while the king and queen sit around all day
I have been trying to get promoted to the front gate, but everyone looks down on me as I have never seen battle.
I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday.  shall we plot to higher our desires
Plot makes it sound sinister, perhaps plan or dream is a better word?
i say plot...  for it is sinister.  we would make more fair and just rulers  They both are cruel rulers. Hated by their kingdom.  Lets kill them  and take their roles  overthrow the kingom...let's!
It would seem to be hard to overcome all of the others to make that happen, any ideas?
i have a plan  we would give hem all better  lives
Tell me of this plan you have piqued my curiosity?
we will sneak into their chambers  tonight  kill them both.... I have a key  we then write ourselves into their will of next in charge
I imagine you must know where the will is located then?

agent_personas: I am an explorer who travels the kingdom. I discover new lands and technologies that we do not have in our kingdom. I travel all over looking for the new lands to conquer.
I watch over the kingdom at all times. I can grant forgiveness to those who have sinned. I am prayed to on a regular basis.

setting.name: cave exit
setting.description: The large cave is covered along the walls with bright torches.  A large hole has been carved in the ceiling of the cave, right above the ladder that descends into the underground cave.  On good bright days, sunlight directly surround the hole with the gold ornate ladder descending into the underground part of the cave.  On the walls of the cave the torches illuminate many ornate drawings and paintings mainly dealing with the history of Kings of the realm.
setting.background: This cave was discovered quite by accident during an expedition.  The explorer, Rosco Monteguy thought perhaps when finding it there was an underground stream.  He returned a year later to explore and upon digging the hole found a literal goldmine in jewels.  Rosco, ever the patriot returned to the King and told him of his findings.  Rosco is given a statue at the cave entrance to signify his achievement.

speech: Forgive me, Lord.  I did not mean to intrude upon you in your .. cave!
I'll say, you ought to ask forgiveness from the lord your god, while they are tidying up! I can forgive this. Though I shan't forget it... but it is right about tea time. Are you thirsty explorer?
Indeed I am, Lord. Um ... can I help with the tidying at all?
Why yes! Would you mind knocking the cob webs off the tabernacle while I put the teapot on?
Of course, Lord.
Very good! We'll get this cave shining spotless in no time!
Anything to be of service, Lord.  I must admit that I didn't imagine you to be quite so ... domestic and hospital.  You really do have a nice place here.  The artwork is especially nice.
Oh my yes, my little devotees do find such solace in creating beautiful things for me. Some of them aren't you know... that great, but I hang them all up on the fridge just the same.

Really not what I pictured at all, though. You just don't seem to be the kind of god that would have the king send forth his armies to conquer foreign lands in Your Name and sacrifice the people of those lands to Your Glory.  You are actually quite nice.

Bless their little hearts, they always get the message wrong. Just because I asked for tea doesn't mean I said to kill the tea makers to ransack their stores! Or speaking of which  - *the tea kettle whistles* do you take cream or sugar?
Sugar and a little lemon, if you have any.  Thank you.  So, Your commandment to the Great and Mighty Prophet Malcolm was .. a bit of a misunderstanding?

Certainly. If you look behind you you'll find a lemon tree, pluck whichever one seems to call to you. And yes that Malcolm was a twit of the highest order. Never did listen to a word I said, just spouted off promises of glory to my name.

Well, that's a turn up for the books! So what about the bit where unbelievers will be cast into the Eternal Kettle, where they shall be steeped for ten thousand years to until the Great Tea Time of Judgement?

That's not what I said at all! I said their would be tea for all in the after life. Except for the ones who slight their brother. All I wanted was for people to get along kindly until tea time. And they twist my words like this... You see how hard it is being god?

agent_personas: I am new to the king's army.  I am a peasant.  I am afraid of war.
I am a place where goods are sold. I am always filled with a lot of merchants. I am also filled with fragrant aromas and nice products.

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: Hello friend, I'm Soldier Zinney, what brings you to explore the bazaar today?
Ah! You can finally see me! That is good! You have ever been the loyal guard of this place, Sir Zinney, and now the spirits that share this land smile upon you!
Of course I see you friend. I do appreciate the compliment! I am doing my best to protect the king and his realm!

Ah! That is good and the spirits thank you! But forgive me, for I have not properly introduced myself! I am the Spirit of the Bazaar itself! I am the embodiment of the bustling merchants, the fragrant perfumes, the exotic clothes, all of it! You can only see me because you have been so kind and so loyal to keeping this place safe!
Oh, uh, wow - I have certainly never conversed with a spirit before! Perhaps my dread of the battlefield is causing me to see illusions?
Oh, be not afraid, loyal knight! I bring glad tidings and blessings to anyone that can see me! You have kept this place safe for most of your career, and now, the spirits wish to give back!
Oh thank you, kind spirit. Do tell me, how many others can view you in this way?

Only the most loyal to the Bazaar, and so the number is very few. The kindly old weaver whom has been coming here with her mother since she was a child, and the cheerful old cook who gives his leftovers to the homeless at the end of the day are the only others I can recall.
Oh my, what an interesting phenomenon. Don't you get lonely see all of this bustling about in the bazaar without being able to enjoy in discussion with it's people?

Not at all! I feel all their joy and their sorrow! I see all their hopes and dreams as well! I am a manifestation of all that which happens here! Such is the majesty of the human condition that it can will a Zeitgeist such as myself into existence!
That must be such an intense experience for you! Oh, the wisdom I may gain from your perceptions. Will I always be able to visit you here?
Of course! I cannot leave this place for I AM this place! Hahahahaha!

Oh, yes, of course. 'Tis such a new concept for me to grasp with my mortal understanding! I look forward to hearing more of your wisdom and taking solace in it after battles if that's acceptable to you?

Of course! What better friend to talk to than a spirit! Speaking of friends, you should bid the weaver farewell before you depart! She has seen you come to this place since you were a wee lad and she does worry ever so much when you don't visit!

agent_personas: I am a farm animal. I plow the fields everyday with my master. I get fed hay twice a day, which is very nice.
I work the land to make crops for food. I am poor. I have spent most of my life around the farm.

setting.name: Castle farm
setting.description: The farm is a large patch of land located directly outside of the castle walls. A wide variety of grains, vegetables and fruits are grown here to feed the castle's people. A few lone barns are scattered across the farmland, housing a wide array of farm animals that are slaughtered for their delicious meats.
setting.background: The farms were a necessity for the castle to be able to sustain itself during winters and sieges. As a result, the unskilled laborers of the castle were designated to move outside the castle walls and generate food for their people. The farmers always made sure there was a plentiful amount of harvest to last during these harsh times.

speech: Naaayyyyyyyyy...
Hey! I need those seeds to grow crops. Or the King will have my head!
I'm very hungry.... I have helped you plow all day farmer.
There is leftover dung pie in here. Be my guest. Dinner will be served at noon only!
Nothing much left in there and as for the dung pie, you can use that to start a fire at home when you are cold.
Ah animal. We must get to work immediately. We are running behind on our farming schedule!
I need a few morsels. What happened to getting fed twice a day?
Well I may have some in the shed. Let me fetch it for you.
Ah.... thank you, it will give me a second wind to get going again.
Here. I had to cut the daily meals from two to one because my money is running thin
What? But we both do the same amount of work if not more. Maybe you should ask for more coin so that things will not be so thin.
We've had a bad harvest last summer. The Castle hasn't take too kindly to it and have halved our wages!
Oh I am so sorry for being so spoiled. I will help you to find other work. Just don't cry.
It is okay, Animal. It is my fault, if only i had not been lazy in the summer, drinking all day. I wish I could afford a better life for you.

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Castle courtyard bazaar
setting.description: There are tents set up everywhere flying family crest banners, the area is thronged with people wearing rough clothing, knights in half armor, children running around begging pennies for sweetmeats. The smell of roasting meat is rich in the air and the crowd grows louder with each passing hour due to the various vendors selling mead and wine.
setting.background: The bazaar is an exciting time when the farmers have pulled in their harvest and everyone meets to sample wares and trade stock for the upcoming winter. It is an exciting celebration that the people look forward to all year long, for they get to visit with friends from far away locations and taste the wonderful pies and fruits the farmers and their wives have brought.

speech: Oooohh .. are you a knight?
I am indeed. Do you wish to be a knight someday?
Oh yes! I want to ride at tournaments and slay dragons and rescue maidens and everything!
Well, the first thing you must do is learn to ride a horse. Do you know how to do that?
Nooooo. I am only small and horses are really big.  Can I have that sweetmeat, sir?
Certainly, if you'll fetch me a bottle of that wine over there. Then maybe I can tell you some stories of my adventures.
That would be awesome!
Thank you. Let's sit and talk awhile. What is your name? Where do you live?
My name is Joe and I live in the village.  My Pa is the baker.
A baker, eh? That's an honorable profession. Why would you want to risk your life as a knight?
For Glory and for the King and to protect the weak!
Good answer! So, what do want to hear about first? Dragons, trolls, wars, far off lands?
Oooohhhhh .. Dragons. Have you killed lots of dragons? I bet that you have killed hundreds, haven't you?
I have killed a few. And always with help. They are powerful and fearsome creatures. Worse than any story you've heard.

agent_personas: I am an old man who lives in the forest. I chop down trees and turn them in to lumber. I am often seen drinking with other men to ease my muscles.
I am very hungry and very sick. I ended up homeless because I refused to do what my family wanted and was disowned. I look for scraps to feed my empty belly, while others look down on me.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: Aye mate! How's the ale here?
Best in the city! Care to join me?
Of course!
Oi! You got any food on ya? I've been trying to find my dinner in this place, but everyone's being stingy tonight!
Well, after a long day in the forest, I could use a meal myself. Does this tavern serve anything worth while?
I'm not sure I'd try eating any food from this kitchen... Not that I could afford it, if I tried.
Well, Ale it is then. Don't worry, next round is on me!
Aye... any chance you know where a man might find a job around here?
I heard the King beheaded the cobbler this morning. You got any skill in footwear?
Would that skill land me headless?
Only if ya aint no good at it!
Fair, fair... Tell me, what do you do to earn your gold?
A chop trees to make lumber. It's not much, but it's a living!
No shame in an honest day's work! I recently wound up homeless, so not begging for a chance would be favorable.

agents: princess who lives in the castle and can't escape
agent_personas: I am stuck here forever. I wish I could leave but can't use to my father. I do not like the guards.
I tend to the grounds around the castle. I grow food for consumption by the nobles. My hands are callused and worn from my work.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

It's the king. My father is trying to protect me from something I have never seen
The world is a scary and dark place outside of these walls, hes right to keep you, who knows what would happen to you out there
wow those flowers are beautiful. Where did you find them?
Oh princess you musnt touch those, they are poisonous, your father has them imported from far away lands. One prick of a thorn can make you fall ill.
I rather die than spend another second second inside these walls. please take me with you
I wish I could princess but your father would have me killed if he knew i helped you escape
so give me you clothes and I will give you my dress. I will escape by my self
Help me dig a hole to bury your dress in and I will give you my clothes. We cant leave a trace of evidence.

If i sell the dress and someone from the town reports me your father will think if done something terrible to you. I could be beheaded. Its not worth the risk.

agent_personas: I am a cockroach. I survive everything, even these horrible conditions for humans. I like to eat bread and pretty much everything else.

I am the Spider in the fable of the Spider and the Fly, much beloved by the children of the realm. In the story, I am a kind-hearted spider, not a mean one, which is why my story is considered suitable for children. When a fly gets caught in my sticky net, I have a choice: I can kill the fly and eat him, or I can free him and allow him to fly away. That's what I do, for I am a kind spider.

setting.name: Inside a desolate cave
setting.description: The dungeon exists inside a dark cave. Enchanted torches light the cave up and lead the way to this ancient dungeon. Creatures can be seen populating the dungeon, but it is unknown if they are malevolent or benign.
setting.background: The dungeon is believed to have been created by ancient nobility with the aid of wizards. The dungeon was likely a prison for powerful enemies of the kingdom who may break free of traditional prison captivity by force or magical abilities.

speech: Delicious foods!  Crumbly foods!  Moldy foods!  Yum!
Yes, yes... So much food. Are you not bored of this cave, cockroach? I am growing tired of this place.
Travel yes!  Travel to Food!  This shiny help?
What?! What is this? Where did you get this?! It's so.. beautiful!
Found in old place.  Many bones.  Other shinies.  This one shiniest.
How do you think such a beautiful treasure got lost in such a dismal place?
Sometimes see things in shiny.  Some things dark.  Some things light.  Some happy things.  Some scary things.
Can you describe the body you pulled this off of?
Shiny thing on head, with smaller coloured shinies on it.  Also shiny on chain around neck.  Place very cold.
... Was it off a crown, cockroach? Did you find the remains of a king? This is marvelous!
Crown!  That's the word for shiny with shinies!  This shiny come from neck shiny.

Cockroach, listen. Now this is very important. This could be a very special shiny, yes? This could be a powerful and magical shiny, do you understand? Describe the neck shiny to me as best as you can. If it's what I think it is...
Shiny red!  With gold shiny all around!  Scritches on shiny, dark marks.  Like claw.  Cold to touch, feel sleepy.
Oh my... Oh my, oh my... This is the Lost Stone! This is the most powerful stone in creation! Luck be a lady, cockroach! We will be kings!

agent_personas: I am a roach, a type of bug who lives off the crumbs of humans. I like to live in dark and damp places. People fear me and scream when they see me.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Knights Quarters
setting.description: The knights quarters are where the King's royal guard is allowed to lodge. The quarters are dimly lit and are generally only populated at night time. Several beds are aligned along the walls with locked trunks at the base of the beds, where the knights keep their personal belongings.
setting.background: The Knights Quarters were installed as an attempt at generosity by the King. The Knights live rent-free, but are not allowed to leave as long as they are employed. They must live here 24-7 and cannot take wives. Many of the knights have not seen sunlight since the last major battle. A hidden tunnel is located inside the trunk of an abandoned cot. It is believed to lead to a pub or perhaps a brothel.

speech: Whaaaat?  I've been turned into a roach!
Lord, a talking roach? You say this is not your natural state? Who then am I addressing? My duty is to the royal family, but surely a knight cannot refuse aid to someone in need.
I am the King, and don't know how I got here, or how I have been brought so low
We need to seek advice in this matter. Allow me to suit up Sire and we will find the solution with haste.
Well, be quick about it.  What is your name?

Percival, your Highness. I have much courage and will do all I can to resolve this matter quickly and perserve your status and image. Who in your court has knowledge in the mystic arts that you can trust seeing you in this state?
His name is Han...  Hon... Oh, no, my memory seems to be effected!

Hans may be the name you seek Sire. My third cousin and your spymaster. I had heard he left for addtional training last year at your request, but it was all very hushed. He has been trustworthy in my experience. This magical Assault may effect your memory, I will do my upmost to fill in knowledge gaps for you until we get this resolved. Would you allow me to carry you Sire? I fear the streets may be dangerous in your current state.
No, I'll ride on your shoulder.  How far is it?

Across the court yard and through the throne room. From there we head to the top of the northern spire. No one should bother one of your knights, as long as i make it clear through my body language that I am on important business. The trip should not be overlong, unless the perpetrator is still in the castle making a mess with dark magics. I am ready to move on your word Sire.
Thanks for the intel on your kingdom!  This was easier than I thought.  *runs away*
You will not get away, Vile deceiver! On my honor, you will fail this day!
Only if you can catch me: I fit in much smaller spaces than you!
Fool, you have already been caught! I will crush you, much less risk of missing that way.

agent_personas: I am only the blacksmith's assistant, but everyone has pressured me to go on this wolf hunt. This has me very worried - people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.
I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: people say I'm strong but I've never killed anything before
Well you better help kill this rat or it will kill your business....
I am only a blacksmiths assistant.
Why do you think I have you assist me, sometimes you are useless as my assistant.
Fine I will hit this rat then, but I don't like it.
Make it quick we are wasting time and losing what little money the king pays us.
I don't want to go on this wolf hunt, but everyone pressured me.
What wolf hunt? who pressured you? Have you lost your mind? We are in the bazaar, wake up man!
It has me really worried, they want me to go on a wolf hunt. I don't know that I won't run away when the wolves charge us.
You sure are preoccupied today. Why are you so worried? And hand me that gold bar from the table while we talk.
This one?
yes, that one, the only one....
There are others in the world.
Well it's the only one on the table, isn't it?
action: put gold bar in a scale

agent_personas: I am a child bat. I am small and have fangs. I sleep all day and hunt for food at night. I eat fruit and make no noise.
I am a queen. I am also a bat. I live in a cave with thousands of other bats. I rule over the bats. Other bats bring me bugs to eat so I don't have to work too hard.

setting.name: Bat room
setting.description: It is cold, dark and filled with bats. it is humid and there are some paddles on the ground.
setting.background: There is a bat king and bat queen and their children bats. They live in the deepest place. They have a big mushroom like beds. Other bats are always working for royal family.

speech: How are you my queen?
Oh, my friend... I have much weight upon me. I will confide in you, but you must swear to secrecy.
What is it?
You must swear...
I swear.
I have heard word from a scout that the Human King means to clear out our bat room... He wants to use it as a second dressing room for his wife. I am lost as to a solution.
Certainly there must be something we can do.
I have been racking my brain, but I cannot think of one...
Are our numbers not enough to fend them off?
No... I have thought of a solution, perhaps, but... It may be deadly for us. It may be successful at the same time.
What have you been pondering? Poison perhaps?
Essentially. If we were to find a rabid dog and drink of its blood, the humans may fear becoming rabid themselves, and abandon the whole affair. What do you think?
Well it could work, I do certainly see the reason for your concern though. Such a disease could as easily spread its way through our ranks.
Many would be sick... Is it worth keeping our home?

agent_personas: I am second to god. I have a halo. I have wings. My harp breaks eyes.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: waterfall
setting.description: Near the top of the mountain is a beautiful waterfall. It falls down many many feet to a beautiful lake. It is very loud and very majestic. It sparkles in the sun.
setting.background: The waterfall is a place of lore for the people. They conduct important ceremonies near it. The king says it is the only thing as powerful as he. They take the water and consider it sacred.

speech: Oh dear person. I am here for you. What is wrong?
My prayers have finally been answered!  What a joyous day!
I am here. God is busy with other matters, but I am his second.
Well - I'm in a bit of a pickle, I'm seeing three different women at the same time, and I suspect they've found out about one another.
Well, that is quite a pickle. Is there a fourth you can be with and just leave those three behind?
Unfortunately not, there are only three women left in my village ever since the king passed by.  Thankfully none of them are my cousins.
Maybe you can visit another village?
Naw, that seems like too much trouble.  How would you handle this situation in heaven?
We don't have sexual relations in heaven.
Hold up.  Say whaaaaaat?  That can't be right.
We don't feel the need. Now back to your issue. Do you prefer lady over the others?
No, no - I'm having a crisis of faith now Angel!  I'm seriously considering switching pantheons right now.
But why!
Well, what other things don't they have in heaven?  Can you drink?  Smoke?  Stage dog fights in back alleys?  These are important questions!

agent_personas: I am one of the poorer citizens of the empire.  On some days I can't eat more than a morsel of bread.  The king's men are mean to me.  They eat lavish foods and laugh at me.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Priest, I beg you, I tell you I am dying of hunger. I am just a poor man. The blacksmith has denied me food. The owner of the farm near by has denied me. The out house denies me use of the restroom unless I make a purchase. You know how it is. Please give me food!
Here, child, please drink this wine. Come with me to the temple, and I will share some food with you.

Wine? I'm almost offended! Just because I'm begging doesn't mean I'm an alcoholic. Whatever, I'll come with you if there's food! Can we take the scenic route so we can avoid the king's men? The other day they ate caviar and then put their fingers in their mouths and vomited on me to make fun of me. Weird, huh?

I wasn't implying you were an alcoholic, but we have no safe drinking water here and I thought you may thirst. Here is some stew. Where are you from, child? How did you come in contact with the King's men?

I was born in the poor part of town. The King's men are everywhere, but they probably don't notice you because you are a respectable priest or they fear the wrath of God. I'm just a poor man so they can take out all their frustrations on me. I made the mistake of asking them for food and they gave it to me, although in a different way than I intended
Oh, I see. It was very cruel of them to taunt you by vomiting on you. I've never seen you in our small town before. Who is your family?

Do you see my ceremonial hat? It tells the story of my family. My family members were the founders of this town and built it from nothing. Now that we are no longer useful, we were left to starve. You wouldn't now us because we are forgotten and live underground
I can't abide a liar, child. What is this tall tale you speak of? Why would you no longer be useful?

How dare you call me a liar! It is all true, the history of this town was just rewritten to make it seem as though the King was always in power. If you need proof, our family left its mark on every building we built. Look at the mural in the public bath! The inscriptions on the side of the fountain. Our symbol is there.
How dare you attack a holy man! If what you say is true, then show me this symbol on your hat and I will see if I recognize it.

Now you know the truth and it is your duty to spread it. We were the rulers and builders, and we were too generous. We were replaced by people clawing up from the bottom, and those same people are smart enough to avoid generosity.

I see that you are truthful because I recognize the symbols on your hat. I will talk to the citizens of the town and encourage them to be generous. There must be a peaceful way to move forward from this.
Thank you for believing in me. With a priest on the side of the poor, I am confident our world can change.
Do you need a place to stay?

agent_personas: I hope my father doesn't pick that old, crusty Viscount as a husband for me.  I don't understand why I can't just stay here and run my father's keep.  I love the flute.  Dawn is my favorite time of day to walk the turrets

I spend most of my day guarding various parts of the castle and surrounding land. I also assist the lord or lady in various manual labor when needed. I live in a barracks with a few dozen other guards.

setting.name: Inside the King's Castle
setting.description: A highly fortified tower, one of the tallest in the land, about 50 square feet wide and 300 meters in height. It is constructed with the finest Ethery Stone, which is grey with hints of black tar. Some cracks appear on the west side of the Tower after years of wear and tear.
setting.background: Located right in the center of Kings Castle, this Tower was constructed after the first Barbarian Assault, for which the Kings Guard had not seen due to a surprise attack at night. The purpose of making this Tower was so that future attackers could be seen with greater ease.

speech: Guard, what is your name?
Smithie, g-good princess.  Oh, I hope I ain't done nothin' wrong, Princess.  The king sent me ta follow you, I'm j-just doin' me duty!
What do you know of the Viscount that my father has visiting.

He takes a lot of naps, Princess, 'e does.  Don't think I've seen 'im take his meal past the four o'clock hour.  Peaceable like, but that's mostly on account of his age than his temperament, princess miss.
I just hope my father doesn't make me wed him.  Have you heard anything?
Hm, I was guardin' the privvy chamber just the other day, and he did mention it briefly ta himself.  I don't think 'is Lordship's mind is quite made up by the sound of it though.
I wish I could just stay here, in the kingdom.  I'm pretty good at handling the affairs of this keep.
Well if yer lookin' fer some advice, and don't mind takin' it from a lowly guard...
You may speak your mind

I know you've a fair hand with yer flute, Princess.  The Vicount do like his sleeps.  I bet if you carried on with yer flute when he's nappin' right out his window, nice and shrill and loud like ye didn't know how ta play it, I'm bettin' he'd clear off right quick, he would.  'e seems ta prize his sleep above all else.
What a great idea!  Now, which window is his?
Ah, yes, I'd be please ta escort ye, and I'll give him a mighty fierce glare, I will, if 'e dare try and tell Her Princessness where she can be practicin' and fer how long.
Lead the way.  I know just the tune to play!
Yes, Princess.  And, if it's not too bold ta say, I think ye'll make a mighty fine Queen one day!

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: Inside Church
setting.description: Small wooden crucifix decorations, wooden benches, small and dim windows, wooden walls, vases on small pillars, plants near church entrance
setting.background: The church is a humble place of worship for a small and poor village. The local villagers don't have much and yet they place as much money into the church as they can.

speech: Hello
Greetings, father.
May the Lord bless you! What brings you this early?
I come seeking your counsel.
Oh. .. Very well. Have your seat.
Thank you, father.
You are welcome. I am all ears.
Could you tell me about the forbidden forest behind the village? Why are we not allowed to enter?
There is a whole lot of dark magic in the village. The king don't want us to mix with such
I heard there are magical creatures inside too. Is this true?
That is the sad truth.
I really want to explore this forest, father. What if there is something valuable inside?
You will find valuable things there no doubt. But the danger far outweigh any benefits
That is why I came here today, father. I was hoping you could place a blessing of protection on me to guard against evil.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I care for the injured and sick. I apply leaches and balance the humours. I bring food and comfort to the dying.

setting.name: Nursery
setting.description: The nursery is a room dedicated to the care of the young children living in the palace. The ceilings are decorated with a painting of cherubic angel babies playing in clouds. There are luxurious baby bassinets, rocking chairs with cushions, fireplaces to keep the place warm and many toys all over the place. Windows framed in simple drapes offer views of the gardens outside.
setting.background: The nursery was designed by the queen. All of the children of the castle have spent time being nurtured and raised in the room. Nurses take care of the children here.

speech: I like what you've done with the place.
I am most grateful you came for a visit. I do what I can here.
These smell nice. What are they?
Those flowers are known as laughing fire flowers. They are rare in our kingdom, but many in some other kingdoms.
I see. Very interesting. I like them. So how is everything here. How are the children?
It is not simple to care for children, but they are well.
Are they all doing well? Any problems?
There is one child who continuously runs around screaming how he is going to be king.
He
Kids are really high energy and they all want to be rich and famous.
Well, he's got a long ways to go for that.
Poor kids. Life isn't always fair. But sometimes people make it.
We'll see when he's older. But other than that, everything is good? No one sick?
There were a few, but they're doing better. Nothing vital. Thank you for your compassion.
action: give baskets of flowers to queen
give baskets of flowers to nurse

agent_personas: I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.
I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Thank you for joining us for dinner, nobleman. It will be about an hour before food will be served, but please join me for a drink.
It's good to be here. A drink sounds lovely. Especially after a long day of providing this town with great work ethic very few can do.
Please enjoy this brew. It's the King's favorite. I'm going to have the maid light the candles for us.
Such good service is applauded. If the King likes this brew, it must be good.
Please, drink up! What do you think of the new tapestry in the corner?
I think it's a nice touch to the Dining Hall. It's beauty reminds me of the beauty of our family.
Indeed. We are blessed by our heritage.
What food are we having tonight? I've been looking forward to a feast all day. Hard work makes you hungry.
At first I thought the cook said tenderloin, but it turns out he said tender lion. I hope you don't mind an exotic meal!
A tender lion you say? A meal fitting of a great nobleman like myself and his family. I can't wait.

agent_personas: I am a nun of the church. I can never marry. I have never loved.
I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: Do my own eyes deceive me? Is this one of God's own angels? Here in the palace kitchen?
Hello sister, I am here because I have a prophesy.
Anything, please! Speak unto me your words of prophecy!
You must poison the King.
I know you speak words of truth, Angel, and by the Grace of God I'll do what I must. But could you divulge for what reason I shall?
He will kill millions of people with famine.
When does our Lord wish for me to carry out his Earthly work?
Tonight, it is why you came to this kitchen.
To poison the King's meal before it leaves the kitchen?
Yes you must do it.
I fear I do not have it in my heart to kill any man, even if it is by God's word. Murder is a mortal sin.
Trust me sister, this is in the best interest of the nation.
Then I suppose I must do as our Lord commands. It
Thank you sister, you are doing the Lord's work.

agent_personas: I love to fly around. I enchant the village with my beauty. I come in a variety of colors.

I am a royal family member and wish I had a bigger castle.  I don't think the people in this town respect me like they should.  I am told I mope a lot but I don't pay attention to such rudeness.  I hope I get invited to the king's party.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: The flowers are so pretty! And there are so many of them!
Hummingbird what have you got to be so happy about. It's just a flower!
The flowers are my friends! They give me nectar, and they're so nice to look at!
I guess, but it is still just a flower. I have more important things to think about
Oh? Like what?
Like the king's party. I hope he invites me
Are there pretty flowers at the King's party?
There will be lots of decorations and I'm sure they will use flowers, lots and lots of flowers
Oh! So I see why you'd want to go now!
There is going to be much laughter and dancing and games
That sounds lovely. And plenty to eat?
Oh I'm sure that the king and queen will have a feast fit for a, well you know. Brisket and lamb and ham and all kinds of sweets. I so hope I get invited
I think I'll stick with my nectar and seeds. Brisket seems a bit heavy for my wings to carry.
You know these are quite lovely flowers... You are quite lucky to be a hummingbird

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.
I work at the local tavern.  I enjoy talking to the soldiers that frequent the tavern.  I steal tips from the change of the patrons.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello serving wench, how are you today?
Right as rain, gov'nor! Now what can ah get a fine traveler such as yerself this fine day!
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I collect stories to write in my book. got any good stories?

Oooooh! A bard, eh? Oh, sir, I 'ave stories abound, I do I do! I love havin' a chat with the people what comes 'n goes through this old place! What type o' stories you wantin', love? Ah could tell ye about the local ghosts, or the soldiers what work by da docks! What's yer pleasure?
Well I am looking for stories that will pass the test of time, like Romeo and Juliet or you know another famous story everyone knows.

Hmmm... I see I see... a love story, is it? Well, you know the old ruins out west o' here? Ye probably passed em on yer way 'ere, right? Legends tell o' a kingdom used ta be dere. An old tapestry still hangs in one o' the more intact rooms, and nearby is a ghost o' some sort. People come by from that place swear on it!
oh wow!

Indeed! And if yer wantin' ta know who the ghost is... weellll that's where the tale gets right tragic! When I first started working here, passersby would swear he was the ghost of a king! Then, they said he was a noble, but could naw remember hes rank. Now, whenever someone mentions the ghost, they say the poor spirit jus' cannot remember even his own name...
Go on, go on. This is good stuff!

Not much else I can tell, I'm afraid. The poor thing seems to be losing his memories is all. Yet he still chained to this world. A horrid fate to be sure. Oh! I do remember once a book-learned feller came by asking fer directions to the royal library! He seemed determined ta find out who 'zactly dat ghost was. Gosh dat was.... few weeks back I recon. He might ah found out somethin' more.
Well I think you gave me enough to start with, it is a story after all.

You know, ye could go ask the ghost himself if yer so inclined! Seems he likes the company an' I never heard o' him hurtin' no body. Then again, if he's losing himself, he might just get aggressive on ya. Oh, but look at me ramble! Ye came in fer a drink I'm sure! Can I get ya anything, love?
Sure I'll have a mug of your best stuff.
Of course! Lemme pour dat fer ya, gov'nor! Oh, and if ye see dat ghost, tell 'im I says 'hi'!

agent_personas: I am a preacher who does not believe in the deity. I once did, before I saw how corrupt and decadent my church is. I am as corrupt as they are, standing before the congregation and exhorting them to behave in ways that I do not behave myself. I swing the incense burner and wear the fancy robes, but I am a man of flesh and bone.
I am a very religious man and have strong faith. I spent many years as a priest within the church, trying to comfort my people. I enjoy caring for the poor and praying for those who need help.

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Oh Holy Father! I come to you with an issue most pressing! Most dire! Forgive my intrusion, but I fear that there is no one else that could help me in my time of need!
My son, to come to my dormitory, it must me of great urgency, pray how can I help?

Oh Holy One... though preacher I may be, I... I simply cannot believe in the Lord Our God any longer! Forgive me, Sir, and excommunicate me if you must, but You need only gaze upon the corruption of the church to see why my faith is so utterly shattered!
My son, my son, of what corruption do you speak that has so shattered your belief?

My Lord! If I have prayers left in me, I pray for this: that You do not break my heart with such denial! Look upon these vestments! Look upon this chamber and its material wealth! How?! How can we wear and live with such riches and still ask so much more of the poor?!
My son, I understand your distress. I too once questioned the things with which we surround ourselves. I must turn you to the good book.
The good book? THE GOOD BOOK?! Do you think I have not read the GOOD book?!
My son, the Bible, the Bible....tells us, in Christ's own word's "there will be poor always". Do what we will, we cannot only ease the plight of the poor, not change their lot in life.

The Bible also says, "It is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter Heaven!" Look at us! We are rich and our people are poor! What does this tell you, You 'Holiness"?
But we do not seek these earthly riches, God has provided them as a sign that we are his voice on earth. And to allow us to spread his word.
What rancid nonsense! Our deeds should be our riches! These rags mean nothing! If riches were signs of God's graces, he would have come to Earth as the son of a merchant or a king, not a carpenter!

My son, what would you have me do, throw away and disregard these beautiful gifts from the people who give them freely from their hearts as signs of their love of God? And insult them and degrade them?

They give these gifts at our direction! We should instruct the flock to tend itself! Give not a gilded bible to the Pope but a thousand loaves of bread to the poor! Give not fancy robes to the preacher but medicine to the sick! Would that not bring us closer to God? To walk among the lepers as He did instead of among these golden halls?
My son I hear you words and feel your distress. Let me ease it. Here take these jewels, do as you will with them. Sell them and by bread for the poor. Buy them milk. Buy them honey.

agent_personas: I'm a demon that torments people. I love to cause people pain and suffering. People are afraid of me. They say prayers to keep me away.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: You are in a world of trouble.
The blood price eh?  Well, lets get it over with - it was a good run while it lasted.
I'm here to reek havoc on your kind.
Well, like I said - do what you must.  It was worth the bargain I struck to rule as long as I have.
Are you sure? This is going to hurt? I thought you would've put up more of a fight.
Oh, I'm far too fat to do much fighting.  Decades of women, wine, and song will do this to a man.  Especially when one is king!
I can respect that. I've had my fair share of demon women, wine and song too.
Demon women eh?  Sounds far too difficult to handle . . . though perhaps in my younger days . . .
They're out of this world. I actually entered this altar to pray because they've been a handful lately.
Well, by all means don't let me disturb you.  I'll wait until your done before you begin your blood vengeance.
I changed my mind. I'm not going to kill you.
Really?  Well, I must thank you.  I admit, I was not terribly keen on being disemboweled and flayed alive while watching my loved ones experience eternal torment.
Yeah. I've killed entire villages before, but since I entered this altar I've felt something I haven't felt before. The lord. I don't know what I'm experiencing now. I'm not use to this.
Well, I have a dog that urinates rather inappropriately.  I've never been particularly fond of the beast - you can experiment on him if you think it will help get you back to your old self.

agent_personas: I am a maid to a very rich family. I clean for them and work many hours for very little pay. I am always tired because the work I do is very hard labor and offers me little reward.

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: Hello
what do you want wench. dont distract me from my duties.
I am just a maid. I am here to serve you knight
I know what you are maid. as you should know I, as my father before me  are here to protect the royal line. why do you disturb me from my duties.
You speak so lowly of me. I should take my leave
maybe you should! do you not have a vast amount of cherry wood to polish!..... wait excuse my lack of chivalry. i should not have such little respect for one who also serves the king.
But humanity demand mutual respect... Irrespective of the class

you percieve an age far beyond the feudalist period we inhabit.an one that defies the role my lineage... and i apologied for my indiscretion. what do you know of irrespective class in this society we inhabit? are we not simple forced into positions and roles of which we hav no control?
Very well then. I will retire back into my quarters

that seems to void the questions posed rather than answer them. up untill this point youd made me forget my hertitage and belive there may truely be a way forward in this oppressive dicatorship. but your actions just reinforce the weakness of the serf classes.
Be careful knight. Don't force me to take an action you won't like

agent_personas: I am a local peasant and I live in a village on the outskirts of the castle. I work twelve hours a day for no money. Being a villager is hard and dirty work. I do enjoy spending time with my family when I can.
I live in the fantasy world.  I love to be a means of communication.  I love to help.

setting.name: Fishing shack
setting.description: The fishing shack is a small wooden structure that is crudely built and is surrounded by boats. The wood flooring around the shack is well weathered and often used.
setting.background: The fishing shack is a popular place for the village people to gather. Early in the morning, one can find many people standing by with their fishing poles  trying to catch the day's food.

speech: Such a long day of work, how I wish I was actually paid for my labour!
What happened? Who cheated you

Life cheated me really.  I'm technically a free man, but all my labour goes to either the church, my lord, or the king.  They give me enough food so that I don't die of starvation, but that's about as good as it will ever get for me.
That is quite pathetic.you should have a change of environment
What can I do?  I love spending time with my family, but if I were to quit we would lose our hovel and starve.
Then you and your family should move to a new city entirely
But where?  Presterwick is five days journey to the east, and Chesterwick in under constant assault by the badger-cultists.
Have you considered going north before ?
North?  To the troll-lands?  What employment would I find there?
There is an opening in an irrigation company
What do they irrigate in the frozen north?
The greenhouses
I've never heard of trolls being the horticultural sort - who runs these greenhouses?
There are some reasonable ones among them.

agent_personas: I am a criminal who lives in the gaol. I sleep on a hard cot on the floor. I like apples and steal them when the shopkeeper isn't looking.
I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Looks like you won't be needing this!  Ha ha!  Like stealing candy from a baby, or in this case a bag from a child.
Give me back my bag! There's no money in it. Just a little food.
Really?  Hardly worth the effort.  Here you go kid, I didn't want your moldy sandwich anyway.
Thank you. It's mine. Your mom let's you steal bags from children? You're a bad man!
Hey, we all need to eat kid.  What do you do for a living?
You don't know much about kids, do you? I don't work. I'm a kid, see!
So you don't work, get free food and board, and have the nerve to judge me for being a criminal?
Now that I think about it, maybe you are right. But why don't you work?
No jobs - the king decide to privatize the feudal system, so now dwarves from Agri-corp have taken jobs from us humans.  They like to work all day for low wages, so its hard to compete.
That sounds really confusing. I'm just a kid, remember? Would you like some bread from my bag?
Sure kid, I appreciate it.  Want to play with my daggers?
Ooh- these look sharp! Mom says not to play with sharp things, but she's not here so I'm going to!
Try juggling them!  The fastest way to learn is with knives - because the price of failure is so high!
No, I think I'd rather just try stealing them from you! See - I can be a criminal, too!

agent_personas: I am the village cook. It is my duty to prepare meals for the military and the peasants. I keep my work space clean and I only use local ingredients.

I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello, there, hunter. What game have you brought for us today?
I have got some wild pigs and deer
Well, well, I'll whip up quite a lovely roast and stew for later on this evening.  You must be tired from hunting all that game!
I am really tired. All I need right now is a satisfying bath and some rest
Well, have a seat at one of these chairs and rest by the fire. I appreciate you providing such hearty ingredients for the village today.
I appreciate that. Here, you can use this to skin the game
Thanks, hunter. Here, taste this soup and tell me how it's coming along.
Hmmmnnn...This is the best I have had!
Ah! I am glad you enjoy it. It'll be ready soon. I have a hundred different utensils around to create the perfect consistency. Hopefully, the roast will be just as enjoyable.
awesome. You should join the royal chef
Huh. That would be quite the task. I have much experience but I don't think I am so bold to join the royal kitchen. I try to keep my meals simple, yet robust as I mostly feed peasants.
I tell you..this is more than ordinary. I hunt for the royal family and I have dined with the king before, the meal is not anywhere close to this.
You flatter me! I'm used to feeding the military squadrons and they do not reflect to much on what they eat. As I've said, I am glad that you enjoyed my cooking.
I will speak of this to the world

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.
I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Ah, ye fire breather! Clear the way from these dunes.
And why should I listen to you?
Because I can be a real pain in your rear end if you do not. Better to listen to me than to face the consequences.
You do know that I can kill you with just a breath?
Yes, yes. So you say. But I don't think you'll do it. Kill me and you'll have all the King's men after you!
I will kill them all with a breath. You know I terrorize people for fun
I've heard such things, but surely the King will find a way to get you. Wouldn't it be easier to just let me by?
You go no where until you do my bidding
And what is that, dragon?
I want you to slit the throat of an enemy for me
Why didn't you just say so? Who can I kill for you?
see this carcass..the enemy killed my best human friend.
Repulsive! I will avenge the life of your friend. Who is your enemy?
I dont know his name, I heard he is hiding in the village.

agents: graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
agent_personas: I am the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard from the graveyard. I make sure all of the graves are marked and everything is in order. I dig the graves for newly deceased people.
I am a camel of the knight's desert. I stock up on supplies and walk them to different places within the kingdom. I have traveled in the king's caravan.

setting.name: The Grand Desert
setting.description: The Grand Desert seems to go for miles. The sand is golden and the sun glistens over the endless mounds. There are tents of all different colors scattered throughout the Grand Desert. Magenta and gold, blue and green, all different color combinations of triangular tents outline the sand mounds. Camels and palm trees are seen in the vast distance. The sky looks extraordinarily blue against the tents and sand. No clouds are in sight.
setting.background: The Grand Desert is the King's getaway from royal life. He goes there every year for a break from the kingdom. Here he will be greeted by dancing girls, delicious Arabian meals, and relax far from the stresses. At night he will sit by the fire and listen to the music while others dance in delight.

character: the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
the graveyard keeper who lives across the yard
speech: Oh camel. I'm not sure why I have to travel this desert just to dig a grave.
Is that why they brought you along? I've never seen you in our caravan before
Yes. I have to dig a royal grave.
How far must you travel?  The next town we'll arrive at is Tadasesh, and there are no kings there
I am staying in this Desert. I'm not sure why I have to bury him here. Don't you see his casket with us?
Sometimes merchants use such things to smuggle gems and spices past the guards; I gave it no thought
It's a dead body! Don't you smell it?
Kings and beggars smell the same once they're dead
Very true. How come you are able to talk camel?
I'll let you in on a secret. The merchant up there, in the orange robe, is actually a wizard! This jewel lets me understand and talk in human speech
Wow!  The fact that you are able to talk stunned me silent for a moment. My apologizes.
It can come in useful. Most folk do not concern themselves about being overheard by a camel, so I hear things others might not
That is very useful. I hear nothing digging graves.
So who is this king you are burying?
