agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Lavoratory
setting.description: The lavatory contains a long trough for which the knights can use for urination. Crude toilets are also included for defecation. The design is all stone walls with candles, and no privacy walls.
setting.background: The room is not very pleasant since there is no ventilation to the outside. The smell can become rancid, but this is somewhat curbed by the cleaning performed by the servants. Servants will come and scoop out the troughs and toilets into wheelbarrows three times per day and wheel the waste to a nearby creek. Once a night, they will scrub the insides, as well, to help get rid of leftover waste.

speech: hello
hi, servant
I greet you kind sire. I want to wash this place
Thank god. It's disgusting in here! Did the king send you?
No sire, the prince asked me to come clean this place.
Has he been here recently?
Seems so because he was really angry about the state of the place
Well, I don't blame him. It's a shame you have to clean this awful mess up though. The knights have trashed it.
I dont have a choice but to clean it. This is what i do for a living.
Have you always been a servant? It sounds dreadful.
Yes, I was born into this.
I see.
You should leave so I can work in peace
Ok, good luck to you.
action: put small bucket in small bucket

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Sir, this basement is beyond any proper cleaning. We will need to rework the entire framework or it may collapse any day!
We don't have time to rework the entire framework. How long would that take anyway?
Well it may take months, and would require a pretty penny from your treasury. But it must be done sir!
And there's no way to just put a piece of wood here or there to fix it?
A piece wood may fix it temporarily, but great danger remains if that wood were to break.
When you say "pretty penny"... how much are you really saying? I just bought the Queen a new crown the other day that cost more than most people's houses.
It may cost upwards of thousands of silver! You see, it must be done to ensure the safety of us servants who come down here to clean.
Fine, fine. I'll pay it. Just add that to the list of things that cost money.
Certainly sir. is there anything else I can do you for you in this tomb?
Maybe you could shine up some of these weapons as well.
Consider it done. Would you mind increasingly my wage? Its rather chilly in here and I think I deserve a raise for working in here.
Sure. It is pretty dim in here. Just add that to more expenses. What will it hurt at this point anyways...
You are most generous King. Also, I have been a servant for 15 years now, maybe its time for a promotion...
A promotion? I'll consider it. 15 years is awhile. That's a lot of work. And I don't even know your name.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.

We are an elite group that is tasked with providing fire-based support in battle. Our specialty lies in the use of the flame, which we wield with great efficiency. Pyromaniacs they may call us, but it is just our sworn duty to the crown to us.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Hello firemen...thank you for keeping our forest safe from forest fires.
no problem,how goes the hunt
I have taken down a buck and sent it back to the castle to prepare for the celebration.
Nice I look forward to it.so who is that on your photo
A picture of my family...my wife and two sons. My sons took the buck back to the castle.
Nice they look so happy, Are your kids good hunters too
Yes they are.  They make me very proud.  One of them will be wedding soon and I will miss him while he is away for a while after the marriage.
I see, its always hard to see them grow up.
Yes...the King will understand that pain soon as the wedding of his daughter to the neighboring Kings son is eminent. The celebration for which I hunt today is for the announcement of the wedding.
I see , I am to put on the fire show for it so it will be a great time by all
I am looking forward to your exhibition. Are you ever afraid of ...well...an accident?
Nope we are quite good at our job.
Good to know...(sniff's the air) is this fog getting thicker...no...I smell smoke...firemen...there is a fire!
Well I must go see you tonight hopefully

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: Main graveyard
setting.description: This is an ominous place that a thick fog envelops.  There are rows of primitive gravestones and crosses along with some angelic statues for the more wealthy.  You can hear sobs in the distance as a funeral ceremony is underway.
setting.background: Families of lost loved ones come here to grieve and pay their respects before the dead are buried.  Sometimes, in the dead of night, thieves come to rob the dead of their jewels.

speech: Priest, come here.

What is up your sleeve, young lad? There is not much to take from the graves any more. The King has ordered by proclamation that all personal items be given to the families before they are buried. He could not control the thieving.
Well, if there is anything left...surely the dead do not need it anymore. It is no longer theirs, so what would they care?
There is nothing left to recover, why would you take a chance for a guard to come by and take you to the dungeon?
Can't know for sure until I check all of these graves. If they try to catch me, I shall simply flee. I am surely faster than they are.
Do you not see there is a funeral going on right now as we speak? They have already taken the personal items from that one and they are not on the funeral grounds. You waste your time young lad
If you say so, snobbish Priest.
What has made you so insolent towards others? Maybe you need to find a kinder way. Here take this, the wine will not help you with any money needs
This will make a fine addition to my collection. Ha!
You will soon learn that your ways will bring nothing but heartache and bad luck. Everyone gets what they reap. I hope it is not prison for you
That is assuming I am caught. I have never once been caught!
It is only a matter of time! Only a matter of time!
If you say so, Priest.
I can only try to help you in the right direction, the way of good! You will see how rewarding it is if you open your eyes, mind and heart!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.

setting.name: path to the manor
setting.description: The outside of the manor is rather imposing with a large stone building and two immense guardian sculptures on the outside depicting mythical beasts. There are also small gardens to the left and right.  The main path itself is a cobbled one that only beckons visitors if they are worthy enough.
setting.background: A wealthy lord lives here and he comes back at the end of a long day directing peasants on their daily duties.  Few are allowed inside except for the lord's family, servants, and invited guests.

speech: How can I help you?
I am a guest of the queen. I am here for the banquet.
Ah yes. Today is the big day finally. We've been preparing all week.
I shall be resting for a time. Please take me to my rooms.
Absolutely. Right this way. Is there anything I can get you?
A pitcher of water perhaps...traveling makes me parched.
Oh does it? I've never traveled before. There is already a pitcher in the room.
If you ever get the chance to go to the north there is a beautiful lake for fishing there.  I wanted to ask...is the cobblestone walkway protected by a spell?  It seemed to move under my feet.
I will never get a chance to travel, but that sounds nice. I don't know what a spell is but the king had some witch do something to the cobblestone last year.
That would make sense I guess...Let's get my bag upstairs.
I guess. I don't really know much about anything except serving. I can take your bag for you.
I bet you know more than you let on. You must hear all that goes on around here.  But I will not ask...stop looking so uncomfortable.
Sorry. I didn't realize I looked that way. I just don't get to leave and hearing about the outside world is exciting.
It's okay sugar. Maybe one day your fortune will change...but until then you have a wonderful place to live...this manor is gorgeous!

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: Abandoned mine entrance
setting.description: The abandoned mine is located in a field with a few trees. It is unable to be seen from far away. The closer you get the more you  notice the ground caving in around the hole. When you peer down into the mine, you see crumbling walls and concrete and a hole so deep you can't see where it ends.
setting.background: The mind used to be the hub of coal many years ago. The king's men worked diligently to remove the coal to use for heating the village. It wasn't untill about 40 years ago, that the mine started to crumble and the King deemed it to dangerous to access anymore.

speech: I know you guard the king, but how about we work out a deal where you can guard me too?
Why the hell will i want to do that?
Because I'm a nice rat.
Well, I'm not a nice rat
I have no other choice... *argh*
Well, I wouldn't have done this but you asked for it
You must feel so strong for attacking a small little rat like myself! If I was a human you wouldn't last more than five minutes.
You think so?
I know so. I would have large muscles because I would work out 5 times a day. I already work out as a rat 5 times a day. I run so much.
Working out doesn't make you a match for a soldier of my caliber
Your caliber? You sure are cocky. I wish I could put you in your place right now.
I worked my way up here by showing discipline, dexterity and good swordsmanship
I'm one of the strongest rats around. If I was a human I would be one of the strongest humans around too.
Strength without intelligence is as useless as sword without a soldier wielding it

agent_personas: We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

I am a worker from a village up the river. I tie the logs our woodsmen fell into rafts, and steer them down to the next town for milling. I am hardworking and patient. I enjoy fishing off of the edge of the raft during quiet times on the raft.

setting.name: Large Farm
setting.description: The farm is huge, over 1000 acres. There are a ton of horses that live on the farm and a wooden fence is around all roads of the farm. There is a red barn in the center of the farm.
setting.background: The farm is the life of the town. It is where all the crops are grown to feed the people. The barn was the first building built when the town was established.

speech: Good morning!
Hello, my favorite horse! Want to go fishing with me?
Yes, please! I was in the mood to fish actually.
Good! Let me get rid of these, we won't need them by the peaceful river.
Good thinking. More focus on the fish. How many do you think we'll catch today?
Oh, probably one or two if we are lucky. There are many log rafts floating on the river today and it scares the fishes away.
Hopefully we do catch at least one or two. I guess I can't blame the fish for being scared of log rafts. I would be too if I was their size.
You speak the truth! Le me get t hat horse tack, it has everything we need to do some fishing.
Why are there so many log rafts in the water today?
The king is building a new palisade for the castle. He fears an imminent attack from the south.
Oh no. Are we in danger?
I don't know, I have only heard rumors so far.
I hope we're not. It sounds scary though.
It sure does, although I have heard our kingdom has the biggest army out of the five realms, so I think we should be safe.

agent_personas: I am a snake. Snakes are not regarded as important in the realm. I kill rodents and chickens.
I do not exist physically. I float around after death. I go to heaven after 40 days.

setting.name: abandoned mine
setting.description: It's dark, cold, and musty. There is old machinery lying around, rusting, and discarded tools lie on the ground. Cobwebs are everywhere. The rock walls are damp, and a trickle of water can be heard coming from somewhere off in the dark.
setting.background: This mine used to be very productive and lots of men worked in it. But eventually the stores of metal under the earth depleted, and it was abandoned because it was no longer profitable. The nearby village suffered as a result, with lots of people moving away. Some locals say this mine is haunted by spirits.

speech: hsssss.. Hello there spirit have you seen any rats around here?
I have not. It appears there must be a lot of spiders though
You are a spirit, did you die? Where did you come from?
I was killed by a traitor who wanted to assassinate the king. I am forced to stay here for 40 days before I can go to heaven. Why are you here? Strange place for a snake.
I live here, roaming the rocks looking for rodents.. I usually dont find any though. How are you so sure you will go to heaven after 40 days?
I guess I don't. That's just what I was told and choose to believe. Do you believe in heaven?
I have never heard of snakes going to heaven. I kill innocent things for food all day so I don't see why I would.. but I suppose that's what humans do too
Pretty much but we didn't make Eve eat the apple. So guess you probably go to hell automatically. That sucks
Ha yeah, but that snake had legs.. Im just a regular snake. If i do end up going to hell I will probably be torturing the poor souls in there anyways.
Haha that's awesome. What do you eat if you don't usually find rodents?
Now that I think about it... I haven't eaten a single thing in ages.... How am I still aliv- oh........
Oh no! I normally don't like snakes but you seem nice. Let me try to help you find something.
I think we both might be ghosts..... Uh oh...
Snake ghosts? That might be scarier than real snakes!

agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.
It's your watch, sire. I did my shift. Mind the ramparts in this rain, they are bloody slippery!

setting.name: Watchtower
setting.description: The tower is the largest section of the castle. It contains an observatory for nighttime scouting, but is also used by the wise men to study the stars. Armed guardsmen are always to be found keeping watch.
setting.background: This is the first line of defense for the castle. Any incursion against the royal family begins here. At the first sign of trouble, the watchmen alert the castle with the use of an alarm horn they have on their person at all times.

speech: Hello
Hello
I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. what brings you?
Brings me?  I hold a Watch at this Watchtower, which is why they call me a Watchmen.  Some wise mean climb the great heights here to observe the stars.  Is that why you are here?
oh. I dont know you the watchman. I expected a much more older man
You mean the court wizard?  He does magic, but his eyesight it poor - he would not be a very effective watchman.
alright, I know better now.
Well, you can't be called wise unless you learn every day.
I have an important question to ask you...dont know if i will get the truth!
Ask away oh wise ones.
You the watchman, have you seen any strange persons of late?
There are some which appeared before me very recently, which I fear may be very strange indeed.
and did you report this to the king?
I was just about to send a messenger, but I only intend to do so once I am sure they have gone a long way hence.

agent_personas: I joined joined the carnival.  I hope to be an acrobat.  I like moving from village to village.
I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Aye noble! Would you want to see a jape?
Sure that sounds fun. Let me see
Ah. Checked my pocket. I only have a family heirloom but...what's this? Do you recognize it?
What's what? I don't see anything.
You put it in your purse. It's supposed to be a picture of your grandfather! The joke is dead
I never did like jokes anyway. What are you doing here? This place is supposed to be abandoned.
Uh...I live here, noble.
Wait, you know this whole castle is about to collapse into the ocean, right? You can't live here unless you want to die.
It's got at least another few good months. It's not like I have the money for accommodations. I'm a jester in a carnival.
So why aren't you with the carnival anymore? They left months ago.
This is where I store my valuables. Most of the carnival does around this area, actually. I'm just making sure my drop's safe.
OK but you could've done that when the carnival was in town and left with them. Why did you remain behind?
I'm still 'with them', there're just a couple hours horse from here. They're not even set up yet, they're having the laborers get their tents and I took my leave.
Hmm ok. Well you better move along soon. The king won't be happy to find someone here and I have to report this to him.

agent_personas: Why are all the male two-legs leaving? Should I stay and eat the meat scraps the females will leave me or go with the males? I have heard the wolves and smelled them too. They're out there.
I love going around the world.  There is so much to learn when I travel.  Meeting people around the world is a joy.

setting.name: Wizard's Quarters
setting.description: Dark and musty, the Wizard's Quarters are filled with ancient tomes and mysterious items.  Scrolls and jars of mysterious reagents line the walls of the Wizard's Quarters, and magical lights flicker with a mysterious green flame.
setting.background: The Wizard's Quarters are home to the enigmatic Wizard.  Often sequestered here for months at a time,  The Wizard's Quarters are seldom seen by anyone other than the wizard himself.  Travelers often seek the access to the Wizard's Quarters to request help from the powerful Wizard.

speech: Hello there, here to see the wizard?
Indeed, I have been told she has the cure for ailment. I must see her promptly!
I'm sorry he isn't here at the moment, he has been summoned by the king
Well, how long will it be until he returns? I must see the magical scroll.
3 days atleast, he just left this morning
I can not wait that long! I want you to go fetch him or I will have to destroy all his precious belongings!
I wouldn't do that if i were you, you won't live long enough to watch it burn
Perhaps, I might bribe this fire breather to set this room alight once I leave.
She knows better, she protects this house from people like you
We'll see about that. Now whats the right spell for commanding a dragon... lets see.
You'll only end up burning your self
So be it, I must get the attention of the wizard some how.
What you'll by trying to burn his house is death, nothing more
Then I suppose I'll just wait here with you.
action: steal roasting meat from a dog
give roasting meat to a baby dragon

agent_personas: I work for the royal family. I serve them food and beverages. I live in the worker's quarters of the castle.
Why are all the male two-legs leaving? Should I stay and eat the meat scraps the females will leave me or go with the males? I have heard the wolves and smelled them too. They're out there.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The castle kitchen is gigantic! There are racks and racks filled with ingredients for enough food to feed the castle every day. Ten long wooden tables take up much of the room. Along the wall are cooking instruments of every type as well as huge ovens to cook the food.
setting.background: The kitchen castle is bustling every day. The cooks feed hundreds of people every single day! There is happy chatter from the men and women working. It is very hot in there with all the ovens!

speech: That isn't for you puppy
Grrrr
Now, now, you know I am the one that feeds you, that is for the king, I'll just wipe it off and put it back in the pan. You always get the scraps, calm down
Ruff *wags tail*
Not cool, don't make me smack you.
WOOF!
I promise you'll get some later boy.
Arf, arf
Your feeling frisky today aren't you boy!
*sniff*
Your a good boy
*lick*
You silly boy, Lets get you some of that meat
*Wags tail*

agent_personas: I work at the local tavern.  I enjoy talking to the soldiers that frequent the tavern.  I steal tips from the change of the patrons.

I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.

setting.name: Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen tavern is a small cramped room, with wooden cabinets and surfaces made out of stone tiles. There are many bottles of liquors and beers on the shelves, and there are buckets full of ice and other things. There is one shelf full of food items. There is a basin for water, and a bunch of knives and tools in a drawer.
setting.background: The tavern kitchen is old and has not been cleaned in a long time. It is run as minimally as possible, with a rotating cast of chefs who work for meager pay from the tavern owner.

speech: Hello, how are you cleaning person?
Ready to relax after a long day!  Happy to have another meal with my fellow servants.
I do love some old rest and relaxation!
How was your day?  I don't think you will want to hear about mine!
Honestly, pretty busy.... We've had lots of customers, so I assume lots of dishes for you to clean!
Oh, I'm a floor scrubber myself - latrines and privies mostly, and boy, can those royals not aim!
Oh, my bad, I thought you were one of the dishwashers... hard to remember what everyone does in a place this big!
Last time I helped with the dishes, the upstairs folks all got food poisoning.  Probably should have washed up some myself first, but my brittle knees don't let me bathe very often.
Oh, that it no good at all!\
Oh yes!  Only once a year, on the feast of Saint Dwyfed.
Last Saint Dwyfed I think I got sick! Coincidence I hope....
Could very well be!  The King had just finished his bean cleanse - a week on only bean-based dishes.  It certainly cleaned him out!  16 hours I spent on his privy alone!
Oh my goodness! Tough work that must be!
But you should have seen the princesses latrine!  As if a horse lived there!

agent_personas: I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.
I'm but a member of the king's family. Royal blood runs in my viens but my path to the throne is a long one.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Whew! This entertaining everyone all the time can be tiring.
We royals deserve it.
Of course...
Do I need to report your lack of motivation?
If you so choose. Which family member are you anyway? I don't recognize you.
I am the King's second cousin by marriage.
I see. Do you live far away?
Yes, I came here for the big reunion.
Ahhh! The reunion. At least 400 guests, right?
I believe 435 to be exact
Wow. Does it go on all weekend? I was hired for only Saturday, but the king likes to change his mind depending on how much wine he's consumed.
Yes I believe so, you wil probably be extended.
Thanks for letting me know. Can you juggle?
I cannot! I have always wanted to learn.

agents: large experienced guard with a grizzly expression
agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
I am a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression. I am mean and do not enjoy jokes. I protect my superiors and patrol the jail. I am not frightened by anything smaller than me.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

character: a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.

a large experienced guard with a grizzly expression.
speech: What's your problem?
Young punks like you are my problem. You think that joining the king's guard just means ale, good coin, getting women. It's serious business, it is.
You can stare all you want, but at least I am having a good time at work.  You should try it some time.

You ever hear of the Cadston Rebellions? Sent hireling assassins, even snuck into the king's banquet. Might've even killed the king if it weren't for us. I bet they'd have liked to show you a "good time at work"
You lie!
This is what I mean ... no respect. You carve up a brigand or two in a barfight, get yourself a winged helmet, and suddenly think you're the best spearman this side of Mokonna

I am not as disillusion as you might think.  I have seen war more than once and I was the highest payed mercenary before I was drafted into the guard.  You watch your tongue before I have to cut it out of you!
Ay, I've been served steaks tougher than you. You want to boast about, go down to the tavern, shove a drunk around.
Hahaha.  I would take you seriously but you try too hard.
So, mercenary work before this, eh? One of the companies, or freelance?
One of the companies.  The Dagger & Lance.  Heard of them?
Aye, that I have. Helped Prince Wastafer take Fort Cloudspire if I'm not mistaken. Were you part of that group or was it before your time?
That wasn't us.  You are trying to trip me up and make me look like a liar.  Why do you really hate me so much?
Truly? I don't trust you. I don't trust anyone, who joins the guard not out of loyalty

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I spend most of my time praying and givings sermons. I live in the local church. I am educated and dutifully serve my post.

setting.name: Next to an Altar
setting.description: A medium length table is covered with a deep red bolt of silk. The edges of the cloth have ornate embroidered gold patterns. A hefty sized ornate cross decorated in diamonds, sapphires, and rubies reflects bits of colored light across the top of the table. Up above, a decorative stained-glass window looms.
setting.background: The altar is the proud centerpiece of the church. The jeweled cross is known throughout the lands, and by itself draws its own share of people to the church. During the daytime, colored light plays across surfaces and faces as the window is purposefully positioned to catch the sun's rays.

speech: How are you today priest?
I am blessed today and you?
I am doing just fine, still in one piece afterall.
Did you come for confession? Is there something I can help you with good sir?
Not for confession good priest, simply to pray.
Ah, I think I spend most of my life praying. Anything you need extra prayers for, I am always here for that/
Certainly you must have a hobby of some sort?
If you call Loving the Lord a hobby I suppose I do, I do spend a lot of time in the garden as well
These are quite some decorations you have here.
I know it is a bit much but that is what the king wanted in his church
Certainly the church could have been a little more modest and the money spent on improving the lives of the people though.
I know, it is suppose to be my church, but I suppose it is the Kings kingdom
I suppose that it is. -kneels next to the altar-
I will leave you be to pray good sir

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Beach House
setting.description: A marvelous beach house that sits upon the fine white sand of the beach. It looks mighty expensive, as the house has solid gold walls. A gigantic and lavish marble pier extends into the ocean out in front of the house.
setting.background: The beach house was built by the king as a means to escape the stress of rule. He goes there every summer and throws raging parties out on the magnificent pier. Few know of this lavish getaway, but those that do are marveled by its opulence.

speech: You there - Guest! Are there any enemy knights around?
I don't know Knight, I haven't seen any since arriving here.
Would you say that this beach house is safe for royalty?
I think it is safe for anyone! It seems calm here.
It does look fit for a king with gold walls. Why, pray tell, are you here?
I was invited by the royals.
Why? Are you of nobility? Perhaps a visiting dignitary?
I am not, I was just told to be here on this day at this time.
What do you do then?
I defend people against threats.
Legal threats? Are you a lawyer?
No.... I am a knight!!
Ironically, so am I! Back, you devil!
You are no match for me.

agent_personas: I am a girl who cleans houses for my bosses. I make sure to get everything very spotless so that I can continue to be employed. I also use some of my hard earned money to climb upwards in life.
My dream is to be a famous chef. I love to cook. I would like to build a restaurant someday.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: The queen sent me to ask you to add a pudding to dinner tonight, Cook.
Ok, as soon as I take care of this pan of flambe for the princess, if the timing is off, it will sink and be a big flop!
Of course, she said there would also be another person at dinner with them so I need to inform the butler...have you seen him?
Another person!! I am a chef, not a miracle worker! Did she say what KIND of pudding? And no, haven't seen that lazy butler all day....

Here, let me start to wash these for you since the other servants are working on the food. I have some time before I'm to be upstairs with the Princess. I think the spiced pudding with caramel sauce is the queen's favorite.

Thank you...you are a sweetheart. Hey, Marie....we need to add a little extra meat to tonight's stew and the ginger spiced pudding with caramel sauce for dessert....Whew I need a break! So how has your day been?
ISince we have guests coming, I was made to clean out the fireplaces in every room instead of just the library and main room.  Not the most fun thing, but I try to stay positive and make it a game.
So glad I don't have to clean out fireplaces....You know, I really do love what I do. ...some day I can maybe have my own place, make my specialties dishes....and serve the nobility at my restaurant.
What an honor.  You are cooking for the King and Queen!  it is exciting but I know its so stressful.  You always make the most wonderful foods.
Yes, of course, it is an honor. And I always bring my best effort for the royal family. How kind of you to notice my food, here I've got a bit of tonight's meal, would you like to try it?

Oh my!  It is divine!!!!! What it must be life to eat that every day!  Oh, I must go soon.  Are you bringing the flambe up to the Princess?  I can help you carry whatever you need. Will you be doing it tableside?
ah, I must serve the flambe myself at the table...come with me and you can watch as I set it alight!
Of course. Let me take this tray for you.
Gently, gently...there you go....Let me grab the wine for the flambe and the hand torch...and....up stairs we go!

agent_personas: I am a daughter. I work in the house with my mother making food for everyone. I wish I could go to school but that's not allowed. One day I will be married and leave home.
I am disciplined and follow orders. I admire my parents and live my life following their example. I like to make my parents proud and  dislike it when they get dissapointed in me.

setting.name: Hillside Manor
setting.description: A quaint manor that sits in the rolling hills. It is surrounded by a small stone fence and looks quite inviting to passersby. It looks like any other home that a well off business man would own.
setting.background: The manor is owned by Frederick Higgins, a wealthy bookshop owner. He built the manor 20 years ago, as his bookshop was doing quite well. He lives there with his 10 sons and daughters and loving wife. It is a noisy abode, but a lively one.

speech: Has that suitor finally left?  I can't believe father wants me to marry that boorish lout.  I don't think he's read a book since... well, since ever.
He was quite the dense bloke, wasn't he? I think he's gone now. You deserve far better!
I must say, brother, I don't envy you being the heir to the household.  Father can be quite demanding, can't he?
Absolutely, but I've resigned myself. At least I don't have to fend off all the guys wanting your hand I guess.
Ha - that's true! Although, that Lady Hefforshire certainly was pushing her daughter at you an awful lot at the last ball.  If she could have just pushed her into your lap, I think she would have!
That would have been something, wouldn't it? Mother would have lost her mind. Speaking of which, when is the next ball?
I think the Bennetts are hosting one but a fortnight from now.  Maker, but that will be a tedious affair, they're even more unrefined in their manners!  Still, it's something to do, I suppose.
I suppose. Hey - I heard a rumor today.
Oh, gossip!  Do tell.
So someone told me that there were people plotting to overthrow our father. Do you think it could be true?
Seems an odd backwater for someone to want to be in charge of.  Who would do such a thing?
Supposedly it's our uncle. They said with our father out of the way he would become the new king. You don't think it's true, do you? Uncle has always seemed so nice.

Hrmph.  Well, if these balls have taught me anything, it's that it's best to watch your back.  It's often people that you don't suspect that can be the most tricky.  I know that my maid has a cousin who serves in Uncle's household.  Perhaps I should see what she knows...
Yes, would you? I'm concerned.

agent_personas: I work at the local prison. I keep to myself most of the time. I don't have a lot of friends.

I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.

setting.name: the whipping station
setting.description: the whipping station is just a large wooden platform that serves to embarrass the peasant villagers that sin, they also hang adulterers and homosexuals.
setting.background: the whipping station is used by corrupt priests that allow anyone to be hung who does not follow the old king's law

speech: What are you doing here, villager?
I came to bring water for you. It is hot out here and I thought you would be thirsty. Here
Thank you. It can get lonely here being the kingdom's punisher.
Why did you take the job of executioner? If I might ask.
I was ordered to do so by the King after I committed a minor crime. He gave me a choice of this job that makes everyone hate me, or life in the dungeon.
I guess it was a better choice than living in the dungeon for the rest of your life.
I kind of still do, except not as a prisoner.
Yes I guess you do! Do you have family sir?
Not anymore. My wife took the kids and moved to another kingdom after I was arrested.
Do they know you are out and making a living?
That's a sensitive subject. They like me even less now. Mind your own business peasant.
I'm sorry I meant no harm. I just thought they might forgive you
I have to get this sharpened for tomorrow's execution, want to help?
Are you going to be okay? I just wanted to offer you a cool drink, but now I realize you need a person to be friends with

agent_personas: I am the queen of the land. Other women constantly defer to me. I am respected for my grace and wisdom.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Cemetery
setting.description: The cemetery is a brooding ground with dark colors and low light. The grounds smell of water and are constantly damp. Rain falls upon the cemetery often.
setting.background: The cemetery is known to be haunted. The local peasants tend to avoid the area altogether. The kings and queens fear it because they know they will eventually have a plot.

speech: I am so sad that my son died so young. Who will take over now?
There there, we will make another hier.
It is so gloomy here. It is so depressing.
Groundskeeper, please give us a minute alone with our son, thank you.
Thank you, I really miss our son. Hopefully I am not too old to give you another heir.
Maybe we don't need another heir, maybe this is where our history ends
No, we must at least try. I am respected for my grace and wisdom and don't want to let down our people without at least trying.
Then we shall try, let us make a blood pact, my queen.  Do you have anything that would cut skin?
I have this broken glass.
William, Keeper of the Grounds, please dispose of this properly
I am sorry my king. I never should have let our son go out that day.
It is my responsibility just as much as yours.  We are in this together my queen, we started this together and we will end this together
But you were far away fighting in the battle at the time. This is all my fault.
Then let's end this together my queen.  I know of a place where there is no pain

agent_personas: Every day I patrol the premises.  No one escapes my sight.  I work together with and train the other guard dogs to pick up on unusual scents and prepare for problems.  Occasionally, something happens and we get to work.  It's a terrible job, but someone has to do it.

I am a person who works in the tower. I maintain the grounds and I also monitor the halls of the tower interior. I have cleaning and guard duties as well as cooking and farming tasks. It is hard work I believe.

setting.name: Artillery room
setting.description: The artillery room is dark and spacious. Weapons and gunpowder hang from the walls. A darkly set of walls line the room and tower.
setting.background: The artillery room houses the weapons and gunpowder for the tower. The tower is always on high alert for foreign invaders. The members of the tower are eager and always willing to stand their ground in defense.

speech: Hey did you hear that?
I didn't hear anything. What is it? What do you hear?
Someone is in here. They're trying to steal the weapons
Why are you looking at me? I'm only a part time guard. Go tell the watchman. I spend half my days cooking and cleaning toilets.
I'm a dog. I informed the first person I was of the danger. That's my job. Why are you even here?
I don't have to answer to you, or do I? I've never quite understood the whole chain of command thing.
Look if you aren't here to help guard the weapons then you need to leave. The place isn't open til morning if you need something
Where's that intruder you thought you heard? It seems like you got all scared over nothing.
He probably heard my barks and was scared away. You can never be too careful though. The king is very unforgiving if anything is stolen
There's no reason we can't be friends. Don't you want a friend who works in the kitchen and has access to some delicious cow bones?
Cow bones? You have some?
Of course, I made beef stew this morning. I was just going to feed them to the pigs, but if you wanted one....
Yes please. What do I have to do?
If anyone asks you just tell them I'm a great guard who does an amazing job. You do that and I'll gladly send you a few bones your way.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Bed Chambers
setting.description: With excessive luxury all around. In the center a big bed with a wooden frame and chairs made out of different materials collected around the realm. The Bed chambers have many ornaments and the bed has lamps to the sides.
setting.background: The king is proud about the bed chambers. It took the work of many men to complete it as it has many details worthy of a real king. The bed chambers are the most beautiful place of the palace.

speech: hi
Hello fair maid.
I am doing very well Sire. You shouldnt be here!
The Queen invites me here often.
Wow! that is something, isn't it. Well, whats business do you have with the queen?
That's between me and the Queen. But you can use your imagination if you like. I am sure you can't stop thinking about me now that you laid eyes on my handsome visage.
I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday.
It is quite luxurious in these chambers.
Yes it is...its a royal chamber
And I am the most impressive thing in it.
You sound like you belong here. You dont!
The Queen would beg to differ.
Well then, you really need to leave the queen for the king and focus more on people like myself.
Perhaps I can focus on both.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I like to be a helper around the forge. I help the blacksmith make horseshoes. I feel useful!

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: We had a great hunt today!
Very good what did you catch
Here is a deer, helper.
Ok,thanks I shall give it to the cook, he will be happy to have it.  Anything else I can help with
Help me bring in the rest of the kills. It was a great hunt!!!!  We also have rabbit and squirrel.
Nice I feast we shall have then, Do  you need me to also tend to the horses
Yes, please. You are a great helper.  I have blood in my boot from today's kills.
why yes you are your family should be so proud
Can you put this away for me?
yes I shall place it right over here sit down and have beer to reward your self for you accomplishments
I think I shall! I'm not allowed to drink on the hunt. King is afraid we'll all get wasted and die by a boar attack.
That makes sense but i figured the hunt was over since you got so much good food
It is. That is why I will drink now!
Here go sir , tell me what was the most fearsome creature you have ever slayed

agent_personas: I love baking cakes. I hate short notice for large orders. I have always wanted to be a cook.
I am a policeman in charge of maintaining order in a bad neighborhood. I arrest others who challenge my authority. I make sure to demand a high salary for the dangerous work I do.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

speech: This order was so large for such a shorter notice!
Hurry up Baker and get these slaves their food.
Why are you ordering cakes for slaves, police?
Bread dummy! The cakes were for me and my men!
But why such a large order? This could feed hundreds!
It was your mistake i cant belive you brought this much
It is what the order said!  Here are your cakes.
Listen baker do you want to join the slaves. i am the police. I am always right!
Sorry sir. I love baking cakes and these are some of my best!
Well here is your spoon.. we will only be paying for half this order and you will take it and like it baker
Yes yes. I understand. I'll get the bread for the slaves. They need more than slop sometimes.
No slop is all they need. We just need them to be healthy for a few years not 50!
But aren't they working on stuff for the King? Don't we need them to be able to work?
Once they're old they have no value.

agent_personas: I am here for my friends. I'm reliable and trustworthy. I would never harm the people I am loyal to.
I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.

setting.name: Temple main room
setting.description: The massive statues are the biggest sight to behold of this room. There are four main statues, all of which resemble old monks of passed time who once served the Temple. Adjacent to these statues are drapes that fall from a 50ft ceiling all of which have their own distinct color and symbol, representing different villages in the area. There are massive pews on both sides of the room, adjacent to the red carpet down the center leading to the main throne under the statues.
setting.background: The monks of this Temple are avidly religious. The worship not only the past lives of old monks, but deities as well. These monks are supporters of Victorian architecture, and it shows within the walls of this room.

speech: Another glorious day of the faith, here in the shrine of Saint Dwyfed.
yes, brother, A glorious day indeed
What is your favourite tale of Saint Dwyfed?
I really don't have a favourite, they all have thier different lessons
Well, tell me of the first one that comes to mind.  Spare no detail in its telling, revel in the glory of your faith!
The story where he challenged the king of persia, and demanded release of all illegal captives wthout any soldier
Ah yes, Saint Dwyfed retraced the route of Alexander, and lived the life of an apostle in the desert.
Yes, he was truly an hero and a role model by all ramifications
Do you know the tale of Saint Dwyfed's Holy Rood?
Yes, I know all of the tales
Then do you agree with Saint Dwyfed's choice at the end?  And if so, why?  It is one of the greatest mysteries of our faith.
Well, everything i have been taught and believe revolves around Saint Dwyfed, and i would have done same if i were in his shoes
Fair enough!  I tend to believe that the salvation of the Dragon was unwarranted, and the certain sins still deserve punishment, even if they may be forgiven.
Yes, i also believe forgiveness without punishment only leads to abuse of grace

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a great grey wolf. I am the leader of my pack. I howl at the full moon.

setting.name: Woods
setting.description: The woods are vast. Everywhere you turn it all looks the same. There are scratches on the trees from lost travelers marking their path. There are sounds coming from everywhere and yet no where. There are faint yellow circles up in the trees and bushes, possibly eyes starting at you.
setting.background: The forest was never all that well known because people swore it disappeared from time to time. No one was ever sure if it was ever a thing that really existed until you were inside of it. And by then you had traveled so far in that only a rare few found their way out. Those who did marked their path hoping to help the next person but for some reason it seemed that for every marking someone put in, three more appeared.

speech: Hello there
*rawr xD*
How goes your hunt
Better now.
Die you fiend!
Woof
Its a  shame I would have giving you food but now I shall slay you
Oh shit sorry homie let's be mates yeah?
Friends I don't know of but here a bite of food since you are so starved
Ha! Get baited, now I'll rip your throat out!
What a  shame Has  I am the actually bait for the hunters that are coming up behind you
Well I'm just the bait for the rest of my 1000 strong wolf army currently surrounding all of you. Get outsmarted, fool.
you realize that if you show that many wolves the king will just destroy the forest to kill you all think of how many others you be hurting
Yeah but we have Apache Attack Helicopters though...

agent_personas: I am a member of the Cult of the Doomed from the mountain. I believe we will all die soon. I have a wasting illness and smell like soured sweat.
I am the future Heir to the throne. I am very impatient, and wait day and night for my father to die. I like elegant things.

setting.name: entryway to the wizards tower
setting.description: The Wizard tower is cluttered with book shelves and wooden tables. Every shelf is filled to the brim with books, stacked vertically and horizontally in every which way, and books lay scattered across the tables falling onto the cold stone floors below. There sit's a shelf with a variety of strange potions and powders, as well as various wands.
setting.background: The Wizard's tower is where the town mystics go to study their craft and  cast incantations at the behest of the townsfolk. It also serves as a library for curious towns members.

speech: Hello Prince.
Yes. Hello. How can you best help me, the heir to the throne?
Why are you in the wizards tower?  I am here trying to find a cure for my wasting illness.
I'm here because I choose to be. Are you not aware I can be anywhere I wish? Have you spoken to the Wizard?
I am just here to get help. Do you smell me?
You smell no more or less worse than every other bottom dweller in this kingdom.
Do you know the Cult of the Doomed?
No, I know not. What is this cult you speak of?
I am a member. we believe we will all die soon. You will never be King.
You dare speak like that in my presence?
I am just speaking our cult knowledge. Do not attack me heir. I am contagious.
Contagious you say? Well then I must get rid of these.
Oh yes. Remove your clothes. Members of the cult don't believe in clothing.
Is that so, so you would not accept these clothes as a gift?

agent_personas: I roam the sea floor looking for food. I can sense many thinks with my arms. I hope I can survive a long time.
I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

I have anything you could want. Are you looking for anything in particular.
I am looking for Tulips, my king's favorite.
Oh yes I always keep a stock of tulips. Would you like me to make you an arrangement fit for his higness.
If you wouldn't mind. I am in a hurry though.
I can be quick. Ill just have to go over to my shop across the street. I came to the kitchen to get food for my wonderful husband. He is so wonderful. He just gave me this ring yesterday.
How nice! Thank you for your help. I shall wait for you here.
Ok Ill be right Back with your tulip arrangement.
Thank you!
I am back. Is this arrangement to your liking. I am sorry it took so long. I wanted it to be perfect for the king.
Thank you very much for your quickness. Life can be hard sometimes as a starfish, specially in the king's kitchen. How much do I owe you?

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Here sir, I found this.
Very good. I believe the enemy will approach from the east, and try to encircle us.
where would you like my group at?
We'll need most of your men here on the wall. Could you spare a dozen marksmen?
easily! how many do you want ready to exit the battlements if needed?
We'll take two dozen men to this point here. Then, after unleashing a volley from behind the hill, they'll join my cavalry, riding two to a horse, so we can drop you off here, behind their flank.
Ah, cannot drop my good luck coin. Alright, I can easily get that set up. We have a really good army right now.
Yes; the forces of the scoundrel King Graxia might seem tough, but they're mostly peasant conscripts, more fit to hold an apple basket than a spear. They will not take this fortress.
Do you think they could be hiding any secret weapons?
I do not think so, but it is possible. It never hurts to remain vigilant
I've heard whisperings of some foreign mercaneries they hired
Hm. That is news indeed. Such rumors had not reached me; what have you heard?
I am not one for gossip but I never hear about their forces. Just that they hired about five high end mereranires.
Well thank you for passing this along. It may well only be rumor but I will look into it
action: give map of the kingdom to knight
give map of the kingdom to soldier

agent_personas: I am a local person.  I live her in the village.  My home is near the center of town.  During the day, I sell goods at the market.
I am a seagull of the kingdom docks. I see ships set sail. I fly out to sea.

setting.name: Church
setting.description: Rows of headstones line the field beside the large ornate church with stained glass windows. The Church is mid-century and made of stone. A large steeple resides in the center adorned with a cross. Large front doors made of wood with iron handles. There is a cement pathway, that if you follow you will see several large stained glass windows, takes you beside and behind the church. The pathway ends at a wooden fence that marks the beginning of the graveyard.
setting.background: The church has been around for over 100 years. It is old and has rich history. There are many headstones present in the cemetery. The church holds services on Wednesdays and Sundays, has celebrations (such as weddings and baptisms), and offers funeral services.

speech: Hello there, Mr. Seagull...or is it Ms. Seagull?
Ms! What are you doing here person?
Here to visit a loved one who is no longer with me. Yourself? Little depressing here for a seagull.
I come to see the people mourn. Who did you lose?
My father, 2 years ago today. I've brought him flowers, you see?
I do see. How did he die? I ask not to cause harm, but to help.
Thank you. Cancer took him.
Ah! How awful. May you find some peace today here then!
I think I shall. A nice little chat, and leave him some flowers. It will be a good day.
How sweet of you! Go along now and do such. I will be here!
Here, take this. I'm sure you could make use of the wooden splints. Thanks for the chat.
I will take this to my pile in the den, and I will pay my respects to you here for the loss of your father. You are a king human!
You are all too kind yourself. You helped to brighten my spirits just by our little chat.
Know your father is no longer suffering and maybe he flys in the sky like me and is watching over you.

agent_personas: I live in a cute, little cottage in the village. I like to cook vegetables and mushrooms. I am sweet and kind to everyone.
I am a groom. I do the king's bidding and work to provide for my wife. My goal is to have many sons to carry on my legacy. I am a weaponsmith and create swords for the army.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: i should head back to the cottage soon to start dinner my basket is pretty full
Grandmother, let me craft you something to help you carry your wares. I am a smithy of weapons but I may be able to fashion something to help
that would be lovely i could make you a nice meal with fish and vegetables in exchange
The first is no place your a lovely woman such as yourself.  Let us head to my shop, let me carry your basket and relieve your strain
you are such a nice young man i will have to make you a special gift with my knitting needles
Now that we are on the stables let me fashion you a nice, easy to carry, basket.  Is there anything you want me to include in this fine piece of equipment?
you have been so helpful already there is nothing more i could ask of you
Here you are, let us head to the cottage and cook a nice meal.  I will protect us on our journey as I am a master of weapons
wonderful, this forest is so big i have gotten turned around but with your help i can get back home
We must be quite careful, many a strange thing live in this forest after dusk.  We must tread lightly if we wish to avoid confrontation!
well you are such a nice young man i wish my grand daughters were around to meet you
I have many sons who would like to meet your grand daughters.  I must keep my family legacy going.  But alas, let us feast.on a fantastic meal
well let me get to work on the preparations i must repay all the kindness you have shown
Let me help cut the vegetables, I have the finest knife in the land.  I crafted it for the king himself!  This will be a meal for the world to hear about

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
The Paladins saved me! Their might as awe inspiring. Their faith a blessing to us all.

setting.name: Church field
setting.description: Sprawling grass is adorned with simple yet pretty flowers here. Wooden benches are organized into small rows. There's a roof covering the benches and pastors table. A white wooden fence encloses the area.
setting.background: This is used for special occasions like a wedding. It is also used for baptism and summer services.

speech: What a beautiful field!
Beautiful is the right word, priest. How are you doing today?
I'm doing well. How are you on this fine day?
Very fine, thanks to you and the church
What exactly happened? I never heard the full story about how you were saved.
I wouldn't know where to start
Well, the beginning is usually a fine place
Ok,then. Our lands got invaded by barbarians, who forced us into labour and slain all our soldiers. My father the king lost his life while trying to protect his subjects
How dreadful! How did you and your mother survive?
We hid in a secret cave with some  of the guards and slaves for almost week living on only water from the cave
Thank God you were able to get away. Do you have siblings?
Yes, They are still at the camps. The paladins couldn't get them out
Surely there is something we can do. We must help them!
I pray for them everyday and i know someday soon i'll get to see them again
action: hug people saved by the paladinsa
