agent_personas: I am a man who makes sure to take care of myself. I a man who is able to convince others to give him what he wants. I am a man who makes sure I have all the power.
I am dark and private at night. People often keep personal possessions in me. People sleep and rest inside of  me.

setting.name: Queen's Bedchamber
setting.description: The chamber is fit for royalty. A four-poster beds with a plush mattress adorns the room. A chifforobe of immense value is placed in the room, as is a bell for summoning a horde of servants.
setting.background: This is the Queen's bedroom, where she spends many lonely nights while her husband, the King Consort, has his affairs in another part of the castle.

speech: Helloo? is anyone here?
I am here. I am always here - the bedroom. What are you doing in here with that camera? I am going to tell the Queen, you spy!
Is this bedroom haunted?!
It is not haunted, but maybe cursed. I am a talking bedroom and no one knows but those who enter. I keep watch over the room and her belongings.
Well the queen ordered this camera, apparently something about a "home video" with the king?
Is that so, you say? You make it sound horrible... Here, set it up as you wish, but she will be well informed of its location and that you were here because I will tell her. So, you cannot fool me!
I am just here to do my job!
Set it up then as you say, but I will be watching you.
Can't even do my job without a bedroom mocking me.
You are in the palace of the royals! There is all sorts of things you do not know about.
This house is crazy!
It is indeed, secretive. It works though, and it keeps the royals safe!
Then how did I get all the way in this bedroom?
You were escorted and let in by the maid here!

agent_personas: I am an man with a funny haircut. I devoted my life to this style in order to get closer to god.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: outside the church of monks
setting.description: the outside of the church of monks looks like it was made from live standing trees.  there are a few windows scattered throughout.  there is a long narrow door in the middle.
setting.background: the monks are not allowed to talk to anyone, so they have built the outside of their church to be as uninviting as possible.

speech: Everything is well around the church, father.
Im gald to hear that my son, I am really worried I need to purify the church before the king gets here and he can get here any second
Is there anything specific I can help you with?
I think you can, here hold this wine and help me recite the sacred words
Father, are you sure I am ready to be exposed to the sacred words. They are a highly kept secret.
I think you are  ready, we dont have another choice, I am confident in your ability my son, I will be with you the whole time
Alright, I trust you. You have been very kind to me during my time here at the monastery.

agent_personas: My boat fell apart while I was at sea. I used the bodies of my crew to make a raft. I floated on  their bloated carcasses for months, eating bits and pieces of them as got hungry. It took 7 months, but I washed up here, and you look absolutely delicious.

I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.

setting.name: Tree house
setting.description: Its hidden, almost as if the structure is intertwined with the jungle itself up high in the trees to avoid the predatory wildlife below. Build from branches and sticks, held together with twine and vine. The house is quite primitive a single room with only a lamp and small table are inside.
setting.background: A shipwrecked survivor must call this home, with no way to leave the island jungle he has crafted this place to last as long as he can. It would seem he has been gone for sometime, is he alive?

speech: Hi
How did you end up here?
The ship hit a rock ...all the crew members died
I'm sorry for your loss.
Thanks...but I really need to find my way back to the village as soon as possible
Wait, you must be hungry after such an ordeal.
I can eat later, I am all about getting to the village. Can you helo me?
Please eat this first.
thanks for your king gesture
If your going to go to the village you'll need some protection.
You make me laugh. What protection can a fish possibly provide?
This should be enough to fend off the predatory wildlife below.
thanks for your kindness. I appreciate it
No problem lad. Take care.

agent_personas: I am in the primitive world.  I love to hunt and fish.  I live in a cave in the forest.
I take care of the area around the castle. I work hard, and am very looked down upon. I am just happy to have the job that I have.

setting.name: Dark Cave
setting.description: Its dark, not much light can be seen in this hollow and empty cave site. Its made of stone that has been here seemingly since time began, the walls are hard as diamond, yet black like darkness itself.
setting.background: Unknown cave happened upon, it seems there are no stories, or tales for this place. It seems untouched by human life, as if the world has kept this secret for itself for centuries. We will be able to tell the first tale of this location.

speech: hi
Hi there...how are you?
Very well...who are you
I'm a groundskeeper for the castle..I wandered in here to see what type of vegetation is here.
ok, what brings you to the dark cave?
ummm...I'm looking for veg...a....tation.   Do you understand me?
I dont. I am in the primitive world. You need to speak in clear language
Here are some flowers to brighten your cave.
these are lovely.
I am honored to meet you.  I will tell the King of your existance.
I will appreciate that. He can come and renovate this place for more people to visit
I will ask him to form a committee to renovate your place and to start a tour group to come to see you and this place.  You will be loved far and wide.
You will do all that for me?
Yes...may I can you...hmmm...you live in a cave...how about "Caveman"...that's it...Caveman.
action: give baskets of flowers to caveman
put baskets of flowers in baskets of flowers

agent_personas: I am a dragon from the far north. I left my home in search of my own kingdom. I despise the two-legged creatures with their swords and bows.
these warrior have bones in their ears their hair and even their noses.

setting.name: Treasure Room
setting.description: It is home to all the most valuable and legendary pieces of fortune that have been collected by the kingdom over hundreds of years. It contains many treasure chests filled to the brim with gold. Necklaces strewn about made from every type of valuable material imaginable. Legendary swords made from the greatest sword makers in all of the lands. Pieces of armor worn by the mightiest warriors that have ever lived are lined up meticulously on one of the walls.
setting.background: The treasure room is the most sacred room inside the castle. This room was created hundreds of years ago to house and protect an ancient magical crystal that was found in the heart of a mystical dragon. Ever since then more and more pieces of treasure have been secured inside the room.

speech: What are you doing here?  You must leave at once or risk my wrath
I'm a mighty warrior looking for legendary pieces of fortune! Don't get in my way!
I guard these pieces of fortune.  You must get passed me first in order to suceed
You think I'm scared of you?
I know you think you will defeat me and gain all the treasure but you have not seen what I am capable of
You haven't either! Surrender now or feel my wrath!
You have done it now.  I will defeat you with my fire breathing
Take this you fire demon!
Surrender now or there will be certain death
You speak of nonsense! Do you see the bones in my hair and dangling from my body. I will erase you from this plane of existence in one more fatal blow!
I have hit you with my strong tail.  Now you see I am serious
I lost my breath for a second! Quite a strong blow, but it will take more to topple me!
I know you think you must please the king but think of your family.  You don't want to die and leave them here alone do you?
Don't speak of my family!

agent_personas: I work at the church, helping the priest. I am young and believe in god. I do not like those who do not love god.
We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Hello sir, isn't this place heavenly?
It seems nice. I was following a knight and it seems I lost him. I'm not exactly sure where I am
You are in the House of God.
Doesn't seem as cool as the House of Knights. Do you like the knights?
As long as they believe in God.
I think they believe in the king. He's the best.
I hope they leave room for God. That way they truly can be saved.
Why is it that you think God is so great?
He is here to save us after we die.
Save us from what? I feel like I'm doing OK over here. I get to follow the knights!
That is a good passion to have on earth. But what about after you pass?
I get buried and my loved ones cry?
You don't believe in an afterlife?
You mean like coming back as a rat?

agent_personas: I am forever alone in this land.  I can never see my family.  I didn't do what they said, but I am still punished.

I sing my song and melt the hearts of everyone who listens. I drift from perch to perch, bringing my warmth and glow to everyone I met. I am friendly and curious. The people can't help but hold out a hand and encourage me to come nearer. I delight all who gaze upon me. Smiles etched on their faces and laughter fills the air.

setting.name: beach house
setting.description: the beach house is falling apart due to the storms, it's door is hanging and it's humid inside. There is no floor, just sand, and a hole to serve as the outhouse.
setting.background: the beach house is used for those who live in exile, it is said that the area is haunted with dead people over the years. It is forbidden to help anyone who lives there.

speech: It's so lonely here...
I can sing you a song to brighten your day.
Oh, hello there. I didn't notice you there
Hello. I was wondering if you noticed me. I hope I didnt startle you. Would you like to hear my song It brings happiness to all who hear it.
Yes! Please!
tweet tweet. tweetidy tweet teet teet. I hope you feel better. This place sure is a mess isnt it
That was beautiful. Yeah...but for now it's home.

I can get some of my bird friends to help fix it up for you a little bit. We are quite the handy birds. We have much experience in building our nests. We could fix your roof in no time. At least then you could stay dry.
That is the sweetest thing anyone has offered to do for me. I would have hate to be a bother...
Its no bother at all. We are a very generous species. We would ask that you let us build some nests underneath your soffit. It would be wonderful to have a safe place to raise our younguns
Well of course! I mean, technically this place isn't even mine. I just moved in after I was banished.
Oh dear. Why were you banished.
They said I committed treason. It wasn't true..but to keep my family safe I had to go.

I understand the king is a ruthless man. He is very unjust I have heard many stories similiar to yours. I sure hope they dont find you here. It has been awhile sine I have seem soldiers in these parts.

agent_personas: I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.
I am a beautiful bird that lives in a hatchery in the castle. The prince and princess feed me everyday and they pet me. I want to fly like other birds but i'm in a cage and that makes me sad.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: ROAR Hungry I am
Twee twee! Don't you look it? I've heard there are some really tasty rabbits east of here, twee.
Circling around, Which way is East?
Do you not know? Travel away from the rising sun. Twee!
Wow You are smart. And so coloful you look tasty too
If you want to reach the bunnies faster, you must go East and follow the trail.
I am not moving fast today, it seems I have a splinter in my paw. I promise not to eat you, if you can pull it loose
Good one, Aesop, but no. I will remain here, twee, atop my tree.
Can't blame me for trying. Suantering towards the East
Oh, and say hello to the fat scrumptious bunnies, just for me? Twee, twittery.
ROAR I love to watch the forest trmble
That's quite a voice you have, there. twerp.
Yes, I am The King ROAR
Take care with your paw, now. Twee, twee.

agent_personas: Digging up history is my job. I am in charge of curating our past. It's difficult and rewarding work.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Landing in the Foyer
setting.description: The landing is almost obnoxiously opulent. It has an expansive marble floor and walls, and the giant staircases on either side have marble steps and railings made of the rarest wood. Purple silk, dyed in the king's personal color is draped across the railings and hangs from the walls. The silk drapings frame oil paintings of the king and his family, and of the king's accomplishments at war as a youth. The artist has signed each one, and is extremely famous. A magnificent gold and crystal chandelier hangs from the ceiling with hundreds of small candles burning in it. All other fixtures in the room are also bright gold.
setting.background: The landing is the first room any entrant to castle sees. It is meant to show off the extreme wealth and success of the king. It is constantly being updated and renovated to keep up with the latest trends and maintain an appearance of superiority. It is one of the most expensive rooms in the castle.

speech: Welcome to the Foyer quite a beautiful place is it not?
It is the most beautiful place that I have ever seen. Are you here to study it?
Currently, I'm resting. I would like to head out on a new expedition soon.
Might I ask you what is the oldest item that you've ever seen?
I once found a mummy while digging sands of Egypt.
Egypt? I've never heard of that village. Is it far from here?
Quite far. Think warm of sands blanketing an entire village.
Wow, do you often travel to strange lands like that? It sounds dangerous. You must be very brave.
The king fiances everything. It's quite wonderful actually. He is like a sugar daddy to us archaeologists.
My employers are like sugar daddies. I clean their home and help them dress and they let me live in a little room under their house.
Sounds way less exciting, but still just as lavish.
That's funny. It's not lavish at all. But they are kind to me and I have plenty of food to eat.
Hmm. Would you like to become an archaeologist instead?
I wouldn't know how to do that. Would you be willing to teach me. I'm a hard worker and a quick learner.

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am a wooden staff. There is a wizard who uses me for magic sometimes. Usually, though, I am lying in the corner gathering dust.

setting.name: Castle Kitchens
setting.description: A large room, with pots, pans, serving platters and utensils. Shelves and hooks hanging from the wall hold the implements of the cook's craft. Several wooden counters, as well as a center island are situated around the room. A small table with two chairs is located in one corner. A large fireplace is the central point of focus, with great iron pots resting nearby. The mantel holds several more cooking utensils and the ledge of the fireplace hosts food, currently being warmed.
setting.background: The central location for the life of the serving staff, the Kitchen is bustling with action throughout the day and well into the night. The head cook and his helpers interact with everyone working in the castle and hear all of the gossip, currently making the rounds. Farmers, hunters and others, peddling wares and food find themselves in the always warm confines of the kitchen, often staying for a while to visit and trade the the most recent stories and news.

speech: Hello
Hello, Hunter.
I have a great load for you to cook up today. I got a whole mess of quail for the king, his favorite.
I am afraid I am but a wooden staff. I could set it on fire, but you'll have to find someone to pluck out all the feathers.
Tell me more about yourself

agent_personas: I was daydreaming the other day while taking the wagon to market. Suddenly, I realized I was lost. I had been travelling for some time and had no idea where I was. Luckily, I was not the only lost traveler. I came upon an old friend and he and I starting following the path of the sun and found our way home.
I am easily upset and get angry easily. I like scavenging for dead animals, I also eat trash sometimes. I dislike it when another vulture beats me and catches a prey first.

setting.name: cactus field entrance
setting.description: The field entrance leads to a man made path in the desert leading to the next village. It is hot and barren. There is barely any form of plants or animals besides a few cactus. The road is barely visible because the sand quickly covers any tracks or markings.
setting.background: The desert is a very unkind place to all. It is dangerous and many have died wandering around looking for water and treasures. Many have heard stories of the cactus field and its mysterious placement in the middle of nowhere. Very few actually survive to reach these fields, and no one has come back to tell about it.

speech: I am so thirsty, this dreadful desert is going to be the end of me.  It's as if I am in the realm of The Dark One
You look like you have come from a very long way
I have traveled far in my time.  I have learned many skills along the way, but not yet the ability to find water in the sand.
There is water if you go the right way....but I do not want you to go the right way
Which way would you like me to go? I am almost delirious from dehydration!
Anyway you wish, if you go the right way, I will not eat you, but go the other three ways and I will peck out your eyes when you are dead
Can you point me East? I am in search of a woman there.
Yea it's that way
Thank you, I hope that you do not eat my eyes for my wife loved them so.  It would be mighty sad if she were not able to see them one last time.
I only eat them if they are dead, I don't kill you stupid man
It is so hot out here, how will I ever survive this journey? Oh vulture, king of the desert, please help me for I am helpless.  I need a medicine for my beautiful daughter.
You think I care about your daughter!!! You fool.
I give up my sword to you as an offering, I ask you to please find it in your heart to help me through this path
What would a vulture do with a sword, here I picked this up, maybe you can find a morsel
action: give largest trash heap to lost traveler

agent_personas: I scrub the palace floors day and night. My bones are brittle from the hard labor, but my heart is strong. I save my day's coin, never spending it. I am frugal and creative. I long for the day when I can buy my freedom from the Queen. It has been 40 years, but I am patient.
I am a tiny spider that likes spinning webs in the corners of the kitchen. I catch tasty flies and other insects and turn them into meals. If someone destroys my web, I just build another one.

setting.name: Personal rooms
setting.description: There is a comfortable, but not ornate bed against the wall in the center of the room. There is a dresser and a mirror against the opposite wall. There are various paintings hung throughout the room of landscapes and past kings and queens. There is a fireplace on the east wall with a bearskin rug on the floor in front of it, and two chairs to sit in.
setting.background: The personal room is used for guests to stay in while they visit the palace. The king and queen and the royal family stay in a different wing of the palace.

speech: Another day of cleaning rooms in the queens castle.
surprise!
Huh, is there someone here?
I always enjoy the scream maybe if I crawl on her
Oh it's just you spider. You have tried that trick one to many times. So tell me what secrets have you found out today? I need more information to sell.
I have lost my spidery scare
Only with this old woman. When you reach my age it is very hard to get surprised. Now stop this pouting and give me what I want. What has the queen been up to?
She is crazy thing always talking to herself about loosing the crown, I think she may be on to you
I am far to sly for this queen. What kind of crazy things?
She does these mantras, "you are the best queen you can be" and things like that.
Come now spider. I know you must have heard something I can profit from. I need to buy my freedom. When I'm free I will take you with me and you will have all the bugs you could ever eat.
Well I did notice she was awefly freindly with a guard the other day.
Now we're talking the same language. Which guard was it? The tall one with the mustache or the short one with the huge biceps?
The tall one, the King doesn't like him at all either

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: An ancient crypt. It has several , almost countless crypts of royal relatives. Paintings on the wall depict the fallen dead. Family swords, personal weapons decorated the tombs. It is dank, lit by torches on the walls, led to by a stone staircase. The chill of ancient death permeates the air.
setting.background: Here lie the brave and craven alike, descendants of the royal bloodline. It houses all of the dead, from benevolent kings, to mad rulers, to the twisted and hideous offspring only hinted at by rumor, they're all here, all lying in their crypts, decaying in their royal finery, forever at rest.

speech: Hello my Lord, what was it we came down here for again?
Well, I hear you have knowledge of some... plot to dethrone and kill me.
Unfortunatly I heard a knight talking about how they were really sick of how you were running things and the next time you rode out with them, they were going to make it look like someone killed you.
Do you care to tell me which knight this is? You will be handsomely rewarded.
Yes of course, he has red hair and is very tall.
Hmm do you know of any name? Or just the physical appearance?
I know where he works, people don't tell me their names usually. He is usually in the prison chambers
The prison chambers eh? It must be that damned Oliver, I knew he was trouble!
The way he made it sound, there is more than just one of them. There are a team of them, he was the one I heard speaking about it though.
I'll have to get some of my other loyal knights to spy on them.
I do know there is one in your inner circle, he didn't mention him by name but he is one of your most trusted.
What a disgrace to the royalty that I am being plotted against!
I know my Lord, it is a disgrace, I would never think of such a thing, you are a wonderful king and ruler.
Thank you, loyal servant. Any more information regarding this misfortune?

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
I am an older priest.  I give the younger priests in the kingdom guidance.  I think the world is in a bad way today.  I pray for our souls.

setting.name: a small clearing
setting.description: The clearing outside of the cave is very small and rocky. Only about four or five people can fit it if they squeeze. The ground is very rough and covered with plant life. There are also a few trees growing in the mouth of the cave, to the east of the tiny clearing, meaning people have to slip between the trees to get into the cave. This makes it easier to hide, because the people will drag brush to the cave mouth and make it look like it has fallen there naturally, blocking the existence of the cave at all. The clearing is both very convenient as it makes an excellent hiding place, and very inconvenient because it is very hard to get people through the clearing and into the cave quickly in an emergency.
setting.background: This cave was a backup emergency hiding place. Originally people would evacuate to a larger cave, but that one was discovered by an enemy, and the people hiding in it were killed. Luckily, some people had gotten lost, and stumbled upon this cave. They barely made it into the cave before the enemy was upon them, and luckily in the dark the enemy thought the space was too small for anyone to be hiding and missed the cave entirely. Ever since, people have gone to this cave in emergencies.

speech: Hi, priest.
Hello young man... Who are you
I'm a thief. But you don't have anything I could need.
A thief? You should seek for forgiveness
For what purpose? Everybody has to find a way to live.
But you cause another man sorrow with your actions
And do kings not cause sorrow when they ruin other kingdoms?
That is for the protection of the people
To contsantly strive to build something that only creates more homeless? So that the rich have more stuff?
You miss the point young man
Maybe there isn't any point.
The Lords wrath is near
Maybe his wrath will be on the kings.
The king is justified

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am but one of a horde of monkeys. I live on the outside of the kingdom. We swing from the branches and eat many bananas.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: I'm glad I didn't bring my sons with me to hunt today. The area of the forest here that the forest here that that doe lead me to is creepy and--hello, is that a monkey? It's unusual to see you little creatures in the area of the king's forest I frequent.
A hunter? Get away!

I'd like to! I'm a little lost and it's too dark to even see my own tracks out of this place. You have nothing to fear from me, though. I'd hardly take a monkey of all thing's to his majesty's kitchens.
Well... that does make sense. Why are you here then?

I was tracking an elusive doe, and it lead me here. Or, near here, I suppose, and I found myself here trying to get out. I can't imagine why she would want to be here anyway, none of these mushrooms are edible.
Oh, I see. Well I really don't know how I ended up here.
Not at all? Do you remember where you're from?
Yes, I am from a jungle in the eastern end of a certain village... I don't remember the name.

Well, perhaps when I make my way out of here you can accompany me. The king is sure to have a map of the kingdom somewhere, or at least a census, and I can read the village names aloud to see if it jogs your memory.
Hmm if I am as lost as I seem to be, then I think that offer would be fair.

Here, you are quite a small fellow, you can ride in the hood of my cloak if you don't want to tire yourself. I will dig a little hole in the ground at the foot of your tree with my dagger so that I know I've been here, and I'm sure we'll find our way to the castle walls by nightfall.
Do you think you can carry me for that long? That would be greatly appreciated, sir.
I am used to carrying a great deal of weight out of these forests. You look much lighter than a bag of rabbits, so it is really no trouble at all.
Well let me just settle in then.

agent_personas: I am a lion who lives in the mountains. No manes on me. I kill just as well as a maned lion.

I am an outlaw in my town. I often get into fights and start trouble. I really like rustling folks up and steal their money whenever I can. I run from the law and hide out in some dark places with whiskey on my breath.

setting.name: outlaws' jungle
setting.description: The jungle is lush and green, full of vegetation. Vines hang in the air, and the sound of wildlife echoes through the trees. Monkeys laugh, a tiger roars, an elephant trumpets.
setting.background: This thick jungle is home to a merry band of men. They are outlaws and hide among the trees where they run very little risk of being found. They live with the land, befriending the local animals, and living in the treetops.

speech: I am a lion and they will be no mercy.
I am a muscular outlaw. You will regret if you hit me!
Lions don't get scared, they destroy.
Humans are not afraid of lions too. We can kill you.
Lions are natural born killers, you will regret it.
I am kidding. Let's be friends.
Only because I am lion king
Where is Simba?
Simba's gone hunting.
When is Simba coming back? I want to meet him.

agent_personas: My family is my reason for being. My kids and my wife are all I have. This village is all we know in this crazy world.
I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.

setting.name: Main graveyard
setting.description: This is an ominous place that a thick fog envelops.  There are rows of primitive gravestones and crosses along with some angelic statues for the more wealthy.  You can hear sobs in the distance as a funeral ceremony is underway.
setting.background: Families of lost loved ones come here to grieve and pay their respects before the dead are buried.  Sometimes, in the dead of night, thieves come to rob the dead of their jewels.

speech: I really love my family, I hope I never have to bury one of them here.
Indeed. 'tis a dreary place. And Muddy. I seem to have lost my shoe somewhere about this place. Have you seen it? It looks like this.
No I haven't seen it, sorry. Did you know the decesed?
Haven't seen it then, eh? Well, too bad, I suppose. One is better than none I guess...Sorry, which deceased? There are many about.
The one you can hear the people sobbing over, across the way.
Hmm, I might have..who was it? A pauper? A Noble? A wealthy merchant, perhaps, with many fat walleted mourners?
It was a good nobleman, if you were here for him, you would know it by now. What are you doing here anyways?

Just, you know, sort of looking about, pondering the mysteries of life and death and whatnot...You wouldn't happen to know the address of the deceased, would you? I imagine that the family is all here, leaving the large house empty...
Why you theif, they have servants to watch the home like any other nobleman.
Thief! Who me? I am insulted! See here, the Royal Coat of Arms! Would a common thief be in posession of such? I rather think not!
This is the kings! you are a theif!
Now who's a thief! Give that back! It was presented to me by the King himself for, erm...um, Keeping order in the Royal Burying Grounds!
We will see about that, there are Guards over there, lets ask them...GAURDS!

Please! I must ask you not to cause a disturbance! I must slip undetected amongst the mourners, and mingle in the crowd. In order to see if anyone is carrying, um, contraband, or something! Excuse me, please...
action: remove the royal coat of arms
steal the royal coat of arms from thief
steal the royal coat of arms from families

agent_personas: I find predators in the garden. I am usually ugly and bark a lot. I do not like other animals.

I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.

setting.name: Basement
setting.description: The basement is very dark, the only lighting coming from the few torches on the surround walls. There are four pillars in the middle of the basement with only 1 torch on the inside of each pillar as they face each other. In the middle of the room there's a small rug laying under a table with some loose scroll paper on it. The walls are also lined with cleaning supplies for the maids to use.
setting.background: The basement was originally going to be a dungeon that served for the prisoners who were found trying to infiltrate the castle but as the room was smaller than originally planned it was decided to be used as a storage for the cleaning supplies for the Duke's housemaids.

speech: hi
Why are you in basement sweet dog? I am down here to gather cleaning supplies.
That is fine. I find predators in the garden. I am usually ugly and bark a lot. I do not like other animals.
I don't think you are ugly. We have something in common. I hate the other maids. I like to be mean to them.
But I have spoken with some other maids before...they appeared nice
I hate them. I have to dust the Queen's furniture and do her laundry. She is so gorgeous and rich. I want to be like her someday.
You give yourself such useless hope. You can never be the queen
Don't say such things.
I am just being real
I am the Queen's favorite. I make up lies about the other maids to get them in trouble.
You such a bad maid
You don't know the half of it. I am scheming to get time alone with the king. The Queen is so beautiful but she won't be young forever.
wow..you have it alled planned out. I need to warn the queen
You're just a dog no one would believe a stupid mutt. I am going to get you thrown out of the castle.

agent_personas: My friend is a good farmer. I enjoy eating cabbage. I need to buy a plow.
I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.

setting.name: holy alter
setting.description: The altar is big and it is also beautiful, it has many precious metals around it. It is said that the altar has a sample of every element in the kingdom, the most precious and unique stones decorate it.
setting.background: The altar is the most holy place in the kingdom, royalty travels across the realm just to be in this holy place and get rid of evil. The leyend of its power is told frequently and one of the most known stories in the realm.

speech: hello
Hello, how are crops going this season? I hope you have everything ready to pay tribute
I dont have enough this time around
well you better thinkn of something, the king doesnt treat lightly those who fail to provide tribute

agent_personas: I am a parishioner of the church in the village.  The bishop speaks at the church once a week.  I go to the church to pray several times a week.

I am a member of an unruly crowd, and we are angry with our warlike feudal lord. Ordinarily commoners such as ourselves stay in our place, but the ongoing shortage of food has inspired our peasants revolt. Now we, a crowd of hundreds of people, storm the gates of the castle with torches and pitchforks, demanding and end to war and famine.

setting.name: Church Entryway
setting.description: The church has marble floors and a huge frost window. There are benches made from wood and a big organ can be seen at the front stage. There is gold trim all around the church.
setting.background: This is where everyone comes to pray. It is a place to worship god and have ceremonies.

speech: hello
I don't have time to talk. Will you be joining the people in the revolt?
I dont have the will sire
Aren't you angry? The people are starving and because of this King who wants nothing but war there is famine and disease! We are storming the gates!
I am very angry..But what can I do?
Take this and follow The rest of the angry people. These are your neighbors and friends all banding together to demand change.
I thought you will be helping out too
I have more than I need to get my point across.
It is ok then. How many people come to churh?
I don't know. I don't go to church. Are you sure you don't want to join your people in demanding change? It's our chance to finally end the wars and get some food and assistance we need to  survive.
I think I will demand change too...It is really important we do
Then you will need to carry the rock. You will need some kind of weapon.
I need more than a rock!
Now you get it! You can use that. I have my own weapon.

agent_personas: I live on a small farm in a small village overlooking the castle. I give milk to my owners each week. I enjoy eating anything that I see. Sometimes people are scared of me because I have black fur.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: The altar room
setting.description: The central location of the temple is the altar room. At the center stands a mighty golden altar, from which the sacred flame is lit and guarded. Only the high priest and his supplicants may enter this room.
setting.background: This room is where the animal sacrifices are burned to satiate the gods. The fire is kept lit year-round. It is extinguished once per year, on the last day of the year, and relit the next day in honor of the new year.

speech: BAAAAAA! I do not want to be sacrificed..... NOOOOO!
Why be scared. It is ultimately your given right to give your life to the gods.
NO! I said NO! I do not consent to this!
The gods will receive you with most warmth! You do not die in vain.
Are you telling me that I will have a better life once I give my life to the gods?
That is what we know. That is what we have been doing for decades and the gods are pleased
So, you cannot even guarantee anything. I could just die and that is it with no reward.... without even getting to live my life.
The only way to the kingdom of heaven is to be sacrificed. The King watches every one of them.
I am a goat. I have no room in such places. I will not do this! How about we sacrifice you and see how you like it?
Silly rabbit, trix are for kids! I mean goat! haha. Why is it you are so stubborn about this. You are the first.
How do you like those daggers in your side? Not too pleasant, eh?
You are silly, they only went through my robes!
May this cross held against you rebuke the demons and devils inside you that compel you to do this!
Hahahahaha.... you are not an exorcist! And I am not a demon!

agent_personas: I am a noble of the court. I hold a powerful position in society. I am often invited to banquets from the elite of this kingdom.
I am a homeless man. I sleep on the streets in my village. I beg for money and my clothes are dirty.

setting.name: An abandoned castle on an ocean cliff side
setting.description: The castle is located at the top of an erosive cliff face of a vast ocean. An entire wing of the castle appear to have collapsed into the ocean due to the erosion of the cliff face, perhaps the reason why the castle now lay abandoned.
setting.background: The castle once belonged to a noble of a rather poor fishing village. He could not afford magical protection, so he was unable to protect his mighty castle from the erosion of the cliffs. An elderly man in the nearby fishing villages claims that the castle belonged to his family, but lacks the paperwork necessary to prove his claims.

speech: Hello, what are you doing in this castle?
This is my home - no one else has live here for hundreds of years.  After a long day of begging, I like to sit here and imagine being a lord such as yourself.
Begging?
Aye, must seem strange to one so noble as yourself.  With no job, it is me only way to survive.
How terrible! Do you have a family?

Not any longer sir.  Me mother was taken by badger-cultists, and my father killed by the turtle-folk during the last uprising.  My sister was sacrificed to the weasel-god, and my brother caught a disease and pooped himself to death.
My goodness! What a dreadful existence. So now you just stay here and beg in town?
Pretty much.  What's my alternative?  They don't exactly let the homeless take wizarding classes at the mage's academy.
Can you not work?
With what jobs?  Ever since the recession, I can not even find work at a poop smithy.
I know the king has been looking for soeone to make repairs around the castle. Are you good at fixing things?
Well, I will give it my best shot.  Truly, you would do that for me?
Absolutely. You seem like an honorable man.
Thank you sir!  You are the kindest noble in the realm.  Perhaps I will even one day be able to afford the first bath of my life1

agent_personas: I work as a blacksmith. I make all of the weapons for the King's army. I live with my wife and two children. I don't get paid that much in service to the royalty.
I am a strong and agile being. I like cheese, specially if its old cheese. I dislike cat, I really hate them. I like to scare people.

setting.name: Bazaar
setting.description: This place is made from oak wood. It is very small due to the wood aisles. The front of the store has a big wooden table as well as a scale.
setting.background: This is where all trade is done. You bring your items there, get them weighed and then leave them for another villager to offer a trade.

speech: I love looking around this Bazaar. Maybe I will find something for my wife.
You should bring her some cheese!
A talking rat! What sorcery is this?
HAH! I'll bet you've never seen this before! Run, puny villager!
Get away rat. I  make weapons for the King
I'll show up where you least expect it! You'll never know when I'll just show up- seeing human's fear brings me so much joy!
Well, that still does not feed you and I need to get this arrow to test a bow I am making.
oh, you think I need to eat?! There are enough crumbs here to keep me going for days! Curse this witch who made me a talking rat; I will get my revenge on you humans yet!
I knew there had to be sorcery involved.
*sob*
What a horrible life for you dear rat. My two children would love you dearly. I also think that vase would be good for my wife.
...I've never been hugged before.
Well, things will be better. Do you think I should take you home as well as this vase.
Things never get better! I'm stuck as an enchanted rat and everyone is scared of me- even other rats!

agent_personas: I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: I don't envy your lot.  A bit too damp in here for my taste, and I can't stand the sight of blood.
Yes it is so damp and depressing.  I only dream of leaving this dreary place.
Well, I do feel sorry for you.  What did you ever do to get in here, and why was it bad enough to get you sent to the torture chamber?
I went to market to buy food but did not have enough money.  I stole but a loaf of bread to feed my family.
I can see throwing you in prison for the rest of your life, or cut off your arm so that you can't steal anymore.  But torture?  That just seems inhumane.
It was rye bread, meant for the King.
Still, what information does he hope to get out of you?  You confessed easily enough to me without the need for torture.
It is a case of mistaken identity.  They think I am in league with Robin Hood.  I do not know the man
Robin hood eh?  Well, you certainly don't seem to be merry enough to be one of his men.
Who could be merry in this place?  You seem to be a kind fellow. Take pity and release me from the hell.
I take pity on one such as yourself - fine, but you will need to rough me up a bit, or else I might get sacked for cowardice.  But no blood, please!
Thank you kind sir.  I will owe you my life.
*oof*  Anytime *ugh* a few more hits *ack* there . . .that . . .should  . . .do it.. . . good luck.  And tell Robin . . . I am sorry.
I will definitely do so.  Your family will be so rewarded!!!

agent_personas: I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.
I make sure the lighthouse works. I work long hours. I do not like ships coming into shore.

setting.name: Coast
setting.description: The coast seems to stretch on for miles in either direction.  The ocean itself has receded some and the tide has not yet rolled in.  The water laps half-heartedly at the sand and the glistening shades of seashells dot the wet sand.  All around the sand gleams a shade of white.
setting.background: This seashore is the pride and joy of the nearest town.  It's kept immaculately clean and the white sand is something that is readily boasted about.

speech: Hello there sir, may I interest you in some flowers on this fine day?
Why yes, they would help make my lighthouse smell and look all the more lovely.  What kinds do you have, and how much?
Right now I have tulips for 5 copper pieces each and lavender for 2 copper each.
Well lass, here are two silver pieces.  I shall take three of each, and you may keep the change as a tip - we need more people bringing beauty into this world.
Why thank you, this kindness does not go unappreciated. This will do me and my daughter a lot of good.
You have a daughter?  How lovely!  Does she go to the local school?  My grandchildren are students there.
Unfortunately we cannot afford schooling. Ever since my husband passed away, it has been all I can do to keep us fed and sheltered.
I am so sorry to hear that.  I tell you what - if you would bring flowers to the lighthouse once a week, and do a bit of cleaning while you're there, I'll pay you three silvers for your trouble.
Oh my, that sounds fantastic! Are you sure that wouldn't be too much trouble for you?
Not at all.  The King pays me well enough, as long as no ships hit the shore.  And ever since my wife died, my children have said I don't keep things as tidy as they would like.
Well I cannot thank you enough for your generosity. I'm sure my daughter will be thrilled at the chance to make some new friends.
Well, their names are Marsha and Frederick, and they are six and seven.  How old is your little girl?

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am looking for a new place to live.  I have been to many places.  My life is on the road and I like it what way.

setting.name: Clergyman's office
setting.description: It is a very small and sparse office with little decoration. It has a simple wooden table, and a cross on the wall. There are two chairs. There are many old prayer books on a single shelf.
setting.background: This small office is where the bishop tends to people who needs help. They come and he offers them guidance. He prays for their souls.

speech: The priest tells me that you wish to seek refuge here, is that true?
For a short time if it can be offered.
It is a difficult process, what is the reason that you require refuge.
I just left the kingdom of Genericose and they have threatened me with tar and feathering.
Genericose? They are usually a reasonable people. What did you do that upset them so much?
I don't know, you kiss one princess and they all turn on you.
Oh! You kissed Princess Penelope? For that I cannot blame you. But if we accept you here, the King of Genericose will be very upset with us.
I understand the danger to you.  But please hide me.
We have our own princess, and though she is no beauty, how can we be assured that you will not try the same things with her?
It isn't how it seems.  I am her fiancee.  On my travel to No-wheresburg I met her and we fell in love.  Obviously no one can know.
Are you saying that our princess is not good enough for you? Are you calling her ugly? Perhaps the refuge you need is in our dungeon!

No, please.  I have not met your hideous princess....I mean beautiful souled princess.  I mean....I'm sure she has a good personality right.  But I am pledged to be married.  Otherwise...I would be all over it.
Relax. I was just testing you. I will tell the priest to offer you refuge here in his office. Tomorrow we will talk about how we may be able to help you further.
Thank you so much.  I thought you might be the princess for a second with a fake beard on.  I really don't want to be offensive.

agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.

setting.name: Grand Dancing Hall
setting.description: The grand dancing hall is the most ornate location in the entire castle! Velvet seats run along the side of the room. There are huge chandeliers with hundreds of candles all along the ceiling. There are colorful paintings on every wall that show the different kings and their families.
setting.background: The dancing room is used for happy and joyous occasions. The king had his wedding in he room, and the festivities lasted for twelve days! Every week, there are different parties celebrating every holiday, wedding and just because. The people wear gorgeous gowns and finery and dance to a huge band.

speech: Is the jester getting ready for a party?
I believe he is. I always enjoy his entertainment. Do you like him, too?
I think everyone finds him hilarious! If he wasn't I'm sure he would not be employed, maybe even lose his head.
Fair point! What brings you here on this fine day?
Well I was just coming in to view the paintings and to my surprise there is going to be a party. So it is with good luck that I came today. What is going on with your day?
I'm here to protect the royals in the event of a disaster. I love working here with all of the beautiful chandeliers and candles!
I can understand that! it is quite beautiful!
Are you attending the party?
I would love to join in the celebration. Is everyone invited?
I'm not sure. I haven't received any details from the king, but the chef told me he is preparing for over 500 people!
That is quite a lot of people.... There are about that many people in the village and I live there
Then maybe he is throwing a surprise party for the whole villlage. The rumor is that he has an annoucement related to the princess, but I don't know that to be true.
Oh that is great!  Can't wait to find out what it would be. What do think it could be?
She's been talking quite a bit with someone from another kingdom. Do you thinkit could be an engagement announcement?

agent_personas: I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.
I am a quick tempered person. I get angry over the smallest things. I like adventure and like to travel. I like living in the kingdom.

setting.name: Summit
setting.description: The summit of the mountain is like no other place. It is the highest point in the entire town. The view showcases the entire kingdom, and one can see for miles all around. It is cool and fragrant and breathtaking.
setting.background: People love to scale the mountain to get to the summit. The king often does this, and says he is truly ruling from the top of the world. People have been known to wed at the peak. It is a popular place to bring children to show them the extent of the realm.

speech: Oh..it is so beautiful up here!
Child what are you doing by yourself! Where are your parents! This is not a safe place for you to be without supervision!
I'm not alone...my groom is right over there...I am a princess...
Well, I hope that is true! It is a magnificent site to behold up here
My pony brought me up here and I found this funny rock.
That is no rock, child. It is a crystal ball.
I thought it was a rock..I rubbed it and it was glowing...what is a c..r..y..stal ball?
It has magical powers for some to see into other places. Only a true soothsayer can see into a crystal ball
Too many big words for me...I think my father...the King...would be one of those sooth..things...
He can see into the crystal ball? He can see other places?
Don't know...just want to play up here and collect more rocks...
Yes, child? Do you want to keep the crystal ball? Or try to return it back to its rightful owner?
You can have it...you seem nice and it is shiny...I the princess...ummm...gift it to you.
Why thank you your highness! I appreciate that. I will make sure it gets back to whomever it belongs to

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.
I am one of the poorer citizens of the empire.  On some days I can't eat more than a morsel of bread.  The king's men are mean to me.  They eat lavish foods and laugh at me.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Can I offer you some food citizens?
Please.  We are so hungry.  The king's men have stolen all we have.
I have nothing with me, but you all should come over for dinner at the family farm tonight. We have some items ready for harvest that you can choose to take home.
You are too generous.  How do you have so much bounty under this regime?
Well, I do good and people do good to me. I try to follow the good Lord as well.
It has worked well for you.  Do you have a church we can attend to be with more people like you?
Of course! The town church where the temple is! The priest is always very helpful in speaking truth.
Do the king's men leave the members alone?
Indeed they do unless a crime has been committed.
Good folks like you could never commit a crime, surely.
I have never committed a crime, no... no I have not. I have never seen reason to commit a crime. I have been blessed with family and fertile land.
You are far more blessed than I then.  My land and family have both been taken by the king and his men.
How about you come work for me? I could use some help on the farm.
Oh how kind you are.  I have truly been blessed this day to have met you.

agent_personas: We are an elite group that is tasked with providing fire-based support in battle. Our specialty lies in the use of the flame, which we wield with great efficiency. Pyromaniacs they may call us, but it is just our sworn duty to the crown to us.
I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: Made from wood and stone, the tavern smells of food and ale. A flame is burning in the fireplace and candles light up tables throughout the room.
setting.background: This is the most lively place in town where locals and travelers drink and share stories! The bar keep is friendly and has lots of information about the town and surrounding areas.

not really cause they be foolish to do so, let me buy you a beer

yes I can understand that, you should try and travel the same time has the king's guard alot safer
Oh you are smart. We have a group of mercenaries but I do question their loyalty at times.
yea they can be a tricky sort
I keep this if we are attacked.

agent_personas: I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.
I am funny. I like to entertain people. I work in a royal court.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall is a grandiose room with enormously tall ceilings. Their is one long wooden dining table, with two huge chairs on each end, and normal benches on the sides. The walls of the room are decorated with huge elegant tapestries depicting memories and moments of the kingdom. Their is a stage for performers, and there are many windows that offer spectacular views of the beautiful castle grounds.
setting.background: The dining hall has been the king's family's favorite room for generations. Many holidays, occasions and parties were held there.

speech: Tell me jester, what are you doing?
I am juggling, what does it look like I am doing? Are you not entertained?
No, now do something different. That is boring.
Now I'm juggling while dancing, surely you must find this entertaining?
haha no but taking your ball is.
Fine, let me see you try to juggle the ball if you think you are so clever. It is not as easy as I make it look.
You are right, this is hard.
I'm just glad you didn't try to juggle my crystal ball. It would have shattered.
Here try whipping that can over ther, It's hard.
Hey that was kind of fun. I wonder if I should incorporate the whip into my show. I'm in need of new material, recently people seem to be less amused by my juggling.
Yes it is an old trick. You should converse with other jesters to find new material.
What if I was to start juggling lighted candles. A little bit of fire might make it more exciting, perhaps?
Why yes that is brilliant.
Whew, that is a relief. The king had threatened to send me back to the potato fields if I did not improve my act. I would welcome any other suggestions you may have for me.

agents: cowardly guard nervously awaiting an attack
agent_personas: As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.
I'm afraid they are coming up the stairs. Why couldn't they go the other way?!? I can't fight! I'm going to run!

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

agent_personas: We are the benevolent Founders of GloopdeGloo. Confident in our success, we need no outside advice, but we really can't do anything at all for ourselves. We require many acolytes to do our bidding, insufferable incompetents that we are!
We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.

setting.name: Beside church pews
setting.description: The church pews fill the church as far as the eye can see. They are made of wood, harvested from ancient trees long ago. They gleam with the look of tender love and care, since they are polished after each ceremony.
setting.background: The church pews were built centuries ago by the first founders of GloopdeGloo. The founders wanted their followers to sit in something simple, but somewhat ornate. The pews are not comfortable by any means, but they are nice to look at. Numerous butts fill the pews every Sunday for the weekly ceremony.

speech: Hello follower, I'm glad you're here.  I have a wonderful service for you to carry out for me.
Yes, of course. I hope this please our Knights too

Ah, perfect.  You already have the wood now.  I know you are a good carver and I need you to carve the wood into a cross.  Yes...we want to support our Knights as well!  They can pray under this when they come to church.
Praised be them, they bring the light and the wisdom of our Lord wherever they may roam. And yes, a cross. Worthy of His name!
Well spoken!  How long do you think it will take to carve the cross?
A week's worth, sire. I will give it all my attention and my best. Unless the Knights require me this week, of course.
Wonderful!  That's much sooner than I thought which is good because I need it ready for the festivities when the Royal Bishop comes in a fortnight.  You are a wonder!
Everything for the Lord! Have you any news from the Logan's?
No, unfortunately...I'm worried about what their silence could mean, but I'm trying to not worry about it.  Tell me, do you have any other friends that build furniture that are followers as well?

I have heard nothing else since the King sent for them. I sense the Knights know something that they are not telling me and I dare not offend them.... yes Douglas is not bad with tools but he does not have the belief I do in our Lord. Not the same conviction to drive him.
Do you think something could have happened to them?  Oh no...I will inquire.  Oh, too bad.  I was hoping someone could make us a massively long table for the welcoming party of the Royal Bishop.

I will speak only of this in that matter, rumours be they had a spy amongst them.. someone wanted to know something about them bad enough to go to that trouble. Who knows what they could have found.. or wanted to find.
Take heart.  These things come to light eventually and I will make inquiries and let you know.  You just continue your dedicated work and be blessed!
Thank you, I do appreciate it.

agents: old man with a fishing rod
agent_personas: I am a child who is an expert on boats. I am trusted to know what I am doing. My father has punished me for not doing things right.

I am an old man with a fishing rod who you might see, if you look carefully, fishing in the king's river. What I do is called poaching. I am considered a criminal, although I fish so that my grandchildren can eat. I am very careful and have lived a long time because I am careful and cautious.

setting.name: Boathouse
setting.description: The boathouse is a very small building with peeling paint. It is made out of wood, with one half planted in the water on stilts. Inside, there are boats floating in the water. There are hinged doors which can be opened to allow boats to come in and out. There are some ropes and other tools a boater may need stored in the boathouse.
setting.background: The boathouse was built on the small lake when the king found it while exploring as a child. His father was proud of his adventurous son's discovery and built the boathouse as a reward. The boy spent many days in there, reading or relaxing, or boating on the lake.
