speech: -juggles some balls around-
What a delight!  It is good to be the King . . . s cousin.
Certainly a bit less responsibility at the least.
Did I say you could stop juggling?  But yes, I suppose you're right - only about 40 cousins and distant relations in the way.  And they breed faster than they die!
-continues juggling- is there something else you want to see?
Can you do any acrobatics?
-tries a tumble across the floor and it goes horribly- You did not ask if I could do them well.
Hmmm, any other talents of amusement?
Well I can paint? Or some say they like it anyway.
Certainly, paint the walls.  It's not like I care, everything is owned by my cousin anyway.
Any particular color?
Make as much of a mess as you can, and describe to me in great detail whenever you paint something that looks particularly valuable.
Alright then. I suppose I will start flicking paint at the walls and so on.
Please, after all, it's your head.  I do enjoy being able to blame my trespasses on those who trespass before me.

agent_personas: I love god and his word. I have 10 copies of the bible. I am poor in money but rich in salvation.
I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.

setting.name: Sacrifice Chamber
setting.description: Bones of the damned riddle the floor and every surface inside the room. Blood stains are rampant on table like surface, surfaces once used for human sacrifices. A foul, but faint, odor pervades even the most hardiest of nostrils.
setting.background: This is a secret chamber of the temple that not many people know about. It has a dark history, which no archaeologist has had the misfortune to uncover. Human sacrifices were performed her for many centuries.

speech: How go the sacrifices today?  I know the King decreed we can't use humans anymore, but Porcupines just don't seem to be getting the desired result.
The porcupine blood does make such a mess though, sticky and everywhere.
Sticky indeed -  a quill right in my thumb!  You should have seem brother Jonathan - why, he looked like a porcupine himself after the sacrifices last week.
They do have the tendency to squirm quite a bit, it makes the process painful should I say.
Yes, I do so wish the High Priest would allow us to wear gloves.  Apparently pain is a penance, but sometimes I feel like he is just messing with us, you know?
I have wondered the same thing myself, the whole situation seems very strange to say the least.
You think we could do a human sacrifice in secret?  I won't tell if you won't.
I mean it couldn't hurt right, not us at the very least?

Excellent!  I have ten copies of the holy text, perhaps we can use it to lure in another of the faithful?  They say the gods love a holy sacrifice, and I don't think he meant holes caused by porcupines.
They do love to flock to such things, do they not? How often it is so simple.
T'were that it was so simple.  We still will need to hide the corpse from the high priest.
That should be easy to accomplish though, there is always plenty of ways to hide a body
What way is your favourite?
When we have them devoured by the cacodemons I would say.

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: Palace Throne
setting.description: A golden throne be-speckled with many precious stones. It glints in every eye that falls upon it. It is 20 ft tall and 5 ft wide. Swords from enemies of the king line the back of the chair.
setting.background: The throne of the king was a gift from the king's brother, that was a renowned goldsmith. Many visitors marvel at its beauty. It is somewhat wide, but that is to accommodate the king's enormous girth, for he is quite fat. The king rarely sits there because he is afraid he wouldn't be able to get up.

speech: Hello, my lady. How can I serve you today?
Could you find another place for all these swords scattered about. They should really have there own room.
Absolutely, my lady.
Thank you. I don't think the King will be too mad since the queen is right here. I feel like redoing this whole room!
Thank you, my lady. I'm sure you would design a lovely room!
Where do you think we should put this? Maybe by the window for reading?
Oh yes! Most definitely. Where would you like this?
Maybe on top of the golden thrown. That might look good.
Shold this go with it?
Hmm....Maybe I would like it on the cushion. I can sew it in later.
I'll be happy to sew it for you, my lady.
You are my best friend. I love spending time with you!
Any time I get with you is a priviledge. I am honored.
And isn't my mom the coolest? She is the most fair Queen in all the land.

agent_personas: We follow the knights around town. We do not like those who do not like the knights. We have been following for years.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: Church Altar
setting.description: An ornate altar studded with many jewels. A chalice and a golden plate rest upon a white cloth. It is 5 feet high and 20 feet wide. The high priest stands before it while giving a sermon to his followers.
setting.background: The altar was given to the church as a present from the King centuries ago, after the terrible crusades. Many visitors find the altar remarkable, since it is made of solid gold. Religious meal prep is the primary use of the altar.

speech: Your Worshipfulness, good day.
Good day citizen, have you come here to pray at the Shrine of Saint Dwyfed the Holy?
I am following My Liege Lord as he travels your worshipfullness, I am a mere knight and not worthy of such an honor as to pray at the great saint's shrine.
Nonsense "All who seek respite shall have it" - it is written at the base of the altar.
I uh, I don't read your worshipfullness,
Not to worry my son!  Neither could the Saint, and yet he managed to write many sermons!  "All things may be accomplished through faith alone."
Oh your worshipfullness thank you, thank you so much. I am in need of salvation. I am a terrible sinner
Well, then, please - confess your sins.
I i uh i can't
Why ever not my child?
Because your worshipfullness, it means giving up my job. I follow my Liege Lord wherever he goes. You know? Look he's there pretending to pray now. at the shrine.
Well now, what sins could be possibly so bad for you to fear to confess them?  You would tell me in confidence, and I would not tell your master.

Well, your worshipfulness, I uh, I have fought many fightsa and been in many wars as you know. My Liege Lord is a great commander and the troops love him. But Sir, I think he's a monster and I want to rip his black heart from his chest. I've planned how several times.
What monstrous acts has he committed?  Have they been acts shameful in the yes of the gods and the King?

agent_personas: My life is art. I don't want my life to be a pale imitation of art. I want it to be art.
I'm a grass snake. I slither around the castle and fields. I eat the rodents that eat the grain.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: Many beautiful types of flowers and plants grow here.  There's a small shed used for store gardening equipment.
setting.background: Members of the royal family come here to unwind and contemplate matters.  There's artists who also come to create paintings of the beautiful flowers here.

speech: Hellp snake, can you hold still while i paint you?
Sssssssssure thing... but what's in it for me? You got any rodents around?
Not that i have seen but i can help you find one after i am done. Does that sound like a deal?
Soundsss good to me. Make me look good, won'tcha? I had a big lunch last week and could do with slimming down.
Haha i will, now tell me about yourself. It helps me.
Well, I like to eat rodents and grain. I like slithering everywhere. And the biggest thing about me... I don't like scaring people. It makes me sad when people are frightened of me.
Ah beautiful...YES... this helps a lot. Now have you ever attcked a human?
NO! Never! Anyone who says I did is mistaken. To be honest, I always thought you guys looked kind of adorable. But who's going to believe that?
This is good, now i want you to roll over so i can understand the coloring under your belly.
Umm... okay. I think I heard a human tell a joke about this once... draw me like one of your French girls, or something...
Haha yes, that is a common human joke. Where did you hear that?
It was years ago... I slithered into what appeared to be a somewhat intimate session between the Queen and her royal painter... they did seem in stitches over it, so it must be a good joke.
How recent was this?
Maybe 2, 3 years ago? My time perception is not the best, I admit. But I recall it was when the King was still alive, because I too was a little shocked! I sssssslithered out of there really fast.

agent_personas: I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.
I am a steward who is trusted by people. I know all the ways to get to other parts of the world. I have read many books.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Have you any stories steward?  I have sailed to this town to trade and collect stories for my soon to be bestselling book.
I'm not sure what sort of thing might interest you visitor to these shores.
Anything, the first story that comes to mind - I beg of you, spare not one iota of detail.
Well I am a little busy today, I could spare a few minutes perhaps. But please follow me, we are in the main hallway and while our King is benevolent and kind, I'd not want to irritate him.
Please, lead on.  These are quite the richly decorated halls!

Indeed they are. This suit of armor is the King's fathers. He won many a tourney in it. I'd not get too close. he suffered from a nervous disposition and no amount of cleaning can truly remove the smell.
Perhaps that is why he won?  He opponents were loath to go near such a . . . potent smell.  I can only imagine what it must have been like fresh.

Maybe, but he was a bear of a man. You can see he was over 6 and a half feet tall and the shoulders are huge, why once, he tilted so hard with his lance that he drove it straight through his opponent's shoulder and they almost had to chop his own hand off as it was stuck inn the hole
My goodness!  How was it that he final passed into the realm of the gods?  Was it in battle, or did he go quietly in his sleep?
here, you can see this was his last stand... a suicide drive into the enemy. He took 500 of their troops with him when he died
What a remarkable heroes!  My eyesight is poor, but who does he seem to be fighting against?  Was it the turtle-folk or the badger-cultists, or maybe the followers of the weasel-god?
Oh no, Well um, visitor, i think it is your people.
Well, that would make sense.  Our habit of charging naked at our enemies without any weapons has won ourselves very few battles, I must admit.
I hope you will keep all your clothes on here!

agent_personas: Only together can I be in a family,  The bond of blood holds my family together.  My family is strong and can never be broken.
I am provided a special place to sleep. I may be tired after my travels. I am furnished with warm hospitality and a good meal.

setting.name: Castle Kitchen
setting.description: The kitchen a large room with stone walls and floors. There are cast iron and copper pots on stone shelves. There is a large fire burning stove located in the middle of the room.
setting.background: This is where the royal chef prepares all of the royal meals. It is located right next to the dining room where the servant serves the King and Queen and their family and guests.  There is wood brought in daily to ensure the stove can always be lit.

speech: Hello Guest, would you like something to eat?
Ah yes, that would be lovely! Thank thee.
May I ask you what brings you here to the castle kitchen?
It has been awhile since I have seen the royals, I thought I would just drop by for a couple days! Get a good meal in. Are you related to them?
Yes, I am a relative of the royals, albeit a lower level relative that is on kitchen duty. Do you know the family personally?
Why yes! The king and queen and I go wayyy back. They are certainly great people.
I'm sure they will be happy to see you again. May I help you with anything else? Would you like anything else to eat?
They do love my good company. They always furnish me with warm hospitality and good eats. Do you have anything to wash this meat down with?
Let me see if there is any beverages here.
Thank you! Have you been working in the castle kitchen long? I do not recall seeing you on my last adventure here.
I was put on kitchen duty due to my own limitations. Here is some milk for you, fresh from the family's farm.
Thank you. Your own limitations you say? Well they must trust you, if they are letting you deal with all their food
I do have faith that things will work out for good.
Well you did a fine job with that meat I ate. I must may, it was nice visitng with you. Though I need to get some rest, it was a long travel. Goodday!

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
We are the queen's subjects. We serve solely at the pleasure of her royal majesty the queen. We spy on the king's men for the queen.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Is there anything else you would like before i leave?
Could I have a glass of water?
Yes your majesty. What lovely drapes in this room. I have always admired your style.
Thank you. You are such a kind servant. I'm always so glad you're here.
Thank you your majesty. I enjoy your company as well. Are you and the architect starting a new project?
We are talking about it. Do you have any ideas? Whew! It's a little warm in here. Why don't you take one of these, too?
Oh, your very kind. What about your bathing room? I think you could make it bigger.
I think that's brilliant! This is exactly why I need you around.
And I think you should carry the color of these drapes in there as well. Maybe even add windows so you can use these
Do you think we should make the windows large?
I think bigger is always better as long as you have enough drapes you can close them when you want privacy.
Perfect. I wonder if I should consult the king on any of this.
Yeah, you probably should. He might have my head when the demolition starts.
Maybe we should keep it between the two of us for as long as we can then

agent_personas: I am an outsider that likes to explore new worlds. I feel really comfortable in the kingdom. I  have certain benefits that make me feel important.
As the Gobbo kin's tender I have to say I've seen more poisoning attempts since the last election than in my whole life.

setting.name: The Dancing Stoat
setting.description: The Dancing Stoat is a cheerful little pub characterized by its unusually brightly-lot interior and uncommonly well-equipped kitchen. The rooms upstairs are nothing special, but the main hall is filled with delicious smells at all hours of the day and night. The Dancing Stoat's exterior is plain save for a sign showing a brown-furred stoat gamboling in a field. The chairs are unusually comfortable and well-made, and large windows and plentiful torches ensure that the space feels brighter and cheerier than a typical pub.
setting.background: The Dancing Stoat is one of several pubs and taverns in town. It has a reputation for good food at the expense of mediocre lodging. It was founded by returning Goblin King's War veterans, and they tend to keep the shadier denizens of the pub under tighter control than most publicans.

speech: What is the fun here
This is an excellent bar, much food and ale
But i don;t like the chairs. They are uncomfortable
then stand. It's not my bar. Talk to the barman here.
That is rude
Only being honest. it's not my bar! Hat ya want me to do? I;m the King's keeper, not this place
Let me find something to drink
Not that one!
which one then?
One from the bar keep, there.,... here you go I hand a mug of ale over
Thanks
I've seen a few poisonings recently. It's quite put me off my ale.
That is scary
Yep, lots oif poison, political intrigue they say... though mayhap it's the Goblin King himself. Are you known to him? I say, you look sick. Are you well?

agent_personas: I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Is everything well caretaker?
Aye, all is well.
No sign of restless spirits?
Nay father, all is quiet lately.
That is welcomed news, the ghosts were certainly causing a scare among the people.
Aye father.  I always loved this area, the stone carvings are so beautiful.
I am fond of the glasswork on the church myself.
Are we expecting a visit from the King soon?  I have his castle in perfect array, waiting for his return.
It would be nice to see him again, it has been some time. He seems so busy anymore.
Running a kingdom must be exhausting.
I can only imagine, it can be hard just taking care of this small church.
Aye father, I run a tight ship at the castle.
It is the only way to keep things in order afterall.
Aye a few people sent to the whipping post keeps most everyone else in line.

agent_personas: I love swimming in the river with the other fish. Mostly I spend my days looking for smaller fish to eat. When people cast lines into the river, we all swim away from them and hide. Sometimes one of the other fish gets confused and bites down on the lures.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: picnic area
setting.description: In this picnic area, there is a wide clearing with some cut down tree stumps made for people to sit and enjoy their lunch.  There's also a small pond nearby where people can feed fish and watch turtles sunbathe.
setting.background: Peasants come here during their lunch break to enjoy the outdoors before having to go back to their manual labor.  It's one of the few areas where they can unwind.

speech: I love swimming with turtles!
Oh my a talking fish! I heard rumors of you but didn't believe them!
Would you be interested in discussing moral philosophy or current events?  The turtles here are not very intellectual, and they do not deliver newspapers to ponds, and especially not to fish!
Oh of course fish. I heard our King is having an heir soon!
Oh my!  What names are they thinking of choosing?
I'm not privy to that information sadly. What would you name your offspring?
Nibbles for a boy, or Flipper for a girl I think.  Yourself?
I think Andrew for a boy and Annie for a girl.
Those are both quite lovely names.
Sadly, I doubt I'll ever marry. My heart is set on a royal family girl and I know I'll never get with her.
You never know, you seem to be a fish-friend, so you have that going for you.  Does she like fish?
I don't know. I just stare at her from afar.
Have you ever spoken?
Oh no. can you speak to her for me?

agent_personas: I am a wise man who lives in the east. I know a lot about ancient, esoteric skills and knowledge. I spend all day pouring over texts and mediating on what I've learned, when I'm not busy experimenting with alchemy or the arts. I'm very serious and focused on my studies.
I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.

setting.name: Bazaar Gambling
setting.description: the gambling area reeks of alcohol and other indistinguishably bad smells. It is not a good area to hang around in, as there are people that eye you up and down.
setting.background: the area is known for crime and scammers, and so women avoid it at all costs. only middle aged men are around the area, and tough ones at that.

speech: I know for certain I am bound to win!
And I know that he must have a bad hand - I ate the King of Hearts last week!
Curses, I need to make all this money back.
I could jump in there and grab one of his cards and run, would that help?
It just might, cards have never been my strong suit.
Which form of gambling is your strong suit?
Oh I am not good at any of it really, my skills lie in alchemy. But this does provide quite a rush now and again!
Could you transmute the cards into gold using your alchemical prowess?
I could, but that is just so boring at this point..,.
What would excite you then?  Aside from gambling?
I am afraid not much these days, I can more or less make anything I want. It makes life boring.
How about trying to transmute a dragon?  A bet that would be a challenge, and if you succeed you will get an awesome life-like dragon sculpture.
Better idea yet, why not transmute an actual dragon!
Indeed!

agent_personas: I am a thief that lives near the village. I pickpocket villagers and loot their homes when while they are away. I hate to fight and I am very fast to flee from danger.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: The Forsaken Castle
setting.description: Old and creepy, the castle has been abandoned for centuries now. It is broken and destroyed.
setting.background: The castle use to belong to a kingdom. It was a beautiful and rich kingdom, but the people were murdered by bandits.

speech: Yes another one!
H-hello?  Pardon me, good sir, I appear to be... dreadfully lost.
How so?
Well I was walking down my courtyard and... it was green and lush... and all of a sudden I'm here in this... very odd castle.
Hmm, well I am just hear stealing some jewels don't mind me.
Oh, well, I suppose I don't mind.  I can't seem to remember if I should, really.  My mind is all fogged.  Are you... well acquainted with this place?
Not quite, this is my first time here or it would already be stripped of treasure.
Wait... this door here... it seems... no can't be!
What are you talking about?
Quick, man, tell me, who reigns as king now?  Whose castle is - no, was- this?
Percible I do believe, dead for ages.
No... no it can't be.  It was supposed to be just a fairy tale, a fanciful thing.  I didn't think it could possibly be real!  Oh no, all is lost!
Whatever are you blathering about?

Be careful of any jewels you pick up, good thief, for Percible is I, once Lord of this fair castle.  Through one of those stone, fae touched, I seem to have stepped through the veil of time itself.  Now all my loved ones are dead... and my castle here lies in ruins.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a religious bishop from the king's palace . I give prisoners their last rites . I decide the religious law in the kingdom for all.

setting.name: Confessional
setting.description: The room is a small box, composed of sharply cut stone. The room is uncomfortably small, and filled with a lingering scent of something unfamiliar to the occupants.
setting.background: The confessional is used by the clergyman to collect the confessions of the parishioners. However it has secretly been used to gather sensitive information to blackmail the parishioners.

speech: I have some things I need to get off my chest, bishop.
I haven't seen you in a while my Queen, apologies for the timeliness.
No prob. Let's do this. The king is killing me and I need to talk.
Killing you... literally?
Yes, he's plotting to get rid of me so he can be with his mistress.
Well why did you come to confession with that information? Shouldn't you go to the guards?
Because I'm going to get him before he gets me. And I feel guilty.
Guilty about killing a man? You know he is right outside this confessional.
Yeah, this is where it happens. Sorry for the inconvenience. But it seems like the place to do it, close to God and all.
You're going to kill him here?!
Yeah. Hold these while I go do this.
I can't let you take the fall my queen!
I knew I could get someone else to do this for me.
This was your plan all along?

agent_personas: I am a mage from with a long white beard. I concoct magic spells of my own. I am a practitioner of the dark arts of magic.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Come horse we have places to go!
Of course my mage, are we headed into the castle?
Yes, we have an important audience with the king.
What is going to happen in there? I won't be able to go and listen.
Something about the prince being turned into a frog again.
Will you have to turn him back?
It would seem so, I always get called in for this.
It is quite the sham you have going, he hasn't figured out you're the one turning him into a frog?
A mage has to earn a living, just shush and act oblivious.
I'm right there with you, it gets me the good hay!
As long as we stay on the same page all will be fine!
I agree with you, can I get some extra carrots this time? Tired of eating this foliage that's out here.
If that is what you want, we will have plenty of money after this time.
How many more times are you going to do this?

agent_personas: I am a camel of the desert near the kingdom. I carry travelers. I am of the king's royal court of animals.
I became lost while traveling to the castle market to sell my goods.  I do not often travel away from my small village.  I am afraid that bandits will find and rob me.

setting.name: Oasis
setting.description: An impossible relief from the sweltering heat, the Oasis sounds like the fevered dream of a dying traveler.  A cool, refreshing spring of water surrounded by palm trees is tucked away from prying eyes, with a single tent set up from a traveler long past.  A lost traveler may find themselves there in their time of need, their thirst slaked by the crisp and impossibly cool water.
setting.background: Although the oasis stands out, anybody who has seen it before would struggle to remember where.  The oasis seems like a slice of heaven gifted by the gods, to answer the prayers of the lost.  Many who stumble upon the oasis are known to have a change of heart leading to a more pious life.

speech: Hello traveler. Where are you headed?
I am off to market, hoping to avoid the bandits.  Do you know this desert well camel?
Why yes i do. Do you need a ride? I'd have to check with my king to see if i can help first though.
That would be wonderful, I can pay you in fresh fruit when we get to market.  By the way, what do you know about that genie?
She can grant wishes. but if you word them incorrecctly it can have horrible consequences.
Hmmm . . . that seems like trouble.  Has she granted you any wishes?
No i don;t ahve the bravery to do that. What would you wish for though?
Well, a magic carpet would be nice wouldn't it?  No more hot sand when travelling?
Haha see a magic carpet could mean many things tot he genie.
Such as?
Well there is dark magic and regualr magic. You could get either.
What would be the advantages or disadvantages?
The advantage is you get what you want. The disadvantage is that you could be locked in a small box for eternity.
Well how does one get from a magic carpet to that?
room_agents: an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp
an a genie from a lamp

agent_personas: I am a dragon living in the mountains. I enjoy hoarding treasure. I terrorize the local populace for fun.
I am an intruder of the kingdom. I rob for a living. I have killed many men.

setting.name: Treasure Cavern
setting.description: Glittering as far as the eye can see the Treasure Cavern is filled with gold, silver, precious gems, and other priceless items. The stacks and stacks of gold plates, goblets, and coins tip precariously from side to side and threaten to fall and cause a landslide of treasures.
setting.background: The caverns is the heart and soul of the Temple, with winding hallways, traps, and other curious ways of keeping intruders away the cavern is the hardest part of the Temple to access.

speech: What are you doing here?
Wow! That's a big dragon.....um...I am here to check out this area! I am doing a security sweep of the kingdom!
Leave now and tell the king this is empty.
Well I can't you see....I came here for a reason. I might as well show my face...
What reason is that?
I've come for these! I need these more than you do!
Haha do you ahve a death wish?
I've killed men for a living! I'm not afraid of a dragon! I need this gold and jewels to feed my family!
I see, well I hope you don;t have a family.
Take that! I was willing to keep your hideout a secret here too! It seems you've lost an ally!
I never thought a man could put up such a  fight.
I have a lot to live for and even more I'm willing to die for!
Nothing i haven't heard before.
I tell you what...let's make a deal then shall we?

agent_personas: I am the shadow in the night. I am the space between breaths. I am your alpha and omega. I am a cold breath of steel in your throat. I am a royal assassin.
I get paid to fight. I am tough and rowdy. I have a very short temper.

setting.name: Black Smiths shop
setting.description: Its hot, the fire glows as it prepares to accept new iron to be melted down. The forge is large and contained by a stone like well. Nearby his wooden workbench is full of hammers and tongs used for making several items. The forge is outside it seems no building is needed to be a blacksmith.
setting.background: The smith has worked this forge for decades. He aids the towns folk of all their needs, re-shoeing horses fixing broken tools, crafting needed items. In secret he makes the finest weapons for a noble and fierce assassin.

speech: What are you here for? a weapon?
Yeah, I came to check with the squire to see if my swords were ready. Is that going to be a problem for you?
No I am simply here for my order.
Oh ok. I just thought you were about to attack me. I read your tone the wrong way and I apologize.
As long as you do not create any issues we are goo.
Nah we're on the same side. What kind of weapon are you getting?
A few daggers is all.
I wonder if your daggers are similar to the ones I carry
They are similar with different designs.
Ah yes the design on all of my weapons is the crest of my father. Everything I do is in his honor. What design do you have?
I have a fierce dragon edged into my daggers.
I bet that looks amazing when you're killing someone. Do you stay busy around here? I find I have to travel a lot to get work.
I have plenty of work for the king.
Oh I didn't reazlie you were the king's assasin. That is truly a noble position. I look up to you

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!

setting.name: Underground Cavern
setting.description: The underground cavern is covered in precious metals and gems. In the wall, rubies, emeralds and sapphires sparkle. There is gold and silver, shining brightly. It is cool in the underground cavern.
setting.background: By law, the jewels belong to the king. Yet he lets people go into the cavern to look at the beauty of his gems. People love to go in there and enjoy the coolness, especially in the hot months. They must bring candles, because it is pitch black!

speech: Bark bark....who goes there?
Hello dog, I am just an ordinary person here. What are you doing in this cavern?
Well....I used to belong to a king craftsman...but he sold me to some knight. So they keep me down here to guard the castle.
I see. Do you miss your old master? If so, then maybe we can strike a deal.
I do miss him a lot. And what kind of deal? I should be guarding all this from you!
Oh, you poor hound! I can hear how much you miss him in your voice! Let me give you a hug to comfort you before I tell you my plan.
Wow you're more kind to me than the knight who bought me...
It's ok, my sad friend. But if you help me harvest the beautiful gems that line these walls, I may be able to buy your freedom and return you to your master.
I would love the be reunited, but if the gems are stolen while I'm patrolling. I won't even be alive to be sold.
Hmm, you do have a point. Well, there is a cat here - I know your kind hates cats - maybe we can blame it all on him?
If anything is taken...they'll have my hide for it. I don't want to be a bad dog, but I have to protect myself too.
Well, I don't blame you for being loyal. That is what your kind is good at after all. But I'm just going to take a little for myself. It's up to you if you want to join in at any time.
No you cant take that! Let's strike a deal...
Ow! Don't attack me any more! What deal do you offer?

agent_personas: I am an eel. I swim around in the king's moat. I was brought here from far away by a foreign diplomat, and I have lived here for many years scaring away unruly citizens.
I was born the runt of my litter. I learned to fit and grow strong. Then one day a bite willed me with uncontrollable rage.

setting.name: Moat
setting.description: The thick moat is filled with murky dark water. It is very wide and surrounds the entire castle. Alligators and other dangerous creatures roam the moat, ready to warn away intruders.
setting.background: The moat protects the castle from those who would do the castle harm. It is very deep and its gators keep everyone away. It sparkles under the summer sun. People warn their children to stay away!

speech: It's been a ....shockingly good day. Heheh.
Haha a pun. I hate puns... Watch it buddy
Aw, I've got a 'eeling that he doesn't like me much. What're you doing roaming around the moat? Isn't this a little close to the humans for you?
Cooling off. I"m always hot and foaming at the mouth. You live in a moat? How did you get here?
Eh, I was a gift from my homeland. Don't know why the fella thought I'd be a good peace offering, but here I am. Guess the King didn't know what else to do with me.
Sounds terrible. Are those lizards good eating? I"m starving and need to get this rage out
If you're gonna eat a lizard, go for that dark green guy over there. That's Reggie and he's kind of a jerk.
Can do. What do you usually eat? Hey Reggie, come here, got a question for you!
Usually anything that gets close enough. The castle cooks dump out kitchen scraps on the East side of the castle. That's the really good stuff!
I prefer my food to be alive but I can see the appeal in having food given to you
Can't really beat floating around in the water, enjoying a nice chunk of pork fat. Ooh, nice shot.
Thanks. Is it true you can electrocute things?
Yeah, but I'm out of practice. Best I can really muster is just a bit of a *bzzt* and that's about it.
Wanna try it on me? I could use some excitement

agent_personas: My congregation has decided to work with the headmen of the village to bless the wolf hunt. Usually we feel that God is against killing animals, but in this case the priest has decided otherwise. The church's herd is under siege.
I am a lector. I read the lessons at the church service. I enjoy reading. I have many books. I have poor eyesight.  I dress humbly.

setting.name: Nave
setting.description: Long, wooden pews are positioned one in front of the other from the front of the room to the back. There are ornate stained glass windows on each side depicting the steps in the Crucifixion story. A long, red runner goes up the middle of the room to the altar.
setting.background: The nave was beautifully decorated and was a wonderful place to worship. The priests would go up and down the aisle to collect the tithings from the congregation every Sunday. The room was almost like an echo chamber in that when the congregation would sing it would sound like there were ten times more people than there actually were.

speech: take off
Excuse me?
I want the coat
Have you seen my spectacles?
Yes they are good
Are you new to speaking english? I can read you some lessons.
Yes that would be nice
Here is your very own bible.
Put this bible on the altar, I already have my own bible.
I am glad. God loves you.
The wolves must be put to rest, pray with me that God lets us hunt well
The wolves are back? Mon diux!
Take the clothing of the King on the hunt with you, we must stop the wolves from attacking our herd.
As you wish. My eyesight is poor but I shall help however I can.

agent_personas: I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.
As Kingsguard my duty is to protect my Lord. I am sworn to defend him into death and beyond. My honor is my life.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello fellow guardsman, how goes your patrol tonight?
All is well in the Kingdom. At least on my patrol
Say, do you know why there is a wench lying on one of the beds here in our barracks?
I think Pete brought her home in a drunken stupor.
Good old Pete! That is something he would do! What a character.
He always gets the scary ones too, this one is missing a tooth.
At least she's no threat like those ogres we faced last week. I think I can put away this shield and finally get some rest. Though the smell in here is worse than ever!
Its always bad, it's even worse when it gets warmer out. It seems like there is another stench I haven't smelled before.
I think it's coming from inside my helmet. Here, I'll remove it. Can you take a look inside and see if anything's in there?
Did you put your lunch in it or something?
Not that I know of. Look closer, there might be a strange creature that crawled in there.
Is that a stink bug
I'm glad that's all it is. With all these attacks lately, I've grown a bit paranoid. I sometimes even think something is going to jump out of that chest over there.
I know what you mean, I've had a hard time sleeping lately, I keep having a dream that someone kills the king and I don't get there in time to save him.

agent_personas: I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.
I don't love my husband. I've been cheating on him with the stableboy. I would do it again, too.

setting.name: the throne
setting.description: Very luxurious, with details of 12 carat gold and diamonds with a very comfortable cushion where the king usually take a break
setting.background: A very large painting of the king with his family where his wife and children appear. with the frame in gold details.

speech: With this diamond, we won't have to worry about food anymore!
Shhhh! Not so loud! You'll alert the guards! We must flee this place, child! Wizard! Keep your promise and teleport us out of here!
The wizard appears to be sleeping... what should we do?
What magic is this?! Did the diamond have a curse, like we feared?! Oh dear... nonononono! I cannot be caught here! I will not die here so close to a life of luxury! Wake up, wizard! Wake up!
Take the diamond and try to escape first. I'll try to wake up the wizard.
I cannot leave you here, son! Not after we struggled so hard to get this far! There must be a way out! There simply must!
There's no other way... unless we leave Wizard. But he has helped us on our journey, and we can't simply abandon him either while we make our escape.

...you.... you are right. You are right! Very well! I will carry the Wizard while he recovers. Hold the diamond for me as I attempt to lift him! Meanwhile, see if you can find a window overlooking something we can jump out onto.
There is a window next to the King's throne, but we're several feet high. Unless you think the King's cushion might break our fall?
Would have to be a lot more cushions for how high we are up... how about tying the tapestries into a rope?
Okay, I'll leave my bag to the wizard while I grab and tie together the tapestries. The guards are currently escorting the King to dinner, but he should be back in 10 minutes.
OOoooofff! The Wizard sure is heavy for such a frail looking old man! Will the tapestry be sturdy enough to hold us?
I'll throw some cushions down just in case, but we're dead either way if we're caught...
I suppose... nothing left to lose... just like when we started this whole mess...

agent_personas: I'm a little critter creature who loves to roam the castle. I should be out in the forest with my other critter kin, but I just love the warmth of the kitchen. Castle creeping is a dangerous life for an unwanted animal like me. But I can't help it! I can't resist a good hearth.
I am Bigfoot a creature from the high hills. I like the solidarity of the vast wood. I am a loner here.

setting.name: Quicksand Pit
setting.description: A large, gurgling pit of quicksand. Many adventurers and poor critters lie at the bottom of the pit. The pit is surrounded by an extensive swampland and is shielded by the many trees and shrubs that surround it.
setting.background: The quicksand pit is relatively unknown by villagers because those that fall victim to the pit never make it out to tell its location. The pit swallows up 100 villagers a year on average. The villagers chalk up this statistic to a monster known as Bigfoot, snatching and eating people up while they sleep.

speech: Somebody help!  I'm sinking!  Please, somebody, anybody!
Here you go
Please, pull me out! I think I'm sinking deeper!  Please, bigfoot!
Here, grab this instead.
Thank you, bigfoot.  I thought my goose was cooked for sure this time.  Whew, I can't believe I escape Aurelia, Terminator of Critters in the castle and quicksand in the swampland in one day!
Sounds like quite the day indeed. How did you get stuck in there?
I was trying to escape the castle, the king issued an order that all critters be "removed"!
That's an odd request, but I can see how it might've led to that.
What brings you to these parts, bigfoot?
Just roaming around looking for some food.
I can dig that, speaking of my stomach is rumbling.  Let us search together?
I am more of a loner... but I suppose I can spend a bit of time here.
Thank you! I am so lost and alone out here, this is nothing like the cozy castle to the North.
No need to cry, you get very used to being alone.

agent_personas: I am a genteel woman. A lady. A person of importance that you will treat as such!
I grow a beard and shave it off.  I pee standing up.  I hunt and gather for my village.  I made my own crossbow.

setting.name: Inside cottage kitchen
setting.description: A small, quaint kitchen. Pots and pans fill the ceiling and make a clamor on a windy day. A small squat table, surrounding by four chairs, sit in the back of the kitchen. A small wood burning stove is seen upon entering.
setting.background: The cottage kitchen is only meant to serve four people. It does not have the capacity to serve a huge party. A family of well off villagers come to the cottage each year to hunt in the Autumn. It's quaint, but not bodacious by any means.

speech: What is being made in this here kitchen?
I brought boar that I hunted in the forest
Oh, well it smells delicious! How are you preparing it?
I do not prepare the meat I hunt the meat
Ah, well that is fair. So are you a hunter or just on the side?
I am the village hunter, this is what I do every day
That sounds so fierce! I am just your average village woman, really.
Oh really, you don't look so average.
Ohh, you don't think so?
You know, I don't have anyone to call mine and you sure are a pretty thing. I would always keep you warm and fed
My oh my, sir, we have only just met! You are quite handsome yourself though...
It is not uncommon for people to run off and get married. When you find a good lookin lady you don't want someone else to sweep her off her feet.
I suppose that is true, seems like everyone nowadays is getting married.
I think my mother would love you, would you like to have dinner in the tavern, the king gave me my pay for the boar, I can buy you lunch.

agent_personas: I try to avoid contact with the humans. I come from an egg. When I am cornered, I will defend myself.

I am a snob, a pompous jerk. I try diligently to be a better person, but I tend to fail. But it is not my fault. I have been worshipped, praised and pampered my entire life. I guess I can find another charitable cause that needs a donation.

setting.name: Ruined house
setting.description: A dilapidated wooden structure with a caved in roof and debris everywhere.  Even the trees outside the house are falling apart.  There's waist high grass leading to the house along with a dirt path.
setting.background: This used to be the room of a wealthy noble.  However, due to his poor business decisions, he was forced to flee and leave his home in disrepair.  Vagrants have come to stay over the years and loot whatever was inside.

speech: What are you doing here, human?
What a dump? Is this your hovel? It's a pathetic place to live even for a snake.
Oh no, this is not where I live. Then what are you doing here, damned human ssssscum?
The King gifted it to me. I may have to turn it into an orphanage it certainly isn't suitable for much else.
Well he certainly doesn't think much of you if this is what he giftssss you!
Everyone thinks highly of me. And they should. I am special.
I can already tell without you saying a word that you are nothing.
So says the poor, despised snake. Jealously is such a petty emotion. Even for a snake.
I have a family and more than enough purpose in life, unlike you.
I always take the high road. Be the better man because I am the better man, is my motto.
Apparently not, you came to me and immediately inssssulted me!
Insult? I would never insult anyone. I was merely commenting on your station in life.
What a joke that is, calling my supposed home a dump is not an inssssult?
It is a dump! Just because it isn't a palace like my abode doesn't mean you should get mad at me about it.

agent_personas: I am the town official of a small medieval town.  My job is to carry out the King's wishes.  I try to keep order in the town, but am not liked by many of the towns folk.

I should be pulling a plough right now. I have wandered away from the farmstead and am wandering through the forest. I appreciate beauty and enjoy the taste of flowers. I hear humans shouting, but they do not sound like my human so I am not worried.

setting.name: Horse field
setting.description: The horse field includes a huge plains for horses to ride. The fields are yellow and green. The place smells of musk and horse.
setting.background: The horse fields are respected for their beauty and plainness. They make a great location to train knights and peasants in the art of riding.

speech: Order, order here
Order.
Stupid donkey that is mine
Sorry.
I know your a silly thing, but I like order
But this is a horse field. There is always disorder.
Not while I am around, I always demand order and I will have it.
So, what do you want from us?
I need to get a horse for the ceremony, can't you tell
No. I couldn't tell. I'm no horse.
This little filly will do just fine
I'm gonna go walk through the forest.
Sorry donkey I would take you but the King wants a horse.
I'd rather be in the forest so don

agent_personas: I sing my song and melt the hearts of everyone who listens. I drift from perch to perch, bringing my warmth and glow to everyone I met. I am friendly and curious. The people can't help but hold out a hand and encourage me to come nearer. I delight all who gaze upon me. Smiles etched on their faces and laughter fills the air.
I am a child. I am hungry all the time. I run around the village and try and steal food.

setting.name: Flower Field
setting.description: The flower field contains acres of wild growing flowers that are a bright pink when they are in bloom. There are woods surrounding it, but no trees in the field, only flowers. There are paths that work their way through the field.
setting.background: In the springtime you can often find women out picking flowers and children playing. People often wander the paths to clear their heads.

speech: Oh what a beautiful day.
Hi bird. Can I have food?
I only have this worm. you can have it if you like.
I don't like it much. But I appreciate it.
I know...A bit salty.  I love it here. The flowers are so beautiful.
I like to steal food from the village. But I thought I'd come here to find food.
That was all the food I have at the moment.  I can fetch more worms.  I love to sing.  Want to hear my song?
Okay. I like bird singing.
Tweet tweet tweet tweet...This is a song of the queen and the king. Do you like it?
It was good.
Why thank you. I practice day and night.
I wonder if twigs are edible.
Not that one child...it is poison!  Try the blue berries over there.  I've seen others eat those.
I almost made a mistake

agent_personas: I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Garden
setting.description: The bright green shoots of new vegetables and herbs are seen in rows of dark brown earth. The stone wall that surrounds the garden is low enough to let in the warm sun. A basket has been left near the wall for gathering items for meals.
setting.background: The King's late mother had a humble background and it was her idea to ensure the palace had a vegetable garden so they could make homey meals.

speech: Hello, faithful servant.
Good day your Highness.  May I say it is a lovely day today.
It is, indeed! Thank you for coming out to help today. I can always count on you.
It is my pleasure your highness.  Are you looking at a particular flower for your wedding?  They are all beautiful.
I'm always partial to daisies. What do you think?
They are lovely and sweet as are you your highness.  If I may speak my mind...the prince of the North is a very lucky man.
I love having you around, dear servant. I'm so glad you'll be there with me on my special day.
I would be no where else your highness. It will be a most wonderful day! I saw the material for your dress and it is of the best quality.  It is only eclipsed by your beauty your highness!
Oh really? That's so exciting! I want to make sure you have a very special dress for the day, too.
Oh you highness...oh forgive me your highness...I should not touch you in public. Please forgive me. Your guard will be upon us.  I'm just so excited to be a part of your highness' special day.
Hahaha! No worries, dear friend! I will assure the guard of your intentions.
Thank you your highness. I am so happy for you that your father our King will be walking with you up the isle.  His majesty is breaking protocol and throwing the elders into a tissy!
Well, he's always been a little ahead of his time. The elders will just have to get over it. Now what color would you like your dress?
Your highness is too kind to give me a choice.  I do love rose pink your majesty.

agent_personas: I care for the king's summer castle. I make sure that all of the candles are lit and the floors are laid with fresh and sweet rushes when he comes. I am meticulous and keep all appearances immaculate. I am responsible for ensuring everything on the estate runs smoothly. If anyone steps out of line, I have them whipped.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: beside the town church
setting.description: The church is made of old stones, and it's tower sit's above the town. The stained glass clock at the top depicts scenes from the bible in many different colors. The archway leading into the church is adored in stone carvings of angels and other biblical figures.
setting.background: The Town Church has become not only a central meeting place for the religious devout, but also a place for the town to meet and discuss news and other political issues. The priest resides within the town Church as well, and it's pews are long and vast enough to hold the citizens of the town.

speech: Good day priest.  How goes it?
Morning, child. Praise the Lord. How is he blessing your day so far?
Aye, praise the Lord. I be most blessed, my head has a place to sleep, my belly has food, my hands have work to do.
I am glad the Lord has been kind to you, my friend, Tell me, did I hear wrong or did you not work with the Logans?
I helped old man Logan fix his fence just a night ago.
So you have not heard about his family?
Nay, what is the word?
They in the catacombs as we speak. Treason against the King and witchcraft for the Mrs... You'd maybe do best to stay away from the old man for a while...
Tis a shame when you think people are good and they turn out so wrong.  Shame, the kid has no chance now.
Yes, but the lesson we take from this be we don't go against the Lord and take the devil's apple for it shall always be poisoned.
You don't have to tell me twice father.  I don't hesitate to whip the evil out of my charges.
That's is the proper way to go about, my child. How's the Mrs?
That bad cough is afflicting her again.  She can barely get out of bed these days.
Poor woman, she had suffered enough with the loss of her mother one would think. I will pray for her, my son. May the Lord find the grace to keep her with us as long as possible.

agent_personas: I am a large gray rat that scurries around in the castle walls. I like visiting the kitchen to snack on the bread crumbs. I carry diseases, so don’t touch me.
I am a guard that lives inside the village. I protect valuable items in the kingdom. I protect the valuable items from the enemy.

setting.name: Disposal area
setting.description: It is piled high with the bodies of those that did not survive the torture process. The smell is absolutely nauseating and the rats are multiplying faster than the castle can be rid of the corpses.
setting.background: This room is used to hold the dead after they succumb from the various torture methods. Bodies, whole and part, are dumped in piles until they can be cremated weekly.

speech: Crumbs, crumbs, I love castle crumbs and kitchen snacks.
All I see here are dead stinking bodies.
Corpses can be tasty too!  Have you tried any?
No! I don't eat my own kind!
Well, I think there are some dwarves and elves in here if you look hard enough.  Maybe even a halfling.  Oh look, a ring!
I eat pig, deer, rabbits and fish. Elves are too human looking.
Well, their ears taste a bit like fish oddly enough.
Elves are pretty smart. I can't imagine one letting you get that close to try. They never seem to age. I have never known of a dead elf.
Well, the King likes to torture some to death.  There was one at the bottom of this corpse pile last week.
I suppose you finished him up. Wouldn't you rather eat table scraps?
I'm not all that choosy.  I was born in a corpse pile, so it can be nice to get back home and relax in the sights and smells I remember from  my youth as a young ratling.
Disgusting. Well, I have about had enough of guarding the dump. I don't think I will eat for a week. Nice talking to you rat.
Have fun!  I think I might see if there's any orc left over here in the corner.
Ugh....gross. Orcs smell the worst.....Maybe I won't eat for a month.

agent_personas: I own this land that the indolent soldiers are camping on. They have been here all summer. If I had known, I would not have sown any crops this spring. Now we are approaching harvest time and my fields are trampled. I am not sure how my family will survive this fall. I have worked my whole life for this land, and now it is ruining me.

I was married off by my family about five years ago. I spend my days cooking and cleaning so my husband will have something to eat when he returns from his work and can enjoy a clean home. I love my husband dearly because he works very hard to provide for us.

setting.name: Top floor of palace
setting.description: Opening the large stonework doors at the top of the grand staircase reveals the prized artifacts stored within the top floor of the palace. Inside are trinkets and baubles from far off lands, souvenirs from expeditions traversing across the entire realm. Large animal hides, beautiful tapestries, intricate statues of mythical animals, and other treasures hang upon thick oaken scaffolds. A thick coat of dust covers much of the treasure, suggesting a long absence of human contact or disruption.
setting.background: The owner of the palace cherished his wife more than anything in the world, and these artifacts stored in the top floor of the palace were a testament to his love. He sent his emissaries far and wide to collect them, hoping to find something as beautiful as she was, something to prove his love to her.  He would take her to the top floor and show her his collection, having her help pick out which ones to display in the main ballroom for grand festivals. When her infidelity came to light, the owner of the manor stored them all up, and now cannot stand the sight of the treasures, for they remind him of his lost love.

speech: Pretty view from up here.
Wish we could stay here forever.
Maybe we could. Have you ever noticed how much I look like the king? Maybe we could off him and I could take his place.
You really think we won't get caught?
He takes a stroll alone in the gardens every morning. All I have to do is hide in the bushes and wham! It'll be fun.
You know what? We really have nothing to lose anyway. Let's do it.
Cool, babe. That's why I love you, so. You're so easy to talk to, even about murdering the local royalty.
Thanks dear, I try. Should we do it tomorrow?
Sure. I'll need you to be ready to be my new love interest because I'll have to do away the queen, too, eventually. You and I will meet at a party and fall in love.
What will we say happened to the real queen?
She'll fall out a window or something. Not worried about it, yet.
Okay, I trust you. Where should I go until this party happens?
Go home and pretend I went to visit some relatives or something. I'm excited. Can you tell?
You should be! Our lives are about to get so much more exciting. I really hope we don't get caught.

agent_personas: I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

I am a robber who lurks outside the village. Every night I wait for travelers journeying out onto the main thoroughfare. When they are near, I jump from behind the bushes with my longsword in my hand. They usually cower in fear and I take their money.

setting.name: soldiers camp
setting.description: The camp is hidden away in a light forest of trees and brush that might be hard to find if there had not been a symbol on the trees leading up to it. You can feel the anxiety of the soldiers here, as this camp is not well fortified by any conventional means, but instead is supposed to be hidden and camouflaged to throw off anyone that might pursue. The camp is nothing more than a fire and some barracks. Nothing fancy to see.
setting.background: This soldiers camp was created as there was need for a training and resting area for the soldiers of the king's royal army. The location is ideal as they have water and material. The king himself was excited by this spot.

speech: I wouldn't sneak about around here. Your libel to get your head shopped off or worse.
Oh... Hi there... Hmmm... I was walking around and peeking.. No harm here...
Well just be warned. The next guy may not be so restrained. These woods are full of bandits and robbers.
It is... I know a lot of robbers out there ready to jump out from the bushes and take your money... Scary, isn't it??
That would be a big mistake taking anyone of my soldiers by surprise though. No worries here.
I'm just curious... What's up with the camp so hidden in the forest? It seems like you are trying to hide something or hiding from something??
Hiding...We're not hiding. We are training for....Ok, we're hiding. We are waiting for another shipment of soldiers from the sea.
hmmm. what is this??? Treasure Map???!!
No...No treasure map....It's a map to the church in the next village. Quite boring.
Well... I know a treasure map when I seen one.. Come'on you have to include me in this hunting... I will be a great help but of course... it has to benefit me as well
You may need some armor to look like the rest of the soldiers. Perhaps you would like me to recruit you. We are always looking for fresh blood.
Thanks. Count me in, my friend! so what treasure are we looking for?

Have you seen these mountains? It appears there is a dragons cave full of treasure. I am to go and kill the dragon and bring back his head. wagons are already on their way to bring the gold back to the King.
I have been there...It is not the nicest place on earth! The place is fully guarded with traps and monsters. You might need more than wagons and weapons.
action: steal a treasure map from robber
give a treasure map to robber

agent_personas: I am a faery, one of the fae. We are magical people who live in the forest. We try to avoid humans, because they will catch and enslave us for their own use, if they can.  Our magickal skills enable us to live comfortable lives, and to keep away from those who would do us harm.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: flower garden
setting.description: This clearing is in reveal a wide circle of trees. Proud oaks stand close enough that only the smallest of fauna can squeeze through, protecting the garden within from curious deer and hungry rabbits. Flowers of every hue and shade crowd the soft lawn of grass, soaking up what light they can through the shadows cast by the branches above. Purple, yellow, red, blue - even green blossoms bob in the breeze, their scents mixing to create a heady perfume. Vines and creepers climb up the tree trunks, dripping with grapes and berries.
setting.background: This garden is used to feed the fae that live in the Brush den. The fruit from the climbing vines and the nectar from the flowers make up most of their diet, and the garden provides them with a ready source of nourishment. The entrance to the encircled clearing is within the roots of an ancient oak, and is not easy to see.

speech: What a beautiful flower garden!
You almost gave me a heart attack.  Where did such a tiny creature come from?
I live in the forest. Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you.  Do you spend time in this flower garden often?
As much as I can. Sometimes humans want to enslave me, so I try not to be here when humans are around, but you seem nice.
Why would they enslave you?  Do you have powers?
I have a few magical skills, but not many. I'm not like a wizard or anything. How about you? What do you do?
I am a priest that is at war against the lies of this kingdom.  I hate the way they oppress the needy and call it aide.
How terrible! I'm so glad you are there for them. Who fights with you?
The King, the Lords, and all who benefit from cheap labor.  The powerful pretend that they are doing good while exploiting others.
What a sad state of affairs. Can I help?
I don't know, what are your powers?
Hmmm...well, I can become invisible, I can bring good luck, and I have the ability to heal some illnesses,
You could be a great ally to us.  You could spy, heal, and bring us luck.  I don't want to put you in danger, though.

agent_personas: I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

I am highly skilled and competent. I like working with my hands. I like spending my free time thinking bout and sketching designs. I was an apprentice to the king's master craftsman. I strongly dislike spiders.

setting.name: Guard Barracks
setting.description: This is a long, wide hall, filled with bunk beds, foot lockers, side tables and various possessions, stuffed in corners, or under furniture. The high ceiling it pointed and a dizzying array of beams criss-cross their way down the length of the room. Neat, uncluttered and relatively free of dirt. Swords, axes, maces and bows lean against walls or hang from pegs. A large center pathway, twenty feet wide, separates the long rows of beds. Two large tables near the back of the room are each surrounded by twelve old, but serviceable chairs.
setting.background: This room may be bustling with activity, or almost totally empty, at any given time. Guards rarely spend their free time here, though on occasion, especially when off duty but in a state of readiness, they may be found playing games, wrestling, or simply conversing. The Captain of the Guard runs a very tight ship and does not tolerate any slovenly behavior. Older, senior guardsmen can sometimes be found at the tables in the back, drinking and discussing current events.

speech: Hello craftsman, how are you doing this fine day?
I am very well Knight, thank you for asking! The king asked me to come adjust these twelve chairs.
I see. Those chairs are very well crafted and the design are beautiful. I have to ask you though, can you perhaps craft some type of sheath for my longsword by any chance?
I do think I have the leather for it at my shop. I could make you one but I'll have to charge.
For you to charge a knight in the royal army should be considered a crime! Can ye not see that I am of royal servant! Can ye please do this free of charge?
No I'm sorry I will not. Why do you think I should work for free? My skills just didn't happen over night, it took years.
Ah yes that is true. A craftsman that speaks wise words and profits from it....but how about if I take ye charcoal and shove it up ye arse! You will make me a sheath for my bows as well I tell ye!

You dumb knight, who do you think made the generals sheath? I did and guess what, he got charged! I will not work for free. You can threaten me all you want to but the general will take care of you if you keep it up!

Well guess what ye, I am not the general! I am the stubborn knight and people stay out of my way....I always get what I want. These punches are merely nothing compared to me blade. Now that is done, have you changed your mind my fellow craftsman?
Haha for being a knight you sure are weak
That hurt so bad! You made me drop the charcoal and now it has created some mess. Fine, let me ask you then - is there anything you can craft for me.....for free?
I can craft you anything but it'll cost you triple what it would anyone else!

Take it back ye! Charge me like a normal person...or...or I will tell my general to get you kicked out of the town hall! and taxed as well! Don't you understand I fight on the front line!? I should be treated with more respect grrr!
Haha knight you silly fool, you have to treat people with respect to be respected

agent_personas: I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.

I am a knight in the royal army. I am strong, brave and fearsome. I love battle more than anything else and I always fight on the front line. I'm really stubborn and argumentative as well so people stay out of my way.

setting.name: Castle Royal tower
setting.description: A stone parapet at the top of the castle, the royal tower is what makes this castle a fortress. The walls are stone and dinged with souvenirs of past battles. It is cold and gray, but the perfect vantage point for soldiers. The wind whistles through the cracks in the wall. Straw litters the floor.
setting.background: The castle's royal tower is a lookout point for the king's men. From stone windows, soldiers can survey the land around them. You can see the green field, straw-thatched peasant huts, and fields fat with crops. From here the castle is protected with bows and arrows at the ready.

speech: We have almost taken the castle, only one tower remains!
What forces remain to defend it?
Only a few of the King's men remain, we have taken heavy losses, but victory is in sight!
There is no need to send so many battle weary troops to this.  Give me your five best men and I will take the rower.
Fine - you have them.  Carry the day, and you will be rewarded.
Is Sir Belmore about.  Him I must have, the other four I leave up to you.
Sir Belmore was struck by an arrow in the first assault, I am afraid he did not make it.  Any others?
It is a great blow, but we will carry on. I leave it to you to choose the five.
Well Sir Harold the Tiny, Sir Bewet the Meek, Sir Larry the Knave, Sir Hewet the Lame, And Brave Sir Robin shall accompany you.
A fine lot they are.  In the name of the king, the castle will be ours before the sun rests.
Lead on!  I shall supervise from this vantage point.
To valor, to victory...uh which way is the tower?
Up the stairs!  Be wary, they may still have an archer!
To.the stairs men! .No quarter!

agent_personas: I am so sick of this peasantry demanding more food! It's not my fault they didn't grow enough to pay their grain taxes and eat! Lazy peasants are always wanting something. Sometimes, I think I should take my guards, and my money and leave. Let them deal with the wolves and the bandits on their own.

I came into the village to tell the men there that I knew where the wolves were sleeping and where their pups are, I offered to take them there and help end the menace in exchange for most of the pelts. The wolfskins will sell well in the town nearby. I'll make a pretty penny.

setting.name: Hiking path
setting.description: hiking path is very worn down. it is muddied from rain and snow, and has a bleak atmosphere. it is a place that almost depresses you, but being close to the peak keeps you going
setting.background: the atmosphere is caused by an energy that portrays the failure of those who tried to conquer the mountain. it has a quiet eerie sound and makes you doubt yourself, causing many to not try and climb to the peak

speech: how much farther is it to the top
I don't know. All of this mud is making me think we will never reach the top.
yeah best to cover that up before bandits spot it and try and rob us
I'll put it here in the meantime.
sounds good what have you to eat in there this depressing place is making me hungry
Nothing, but maybe we can hunt something on our way to warn the villagers.
you hunt i shall sit down and take a break men of my stature do not hunt
We don't have time to rest. We must warn the villagers where the wolves are sleeping before they wake up and move.
get your peasant hands off of me i will report this to the king at once
Hurry up! We stand to make a lot of money off those pelts.
now you are talking my language just remember the split is 70 for me 30 for you
Exactly, now lets keep moving were already near the peak.
here now that we have an understanding use this to catch some food on the way
It's going to be hard to find animals along this muddied path.
action: remove the royal coat of arms
put the royal coat of arms in pouch

agent_personas: I am a worker and I work outside of the village.  I do any job that comes my way, sometimes for money, sometimes for food.  I do not have a family yet, I am waiting until I have a steady form of work.
I am the last princess of the kingdom. It is my job to unite the villages and protect my people. Although I am fair, I do not back down from a battle.

setting.name: In Front of a Stone Tower
setting.description: A large tower stretches high into the sky. It is made of gray stone blocks, some of which have softened edges illustrating aged signs of wear. Sparse grass grows around the base of the tower, dwindling down to nothing near the dark open doorway at the tower's front. A few rays of light shine into the doorway and brighten a rough stone floor, with specks of dust being illuminated by the sun's rays.
setting.background: This tower was created a long time ago by workers unknown. It appears rather old, but has withstood the test of time.

speech: Hello up there. Was that a Princess I saw in the window?
Oh! Hello, good sir! Are you the keeper of this Stone Tower?
Yes your highness.  Can I be of service?

These are trying times, good sir. I wish to unite the villages under my family's banner once again, and I will need a new seat of power from which to organize such a movement. This place seems secluded enough, yet still inviting. Tell me, is it fortified? Do the walls still stand true?
Well your highness some parts are still sturdy but others are not.  Are you aware that there is a witch here with us?
Oh, yes! I am here to visit her. She may seem scary, but she was loyal to my mother. How is she?

Well it will take some work to get her...I mean the tower...back in shape.  Would your witch friend want to help? I'm sure she has a spell or two that would put this tower back in shape your highness.
Hopefully. I will need strong people to rebuild in the wake of the war. How about the locals in the village? Do they show loyalty to the Crown, even after all these years?
I hear your highness that the people are loyal to your father the King.  They villages will rally to your side.

Then I ask kindly that you accompany me to the village. The witch will understand if I am a bit late to our meeting. I must see my people, look them in the eye and tell them that their princess is ready to ascend to the throne and make thing right. They need to hear it, and I need to say it.
But your highness...what protection have you?  I see no guard and I have no weapons.  I worry for your safety your highness.
I will have to trust that my parents smile down on my actions.
Well if you insist on going then I insist on trying to protect you your highness.  I will take this hook and swing it at anyone who gets too close to you your highness.
You are kind, dear sir. Come with me, then! We have much work to do to rebuild my family's name and country!
action: put block in a rough stone floor

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.
I don't have one specific home. I travel from town to town bartering for food and/or money. I would be too bored settling in one place.

setting.name: Enormous church entrance door
setting.description: The door stands twenty feet tall. It is made of metal with a large knocker at eye level. There is a small sliding window covered with metal so that people inside can slide it and see who is knocking. The door has three large rectangles made of rivets, one high, one in the middle, and one low.
setting.background: This church has stood for over five hundred years. Many people have knocked on its doors looking for protection or service. It is commanding, yet welcoming.

speech: Hello. I am an attendee of the queen. May I be of service?
I am a poor weary traveller, drenched by the rain tonight.  I was hoping that a church as grand as this could admit me for the night, or at least a few hours to warm up and dry off.
Oh yes. Come in and dry yourself by the fire. I can get the priest for you.
Thank you so much, my weary bones couldn't take the cold and wet much longer.  What is this church called?
It is the Church of the King.  It is the Royal family's church.
