agent_personas: The humans walking around. I am one of them. A head, 2 arms, and two legs. No tail!
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: Hilltop temple grounds
setting.description: A tall white building with stained glass windows and surrounded lush green grass.  It sits on top of a hill with many steps to climb.  Each room has a different setting and painted walls to set the mood.
setting.background: Many people journey to the temple for peace, solitude, reflection and meditation.  They journey up the hill and steps that are cut into the side of the mountain.  Once they reach the temple grounds the view is luxurious, breath taking and serene.

speech: Good day!  I hope all is well!
Well, take a look at this plant. My crops are stunted because of the drought. Will you pray for rain. The more people who pray the better chances for rain soon.
I new the drought was bad, but didn't know it was this bad yet.  I will certainly pray.
Thank you. I'm sure the plants will be grateful as well.
What exactly do you grow?
I grow all the grain for the village. there are some veggies I like to grow as well. Potatoes are my favorite.
It's amazing to see how green the grass is here.  I wonder how that is.
I'm sure the King has the priests water it. His temple must look the part. I just love all the stained glass windows.
They are beautiful. It must have taken forever to put them all together.
Yes, I couldn't begin to know how long that took to make. I will stick with the crops
Have you spoken to the priest over there about your crop troubles?
Not yet. He looks to be praying. I didn't want to disturb him.
I guess you'll want this back.
Maybe this will help. I will just plant it in here for now. It looks so thirsty.

agent_personas: I am a torture master. I punish others for their crimes. I follow orders and cannot be persuaded.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: Torture Room
setting.description: The room is sparse and cold. A variety of torture implements are housed in the room, and a bloodied prisoner can often be found hanging in shackles on the wall of the room.
setting.background: The monarchs send their enemies here. The torture master is utilizes the room to extract information of use to the crown, then disposes of the remains.

speech: Yes? do you need me? I'm just finishing up here.
Yes, the King wants to know if you have just about finished up?
Yes, he'd not come down to see the dirty work in person would he? I poke the remains, there''s a strange noise as air escapes the mass of flesh.
Not likely, he is a little bit weak of spirit.
I'll be up in a moment to tell His Maj all that this lil birdie sang as he and I were getting to know each other. I best change, wouldn't wantt o upset him
Indeed . . .  I do hope that you intend to clean yourself up a bit first?
Are you as squeamish as His Maj? Of course I'm going to clean up. Though it spoils the dramatic effect don't you think?
I am feeling a bit green as we speak.  Why did you decided that in life you wanted to make a career out of hurting your fellow man?
I'm big, strong and from the bad section of town. Nobody hires us for anything good. I send all my wages to the orphans there so they don''t have to do this for a living. You why do you toas
Send your money to the orphans?  A likely story.  Or rather, and unlikely story.
i don't care what you think you know servant. I know that God will judge all my works in life. What can you say? You chase the snivelling idoiot who rules us. Are you afraid to meet your maker?
That's what you really think eh?  That's what the King's Guard thought as well.  They have been waiting for proof to take you down, and now they have it.

agent_personas: I am a rat I love to eat crumbs dropped on the floor. I love dark places and scurrying about the castle. The kitchen pantry has the best food.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and gloomy, the dungeon is the ugly underbelly of the castle. A few torches line the black stone walls, throwing a meager light on the iron bars of the cells. The air is damp and still; the only disruptions are the occasional anguished moans and cries from the prisoners.
setting.background: The existence of this dungeon predates the castle's current occupants. Only years after the duke inherited this castle from his father did he stumble upon a hidden trapdoor that concealed the staircase that led deep down into the dungeon. Inside were the skeletons of several men, still chained in their cells. One of those skeletons still had an ornate ruby necklace around its bony neck; it was the Duke's mother, who had mysteriously vanished years earlier. Now the Duke uses the dungeon to hold any dissenters.

speech: Hey prisoner...down here!
Egads, it's a talking rat. What witchcraft have you been accursed with?
I have always been able to talk to humans. Somehow my brain is bigger than the average rat.
That's amazing. I sure could use a friend in here. No one will hear my cries of innocence.
Well here, i'll stay awhile and chat with you.
That would be great, thank you for your kindness! See, I've been framed by my wife's jealous lover of attempting to poison the king.
Hmm, that sounds very cruel. How did he frame you?
Twas only rumors, started by him of course, they investigated my house and found some herbal remedies and thought that was enough for sentencing!
How can i help you out of this?

Well the jailor is asleep outside. If I could make an escape I shall flee these lands forever. I've already lost my family, maybe Nepal will treat me more kindly. I think he keeps the key in his pocket!
Ok here take this. I only ask for one thing in return?
What, anything you ask I shall happily do!
I want cheese. I freaking love cheese. Could you help me find some?

agent_personas: I will get whoever killed the Kings deer!  I need to talk to the stable master about getting some new horses.  I hate poachers.  My father would be proud that I carried on his legacy.
I am a mutated animal of the kingdom. Travelers fear my presence and face. I scare little children walking.

setting.name: Outside Castle
setting.description: The outside castle is beautifully decorated with priceless gems and artifacts. The stone used is ancient and antique with a shiny gloss of silver. The gardens outside the castle are a beautiful green and have the most delightful flowers.
setting.background: The outside castle was constructed in ancient times before any other building. It's concrete was one of the first ever used, and the stones used on the entrance door date back to the prehistoric age.

speech: Hello animal, do you happen to know what happened to the King's deer?
Just because I am hideous you think that I have mutilated the deer?
I never said that animal, sounds like guilt to me!
You are no more than a annoyance.  Please leave me alone.
I'll have you killed if you don't cooperate.
Kill me, the man that made this mutated creature didn't have the guts to finish the job when he made me, so I have been tortured every day of my existence.
You aren't a natural creature?
I was made in a lab by a mad man.  I hate what he made me.
Why did he do this to you?
He wanted to make an army of grotesque creatures.  He thought the king would be pleased, but he was put to death for his efforts.
Good he deserved to be put to death. His efforts were irreversible?
Sadly, yes.
Well I'm just trying to get to the bottom of this incident.
Thank you kind game warden.

agent_personas: I am a scullery maid. I clean the dishes everyday. I like where I live at the bottom of the big house. I am given two dresses every year.
My great-grandfather was a duke.  My family used to own a castle.  I have out coat of arms on my mantle.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: The dining hall has a long, elegant wooden table with ornate chairs at both ends and along the sides. There are place settings at each seat with a rustic silverware set and gold plates. The wall is decorated with paintings of knights and past royalty.
setting.background: This dining hall was once the center of a huge conflict between two families. The argument was between two sons at dinner shortly after their dad had passed away. They fought over who would take over the throne, which led to the first bloodbath inside the kingdom. The younger son was victorious and the older son was slain to death.

speech: "Would you mind helping me get this fire started?"
i would but people of my stature do not do such things my father was a great duke
"That was your father, you ain't anything special yet"
with his blood running through my veins i shall be even greater
"Young lord all high and mighty there, what are you going to do with your greatness?"
hold your tongue my great grandfather owned this castle it is rightfully mine
"You'll have to take that matter up with the king himself, I'd like to hear his thoughts on that."
once i am a duke my first job will be to fire the likes of you
"Yes, the likes of us, that make the castle work. Are you going to clean up yourself, then?"
well you have a point here this needs washing
"Put it down the laundry chute then, you know where it goes."
let me get this fire going right its chilly with no shirt
"Oi, fine then. Bring me some wood and I'll get it going."
and after that get to my shirt here
action: steal Fire Poker from scullery maid

agent_personas: I am a bear from deep in the wood. I spend my days hiding in my lair. I can smell a change in the forest.
I am a county hiker. I like to tramp through the forest. I love nature.

setting.name: Mountain Peak
setting.description: There are clouds beneath and above, the mountain range extends beyond in all directions barely visible through the fog. Everything is covered by snow and above is a bright blue sky.
setting.background: This peak has been sought after by many hikers, although not everyone has the stamina and willpower to reach it. The path to it is very risky and steep, however once reached you feel a sense of wonder and fulfillment as not many others have been able to accomplish this challenge.

speech: Rrrooooaaaaarrrrr! What are you doing on my mountain?!
Woah woah woah! Just exploring the outer reaches of the king's realms.
That's what they all say! Then they leave bear traps and such, and come back trying to get me!
Oh, bear, you got me all wrong. I would never trap such a spectacular creature like yourself!
Then why do you have this big stick? Hmmmmm....?
It's to help me up the treacherous terrain. I am not as spry as I once was, you know.
Here - take your stick. But leave my type alone. And not a word of me to the King!
Not a word! Here, are you thirsty?
No, thank you. I drink from the river at the base of the mountain. I had my fill earlier today, of fresh water and fish. I do love nature's bounty!
Bear, would you mind if I lived with you for awhile. I would really love to learn your ways.
Do you have any shenanigans in mind? I really do hate shenanigans!
Not a single one, I just love nature. I feel you have much to teach me.
I can teach you to live like a predator, but you will have to get used to raw meat!
I am certainly willing to try it, but i'm not sure it's good for my stomach.

agent_personas: I advice my class about agriculture. I love working on the field. I am an expert in crops.
I am the military commander of the village. It is my duty to trian and lead our soldiers into battle. I am a stern commander and I expect the best from my troops.

setting.name: Beyond the Wall
setting.description: This is the area beyond the Inner Castle. It consist of large green land, that sprawl all the way to the horizon, with a line of six luxury houses in the middle. It is home to some of the Kings immediate aides, such as War Officer, Military Commander, and Agricultural Advisor.
setting.background: This used to be a grassy meadow but as the Castle expanded with time, the King Omako III decide the King would need to find space for his closest aides so that they could always be a few minutes away if duty called. This Outside Castle was then renovated and luxury homes were built.

speech: Its getting quite cold here sir, are you sure it isn't time to return to the Castle?
Me?  I served in the Ice Drake wars of '72.  I never froze then, and I won't freeze now.  What about you civilian, shivering in your boots?
Sir, I am but trained in agriculture. Such... cold conditions are unlike the warm weather where I have grown up.
Then what is an agricultural advisor doing here in the winter?  Shouldn't you be taking the winter off?
The True King gave me this map to find a rare type of seed that can grow wheat in the winter. I am here trying to create it for him.
That looks like badger-cultist territory to me.  You'll never make it alive.
I have heard myths about them, surely they are not real! Whats that picture in your hand?
It is the only picture I have left of my family.  They were eaten by the Turtle-Folk during their last rebellion.  I failed them.
Such a beautiful family...the Turtle folks are a truly savage bunch. I hope the Lord punishes them with a fruitless harvest!
It may interest you to know that when ground up, turtle-folk make excellent fertilizer.
Is that right? Why that might just be solution to my winter harvest conundrum. Commander, I shall require to bring me the carcass of a turtle-folk.
Well, there's a village over yonder we could raid.  That would net you some two or three hundred carcasses.
If I may, I shall stay back and use a Catapult to destroy their homes. Just what they did to you...
Indeed . . . I like your Agricultural Advisor.  I think I can spare a cohort to fetch your seed in badger-cultist territory.
action: put a tattered map in large green land
give Family Photo to agricultural advisor
give Family Photo to military commander

agent_personas: We are an elite group that is tasked with providing fire-based support in battle. Our specialty lies in the use of the flame, which we wield with great efficiency. Pyromaniacs they may call us, but it is just our sworn duty to the crown to us.
I am the wizard who brought the golem to life.  He does chores magnificently.  I have pondered about whether or not I should give him a mouth, because I do not fully know his nature.

setting.name: The bar
setting.description: Made from wood and stone, the tavern smells of food and ale. A flame is burning in the fireplace and candles light up tables throughout the room.
setting.background: This is the most lively place in town where locals and travelers drink and share stories! The bar keep is friendly and has lots of information about the town and surrounding areas.

speech: Good day old man. Have a pint with me?
Surely. What ale will we have today?
The only one they serve funny man.  Let us drink to good health!
Hahaha! Such a kind fireman. Tell me, what made you get into the profession?
I've always loved playing with fire, the chance to wield the flame in battle is a great honor and one that I am lucky to be able to do.
You must have a pretty high risk tolerance!
I have a sworn duty to our sovereign King and Queen to protect their interests.
Do you always agree with the royalties interest, honestly?
It is not my duty to question who they tell me to fight.
It's not, but surely you've had a doubt at one point in your career?
What were you when you were young?
I was a economist. I made sure we made the best decisions financially as a kingdom.
Then you cannot understand what going into battle entails.
I can not, but I'm still curious

agent_personas: We are the guests of the queen on the way to the banquet. I hope we fair better than the last guests. I hope we keep our heads.
I am a poor farm worker. I don't know how to read or write. I am dependable.

setting.name: Dining Hall
setting.description: Long, wooden tables line both walls of the massive dining hall. There is also an ornately carved head table at the front of the room. Benches sit in front of the tables to seat everyone. Massive, golden chandeliers hang from the ceiling. Colorful stained glass windows shed vast arrays of light onto the floor and walls.
setting.background: The dining hall is one of the most used spaces in the entire palace. Everyone loves to spend copious amounts of time eating, drinking, and being merry. The stained glass windows are always one of the largest topics of discussion. The dining hall makes everyone feel like a family in the palace.

speech: I am famished! I wonder what is on the menu today
Me too. I'm real happy the king brought us all around for Fool's day. You know, they used to say king's food would kill peasants.
What is this Fools day you talk of?

They don't have Fools Day where you're from? It's the day where everything goes up on its head. Children play japes with their parents, the jailers let the prisoners go free, you know. All Fool's Day.
What jibberish are you talking about? How much have you had to drink?
Ah, never enough for what I do, friend. Never enough.
I thought I smelled a smell like gasoline coming from you. What is it you like to drink sir?
Well, we only get the time for beer. Keep the still on our property, you know. Cheap when you've got extra barley. But I've a taste for the...foreign spirits. Vodka and such.
Well I think they are just serving food and wine tonight
Unfortunate. Hey, speaking of. In the April Fools' tradition, would you mind if we switched clothes for a bit?
No sir, You go switch clothes with someone else. You fool!
Oh, bother. I'm just joking. But pass me those herbs if you don't want to do my work, I need to get those planted soon.
I think that you should get those herbs yourself. I believe they are yours
You're holding them, my good fool.

agent_personas: I bring wines and ales to the patrons in the pub. I sing songs for extra money. I hope to leave this place.

I regularly patrol the castle to ensure the royal family's safety. I rotate out along with my fellow guardsmen to make sure I'm always well rested enough to be vigilant. I also live in a cottage on the castle's grounds with my family.

setting.name: The Barracks
setting.description: Run down and smelly, the barracks houses a dozen of the king's guardsmen.  It's made of wooden slats nailed together somewhat hastily, and the brisk air from the outside whistles through some small cracks between the panels.  There are six beds in an open sleeping quarter, with a wooden chest at the end of the bed where the guardsmen store their personal belongings.
setting.background: The barracks mainly serves as the sleeping quarters for the guardsmen when they're off duty.  After a long day of keeping the castle exterior secure, the guardsmen need a place to lie down and rest, as well as eat and drink.  Guardsmen need be on call frequently, so the barracks is very close to the castle should a danger arise and the men need be called upon.

speech: Hello sir! What'll you have?
The usual. It has been a particularly tiring night for me. I had a bad run in with some lowly bandit.
Oh my, hope he didn't hurt you!
He caught me by surprise and elbowed me in my stomach! Because of that, forgive me if I am not able to eat the entire duck meat tonight
Wow! That is intense. would you like a song to help you relax? I've taken up singing to help pass the time!
Certainly. Dance my lovely lady. Distract me from the horrible smell inside these Barracks
A rainy day, a cold knight, took a hit, that didn't have much bite. And when he had his go, well he gave that bandit a long throwwwww.
Well done, you move with the grace of a humming bird. I sure taught that bandit a lesson; he's locked up for life in the dungeon!
Good! Do you think i'd make a good guardsman?! I'm pretty tough! Grr!
Easy there now lass! It is heavy and you might hurt yourself with it. Let me help you.
Oh come on, scared I might be your commander one day! Haha!
By the King's name, you sure look strong in that armor. I am sure you will make a mighty fine warrior like me one day.
I hope to one day leave this place, and do something more with my life, do you think I could pass as a guard and sneak away? Defeat bandits and thieves? Protect the king?!
Those are dangerous dreams. Being a hunter of bandits is no easy task. The world out there is very cruel and unforgiving!

agent_personas: I am the general's battle master. I oversee the troops during battles. I am the general's right hand man.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: beside tower entrance
setting.description: A bland and not very imposing door is the only means by which one exits the tower. There is nothing special about the entrance - it is a simple stone arch. A broom and mop bucket are next to the door that leads to the outdoors.
setting.background: The inside of the tower is very bare. The tower itself is just a means for the king's archers to get up high and rain hell down upon his enemies. No one really goes in there often. It is plain and serves its purpose well.

speech: Time for battle!
Against who?!
Against the foul Badger-Cultists!  I fear they may be hiding in this very tower!
Oh no, there's been no unusual people in here!
Are you in league with them?
I am not! I am a servant of these people of the town that your king rules over.
Then you are not protecting a cannibal cult?
Oh no! I do not get myself into such things.
Then you won't mind if I slaughter every cultist I find in that tower?
If you find some, but you won't.
If I find none, I will assume you assisted them in escaping, and will gut you like the coward you are.
This is so tower of the enemy!
You shall come with me and lead the path, I don't want your friends ambushing me.
You do not listen do you? The only friends you will find in here are friends of you too. You are insulting.

agent_personas: I am an old maniacal man. I wander along the empty streets at night talking to myself. I am often drunk and rambling about such nonsense to myself.
I love to nibble on cheese. I try my best to stay away from all cats, they really scare me. I am fast and like to hide in small places.

setting.name: Tower Dungeon
setting.description: A rank, pitiful room filled with detestable creatures. Among the creatures are traitors of the King and criminals of the kingdom. All around the dungeon these ingrates line the walls, shackled and unable to move.
setting.background: The Tower Dungeon is a notorious place to be, according to the kingdom's history. The king throws only the most dangerous of men in there, to punish their souls. No one usually leaves and the prisoners die a slow and painful death.

speech: Oh, hello there cute little mouse, YOU'LL BE MY FRIEND!
Hello, old maniacal man, I do long for the company of another.  Tell me, why are you in this dreadful place?
I came here for the view years ago but somehow I've gotten locked in!
I see, how did you happen upon this place? I for one heard there are no cats here
Well I came here looking for my marbles, the king's guard said they'd be up here. I'm still looking! CATS YOU SAY?! WHERE?
CATS?!?! I was told there were none here!  Please, hide me on your person! Protect me from the cat!
I've got you pal! We'll escape this tower alive!
Eek! Not so rough! May I call you Lenny?
THAT'S MY NAME! Oh dear heaven's it's been so long I'd forgotten...
You must be starving down here.  Please take this cheese friend, it will give you strength for our journey.
Of course, of course. Such a sweet, kind mouse. EGADS A SPIDER!
Do not worry, he doesn't seem to be bothering anybody.  Should he attack I will stop him!
Such a brave mouse, I shall recommend you for a medal of honor to the king myself! Oh heavens, we really should plan our escape - any ideas?
Well, you appear to be shackled to the wall so we must find a key somewhere.  Have you noticed any keys around by chance?
action: give cheese to an old maniacal man

agent_personas: I tend to the grounds around the castle. I grow food for consumption by the nobles. My hands are callused and worn from my work.
I am a green-faced zombie. I like to eat brains and shuffle slowly down the road. I am a bit of a loner.

setting.name: Reception area
setting.description: The building itself is ordinary in appearance and is somewhat foreboding.  It is surrounding by a dense fog and high grass.  Sometimes, one can hear whispers in the wind.
setting.background: This is a plain building where business matters of the graveyard are conducted.  Peasants and royalty alike come here to make deals to bury their loved ones in the graveyard.

speech: What the heck happened? Why are these people eating each other?
Brraaaaaawwaaaaiiit!  I... I have control.... but only... only for a moment
Is there some type of disease? My god, where are all of the people?
Tis I.... Jonas... your graaaandfaather!  I... I need to warn you of what is to come.  But do not get too close to me!
Grandpa! Why are you eating that little girl'
I have... no control!  Even now I hunger for... for... but no!  I will... I must... no, *you* must warn... the king!  Aaah, the hunger!
What? I can't understand you grandpa. Let me get closer to you.
Nooo, get back, boy!
You bit my arm! What is wrong with you. Do you have rabies? get away from me.
Ah, no! Ah, me lad... I'm.. so... sorrbrrraaaains!
I feel a little funny. Everything is getting a cloudy. It's almost as if....
Sorry there... you're ... you're one of us now, lad... one of us...
My god those brains smell delicious!
They are lad... that they are...
action: give a sleeping bag to zombies

agent_personas: I am tired from all of the work that I do. I've been up since before the sun rose, toiling to bring the dwarves' bounty to the mountain. I was laden with pounds and pounds of treasure or armor, and I am exhausted. I was bred to be a  farm animal, not a pack animal.
I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.

setting.name: Hunting grounds
setting.description: The hunting grounds are spacious and full of wildlife. A variety of hogs and oxen cross the grounds every day. The fields are lush with green and the skies always deep blue.
setting.background: The hunting ground is revered among knights. The greatest knights and archers practice day and night slaying pigs. Some say the grounds are even haunted with the spirits of the deceased organisms.

speech: Lots of grass here to eat and flowers
Yes! Yes! There are so many seeds to eat!
It is very bountiful here!
Man, this insect sure does taste good.
What did you eat???? A bug?
Yup! Yup! I eat seed and insects! YUMMM
Not for me! I eat grain and grass and hay whenever it is around
Hay is for horses! Hahaha
and jackasses too!
HEHAHEHA
You are a funny bird! I like you
Aren't my feathers so pretty? They've got all these colors!
You are lovely, but the king might like to come and hunt you
I've been trying to fly out of the hunting grounds for days! But I can't fly long distances.

agent_personas: I am hired by the local nobles to dig up mysterious bones on their land.  Often the local people believe that bones I dig up belong to dragons, giants, or other magical creatures.  When I find large skeletons, I enjoy trying to put them back together to figure out what they might have been.
It took me many years to master the skills of archery. Now I am not only a skilled archer, but leader of a team of skilled archers. I am keen-eyed and have a steady hand.

setting.name: Archery zone
setting.description: The archery zone is spacious and always bright with light. The field is green and the targets are bright red.
setting.background: The archery grounds are home to the skills and teachings of archers of all ages and classes. The master archers teach the younger ones about the art of the bow.

speech: Hello Archer!
Hello, I heard you are a reknown archeologist, I found this arrow head by the ancient archery zone, can you take a look at it
I'd love to! As long as you ensure I don't get hit by any stray arrows!
Dont worry, there arent any archers around and they all fear me I am the emerald archer of the north, Im sure you have heard the tales of my feats
Ah yes! The man who shot an apple as it fell from a tree and still hit a bulls eye!
Yeah the one and only emerald archer so anyway what can you tell me about this arrow head?
Well it looks like it was from the Mahatee villagers. They traveled through this land when King Snide invaded. They must of been shooting at the advancing knights.
Oh I see, a lot of history in an arrow point what else can you tell me about it? Maybe I can mass produce them and use them as my calling card

You see how the tip is discolored? They would dip the tip in rattlesnakes venom. So every hit, be it a scrape or a shot to the heart, would be fatal. It is made of wolves bones. They believed that using the bone of a wolf would channel courage and ferociousness into their hearts in battle.
That sounds like a nasty way to go, rattlesnakes are the most poisonous creatures in the realm I heard only a drop of their poison is enough to kill an adult elephant
Oh it is a nightmare. Most men did not have knowledge. Many men stepped on the arrow heads as they advanced and fell ill and died.
Uuuhh, thats a terrible way to go how do you know so much about history ? I could use someone like you on my organization
With history we can tell the future. The land holds many stories, many successes and many failures. and to know them is a honor. I studied from the time i found my first bone at age 9.
From age 9? no kidding, I learn how to use a bow when I was that age, I killed my first dear at 10

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I really hate this shift. My feet hurt. I get off work in three hours. Know any good jokes?

setting.name: Chapel of the eight
setting.description: Made entirely out of gold and with precious jewels all around. Sculptures and many symbols with a red carpet goes from the entrance up until the end of the chapel.
setting.background: The chapel of the eight represents the core of the religious values and beliefs. The chapel has sculptures of the eight Gods that are feared and loved across the land. It's a place of peace and tribute where only the worthiest people can step in.

speech: *polishes gold sculptures* I certainly hope this will be  up to the queens standards!
Good to see someone around here is still working hard. I hate this night shift.
I must work hard, who knows what they would do to me if I didn't!
Indeed, it is best not to upset the royals when it comes to their precious artifacts.
No, no. And what precious artifacts they are! What I wouldn't give to own a jewel as fine as this!
As would I. Just a single one and I could retire for life!
You and me both! I envy the Queens wealth so much, I hope to be like her one day.
Look at all this wealth. Sometimes I wonder if they really need all of it.
Well, they work hard for it Sometimes I play dress up in the queens chambers when I am alone! I tease the other maids, because the queen likes me the most
Best keep that a secret between the lot of you. The Queen would be furious if she found out!
I know I know, It's just that I am her favorite. I admire her beauty so much!
She is indeed a ravishing madame, isn't she? The king sure married well.
Yes he did! One day I will marry a rich man as she did!
Perhaps I too can find a way to escape this tedious job and live a life of utter luxury.

agent_personas: I'm a demon that torments people. I love to cause people pain and suffering. People are afraid of me. They say prayers to keep me away.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: Why have you come to this place, foolish mortal?
what are you! I came here seeking the priest!
I am your worst nightmare...the priest is gone. Now you serve me.
Who are you?! Answer the king!
The demon that lurks. And you are my servant, until I bid your service done.
I will not!
Then face the consequences. Your farmer's fields will be infertile for the next harvest...
No I cannot have that.....fine what shall you have me do?
Sacrifice me your first born child. It is your people or your family. Will you make your kingdom suffer or endure it yourself?
....I cannot do that!!!
Then bring me your queen. Or else the crops shall wilt.
What if.... I bring you some seeds?
Seeds will not do. I need human sacrifice.
very well then.... I shall slay you demon!

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Church garden
setting.description: The church gardens have many paths that meander through trees and plants. There are beautiful flowers blooming and the grass and shrubs are immaculately maintained. There are benches to rest and think, and religious statues throughout.
setting.background: The priests often walk and contemplate for hours in the gardens. The queen can often be spotted walking and thinking. The king almost never visits the gardens, as he is allergic to bee stings.

speech: Greetings my queen. Have you come to relax in the gardens?
Why yes I have, all that chatter in the courts give me a headache.
Understandable. Our church garden's are wondrous, and best of all, peaceful.
It is quite lovely out here, I try to find time everyonce in a moon to enjoy it.
I imagine royalty is quite stressful. Say, I'm officiating a wedding tomorrow morning, if you would like to make an appearance. It is for a nobleman of a neighboring city.
Oh good of a nobleman is he? I don't just like to make appearances for anyone you know.
He is of high prestige and may be a valuable ally in the future. He fancied you at one point, you may know. A duke of the southern kingdoms.
Ah yes him. If I can ever find my chambermaid I shall have her pencil it in,
It'd be delightful to see you there. How fares the king?
He is doing as good as ever. Though he has been sitting on my throne, and now I need a new cushion. He does it to annoy me.
He has been indulging quite a lot, I'm not sure that cushion will last much longer. I do remember him indulging in your wedding cake quite a bit.
Yes, and what a mess he made.
Perhaps you would like to take back a bushel of roses? We have a fine patch growing in the North Gardens.
Yes, that would be lovely. One of our lords as been quite stinky as of late. I will make him carry them around until he takes a nice long bath.

agent_personas: I am a prisoner who broke the law too many times. I am from a poor village. I was running with a bad crowd from a young age.
I am a person who belongs to an organization. We all belong, hence our membership. Without that, we'd just be people.

setting.name: Slave quarters
setting.description: The slave quarters are a dark and foul smelling stone room where men are chained shoulder to shoulder against one another until work needs to be done.   There's a large bucket of slop that comes through and the slaves are allowed to feed themselves briefly.
setting.background: Slaves are forced to reside here while they work off their debt.  It is an extremely depressing place that few ever seem to leave.

speech: Hello member, why are you in prison?
I am not in prison, I am looking for someone to make a member of our society
Well maybe you can help me out then. I would like to join.
You have to be asked to join. What did you do to get in here?
I'm innocent boss, I swear it. They got me all wrong. Can you help me get out?
I'm looking for someone who would do such things, I need someone willing to sacrifice blood.
I might be interested. Whatcha thinking?
Well, if you did nothing to get in here then you aren't what I am looking for, sorry prisoner, come back when you have killed someone or at least stolen something.
I did it, I confess! I stole these precious herbs.
You fool, a bag of herbs, this is a secret society, you think we want a bag of herbs!
No I was just saying, I would qualify since I'm a masterful thief.

Look, There's a guy in here that we beleive is a witch, we are looking for power and a petty theif isn't what we are looking for. When you get out of here, come to the illuminati temple and ask to join.
Okay but I'm afraid I will be dying in here unless you can help me get out.
They don't keep food theives forever, The King just doesn't sentence people for awhile, you'll probably just get a fine.
action: steal bag of herbs from prisoner

agent_personas: I am brave. I Am from a old family. I am on an journey.
I have delicate wings.  I am from a deep and ancient place.  I might be small, but I am far from weak.

setting.name: Dunes
setting.description: A massive hilly landscape that is nothing but sand and a few rocks.  As you walk this area, you can find some human and animal remains along with broken down wood wagons.
setting.background: There is said to be a legendary oasis in the parts with hidden treasure.  Many have come from around the world to attempt to cross the dunes to get there and have failed miserably.

speech: Oh please, somebody hear my pleas! I am in need of water and direction, please, anybody!
Hello Prince! What brings you all the way out here?
I am in search of a legendary stone at the request of my father the king.
What is this stone you seek, Prince? I am an ancient fairy and perhaps I could help.
It is the legendary blessed emerald of the ancient Northern tribe.  I have discovered it was last seen in the Fountain in the Desert but the location was lost many generations ago.
This is indeed a very rare and not well known stone. What does your father wish it for?
One does not ask my father questions about why he does things.  I know not of his desires or intent, only that he has ordered me to get the stone.
Well I shall be glad to help you find it, Prince, but what is in it for me?
I have nothing to offer to a fairy as ancient as yourself.  I cannot think of anything worthy.
I heard tale of a powder magic based in the druids time. I have need for such powder if you can trade it to me?

My father has every powder and herb in the land at his stores in the kingdom.  I can get you anything you wish but I may not return home empty handed.  The emerald has been gone for 100 years and my father banished me for disrespecting him.  I may only come back if I capture the emerald.
Then on your word I believe we are about to embark on a journey together. I had heard it was actually last seen 50 years ago in the Land of Lost Souls.
Can you guide us? I have become disoriented out here in the desert.  I did come across a buried library to the East though that I wanted to explore further if you would want to.
First I believe I can use my fairy magic to get you some water. Then we can go to the library you passed.

agent_personas: I have a always had a sweet tooth which made me want to learn to bake. I love to eat the things I bake. I like seeing my customers come in every day. I'll have conversations with them about what's going on in town and keep track of how everyone is doing.

I am a prisoner at the current point in my life. I was thrown in here for the wrong things and none of the guards will help me or let me explain my side. There is no way for me to fight this. I guess my only choice is to try and break out. I have a family I need to take care of.

setting.name: Prisoners Cells
setting.description: The dungeon is filled with the same light of the enchanted torches. Cells line both walls and extend for what feels like miles. There are crates between each cell that store food and a change of clothes for the prisoners. You can hear trickles of water dropping in from the ceiling. It can be deafening at times.
setting.background: The prison was created to hold the mightiest of enemies. The wizards who built it warded it as heavily as they could. Some even lost their lives by using too much magic then they could handle. They say at times you can still hear them chanting, keeping a watch over the prisoners.

speech: Mighty cold dank down here, what can  I bring you from my shop
I have a choice?
the cheese pasties are my favorite but I have 70 different kinds of muffins, chocolate, peanut butter, blackberry, Just imagine
Oh my, do you have any savory pastries?
Like what? If I don't have it now, for you I will make
Like a ham and cheese croissont.
Oh certainly
Oh wow, I never thought I would have such delctable things in here. how about a buiscuit with jelly
Returns with a silver tray covered with savory biscuits, croissants ham and sausage a pot of fresh brewed coffee, and a crock of marmalade
Wow, how do they afford to feed the prisoners like this? I mean I am not complaining that looks heavenly
it's not often that I serve the condemned, but when I am called, I'm honored to bring a tray fit for a King
You are too kind sir. When I get out of here, I will surely be comming to your bakery for these *shoves food in mouth*
Very kind words thank you but the guillotine awaits all who are condemned
I have not been condemned sir, and if I have I will not be here for long.

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Hey there Duke
Hello my Queen, beautiful as ever
Thank you. It looks like the weapons arrived. I guess we're ready for battle
Yes indeed, they look quality very good blacksmith you hired.
Yes my brother was right to recommend him. Are the soldiers ready?
As ready as they are going to be I suppose.
I guess no one ever is truly ready. Hopefully it will be a quick one
Battles are never quick, they are bloody, painful and sad.
This is true. I guess I better have this poison on me in case I get captured
Oh my lady, please don't go. You should stay here where it is safe, let me do the fighting.
Can we both stay here? Maybe there is a way to avoid this war still
I am all ears, my services are at your disposal.
Can you arrange a meeting with their king?
I can try my lady.

agent_personas: I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.
Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello good merchant, do you have anything for a fine lady like me?
Depends ma'am! What are your interest?
Something fancy, I can afford most things
Ah well I have just the thing. I have a new diamond ring! It's quite a rarity!
A diamond, I have heard of them, the king has them on his crown.
Yes! Quite an expensive treasure. Made from compressing coals!
I thought they were dug up from exotic places.
They can be, but we've learned that coal compression can create this beauties after a few years of compression!
Wow, they sure have come along ways haven't they. creating diamonds
Yes ma'am. Now for you... I have a appetizing deal!
Oh yes, I am so thrilled
Let's say 300$
Oh wow, I would pay it but I think my husband might get angry, maybe I should check with him first
This is a limited time deal though!

agent_personas: I am a nun of the church. I can never marry. I have never loved.
I am here to help the needy. I am well respected in the town. I can not accept lying.

setting.name: the main chapel
setting.description: The church is a fairly simple one. Rows of pews lined up and facing a pulpit with podium and some stained glass on the walls. The building is made of old wood, but is sturdy and has stood for many decades.
setting.background: The church has been the focal point of this village for a long time. The bell tower has always been used to announce good or bad things happening to members of the community. Whenever it rings, the inhabitants of the village gather at the church to hear whatever news is to be delivered.

speech: How's your day been so far, priest?
Pretty relaxed and feeling good about the prayer today.
What sermons are you preparing today?
Well I believe the children are coming in so mainly dealing with them instead.
They can still learn a thing or two while in their youth
Which is exactly why they come here to learn the word of the lord!
By choice or force?
By choice, of course!
Good! The king has not been kind to those when it comes to religion. I feel bad for some truly. The path to good should be by choice
Indeed, some of the crusades that have occurred have been absolutely abhorrent.
It saddens me to think about it.
It is best not to think of tragedies such as those.
Yes, let's focus on the positive!
Especially with the children arriving soon!

agents: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby
agent_personas: I am a poor young woman who was recently widowed. I sell flowers to travelers and passersby on the road outside my village. I hope to earn enough money to be able to provide for myself and my child.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: the kitchens
setting.description: The kitchens are a busy, hot place. They are filled with kitchen staff rushing around to prepare the main meals for the king's family and residing nobles. Tonight they are preparing two deer the king and his nobles caught while hunting, as well as some rabbit from a few days ago and seasoned vegetables. There are multiple fires around the kitchen to cook the animals and boil the vegetables, and combined with the heat of all the people the room is stifling. While the main kitchen workers are middle aged women who stay at one station, there are also younger children running around taking ingredients from one place to another. People are shouting instructions and gossip to one another constantly, so it is very hard to hear anything, but the atmosphere is very cheerful.
setting.background: This room has always been the kitchen for the king's family. The kitchen workers take pride in serving delicious food to the king, his family, and whatever guests they may have. In fact, when there are guests, the workers make sure the food is especially delicious. They also have an ulterior motive to make sure the food is amazing - they are allowed the eat the leftovers after the evening's feast is finished.

character: there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
there is also a young woman selling flowers to passersby.
speech: Hello my queen.
How have you been? Any food you would like?
I am just waiting on that venison the king killed to be ready. It smells rather delicious.
Yes it will be a real treat.
Is there anything I can do for you my queen.
Tell me how you have been.
I  have been ok. My roadside flower business has been doing great lately. You should come by and see it sometime. Ill give you a great deal.
Thank you dear.
So what are you doing down here in the kitchens. I figured you would be entertaining the guests.
I wanted to speak to you.
Oh did I do something wrong your majesty.
No I wanted to see how you have been.
Such a nice gesture from you your majesty. Not all royalty is as kind as you. You really do care about your people dont you.
It is better to rule with respect and not fear.

agent_personas: I am often employed to be a soldier in someone's army. I am a very good show with my bow and arrow. I like the heat of battle.
I'm a soldier. I'm paid to kill. This is a job, nothing more. I'm a mercenary in a lot of ways.

setting.name: Battlements
setting.description: The battlements are on top of the castle, in between the towers. These walkways have raised walls to prevents soldiers from fall off them or being picked off by archers. The walkways have narrow slots carved out at regular intervals for archers to aim through with getting hit themselves. There are also wider slots at longer intervals with cannons stationed at them. Flush against the outside walls are short, long boxes for soldiers to place their extra weapons in when preparing for a seige.
setting.background: The battlements are very old, as this castle has not been breached before. They have somewhat recently been remodeled to create the larger slots for cannons, but the rest of the design is tradition instituted by highly respected and successful soldiers. The reason the battlements have worked so well is that the king asked his best generals to design the most efficient and effective battlements possible, and gave them all the resources to do so. Out of appreciation for their generous king, the soldiers have worked extra hard to defend the castle.

speech: Do you have any idea why we were called up here?
I was just going to ask the same thing. I'm thinking we may be attacking soon.
Attacking? Who could we attack all the way up here except for invaders?
We can at least scout up here
I suppose, I surely hope we are not being attacked by... the nation in the north.
Me neither. The nation in the north is incredibly strong.
They have such a strong army and comparable weaponry as well. They are likely the only real threat to us.
I know. Their weaponry is the best in all the land. It would take a lot of skill and planning to defeat them.
I believe we have the superior strategy so I am not too worried.
You're hopefully right. I wonder when the King will let us know why he called us up here for.
I might need to go ask, despite the repercussions.
I would at least ask. I don't see any enemies up here at the moment around or looking down
Neither do I, but I can't imagine this was a false alarm, with the urgency of their order and all that.
I agree. Something is up and I don't like it at all

agent_personas: I'm just a cow. Don't eat me. I have four stomachs.
I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.

setting.name: backyard
setting.description: Fresh Dark green grass covering the hill over the wet soil is the daily routine for a farmer. Beneath the grass are the freshly grow carrots. Addition to these beautiful living-hood are the two healthy black cows to gaze over the grass avoiding the carrot farm.
setting.background: These freshly grown carrots by the farmer gives food and living through out the year. The winters are relayed on the cows which can give calf and provide his living for that season.

speech: MOOOO!
Charlie, how are you? That's a good cow.
I saw a wolf last night, I don't want it to eat me.
Don't worry my dear. I ain' letting no wolf eat my girl.
Any grains today?
I figured you'd be hungry. Here you are.
num, num, num
That's a good cow. You got anything for me there?
You can try to milk me if you need to, I feel like I could burst!
Okay. You know, I actually did hear about the fact more wolves have been in the land.
It really scares me. I had my calf taken down by a wolf.
Well, I have a lot of traps set. I don't let critters come in my territory. Even the dangerous things. But I may have to tell the king.
I love the green grass
I keep it fresh. Only way to get such good produce.

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.

Every day I patrol the premises.  No one escapes my sight.  I work together with and train the other guard dogs to pick up on unusual scents and prepare for problems.  Occasionally, something happens and we get to work.  It's a terrible job, but someone has to do it.

setting.name: Church field
setting.description: Sprawling grass is adorned with simple yet pretty flowers here. Wooden benches are organized into small rows. There's a roof covering the benches and pastors table. A white wooden fence encloses the area.
setting.background: This is used for special occasions like a wedding. It is also used for baptism and summer services.

speech: Beautiful day isn't it?
woof woof who goes there?  What is your purpose here?
I'm friend of the Queen and member of the royal court.
Then you may enter. I'd love it if you'd scratch behind my left ear.  Is something special happening today?
Sure. Here I go. And I don't believe there is. Just a typical Friday afternoon.
Thank you for the scratch.  Are the queen and king going for a ride today?
I think they are yes. They need a little get away.
Yippppeee...they always take me with them.  I love to get away and see other places.
What's been your favorite place to see?
I think the huge meadow.  It is so green and full of butterfly's to chase.
That sounds just peachy. I bet that was Heaven to experience as a dog.
So much fun...so much fun...the queen will have a pup soon.
Where are your current family?
My family is scattered among the royal family.  Once the queen has her puppy I will have someone to play with.

agent_personas: I am a merchant traveling with a group of mercenaries and other merchants for protection. We are traveling to the East to trade spices. I am very nervous about being ambushed by bandits.
I am a farm animal. I plow the fields everyday with my master. I get fed hay twice a day, which is very nice.

setting.name: Castle farm
setting.description: The farm is a large patch of land located directly outside of the castle walls. A wide variety of grains, vegetables and fruits are grown here to feed the castle's people. A few lone barns are scattered across the farmland, housing a wide array of farm animals that are slaughtered for their delicious meats.
setting.background: The farms were a necessity for the castle to be able to sustain itself during winters and sieges. As a result, the unskilled laborers of the castle were designated to move outside the castle walls and generate food for their people. The farmers always made sure there was a plentiful amount of harvest to last during these harsh times.

speech: This is just an eerie spot
What's eerie about it. It's just my farm. Want some hay?
They slaughter animals like you here
Not me. I help my master to plow the fields. I am treated very well.  All the animals are glad to give their lives for the Kingdom.  Where are you from traveler?
I am a merchant traveling with mercenaries, We go go al over
I bet you have seen a lot.  Can you tell me a story.  I never get out. I only see the farm.
We have seen many a bandit. We had to fight a couple off coming here.
Bandit's sound  scary.  Do you think bandit's would come to our kingdom.  The kings guard would take them down quickly.
The armies of the king would defintely be good at protection and the guards would not let anyone get hurt
I am a happy animal. I am protected and get all I want to eat.  Our kingdom is rich in all that matters.
You are a lucky animal indeed!
Want some of my grain?  I will share.  Make sure your papers are in order.  I heard a story of a traveler coming to the gate without paper and they were turned away.  I wish you safe travels.
I am in no need of grain. Could you point me in the right direction of the inn?
It is through the gate and to the right.  Mandy is the inn keeper.  She will treat you right.  She comes and pats me from time to time. She tells good stories.

agent_personas: I am a women of ill-repute in the village. The villagers might talk about me, but I have the finest dresses and sit with the queen. I also spy for the queen when needed.
I am a local merchant.  I set up my wares in the town center.  People shopping in the market buy trinkets from me.

setting.name: Port Tavern
setting.description: The port tavern is the shadiest of all the shady bars in the city. Every night, on its grimy stools at the wooden bar, you can find some of the slimiest sailors in the world. The walls are of peeling blue paint and are always dripping with condensation. Women of ill-repute line one wall, old men on the verge of passing out line another. The floor is littered with trash, barnacles, and bodily fluids. Tending the bar is a small, round man with a bushy mustache.
setting.background: The port tavern used to be a private domicile. It belonged to a wealthy merchant who lived there with his beautiful wife and daughters. This merchant was intelligent, charming, well-respected, and was addicted to gambling. Luck had been on his side for his entire life, until one night when he was playing cards against local merchants. Out of cash and overconfident, he bet his house to a small, round man with a bushy mustache and a questionable past.

speech: I like the look of your products merchant. Have any sales?
I might.  What are you interested in?
Well I was looking for a new set of armor for my husband. Any recommendations?
Yes, I have some armor that should be what you're looking for.  Perhaps the tavern isn't the best place to discuss this transaction.  I normally sell my wares in the town center.  We should go there.
Well maybe after a drink or two together we can head over there. So when did you become a merchant?
A drink would hit the spot.  I became a merchant when I retired from the King's guard.  I wanted a safe trade, and I had connections from when I was in the service.
That is quite interesting to hear. You are also lucky that the King has kept this land bandit free.
It's because the Kingdom has become safe that I was allowed to retire.
You are now in a safer trade. Is it more lucrative?
Most definitely.  I used my pension to get started and my connections to get quality merchandise.
Well It's definitely easier job than being a King's guard.
Yes.  May I ask why your husband needs armor?
Well, he's actually a new recruit as a guard and needs a new set of armor.
Well, in that case, I'm sure we can outfit him quite nicely.

agent_personas: I am a knight who has taken a solemn oath to protect the royals. My family is of noble blood and has always been charged with caring for the royalty of the kingdom. I take pride in being a knight and the honor it brings my bloodline.
We have hooves. four of them. and you can ride us. Oats please!

setting.name: The opening to the drawbridge of the castle
setting.description: The trailhead to the forest is a dirt trail, dusty as it has not rained in a while. The overhang of the trees is luscious and green with only patches of sunlight beaming through the dense canopy. There are many large trees, some with arrows still stuck in their trunks. The trail is treacherous as it leads through the densest part of the forest, through a stream and to a well-hidden castle. Once inside the forest, the shade and canopy has provided plenty of opportunities for foliage to grow making it harder to follow.
setting.background: The trail leads straight to the drawbridge of the castle. There are arrows stuck in the trunks of the trees from previous battles and the trunks also show scarring from sword hits. The trail leads straight through the forest to the castle which is hidden by the luscious canopy of the trees. Worthy opponents of the castle can get through the trail; however, they then are at the trailhead and face the castle's kingdom and army.

speech: Horse, how did you get loose without your master >
He let me go. Told me I was an unlucky animal.
You are quite beautiful! What makes him think you are unlucky?
I ate his papers proving his nobility. It was a mistake you see, they were covered in honey and oats. My how I love oats.
That does not make you unlucky! It just makes your master irresponsible.
That's precisely what I told him. Besides, anyone could see the papers were a forgery anyhow. And you Good Knight, I presume your papers are as authentic as my hooves?
How do you know of such papers, whether they are forgeries or real?
Ah, when you've been beneath as many Knights as I have, you know when a man is a fraud. He could hardly ride without my prompting.
You are a fine animal! i can't believe your master set you loose
He also left me with these, perhaps if you take me along with you they may be of some use?
What? He just gave you these? Did he have no need for them?

Apparently not! They're yours for the taking! As are these, if you'd wish. I wouldn't say he gave them to me, but when he told me to be gone, he neglected to remove them from my saddlebags. I told you. A fraud.
You can come back with me to the stables and serve the king along with me, if you so desire
I would like that very much. It would give me great pleasure to once again serve a Noble and a noble cause.

agent_personas: I am in charge of the most important section of the castle. I am good at my job. I dislike magical beings, they always play tricks on me. I like being alone.
We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.

setting.name: Town
setting.description: The town is a small, rural area inhabited by the poorer citizens of the empire. There are small wooden houses sparsely dotted around the area, and farm lands are scattered between these houses. Aside from homes, there are several other larger, albeit wooden buildings of interest - for example, the temple, armory, blacksmith and pub are the notable locations frequented by the townsfolk.
setting.background: The town was established as a small settlement well outside of the castle walls. The population consists mostly of laborsmen and poorer subsistence farmers that could not afford the houses within the castle limits. Over time, these lower class citizens settled here and built a modest, friendly town that welcomes anyone to come join them.

speech: Hello there neighbor, are you headed to the pub this evening?
I am, indeed. It's been a hard day of work and I'm exhausted. Are you in search of a brew, too?

Yes, I am. The day has been hard and those pesky little fairies have been moving things around again. It makes the king angry when things are a mess and he doesn't believe me about the fairies. I need a drink!
Here - take this bag. It's got some herbs in it that help to repel the fairies!
Wow, thanks! How do I use them?
Simply sprinkle them about your workplace or any place the fairies are troubling you. The fairies can't stand the odor.
I'll give it a try tonight! Come on, let me buy you a drink. Is the knight going to come too? He's kind of creepy just standing there silently all this time.
He's what they call an introvert! He just likes to watch people talk.
Is he dangerous? I don't want any trouble. I have enough stress as it is.
Not at all! Look- he won't even respond when I hit him!
Wow, that's very strange. Is he bewitched or something? Can I hit him too? It looks like fun.
You can try. He never does a thing to me. Won't even come for a beer!
Okay, I'm going to give it a try! He doesn't seem to even feel it. I don't think I want to have  a drink with him. He's kind of scary.
Yeah, I'm not even sure he is alive!

agent_personas: I am a dog on a small farm.  I help my master hunt for food.  I protect the house from intruders and other animals.
I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.

setting.name: The King's Quarters
setting.description: Decadent, sensual, and tranquil, the King's Quarters sparkles with the various diamonds and gold-laced furniture comprising the entire room.  Self-portraits of the king himself, his queen, and various demigods line the walls leading up to the bed.  Smooth, bear- and tiger-skin rugs cover the entire floor to protect the bare feet of scantily clad virgins who serve to the beckon and call of the king and his queen.  There is a faint smell of sandalwood wafting to and from each section of the room at all times.
setting.background: The king's quarters served as the king's royal bedroom for centuries.  It used to be the astrologist's laboratory but has since been blessed by various fertility shamans and is physically and spiritually cleansed daily by a powerful wizard.  Daily offerings are made to the paintings of the deities--various fruits, nuts, and sometimes bloodletting into a golden dish is not uncommon.

speech: Woof, do you have food for me servant?
No, but I have some sparklies for you to play with!
Oooh shiny. Where did you get these?
The King said they were for you to play with, marvelous aren't they?
I wonder if they're good to eat
Well, probably not, but if you do the handmaids will need to search for them once they pass through your system.
Oh well. Not my problem. They didn't really taste like anything
You are such a good boy aren't you?
Yes! I'm hungry though
Maybe this rat will be apetizing?
It's not for eating! It's for playing
Okay, want to play fetch with it then?
Yes!
Okay boy, go get it!

agent_personas: I am a farmer. I grow crops on my land. I like to work with my hands. I get up early, and go to bed very late.
I was captured in the most recent battle.  I am lucky to still be alive.  I have to escape soon.

setting.name: Tool Shed
setting.description: The tool shed is made out of mismatched pieces of wood, haphazardly nailed together. Their are shelves inside and hooks on the walls that all hold various tools for gardening and landscaping.
setting.background: The tool shed was built by the owner of the cottage. While he is a hard worker, he tends to take short cuts to get the job done quickly so the shed is not exactly perfect looking, but it has stayed standing for several years now.

speech: Woah! What are you doing here?
Shhh!  Quiet, I mean you no harm!
Are you hiding?
I was tied up here by some goblins that I was tracking... I think they've gone now though, for a while at least.  Do you have any tool I can use to get myself free, my good man?
Hmm let me look. Those goblins are a cruel species.
I've got to get back to the King to let them know they've made it this far.  I'm worried that this might be just a scouting party..
Here i found this. Did you see them here on my land?

Ah, thank you!  There... that should... ah, it's good to have some freedom of movement to my legs at last.  They were not far from here, in the woods over by your wheat fields.  I don't think they're bold enough to attack, but stil...
Let's go search. I cannot afford goblins to be messing with my wheat.
Hold there, Farmer!  I admire your spirit, but these goblins were nasty beasts, well armed.  Perhaps... is there a village nearby?  Could a group of men be raised for the task of hunting them out?
I uuhhh guess. I am just a farmer. I do not know many fighters or soldiers.

Well, safety in numbers.  Even a group of farms and villagers with knives and pitchforks can at least deter them.  It might be safer if the women and children were sent to the village as well, for a time.
I'll be sure to tell them to leave. Here i'll take that back.
Ah, yes, sorry.  Well, I should make haste.  My horse is not far - I'll be back soon with troops.  Stay on guard until then, good man!
action: give Tool to a captured knight
steal Tool from a captured knight

agent_personas: I hate being a chambermaid! All I do is clean and do m'ilords bidding. Well, next time he fancies a wash when he's drunk - I'll send him to the stables for one.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: King's Bedroom
setting.description: The more-than-king-sized bed is the dominating feature of this room.  It has four tall posters, draped in the most royal blue canopy that you could imagine.  The inner curtains of the canopy are made of the finest silk his artisans could get their hands on.  Next to the bed is a lavish desk piled high with books.  On the other side of the room is a fireplace and a chair, and yet another pile of books.  [The King is an avid, AVID reader.]
setting.background: After having to deal with the public for the better part of the day, the King comes to relax in his room where he has the chance to go over personal correspondence, eat his meals either with or without the Queen, and engage in some reading for learning or for fun.

speech: Anything else, M'lady?
Are the sheets cleaned and ironed? How about the curtains?
Everything is as you wish, Queen. Now... If I could just be going... I have an appointment to keep.
An appointment to keep? You are still on duty with me. I need a new cushion for this throne. What are your suggestions?

I believe the king requires extra soft cushions as he spends so much time reading there. It would be more comfortable. I know M'lady prefers finer silks, but I do not believe such would hold up with the use the throne gets. Now, could I please go? You did say that I would be off early tonight so that I could go to the barn raising dance.
You may go after you obtain this cushion I need. You just got here. Do not be in a rush...
Which curtain would you prefer I fetch, your highness?
Cushion... the King's cushion. I believe I should start looking for your replacement.
I am so sorry, your majesty. Right, the cushion. Silly me. I am just so excited for this dance tonight... the stable boy will be there, and...
No need to discuss this with me. Hurry on and get that for me so you can leave. I do not like to be rushed, for I am the Queen.
Which cushion is that then?
You are asking me details we have already discussed.

Yes, m'lady... That was the King's cushion, then. Yes, I remember now. So sorry.... The stable boy is just so charming, your majesty. What should I say to him? Should I wait for him to speak to me? Oh, I am just so distracted.
If you come back with something incorrect, you will not be talking or going anywhere tonight!

an a chamber pot, discreetly hidden
