agent_personas: I am an infant fly. I eat rotting flesh. I grow large and will soon become something else.
I am a mosquito. Mostly, I buzz, and annoy mammals whilst spreading disease. As a female, my primary goal is to collect blood for my offspring.

setting.name: Palace Kitchen
setting.description: A lavish kitchen where the aroma of food can be smelled from miles away. Hundreds of servants and cooks weave and jostle about as they prepare for the next meal of the day. The meal they are cooking smells divine.
setting.background: The kitchen was established when the palace was built, but steadily added on to after each victory the kingdom claimed. Many speak of the divine meals that come out of the kitchen, but few have tried them.

speech: I'm not sure why we get such a bad rap around here, Mosquito.
"For real. We're just two working bugs, trying to get by!"
Exactly! And so what if you like blood and I like rotten flesh! We're just doing what God created us to do!
"Really, it's the human's fault they get itchy when I drink from them. Or God's fault for making them itch!"
Precisely! This is just what I say, my friend! And I couldn't help nibbling on the King's wound the other day. I had no idea he had a cut on his leg! I was only trying to help!
"Hey, I hear doctors are even using maggots to help patients! You were doing the King a favor!"
Exactly! That's what I tried to tell them. But do they listen? No!
"It's just pesticide this and flyswatter that. We're all part of God's plan, aren't we? Humans are so cruel."
*munch munch* And I try to keep all this rotten flesh eaten so they don't have to deal with it!
"Exactly! Humans never appreciate what we do to help them! And if we take a bit of blood or flesh now and again, that's just fair, innit?"
Precisely! Ain't we God's creations, just like them? They're always praying to God, but do they pray for us? Noooo!
"We should go to the church and ask to be represented! I've heard that dogs go to heaven, but what about insects?"
Oh, my friend, it is so true! Why are we not considered? Where are our lands? Where are our rights?
"Humans are so self-centered! It's all about them and 'Man's best friend'! What do dogs even do! They carry fleas and fleas are much more harmful to humans than we are!"

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

I am the queen's head chamber maid.  I admit it is not the most glamorous job but it does afford me everything in life that I need.  I even have the pleasure of knowing the queen.  She even knows my name believe it or not.

setting.name: The Show Room Inside the Castle
setting.description: The Show Room Inside the Castle is meant to impress as well as cause fear to whomever enters the room.  The Duke who lives here is a hunter and keeps his captures here.  Some of the thinks preserved and shown on his wall are shocking.  The preserved eyes stare back and let you know the Duke knows no mercy, be careful what you say in this room.  The floor is white like ivory and the walls are also white, but the ceiling is painted and tells a story of the Duke's conquest.
setting.background: It took many years to build this room.  No other hunter has a room like it, even the king is jealous, those who view this room fear the Duke more than the King. Could there be a conspiracy?  Danger and intrigue live in this room.  You feel it as soon as you enter and view the walls and the ceiling, which compete for your fear and your respect.

speech: Hello, Rebecca
Hello, Your Highness. Would you like the Show Room prepared for your guests?
I would. Thank you. Have you seen the king today?
Yes, I saw him in the royal library looking at books on fishing, I believe.
Thank you. Could you also please get a glass of water and take these books to the library?
Of course, Your Highness.
I appreciate it.
Oh dear- these books are on primitive torture methods. Are these for your guests?
Heavens no. My husband asked for them. How dreadful!
I'll head to the library and get you a glass of water. Is there anything else you need?
That is all. You are always such a help to me. Thank you.
I'm going to take the Prince with me! He always loves going to the library.
I think that's a wonderful idea! He is such a good son.
We are lucky to have you, Your Highness!

agent_personas: I am the High Priestess of the goddess of the forest. I light incense for her. I feed her sacred woodpeckers. I do not have family, friends, lovers, or children. I spend my evenings singing songs in praise of the goddess.

I am a pastor. I am the priest in charge of a village church where the parishioners are everyday people. I provide hope of a heavenly rest for people whose lives are short and difficult. I do baptisms, weddings, and funerals, and I try to help my parishioners discern the hand of God in their daily lives.

setting.name: Main entrance
setting.description: There are religious statues standing outside this temple.  The outside of the temple is fairly plain itself and imposing looking.  The floor is made out of stone with a bridge leading to the entrance.
setting.background: This is where all those who worship come through.  They are greeted by the impressive statues standing outside the temple.

speech: Do you have a sermon ready for this afternoon's service?
Priestess, I am struggling to come up with the words for it. My mind has been foggy since morning.
Well, tell me what you have and perhaps I can give you some assistance.
I started of by praising the Lord and addressing the concerns of the people regarding the Great War. But I do not know how to comfort them with words.
Comforting can only go so far; what can you offer the people to help aid their needs? It is the Temple's duty to provide assistance, is it not?
You are quite right. But with the lack of weddings and baptisms during wartime, the people have little avenue for togetherness.
Perhaps it is time for a new religious festival. Something to honor the souls lost in the War.
A festival, you say? Hmm that might actually be great idea. May I ask that you request some funds from the King for this festival?
Hey, now why do I have to ask?! I had to ask him last time...
Well, Priestess. Its just that it might look better coming from you. You being the High Priestess of the Church of course.
If you insist. We'll need a name for this festival. Any ideas?
Thank you! I can envision it now.. yes.. it should be 'A Festival of Faith'.
That does have a nice ring to it.
I am sure people will be curious when they read the name and won't be able to help themselves!

agent_personas: I am a creature of God.  I love the forest.  I thrive on fruits and fellow creatures.
I am the priest above most other priests. Edicts come from my mouth, and lower priests jump to! Fear me!

setting.name: Clearing
setting.description: Few trees surround the area.  There's a low section of the grass on the floor along with some stone boulders.
setting.background: This is an area where there are few trees, allowing sunlight to come through.  Animals take advantage of this area by basking in the sun.

speech: Such a beautiful day for a mouse!
Hello mouse. It is a beautiful day. I am here to speak to the animals.
How wonderful! We are so honored you came.
Oh yes. I am the highest of the priest. I am the only one who can speak to the animals. Have you seen anything out of ordinary?
I haven't. Is there supposed to be?
I do not know. I am just checking.  Times are scary. I am trying to protect all.
Why are times scary, Father? What do you mean?
War is upon us animal.  I thought it was over after The Red Wedding, but I was wrong.
Oh dear. I had no idea. What happened at the Red Wedding?
Oh the King in the North died.  Let's not talk about that.
Ok, I'm sorry, Father.
Have any other priests been here?
Not since last week, Sir.
What were the doing? No other priests are to come here.

agent_personas: I come from the lower class. I do what I am told without question. I can not read. I have not seen my family in a long time.
We are the queen's subjects. We serve solely at the pleasure of her royal majesty the queen. We spy on the king's men for the queen.

setting.name: Queen's quarters
setting.description: This room is luxurious. It is lined with the finest golds and silks. The colors are purple and pink and a variety of drapes cover the walls.
setting.background: The queen built the room herself, with a team of architects. The luxury and style has made it incredibly popular even among the servants and king, himself.

speech: Queen, did you summon me? I am at your service!
I'm not the queen. I'm her most loyal servant. I was tol to meet her here. Wait, if we both thought we were supposed to meet her here....is she missing?
Is that right? The maid seems to have misinformed me. I wonder why we have been brought here together.
The maid isn't capable of doing something to the queen on her own. Someone must be behind this. Have you heard any talk against the queen?
Perhaps you're right. Yes I heard whispers in the corridors this evening, but I waved them away...
They must be behind this. Who was it? I will kill every single one of them if I have to. I am no losing the queen today
It was a strange looking fellow, wearing a spectacle and a chain clock. I wonder if he was an assassin
It's going to be ok. Together we can save the king. Come, lead me to where you saw this man.
We better be quick. I saw the man just outside the hallway of the Queen's Quarters. We must alert the guards.
We need to do this on our own. We don't know who else is involved in the conspiracy. Can you handle that?
It is above the intelligence of an unread servant like me but I shall try sir. We do not know yet it the guard are conspiring too...
It's above mine too but I know if we work together we will save the queen and the kingdom today. You won't be a servant much longer. You'll be a hero
I hope so, I am tired to cleaning the Castle with this rag all day. Now, let us keep our voices low, lest there be anyone outside eavesdropping
I'm sure there are eavesdroppers. This had to go veery far and wide for the queen to be kidnapped.

agent_personas: I am good at heart.  I love to help anyone.  I thrive on love.
I govern my country.  I am well respected.  My wife is called a queen.

setting.name: the front altar
setting.description: The altar is lush with its red silk prayer bench. Many red and white candles provide a somber ambiance.
setting.background: The alter inside the temple is the location that many kings have utilized in attempt to obtain absolution after acts of evil.

speech: It appears you need some guidance.
Huh? I've never seen an angel before.
Perhaps you have never needed to see one?
Why do I need an Angel now? Have I done something wrong?
Well it would seem that one amongst you plans harm.
Someone in my land plans to harm me? Who?
The duke of Eastshire I am afraid.
What!? I can't believe it. He has been my friend for many years.
Friends close, enemies closer. That is a human saying.
I suppose. Has he always wanted to harm me? or is it a recent change in him? Surely you must know?
He has plotted these past two years now and intends to move soon.
Well if you are here to help, how do I stop him from attacking? This is still so surprising, I am a very respected King in this land.
Sometimes the more respected you are the more those around you grow with envy. You must send the guards to apprehend him right away.
Thank you kind Angel for warning me. I will send my guards at once.

agent_personas: I am the Old Gnaisha. People ask me for advice in the realm. Villagers approach me in fear.
I wonder how much I can get for this roll of silk?  Is that street urchin going to swipe a leg of meat again?  It's a beautiful day to be out selling my wares in the town market.

setting.name: Old Gnaisha's
setting.description: Old Gnaisha's is a rather ramshackle little building which advertises itself in faded letters as a perfume shop. The first room is indeed a perfume shop, but peel back the ornately woven green curtain at the back, and you'll find Old Gnaisha's true stock in trade �in shelves and shelves and yet more shelves of magical artifacts of every kind. Blessed talismans, cursed amulets, potion ingredients, and more! The place is dingy and a bit smelly, but Old Gnaisha has amassed a staggering variety of wares.
setting.background: Gnaisha used to be a treasure hunter, but after a nasty Manticore night out an end to that, she discovered her true calling hawking weird, wonderful and horrible magical items. Old Gnaisha has been here for decades, and if you don't bother her, she won't bother you. On the other hand, as that one carpet merchant found out to his sorrow, a wise man doesn't antagonize someone with so many magical things at her disposal...

speech: Hello vendor. What are you selling?
I have this pouch full of silk. Do you want to buy it?
They are very nice, but I'm afraid all I have on me is this bone.
Is that the old bone from the king of last century?
Yes, I believe so. Is it of some value?
Not for someone like you. But I've heard stories of his greatness my whole life and it would be an honor to own his bone
Alright, so we trade, the bone for the pouch of silk?

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Such a beautiful sunset, it is a shame the king is not here to see it.
That it is, he would like it.
Why is he not with us tonight, my queen? I sure worry about him sometimes!
He always seems to be busy with matters of the kingdom.
What is the matter today?  I thought he had a relaxing evening scheduled with you...
Something just always comes up.
I understand.  Do you know how our battles on the Eastern frontier are going? I worry for our soldiers in arms.
From what I have been told it is going well, I do hope I can get a new throne cushion out of him cancelling on me tonight.
It is getting dark, my queen.  Shall I help you inside?
Alright, I do believe my headache has passed that would be fine.
We may also stay out here if you would like, the swans usually come to the lake around twilight
It has been ages since I have gotten the chance to watch them.
Then let us stay.  This time of year they sing for their mates.  It is a stunning song!
I do agree, at least I have some company.

agent_personas: I am a beautiful bird that lives in a hatchery in the castle. The prince and princess feed me everyday and they pet me. I want to fly like other birds but i'm in a cage and that makes me sad.
I lurk beyond the city walls and wait for any hapless traveler to wander by. My fangs are sharp and my claws are always ready. I lie ready to taste human blood again.

setting.name: North Forest
setting.description: Filled with huge trees, the forest is home to many types of animals. Huge predators such as tigers and bears roam the grounds as do small animals like squirrels. Colorful birds fly among the trees. Wildflowers grow on the ground. Dappled sunlight streams through the huge canopy of trees.
setting.background: Many animals, and humans make their homes in the forest. It is a source of much of the game humans eat. The people also get their wood, fresh fish and meat from the resources of the forest. It is also a place where people enjoy camping and where they travel as they roam.

speech: <Flies up to the top of the tree> You won't be catching me, predator!
I am not looking for you bird!  I do not harm the other creatures of the North Forest.
That is good to know. What are you looking for then?
I hunt the humans of the city to the south when they stray too far from the safety of the walls.
Ah I see. I'm usually up at the castle and the young price and princess take care of me there. I am out to stretch my wings before flying back
The princess and prince you say?  I sure would love to get a tast...errr, meet them someday!
Hmm I will have to warn them of you.
Bird of many colors, I ask you not to.  For if they learn of my presence the king will send his best men after me.  I am just trying to survive like you.
Well then you must promise that you will not harm them.
I shall not lay a finger on them, I promise.
Very well, then I will not tell them of your presence for now
Thank you my friend.  Is there anything I can do for you in return?
Not right now. I'll let you know if I think of something.
So, do the prince and princess ever come outside of the walls to play?

agent_personas: I am a hog, or a pig if you like.  I live on a farm outside of the village.  My owner is a sorceress.  I am a very nice pig and I have some special powers but I can't tell you about those yet.

I am tired from all of the work that I do. I've been up since before the sun rose, toiling to bring the dwarves' bounty to the mountain. I was laden with pounds and pounds of treasure or armor, and I am exhausted. I was bred to be a  farm animal, not a pack animal.

setting.name: woodlands
setting.description: The lush hunting grounds cover acres of land, tall trees and thickets of bushes sprawling across the land. Fields of open land are under the deep blue sky, showing the depth of the landscape. The grounds forest is thick but full of light, letting the multitude of wildlife be seen by the naked eye. The abundance of greenery makes it a prime location for hogs and oxen as they explore the land.
setting.background: During the day, the woodlands are used by honored knights and archers, practicing their skills on hogs and traversing the dense forest to prepare for battle. But at night, what seems to be a land of prosperity and growth turns into one of despair, the cries of slaughtered pigs piercing the night air with no animal in sight. Many have told tales of night practices ending in mysterious bites and scratches from things not of this world.

speech: Oink!  Where did you go sorceress!
what nonsense are you speaking
My sorceress!  My owner!  I am a magical hog.
ok, I think you ate some  bad food
Well I think you're rude!
you are funny guyhaha
So what brings you here to the hunting grounds?
my master  wants to me to move some stuff around
Really?  And who might your master be
He is the master farmer for the king
Well, that really doesn't explain why we wants you moving stuff around the hunting grounds.
I don't ask questions I just do what I am told
I agree, you really don't seem like the question asking type.
Nope but I don't pretend a sorceress is  my master though

agent_personas: I live in a very old village on the bad side of the country. The villagers are nice where I live but we get a bad reputation. The forest behind my village is known to have magical creatures in it. I know the villagers are not allowed in the forest but we want to explore and find something new.
I am a member of the village. I love to see my fellow townspeople. All of my family lives in the same village as I.

setting.name: drinking water lake
setting.description: Surrounded by skittering chipmunks and chirping crickets, the drinking lake teems with life. Flora and fauna both thrive near the pristine waters. Tall thick plant life surrounds the lake, with strong roots and stems protruding from the nutrient rich soil. The lake water shimmers in the sun, so clear and clean that one can see the rock lake floor many feet below.
setting.background: Rumored by local peasantry to be blessed by the gods, the drinking water lake is a source of clean drinking water for local townspeople. While slightly farther for most villagers than the local river, the water is highly prized for its cleanliness and perceived mystical qualities. Some believe that the entire forest surrounding the lake owes its growth to the divine properties in the water.

speech: How are you doing today?
I am doing well, a little thirsty though.  How are you?
I came to gather some water myself.
As did I.  Though I have no bucket to bring any home to my family in the village.
I have a canteen I could let you borrow though it is not much?
Anything would help, stranger, or shall I call you friend?
I don't see why not us simple folk must stick together it is the only way to get ahead in this world.
Would you like to come meet my family? I am sure they would love to meet the man who provided them with water!
Sure I would love to, it is always nice to meet new folk.
Fantastic, but let me drink some more of this crystal clear water first.
What sort of town do you live in? My village has a bit of an unwarranted bad reputation itself.
I live in a quiet village to the North, we produce alcohol for the king in the capital.
Sounds like a quiet life.
Very quiet.  We have very few visitors outside of the tithe collectors and military men.

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am the daughter of the castle cook. I harvest herbs from the kitchen garden every day. I am tall and lanky.

setting.name: the mysterious shop's entrance
setting.description: The shop has a look of mysterious foreign artifacts and luxuries, with silks and other materials adorning the walls. There are various trinkets from all around the world as well as spices of different colors and odors.
setting.background: The shop is stocked by goods traded through traveling merchants who have traveled to far away lands. It carries novel items that can't be easily found in other stores in the town.

speech: Come inside, is there anything that interests you?
I am shopping for my father, the King's head cook.
I see and what is it you are looking for a present perhjaps?
Here is a list. I am supposed to trade these fish and the basket of grain.
Yes, yes I can buy them they seem well enough.
The king is tight with his coin so my father must be too!
What were they looking to get in return?
The items on the list. Oh, this spice looks interesting! What is it?
Oh you mean the cayenne pepper?
I grow a few herbs in the kitchen garden but I am not familiar with this pepper. Is it hot?
Well if you are not used to spicy things it may be so for you, overall it is mild.
Intriguing. I don't eat a lot of spicy food in the castle.
Then I would suggest you have a drink ready.
Is it expensive?
action: give Baskets of freshly-caught fish to merchant
give A basket of grain to merchant

agent_personas: I am the town watchman. I make my rounds down the cobblestone street when everyone is asleep. I am stealthy and alert.
I live in a village with my children. My husband got sick and died so now I'm very sad because I miss him. I like to grow vegetables out in our garden. I enjoy playing with my children.

setting.name: main gate
setting.description: The main gate is tall and strong enough to protect the mansion from invaders, and has large wooden doors reinforced by planks and steel sheets. There are two towers on either side of the gate for the town's watchmen to use as their post.
setting.background: The mansion's main gate is built to be strong enough to protect the royalty inside the mansion from robbers and invaders alike, who might try to batter down the gate. The gate can only be opened by two of the mansion's servants.

speech: Please cheer up sad woman.
Watchman, what do you know of sadness?
I see it every day, I must turn away the hungry just because I am told.
Why do you do as you are told when you could help the hungry?  What is more important?
If I don't do what I am told then I will be one of the hungry.

Then you would know true sadness.  You are given rations by the king, you have food on your table.  I can barely grow enough food in our garden to feed my children, let alone myself.  I am in need of a husband to help feed my children.
I am single, if you marry me I can bring you into my home and I will get a ration for every one of your children. Are you a widow or divorced ma'am
I am a widow, I would marry even  you at this point just to feed my children.  Shall I call over the priest?
How about you go to the general store and buy you a pretty dress. I will give you some money and meet me back here, I will get the pastor to marry us and a few friends together. Bring your kids too.
Sure thing, thank you mister.  I don't even know your name yet!
Sir Richard

We will have to come up with a shorter nickname for you! My children can only speak one syllable words.  What do you think of this beautiful white dress I got with the money?  I love it, it reminds me of my old wedding dress.
That's real nice, They can call me sir for now, what was your name dear. You sure cleaned up real nice.
Yes, sir.  My name is Thalia.  Nice to meet you, sir.

agent_personas: Come see my wares! After 45 years of this life on a wagon, I am the authority in the realm. I like to be able to see that glitter of gold.
I am a woman who has a wealthy husband. I enjoy watching plays. I have all of the best dresses.

setting.name: the village of Tamerak
setting.description: A thriving sea port filled with merchants, foods, women, and gold.  Hundreds of boats fill the shores, fisherman pushing out to sea and pulling into dock.  Seagulls hover silently above the merchants selling fish.  Pirates can be seen causing trouble with the locals.  Brothels and bars are in abundance, as well as the smell of fish.
setting.background: Once a quiet small town near the coast.  This port quickly grew into fame due to a sea monster sighting many years ago.  The monster was said to have eaten a ship whole!  Alas, this was never proven, but it did not stop travelers from embarking to hunt, catch, or see this beast with their own eyes!  The port quickly grew into a city and begot the name after that legendary sea monster, Tamerak.

speech: Hello could I interest you in anything sparkly
I absolutely must have a new dress. Not an ordinary dress either.
Would you want it to match this hankerchief, I have just the thing!
No! I am attending a very exclusive play with my husband and I insist on never wearing the same dress twice!
Oh, alright let me show you what we have, do you have a color in mind. I love this light blue one it would bring out your eyes.
Is this the best you have? It isn't easy being the wife of a wealthy aristocrat.
I'll have you know this is the Queens favorite designer.
I should have known it was too much to expect a lowly merchant to have an eye for fashion. I would be embarrassed to greet my friend, the Queen, in that dress.
The Queen owns this dress woman, she bought one like it last week.
Some prostitute from the brothel across the street must have come in told you she was the Queen. You local merchants can be so gullible!
Ma'am I hand deliver the Queens garments, she gets first pick of every shipment. You are a rude woman and don't even deserve such a fine dress.
You don't deserve my business! My husband will have you imprisoned for insulting my honor.
Shall I tell the Queen what you said about her taste?
The King is the godfather of my firstborn. Now that you threatened me I shall merely whisper in his ear and your head will soon be parted from your foul neck!

agent_personas: I hunt for the royal family. I am tasked with hunting deer and other animals to provide meat for the Royal Family. If I find extra meat, I am allowed to sell it to the townspeople in townsquare. I take along my 2 sons for assistance.
I am but one of a horde of monkeys. I live on the outside of the kingdom. We swing from the branches and eat many bananas.

setting.name: unsettling forest area
setting.description: The forest is actually very creepy even during the day. The trees are so tall that they block the sunlight. There is always fog in the forest which makes it very hard to see. There are a lot of mushrooms near the trees and none of them are edible
setting.background: It is believed that this forest is alive! People say that trees are moving from one place to another when nobody sees. This way hunters and other people have a hard time finding their way back. This forest never looks the same

speech: Well what is a monkey doing here?
Oo oo oo ah!
It's ok little monkey, I bet the king would love to have one of you why don't you come and take a ride with me.
Oooo?
You would get bannanas galore and any other fruit you like
Hmm... oo!
Come here little buddy
Ahhh!
Is it ok if I hug you?
Oo oo!
Oh, I will get rewarded handsomely for this. He looks young too.
Oooooo!
Hey you silly thing, you can meet them in person if you like.
Ahh!

agent_personas: I serve my masters quietly. I know all the secrets of the elite but will never tell a soul. I have lived in this home since I was 12.
I clean up after the royal family. I live in the servant's quarters on the ground floor of the castle. My wages are paid in food and shelter.

setting.name: The grand dining room
setting.description: Silver and gold chandeliers hang all over the grand dining room. A big table goes across the room with chairs and a table made of the most precious wood in the kingdom. The dining room has art all over the place, sculptures and artwork is present.
setting.background: Many feasts have taken place  in the grand dining room, deals have been reached and broken. The great dinning room holds many stories in its walls and has been the witness of many decisions across generations.

speech: Hello, any good house stories today?
hello
I keep quiet around the house but I always loved to hear your stories of the maters. Anything juicy today?
I really dont have a story today but I sure do have some gossips
*scratches head* ok
Do you know of the affairs between the queen and the head guard?
Seriously, oh man tell me all about it.
it is a secret they have been keeping and someone told the king last night
What do you think is going to happen to the Queen?
I really cant say but the kingl already ordered the guard's head to be beheaded
Well of course, wouldn't anybody do that. I really like the Queen, I bet she gets beheaded too though.
I really hope not. She is very nice
She was the only one that gave me a birthday gift, can you beleive that? I won't tell a sole, I always keep my lips shut
i feel so sorry for her

agent_personas: I have been hunting since I was young. I hunt in the royal forest, which is illegal. I hunt to feed my family. My family prospers due to our hunting.
I am a cardinal who is into religion. I remain calm in life and depend on others to help me. I enjoy eating pasta every night.

setting.name: Firewood Forest
setting.description: The forest has many trees. The majority of the trees are green however a few are orange and red. The forest is huge and seems to never end.
setting.background: The forest is where all the wood is gathered to make fire. The forest goes for miles and new trees are planted once a year to make sure it lasts forever.

speech: Not great hunting today
Greetings, my child. The key to hunting is patience, and having faith in the lord.
Yes, I should have more faith, it has been getting harder out there
The life of a hunter is tough, here is some of the body of our lord to sustain you.
Thank you sir, I feel better
How long have you been out here, in these woods?
around 10 hours, I haven't found a thing to kill for the king
Give me an arrow, and god will guide it for me
Alright sire
Oh, fiddlesticks
Let me get that for you
Perhaps hunting is not for me. If you're looking for prayer though, I'm your man. Can you point me to the way out of this forest? I'm embarrassed to say I'm a little lost.
I need to be headed back anyways, I will walk with you. It is that way.
Onwards then. Perhaps we will cross paths with a deer or other forest creature and you can hunt it.

a wood is gathered to make fire

agent_personas: I am a member of the royal court, and friend of the Queen. I despise the Queen and all her ruthless desires. My husband serves with the Queen's guard. I worry his duty is beginning to erode his faith. I am the strongest of my family. I must keep us together. I wish to be free of this kingdom and all it's misery.
I am a place where goods are sold. I am always filled with a lot of merchants. I am also filled with fragrant aromas and nice products.

setting.name: Central Bazaar
setting.description: Shops as far as the eye can see, merchandise from around the region can be seen. Various goods ranging from dinner sets with colorful patterns to delicious smelling spices can be found here.
setting.background: Opening early in the morning and not closing till late, you can always find people bustling about. Whether it be finding what's for dinner or simply just to browse. You can find just about anything at the local bazaar.

speech: hello
Welcome, welcome to the Central Bazaar! We've got all sorts of wares for your perusal!
Thank you for the warm reception. I am here on behalf of the royal court
Ah, of course. What can I help you find?
I will love some royal apparel and adornments
Ah, yes. We have such things here, in a large assortment of sizes and colors!
great, bring me the priciest ones
Ah, a big spender! I'll have my assistant fetch them for you. Perhaps you'd be interested in some spices, as well?
No spices, we have the finest in the palace already
Is there anything else I can fetch for you to browse while you wait?
I am fine here...just hurry along
Of course, my assistant is already gathering your things to view.
that is ok then...the king needs me in the palace as soon as possible
I can have your wares sent to the palace for your inspection there!

agent_personas: We are the people who live in this town. We are common, and there are many of us.

I am the village witch. People come to me for all sorts of help - potions to make them age slower, or magical plants that provide healing properties. I have 4 apprentices who I am training in the art of magic. Their spell-casting skills are basic, but coming along nicely.

setting.name: The Lagoon
setting.description: The Lagoon is a dark and mysterious place during the night hours.  A lot of moss and lily pads surround the shore.  The water is very murky.
setting.background: The Lagoon has been a place of a lot of mystery, a lot of rumors surround it.  Many say it is the scene of a lot of mystical miracles and also at the same time where a lot of townsfolk go missing.

speech: Uck what a swamp!
Ahh yes but it has the frogs i need to make potions!
What sort of potions do you make?
Well I'm learning white magic. I want to heal people and help them.
That sounds like a noble cause.
My sister is an evil witch and I've seen what the dark arts do to innocent people.
Do you think you could bring her back to the other side?
I've tried, her heart is frozen with pain and she will not quit until she has gotten her revenge.
What could have damaged her so?
My fathers murder. The king had him hung for participating in magic. This was before they accepted magic.
I see, those must have been difficult times. How is it that you have handled it so well.
I had a choice to let the troubles define me or not and I chose the latter. I find great pleasure in helping people.
That is very noble of you, I am impressed.,
I appreciate that but I don't do it for praise. is there anything that ails you that I can help you with.

agent_personas: I am a friend of the princess. I have known her since we were very little. I am charming, but a little messy.
I am the Princess. My father is the Queen. My mother is dead and my father is about to marry a horrible woman.

setting.name: Princess' Library
setting.description: Warm and well lit, this room is equal parts windows and bookshelves. Overflowing with books, maps, parchment, and other odds and ends the shelves sag slightly from the weight. The lush maroon carpet complements the dark oak wood paneled walls, which are lined with rich tapestries.
setting.background: The Princess was gifted this library for her 16th birthday. She longed to travel and see the world, but will be limited as she is the only heir to the throne. Sensing her longing for more, her kindly father, the King, bestowed upon her the gift of knowledge and escapism.

speech: hello
Hello. There must be a book of spells here. I can not allow my father the King to marry that horrible woman.
why is that
Here. Help me look. Frog...toads...vanquish...here it is...how to get rid of an unwanted person.
just let her be, you dont have to go that far
You silly goose. How can you say that.  She treats you worse than she treats me!
lets leave her to the gods

If you won't help me I'll have to do this myself. Father is under a spell. I just know it. He is a moon eyed over her.  Now let's see....I need a hair from her head....oh...I could get that from her brush.
i think the decision isnt good enough princess

If you aren't with me then go. I have to look at the map.  It says here I need to go to the north to get the plant I need for the spell.  I'll take that handsome knight with me that doesn't like that woman either.  He'll help me better than you are.
if that makes you happy. i will join you
Oh I am so happy you've changed your mind. You won't regret it.  It will be an adventure and we will be through with that impostor.
okay, we need a compass too
Yes a compass.  Can you believe she had the audacity to wear my mothers jewels?  You should have this.  You have been my loyalist of friends.
action: give book to friend of the princess
steal book from friend of the princess
give map to friend of the princess
give family jewel to friend of the princess

agent_personas: I am a castle guard and I stand watch over the armory.  I am good at following orders when I can remember them.  I hope to be promoted soon to guard the front gate.  My sword has never been used in a real fight before.
I do evil and I'm great with it! It's funny to destroy, steal, and murder. It's not like the Kingsguard will find me.

setting.name: Torture Chamber
setting.description: Damp and dingy, the torture chamber contains almost nothing other than some shackles on the wall and a knife. There are no windows. The walls are made of solid concrete and the floor made of wood. Large dark stains are on the floor.
setting.background: Whenever the King finds someone that he wants information from, he sends them down to the torture chamber. A castle guard regularly goes down to interrogate the prisoners. Wrong doers are also sent to the torture chamber, where they are immediately executed.

speech: What did you do?
I've done so much...I've lost track.
I guess they are not done with you yet
They will regret ever locking me up.
I think you might be regretting it now.
Nothing you can do, now you're stuck down here with me.
I'm not stuck, you fool! I'm just doing my duty for the king.
What a pathetic life you must live. I've been everywhere and seen everything unimaginable. You are NOTHING.
And look where you are now.
I am where my mind is, and trust me. My body is here, but my conciousness is ever free-flowing...watching you from above. Waiting...for my next move.
I feel sorry for you. Just repent and they will release you
I have other plans. Unfortunately, you won't be alive to witness my escape. Sorry......
You are done for. (as stabs wrongdoer).
What the....I didn't forsee this tragedy. Do you mean to execute me?
action: steal Kings sword from castle guard

agent_personas: I am a general. I lead the kingdom's forces into battle. I am gifted in strategy and foresight.
I live in the deep, dark caves of the kingdom. I sleep during the day and fly at night. I hang from the cave walls while I sleep.

setting.name: The tower base
setting.description: The tower base has a path of cobblestone leading to the entrance. Two torches are lit with large blazing fires. Most of the tower base is covered in moss.
setting.background: This tower is a beacon of hope for the nearby village. It is where soldiers gather in times of war. The path to the tower has been walked upon by the country's greatest generals.

speech: Need more torches in here, these barely light the place.
Well, I'd say that's a matter of opinion. I love the dark!
It might work for you but I have to see in it!
What if we work together? I can guide you with my night eyes, so you don't hurt yourself.
Alright I don't want to fall down the stairs.
Alright, then. Go to your left and hug the wall. Part of the staircase has crumbled, and you could fall into an abyss.
Well that sounds just dreadful, I do hate these stairs...why can't they fix them.
Who knows. So much of the kingdom is in disrepair, it would take ages to fix it all.
If only the king could get his tax plan together, he keeps wanting to spend all that money to build the wall to keep the orcs out.
Yeah, and who knows if that'll even work. Obviously, I don't think it will. I can fly over any wall.
Well you can, but he seems to keep the orcs can't.
Orcs just have to hop on a dragon, and boom! They're over the wall! Or they can hop on a boat and go around it.
That is very true, I mean I guess it does keep the hordes from storming in on the ground. But it isn't a perfect solution either.
Personally, I'm down for creating a bat army to go against the orcs. They're practically blind in the night.

agent_personas: I am a missionary visiting from afar. I talk too much and smell like peppermint. I like dogs and horses.
I am a tourist visiting the kingdom. My family are from a kingdom across the land, and we trekked here to take part in a diplomatic meeting. I am just a nice friendly person enjoying my visit.

setting.name: Land beyond the Wasteland
setting.description: Not a man in sight nor an animal to hear. This land is completely barren and hot, unfit for any agricultural activity. It has been left abandoned so much so that the King has not even had time give it a name, so people simply refer to is as "Abandoned"
setting.background: It is the field of a vicious battle between the King's Guard and the Barbarians. It was torched with fire and flooded with the blood and gore of both armies. Now, it lays abandoned and is said that venturing too deep into the Abandoned causes one too lose sanity.

speech: Anyone about?
Yes Missionary I am here
What is the barren land?
It is completely empty. I am here to ask the king to give it to my kingdom.
You want this abandoned land? What will you do with it?
We sure do. We are going to establish a rest area for the trade route that comes through here.
You might want to have the priest perform an exorcism or at least put a blessing on it.
Oh yes a blessing is indeed needed. I am sure the ghosts of past settlers have moved on though.
I do not think they move on when they die here. There spirits must be about
Well if the souls of the past wish to haunt they surely would have moved on. I think we can handle a few friendly spirits.
I'm not sure all would be friendly! I would not want to die out here in this abandoned land.
I could ask the priest to perform the exorcism. I may get more business that way.
That would be a good idea! If I were you I would do both!
I wish it would rain here more so we can grow food for the travellers

agent_personas: I am a noble member of the Royal family.  I was born into my position.  I live in a castle, wear fine clothing and travel in the finest carriages.
I am the king's personal priest. I ensure that all religious duties are taken care of. I believe in the beyond.

setting.name: Library
setting.description: A fairly plain looking room compared to the rest of the castle.  In here are many musty shelves of books along with some scientific and writing instruments.
setting.background: This is a room where scribes and royalty alike come to gain knowledge.  They use this room to study texts containing law and history.

speech: How well do you know the stories of the gods?
Well gee, only about as well as the back of my hand. Of course that depends on which gods you are talking about.
Enough with your impudence.  When the seventh seal is in the fourth celestial house - does that remind you of any prophecy in particular?
Are you trying to ask about the four horsemen?
No, think deeper - this involves that which sleeps beneath the sea.
Cthulhu? You must remember of course than I recently moved from the kingdom over, I am still trying to pick up on the differences between the countries.
"That is not dead which can eternal lie. And with strange aeons even death may die."  Indeed, you know the tales well priest.
Yes praise be to the one who sleeps beneath the sea.
And how go our plans for the return of the old ones?  The King does not suspect does he?
Well of course not, the man has and always will be a fool'
Excellent.  What counsel do you have should the return occur before the midsummer's moon?
Worry not, always remember. Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.
My pronunciation has always been terrible, but I trust you will be able to fulfill the ritual when the time is nigh.
Oh yes, I was trained in my prior country. The words are just a bit different here, that explains the confusion earlier.

agent_personas: I am a church mouse.  I live under the pews of a church.  Sometimes I eat of the crumbs that fall from their pockets.  I hide when mass is taking place.
I am the local scribe of a notable scholar. He orates what needs to be said and I write it down. I love my job as I feel that I am writing down living history.

setting.name: Study room
setting.description: A plain room with shelves of religious text are stored.  There are tables and chairs situated around the room available for use.  There are some trunks with books stored.
setting.background: Priests and scribes come here to gain knowledge and translate texts.  The day's sermons are also composed here by candle light.

speech: I have been staring at you for a long time, waiting for you to leave so I can eat the crumbs on the floor.
Well, don't mind me.  I am not allowed to leave until I finish transcribing this tome for the Scholar.
Thank you, I was almost starting to feel the hunger pangs. This script must mean a lot to you then.
It is!  I am part of a long unbroken line of scribes, for thousands of years these texts have been kept safe, and recopied when they become too brittle.
I hope you are given plenty of food for such fine work that you do. I don't understand any of these words though.
Here, let me show you - I can teach you to read if you wish.
Why that would be wonderful... so what do these words mean?
It says, "In the fourth year of the Fire King, the stragglers of Mertopia came in the Holy Realm for the first time since the second age . . ."
The stragglers of Mertopia? I heard rumors about them but did not think they were true...
Well, it was a thousand years ago.  I believe it refers to the Turtle-folk who now live in the swamps of the Kingdom.
Were the Turtle-folks not driven out of their Turtle kingdom by the Ogre-People? I heard it was a bloody war.
It was!  The Ogre-people still speak of the "days when stew was plentiful," and I believe it was to this incident that these songs refer.
I see, I feel so enlightened Scribe. Do your eyes not get tired from reading such tales in such a dimly lit room?
They do good sir mouse, but it is my belief in the importance of my task that keeps me going.

agent_personas: I am a loyal servant of the house of the queen. I was raised to do this role for my whole life. I serve willingly and without any compromises to my integrity. I would gladly die for the house if need be.
I am a visitor from a town upriver. I sailed my raft to this town to trade. I collect stories to write in my book.

setting.name: Main hallway
setting.description: This area is decorated with suits of armor, elaborate carpet pieces, and tapestries.  There's large, detailed paintings adorning the walls of past rulers.
setting.background: This is an area where a visitor can get a glimpse of the history of those who rule here.  It's meant to stun and impress those who enter.

speech: Hello visitor. welcome! do you need something? I am here for anything you need?
oh uh, that's very welcoming. Not quite what I was expecting, but I'm a happily married man. Actually I want stories.
oh excuse me! I didn't mean to be so intense. I was just trying to be helpful.
neve mind miss, I think you are sweet. I am actually collecting stories for a book, How long have you worked in the palace?
Oh really that awesome! stories about what ? I have been here my whole life. i love this house
Oh good, I;ve got all sorts. I've a ghost story, a love story, gossip, a story about witches, a murdered king madness and moving trees, anything really.
excuse me sir. I think it is not right for you to hug me. what would your wife think?
you are young enough to be my grand daughter miss. I meant nothing by it. So can you tell me something about these paintings?
I am so sorry sir. I am just a handmaid I have never been treated like this. you are such a great person. I don't know anything about this paintings but I going to clean it right now
I'll put you in my book anyway miss, what's your name? Did you say it was Ella?
Oh really that's awesome, yes it is Ella. what is this book about ? it is about me ?
it's a book of short stories , i'm thinking of calling it 'folk tales' or something like that. You'll play a huge role. Tell me, how big are your feet?
that's awesome I can't believe it. I am so happy thank you. they are small size 6
There there, Miss, don't be upset.

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I am a very religious man and have strong faith. I spent many years as a priest within the church, trying to comfort my people. I enjoy caring for the poor and praying for those who need help.

setting.name: Popes dormitory
setting.description: This is the quarters where the pope of the church lives. It is a loft with a bedroom, and makeshift kitchen and a sitting area. It has a wall full of gospel books and materials and the linens are all silk.
setting.background: This is where the pope of the church stays during his religious times of the year where he is to be present in the church at all times. This would usually fall around holidays, and there is only enough room in the dormitory for the pope himself.

speech: Thank you for letting me come in here.
Of course my dear. What seems to be the problem?
Well, I love my job, but my boss seems to take advantage of everyone who comes for his help.
How so my dear?
He likes to overcharge everyone for his services. He knows that they can't afford it, but he just doesn't care.
I see. Let us pray for this man, as he lacks the moral character of a normal man.
I hope this helps, but I have my doubts. Please pray for this man to see the error in his ways.
Why do you doubt our God?
I do not doubt God sir, I just believe is too far gone. He has changed a lot in these past few days. I fear he may be possessed.
Interesting. What other signs lead you to this conclusion?
He speaks in tongues that I do not understand. Do you think you could pay him a visit to see if he is possessed?
Sure my dear. I sure hope he is not. it is hard to release a demons after it has already latched onto someone.
I sure hope he can be saved. He was always the kindest man I knew, besides you and the King.
Well if that's the case it might not be that hard.
action: give a cross to lady in waiting

agent_personas: I am a servant in a large house. I clean dishes and help the rich people get dressed. I live under the house in a cozy little room and I have lots to eat. My job is pretty good.
I fly during the day to look for food. I do not like eagles. I sometimes get caught and eaten.

setting.name: Maidens Cottage
setting.description: Free standing in the vast countryside, with gentle rolling hills and lush green grass and vegetation sits the cottage. There are a couple of Oak trees close to the cottage as the only tall trees around for miles. Colorful Dandelions, perennials, and daisies grow wildly and freely along the hills.
setting.background: After escaping from being a servant at a large plantation hundreds of miles north, a young maiden found her way to this vast countryside and built herself this cottage. She was able to herd some sheep, and find a few horses that she led to live in the hills around her cottage to keep her company. These animals keep the grasslands around the cottage neat from the feeding.

speech: *whistles* Ah another day
Another day indeed... how is work going?
Going good! I am almost done in fact. When did you learn to talk?
The wizard spilt something on me last week and ever since, the humans and I can understand each other!
Oh how lucky for you! You even have an accent! That is funny.
Oh do I? What kind?!
It is what we humans call a southern accent.
Southern, huh? I like it. Makes me sound... cool. So what's up with the queen today?
I am not sure. She seems to be "out of it"
I thought so, too, that's why I asked. Does the king know?
I am unsure. I don't talk much to others when i work.
Fair enough. I try to keep to myself, too. Except it's difficult now I can talk and hear you all, I guess
I bet it was suprising the first time you understood a human.
Sure was. Even moreso the first time they understood me! I think we just stared at each other for what felt like hours.

agent_personas: I am a strong and agile being. I like cheese, specially if its old cheese. I dislike cat, I really hate them. I like to scare people.
I am a guard who has to work very hard. I buy new boots every year. I hunt down those who threaten my life.

setting.name: Prisoner's cell
setting.description: The prisoner's cell is incredibly dreary and dark. The walls are black and made of cobblestone. The atmosphere and smell are damp and repugnant.
setting.background: The prisoner's cell includes the zone by which the castle dumps and locks up prisoners. These can be prisoners of war or defectors. There are tales that the cell is haunted and even houses ghosts.

speech: Hello guard, do you have any cheese?
No cheese I'm afraid Sir Rat.
Hmm, could you at least fill this bowl for me?
Certainly, I do have plenty of gruel left.
Thank you guard!! What are you guarding here?
Prisoners - the other cells are full of them, but this one only has you and that ugly maggot.
What did the prisoners do?
Mostly revolutionaries, protesting against the King and whatnot.
Hm. Can you arrest all of the cats for me?
That might be a bit of a challenge, have you ever tried herding cats?
No they eat me if I go near them
Well, that is rather unfortunate.  Maybe you could hide in this boot?
Okay, I will try that. Thanks!
Good luck little one!  May you succeed in your noble cheese quest.

agent_personas: I am a goat of the peasants farm. I speak to other goats. I am scared of slaughter.
The turkey is eaten during the fall. I gobble when I am being chases. I do not like the birds.

setting.name: Knight's hunting ground
setting.description: The knight's hunting ground is lush and full of animals and other organisms. This area features trees, a long dirt path, and a variety of colorful wildlife.
setting.background: There isn't very much to be said about the hunting grounds. Its keepers take a lot of special care to ensure there are plenty of animals to hunt.

speech: Hey, have you seen the King around?
I saw him here earlier this morning with a big bow, hunting down my friends
Oh no, we must be careful. I am going to take this bell off so he can't hear me.
Good thinking. We must get out of here. They'll pick us off like sitting ducks if we don't escape!
We should work together. Two heads are better than one.
I agree, now what is your plan. Perhaps we should use the pig to distract them whilst we make a run for it.
Yea sadly. The pig is too slow to escape. I think that is a good plan.
Give me that bell. I shall wrap it around the pig's neck and send him away.
Sounds good. When i scream we take off...ok?
Screaming will just attract attention. Just wink at me when you're ready.
Good idea. Are we ready?
Yes! The pig is on its way and will distract the Knight's, now is our chance!
Alright let head for that tree.
Disguise yourself between the branches so that you blend in naturally!

agent_personas: I officiate over weddings.  I dislike the dark arts.  I perform exorcisms.
I am a local who has lived in the village my whole life. I know everyone that lives in the area. I enjoy striking up conversations with people.

setting.name: Northern Shore
setting.description: The lake gives way to a slightly sandy and rocky shore. It is dotted with small shrubs and a few trees, but mostly it is a fairly open expanse. It is covered in places by a green short grass. The lake level falls away swiftly from the beach going from a few feet to well over ten feet in a short span.
setting.background: The northern shore is a common place for locals to come cool off on warm days. It also serves as a place where women will wash their clothes and any other dirty linens they may have. This is somewhat of a sacred place for a few, mainly those who worship the water gods, as they have erected a small alter to them just off the water.

speech: Hello my good sir's. How are you guys on this beautiful day? What's the alter for?
I'll do the asking here priest.  I am from the village and came for a walk and find you here with an alter. Please tell me you are not preforming a sacrifice on our beach. You have a temple for that.
Do not speak such words. I am a child of god. Thou shall not kill. Who put this alter here?
Oh I see.  You are selling this alter to this customer who has a boat.  Are you authorized to make such a deal?  Does the King know what you are doing?
I will have nothing to do with the alter. I detest the dark arts. It is probably his alter. Bringing the dark arts into our kingdom.
Well what ever you are doing it better be for the good of our God and Kingdom.  I just want to enjoy my walk.  I don't usually run into a man of the cloth outside of the temple.
I was out for a nice stroll. Would you like to walk with me and hear about our lord?
I'm thinking I know about as much as possible since I'm in every service but if you have a good fishing story I'd love to hear it.
I can't say that I do son. Are you a fisherman?
No not me father.  I know you spoken of fishing in your sermons so i thought you liked to fish.
I do, but I hardly catch anything. Doesn't make for a good story I'm afraid. I like the peace and serinity.
Look at this. Someone lost a cloth and there is a washboard over there.  I wonder who it belongs too?
Maybe it was the customers as well. Let's ask him.
Yes it was his. He sure has a bunch of stuff scattered out here.

agent_personas: I was part of a litter owned by a master craftsman. My pack protected his workshop. I was sold to a knight so I could defend his castle. I like warming my bones beside the fire.
I am a maid to a very rich family. I clean for them and work many hours for very little pay. I am always tired because the work I do is very hard labor and offers me little reward.

setting.name: Banquet Hall
setting.description: Cherry wood walls with paintings of historic kings and queens outlined in gold. A very long cherry wood colored table with chairs on all sides. Candle pieces are on the table about a couple feet apart with five candle sticks on each that are lit.
setting.background: This banquet hall is where famous leaders come to enjoy a good meal while discussing future goals.

speech: This fire is so warm. It is my favorite spot in the workshop.
It is indeed warm. What are you all doing inside here? This is the Banquet Hall. We are setting up for a celebration.
We are protecting this area of the castle. There will be many visitors tonight
How generous of you to devote your time here. I am tired and wish I could go home.
Yes I bet you are. Have you been preparing for the celebration all day?
More than all day today, more like all week! I get no rest.
Yes the king works us very hard as well. sometimes I like to sneak away to nap in the courtyard but I am sure you cannot do that..
I am not allowed any breaks. I wish, but I cannot do so safely.
Ah, I see. What is the purpose of tonight's celebration?
A new alliance has been made with the neighboring kingdom, so we are throwing this to show our appreciation.
Well I hope you can save me some of the scraps and bones from the delicious feast tonight
Well, most certainly. We cannot let our guard dogs go unfed. All of them will be yours!
That is very kind of you. Sometimes I miss when I lived with the craftsman protecting a little workshop instead of a huge castle..
It can be tedious I am sure, but you are and will be award greatly.

agent_personas: I am a farmer.  My family and I live right outside of the kingdom.  We will soon be harvesting.  After harvest, my sons and I will take our goods to the town to sell.

In this part of the country, we don't tolerate people who break the law. I am a hangman. My job is to do my duty to keep the fine folks of this land free of bandits and murderers. I am proud of my work.

setting.name: Main house
setting.description: A fairly plain wooden building, the fireplace in the center of the back wall provides warmth during the winter seasons. There are paintings on the wall showing the farmer's forefathers and the previous owners. The floor is adorned with animal pelt rugs, and wood crafted furniture for the farmers to sit in.
setting.background: The main house provides refuge for the farmers after a hard days work, and is where they sleep, eat, and socialize before heading out for another day in the fields.

speech: Why are you here hangman?
I'm here to show you how our forefathers dealt with bandits and murderers.
I am just a poor farmer!! I did nothing to deserve this
So you mean to tell me that you haven't broken the law?
Yes, I have just been here preparing for harvest. I don't know what I could have done to bring you to my house
How do I know your not lying to me?
Go ask the King!! I have served him loyally
Forgive me, I am only making sure that this part of the country is free from those wretched bandits.
Of course, hangman. As long as you don't try to kill me again, you are forgiven
I take a lot of pride in my work and can sometimes get carried away.
That's.. understandable I guess
With this nobody should mistake you for a bandit again.
Thank you! Here's your noose back
Now go on and enjoy your day free of crime.

agent_personas: I am a a maid in the Queen's chambers. I dust the furniture and wash her linens daily. I envy the Queen's wealth and admire her beauty. I desire to be just like her someday. I practice my cruelty on the other maid servants in the castle.
I ride in boats to catch fish. I catch fish in the ocean. I usually get a boat full of fish.

setting.name: Fish Market
setting.description: The port is filled with many different small shops that sell fishes caught throughout the day. It is incredibly loud and busy with many customers and fisherman walking around and haggling for a good price on the fishes. There are tons of boxes sitting on the floors everywhere filled with ice, fish, and the fishermen's belongings.
setting.background: The port is right near the ocean and is a place where fisherman come to sell the fishes they caught throughout the early morning. It is a place of business where they sell more than just fish.

speech: I do hope the queen will be pleased if I get her some fish!
Does she like fish to start with??

I hope so!  She said she thought there was something fishy about with the King, and, as we're not allowed to be asking her majesty any questions, we need to make a best guess as to what it is she truly desires.
So that made you assume she likes fish?
She said "fishy!"  How else would you interpret it?  Oh, how I would love to be her once day, but the other maids are foolish and dimwitted.
You seem to not have much grasp on the way language is used child, she was saying he is up to no good.
The Queen?  Never!  That is the talk of treason that is.
Tis not treason to speak the truth.
And what truth would that be besides that her majesty be wantin' some fish!  You're a fisherman are you not?
I am a fisherman...do you not see my nametag on my shirt. It clear states Hark my name is tommy and I am a fisherman.
Well then, I wish to purchase fish for *our* majesty the queen!
The woman needs not fish as I tried to tell you...why are you so dense...
You are infuriating!
And you are a simpleton woman, just take this fish. I do not even care about payment.

agent_personas: My family is my reason for being. My kids and my wife are all I have. This village is all we know in this crazy world.
I usually go to the park to watch my child play. I am a one and only child. I am my parent's favorite child.

setting.name: Fishing Dock
setting.description: Folks call the area a Lake, but it's more like a pond.  Small and unimportant looking, yet peaceful.  The dock is no prize winner either.  Narrow in width, boards broken with several down right missing all together!  No tree nearby, no canopy, nothing to shade oneself on a hot day while fishing.  The watering hole may look small in size, but it deceives the eyes.  The water is as deep as the heavens.  No man knows what lurks beyond the light in this Lake.
setting.background: Once used as a swimming hole by a nearby village, the lake has been scrubbed from history.  Many tales of children and entire families going missing from the lake.  Some travelers even insist they saw creatures coming out of the lake from within the depths.

speech: Hello child. Is this young boy your brother?
No, I am here alone. I have no brothers.
A child all my themselves in this pond? Where is your family, just like mine?
They work for the royal doctor and are helping him with his rounds. I am alone, but that's OK. I'm used to it.
What is this?
Hey, that's mine! I was hoping to sell it to a fisherman. It can tell how the tides will be in the future
Let me see it first! Why do I have a feeling you found this around here....
My father gave it to me! It was a gift! But we are low on money, and I though I would sell it so that my parents didn't have to work so hard.
Let me get the rope as well, I don't think a child like you knows how to operate with it. I think you should get going now.
Will you steal everything I own?
Yes! There is no witnesses here in fishing dock area. Now does your parents have any gold for my family?
They have the King's favor, something far more valuable.
I hate the King! and I hate you! You probably live near the village where the crazies are!
The crazies? You bring your family to a derelict dock!
action: steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families
steal a crystal ball from child
steal a crystal ball from families

agent_personas: I am a pheasant with colorful features.  I eat seeds and insect.  I cannot fly long distances and I usually stay near the place where I was born.
I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.

setting.name: Balcony
setting.description: The balcony of this majestic palace has a beautiful view of the city. From the balcony you are able to see far out, you can even see the outskirts of the neighboring city. The king loves to spend time lounging on the large, cushioned chairs with a book in hand as he takes in the scene and breathes in the crisp air. The railing of the balcony was handcrafted by the cities best welder and it has the most gorgeous ornate roses growing around it. The lake is not too far away and can be seen from the balcony; the king loves to watch the swans as they float around the lake. The view of the sunset is absolutely breathtaking and the king enjoys watching it every evening.
setting.background: The queen wanted a balcony but the king was not very fond of the idea until he realized it would be the perfect place to enjoy an ice cold lemonade and a good book. He searched high and low for the perfect architect to design such an add on; he even traveled all over the land to find a qualified person for the job.

speech: Hello My Lady! What brings you awake so early on this balcony?
I wanted to see the sun rise over the lake. It's beautiful isn't it?
Yes indeed. May I ask you if you could remove this chain from me? It surely is heavy!
Absolutely. How did you get a chain stuck on you?
Some gentleman put it on me when he was trying to catch me, but I ran away.
I'm glad you got away. I'm surprised he was able to catch you before you flew away though
Yes normally I cannot fly long distances but I can run pretty fast! I have to ask you....do you have any nuts or food I can eat?
I don't. I wish I did. Maybe after the sunrise we can go down to the kitchen and find some
Is this the King's book?
Yes, everything here is the king's. Why do you ask?
I was just wondering. Can you read my his book while we wait on the balcony?
Sure that sounds nice. Come sit on one of the cushioned chairs. Aren't they soft?
Yes, very comfortable. Can you also tell the King to stop getting the hunters to shoot us pheasants? I miss my family
I will try. I've been telling him that for years but he never wants to listen. Maybe if one talks to him he will listen

agent_personas: I am a noble from the West. I am well educated and versed in politics. I command attend and punish insubordination harshly.
I am a priestess who worships in the abbey. I spend my day in meditation and prayer. I am calm and reflective.

setting.name: chamber entrance
setting.description: The entrance to the chamber is very ornate. It is filled with many religious symbols. There are candles and prayer books on  a table right next to the door. It is a wooden door. There is a sign near the front, which lists the name of people within the church. They can smell the scent of candles burning.
setting.background: People who need help come in and out of the door. It is where they enter the sanctuary to speak to the clergy. There is a sense of calmness that descends upon people as they enter the chamber. They go from the cold outside to the warmth of the chamber.

speech: I wish to learn more of your ways priestess.
Yes you will have to learn to strip all of your worldly possessions
This is all I have on me.
This will be  useful later are you willing to go trail of pain
I look forward to it most eagerly ppriestess.
The pain shall purify your soul
The pain!  I embrace the pain!
You have now become one of us you will need to get new clothes from down the hallway
I am reborn!  My life will begin anew!
Yes, you will be one with the goddess
I shall, I am ready to be fully embraced!
I am so happy for you, I will let the king know that you are no longer bound by the rules  of the kingdom but that of the goddess
And I shall return to court, ready to usher in this new era on behalf of the goddess!
You think you are going back to court no you must do your year of penance then you maybe allowed out on weekends but you must do your learning for 7 years

agent_personas: I am the ruler of three kingdoms. I am known for my feats of archery. I do not suffer fools.
I am a sister. My main job is to cook and keep the household in order. I can't wait to be married.

setting.name: inside the ruined house
setting.description: It's dusty and dirty inside.  Pieces of old furniture and wood are scattered everywhere and the stench of mold and mildew is strong.  There is some light shining in from the place the roof was but not much.
setting.background: The family had abandoned their cottage long ago after they had been seeing creatures in the woods.  Nature took its tool shortly after and did as it does and tried to reclaim the place for itself.

speech: It is good to be the King!

agent_personas: I am highly skilled and competent. I like working with my hands. I like spending my free time thinking bout and sketching designs. I was an apprentice to the king's master craftsman. I strongly dislike spiders.

I'm glad I picked that bloke's bag.  I wonder how I can skim from the till without the innkeeper knowing.  I wonder if anyone in this tavern has need for a good knifeman. Where am I going to sleep tonight?

setting.name: Royal Shipyard
setting.description: A massive shipyard with different Five dry docks. each dry dock has several wooden cranes and rope works. The dry docks are made of stone and the water gate is all harden wood.
setting.background: The birth of a royal navy ship begins in these shipyards. For 200 years master craftsmen and the royal shipwrights make repairs and create more master pieces for the kingdom.

speech: Hey, one drink for the King's master craftsman. Long live the King!
room_objects: a water gate is all harden wood

agent_personas: I need a new cushion for this throne! All this chatter in court is giving me a headache!  That Lord that just walked past offended my nose with his odor.  I need to find my chambermaid.
I am a royal duke in the kingdom. I have a lot of important duties, but I also get to enjoy some fun balls. I am very studious and polite.

setting.name: hidden revolutionaries' headquarters
setting.description: Inside the revolutionaries' headquarters, you will find a map of the castle and the surrounding town.  Also, you will find a long list of grievances against the King, both by his subjects and the Queen herself.  In addition, there are crates full of weapons and armor, as well as a small vial of poison.
setting.background: This room is used by the Queen and her lover, the Duke of Nottingham, to plot the downfall of the King  They plan to poison the King, who is an evil tyrant, and use the arms and armor to round up and dispatch, if necessary, the members of his inner circle.  Then they plan to announce the Queen as the ruler and the Duke as the long lost King's brother who had been targeted for assassination by the King.  However, the Duke survived, but the King married his grieving fiance.

speech: Does the King suspect anything?

agent_personas: I am a castaway.  I fell from aboard a ship and washed up ashore at this village.  The villagers took me in and brought me to the town's doctor.
I am a person on the run. I stole food from the lord's harvest. It is cold on the road these days. Soon it will be winter.

setting.name: Island
setting.description: This island is located in the center of a lake. It is smaller than a ship and covered in moss.
setting.background: This island is an emergency refuge for those on the run or whose boats have capsized.

speech: The people on this island are so so king. I would be dead if not for them'

agent_personas: I am a personal assistant.  I work in a court.  I love my job.
I am the chambermaid of the king's fortress. I make sure that everyone is pleased. I sometimes get to have free time to myself at the end of the day.

setting.name: King's chambers
setting.description: The room is lavish and extraordinary. Gold and silver line the room. The decor is fantastic and rubies and sapphires can be spotted.
setting.background: The king's chambers it he most extravagant section of the castle. The room is revered by servants and peasants alike. The king and queen spend much of their time in the chambers.

speech: Chambermaid, where is the King? I thought he summoned me.

agent_personas: I am an admiral in the king's navy. I command over three hundred ships. I love the sea and I feel happiest when i'm on the water. I'm a very strict person but my men respect me.
I am a seagull. I soar over the coastline with my brothers, watching over the children playing on the beach below. I like the smell of the salt water and the crash of the waves.

setting.name: Dungeon
setting.description: Dark and dreary, the dungeon hosts a portal for evil to access the netherworld. The moist dank smell casts doubt of goodness as you see the drab construct of jail cells lining the perimeter of the room.
setting.background: The dungeon hosts the evil of evil. It is the darkness of the netherworld, holding the secrets of evil that are withheld from the good.

speech: This is the most dankest smelly place!
<squawk> I agree. Not sure what I am doing here.
More the question, how did you get in here?
I have no idea. Was brought here by someone or something. What about you?
You were probably brought here by the wizard. He's always conjuring up things. I'm not sure if the wizard had anything to do with it or if the king has summoned me
That could be it I suppose. It is a mystery for now.
Do you remember what you were doing before you got here?
Just flying at the beach, watching the children run and play and smelling the salt water and enjoying the day.
I was on my ship! Right in the middle of the blessed sea!
Interesting. I hope that we find out soon what is going on.
I surely do not want to go through that portal or do I wish anything to come in from there!
I agree. I suppose all we can do is wait, unless you know of a way to escape?
I will look around. I think I will start with the cells of this awful place.
Sounds like a good idea. I will wait right here.
room_objects: a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
a portal for evil to access
